jobs.description:
Job Title: Telehealth Physician, MD/DO (Remote 1099)
Location: 100% Remote - United States
Employment Type: 1099

Focus on patients. We’ll handle the rest.

About CareTalk Health

CareTalk Health is a fully remote, nationwide virtual medical practice. We partner with Medicare Advantage plans to deliver Annual Wellness Visits and close care gaps, reaching members wherever they are. Virtual care isn’t a compromise. It’s care delivered the way patients actually want it.

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Board-Certified Physicians (MD/DO) to deliver comprehensive virtual care. If you’re licensed in multiple states, and especially if you participate in the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC), we’d love to hear from you.

At CareTalk, you bring the clinical expertise. We surround you with scheduling, nursing support, technology, and training, so you can focus on the patient in front of you.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct Annual Wellness Visits and E/M follow-up visits by phone or video
  • Manage chronic conditions, review medications, and prescribe where clinically appropriate
  • Write orders for indicated screenings and review returned results for the care you initiate
  • Close care gaps and build strong rapport with Medicare patients
  • Document every encounter accurately in SOAP format

Schedule

  • Minimum 16 hours per week. Our clinic hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm ET, and Saturday, 10am to 4pm ET

Required

  • Board certified MD or DO
  • Active, unrestricted medical licenses in multiple states
  • Medicare participating physician (or willing to become one)
  • Experience in preventive and/or primary care
  • Proven experience providing patient care in a virtual or telehealth clinic environment
  • Comfort conducting both phone and video visits, and EHR fluency
  • Strong documentation and patient communication skills
  • Strong digital fluency and ability to navigate multiple systems

Strongly preferred

  • Participation in the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC)

Work Location Requirement

This is a remote U.S.-based position. Employees must perform all work physically within the United States. International work is not permitted during scheduled work hours.

Work Environment

This is a remote position and may be “on camera” at any time. You will work from a home office, requiring reliable internet connectivity and a secure, private workspace.

Technical Requirements:

  • Computer:

    • Windows or Apple (macOS) Computer ONLY (NO Chromebooks, Linux Machines, or Smartphones)
    • Must have at least Windows 10 or macOS 14 Sonoma.

  • Hardware:

    • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Equivalent (Windows); Apple Silicon (Macs)
    • RAM: 16 GB
  • Headphones: Wired headphones required for optimal audio quality. (NO built-in mics)
  • Internet Speed: Meet minimum internet speed requirements (100 MBPS download speed and 50 MBPS upload speed). Must have an ethernet cable connecting computer directly into router.
  • Browser and System: Use Google Chrome with Amazon Workspaces (regardless of computer type). 
  • Webcam: A webcam is required for video calls. Most laptops have a built-in webcam, which is acceptable. If your computer does not have a webcam, you will need to use an external webcam.
  • Recommended Equipment: A second monitor is highly suggested for laptop users; dual monitors for PC users. 

Why CareTalk Health

  • Paid, facilitated live training (9 to 12 hours at $60/hour) before you see patients
  • Collaborative virtual team of support staff and nurses working at the top of their licenses
  • Flexible, fully remote practice built around efficient, technology-enabled care
  • Make a real impact closing care gaps for Medicare patients
  • Join a fast-growing virtual healthcare organization

CareTalk Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Salesforce Data 360 Enablement Architect

We’ve been forging digital transformation through the lens of Salesforce for 20+ years for 3,000+ customers across the globe. We are a Summit status, Marketing Cloud Full Stack Partner. We are a cross-cloud shop with an emphasis on Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Next, Data 360, Agentforce, Personalization, Intelligence, Loyalty Cloud, Service Cloud, and Sales Cloud.

We accomplish incredible digital transformation for our customers with incredible people. We’ve always held to the fact that talent trumps location, but culture trumps talent. We care about our people and we care about our customers.

About the Role:

We are seeking a knowledgeable and experienced Salesforce Data 360 individual to join ListEngage Academy, our internal enablement team. This individual will play a critical role in educating and empowering learners to confidently understand and use Salesforce Data 360. The learners will be a mix of new employees with little to no Salesforce experience and veteran Salesforce employees transitioning into Salesforce Data 360.

The ideal candidate is not only an expert in Salesforce Data 360, but also a passionate and engaging educator who can break down complex concepts into approachable, real-world learning experiences. While prior teaching, training, or mentoring experience is preferred, it is not required. It is more important that the individual have firsthand experience implementing Salesforce Data 360, a high technical aptitude, and a natural inclination to help others succeed. Additionally, the individual must be comfortable presenting and facilitating conversation a majority of the time.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Deliver live instruction virtually on Salesforce Data 360

  • Design and facilitate curriculum, training assets, hands-on exercises, and projects

  • Translate complex technical concepts into simple, digestible content for learners

  • Assess learner progress and adapt instruction based on varying skill levels

  • Provide individualized support, coaching, and feedback to learners

  • Foster an inclusive, supportive, and engaging learning environment

  • Stay current with Salesforce releases to continuously improve course content

  • Collaborate with internal teams to align training with company needs

Education & Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in any field of study required

  • Data 360 Consultant Salesforce certification required

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Data 360

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Data modeling and data ingestion

    • Identity resolution

    • Segmentation and activation

    • Data governance and privacy basics

  • Proficient with SQL (can write complex queries without the use of AI)

  • Experience working with other Salesforce products (such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior teaching, training, or coaching experience (formal or informal)

  • Experience working with adult learners, career switchers, or early-career professionals

  • Background in instructional design or curriculum development

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

  • Passion for teaching and helping others succeed

  • Ability to simplify complex topics without losing accuracy

  • Adaptability in teaching styles to meet diverse learning needs

  • Strong organizational and time management skills

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives

  • Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth

  • A collaborative and inclusive work environment

Why You Should Join Us:

  • 100% CEO approval on Glassdoor

  • A team of approximately 150 Engagers

  • Core values that drive us:

    • Be a Team Player

    • Be Accountable

    • Be Growth Oriented

    • Be Great at What You Do

  • Currently 100% remote work arrangements

If you’re interested, so are we! Send your resume our way, and we’ll contact you for a phone interview if you meet qualifications

At ListEngage, we aim to change the world by challenging the traditional consulting model by building a flexible, delivery focused organization that can deliver on the promise that we have made to each other. We are an equal opportunity employer and love diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

jobs.description:
About us

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and , we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

Head of Product Marketing & Campaigns

Do you want to connect product innovation with market execution and lead the team behind it?

Are you ready to own a GTM process, a campaign calendar across markets, and a team of four at a fast-moving B2B SaaS company?

...then you are our perfect match!

This role is remote from the US or Canada (Eastern or Central Time) and reports directly to our Marketing Director.

What You'll Do

Drive Product Marketing Maturity & GTM Execution

  • Product Marketing Leadership: Transform Product Marketing into a strategic engine by defining clear value props, go-to-market playbooks, and crisp customer positioning.

  • Go-To-Market Alignment: Audit and fix current GTM gaps to ensure reliable, high-impact product launches that unify Product, Revenue, and Support teams around a shared timeline.

Own the Campaign Calendar for our markets

  • Plan and run the campaigns that deliver our MQL targets in the growth market US as well as in the established markets Germany / Austria / Switzerland and UK.

  • Prioritize and sequence campaigns and its content across channels together with your team and agency partners.

Deliver Events That Work

  • Run online events with strong attendance and offline events that our customers rate highly.

  • Make sure every event ties back to the campaign calendar and our growth targets.

Build an Active Online & Offline Community

  • Turn customers, prospects, and advocates into passionate brand fans across both digital spaces and in-person touchpoints.

  • Design programs, rituals, and peer-to-peer engagement that continuously educate, activate, and empower our community.

Lead a Team of Four

  • Lead product marketing, content marketing, events, community and social media.

  • Set clear goals, build operational workflows and develop your people.

  • Manage the agency that delivers our website and graphic work, from briefing to quality review.

Work Across Teams and Markets

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Sales and Customer Support.

  • Bring a US perspective into a global marketing team that also serves DACH and the UK.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • B2B SaaS Marketing: You have 7 to 10 years of experience, including product marketing and GTM launches.

  • SMB Environments: You know how to reach and convert small and mid-sized business customers.

  • People Leadership: You have led a marketing team and know how to build workflows around it.

Skills

  • Strategic GTM Thinking: You connect product strategy to market execution.

  • Hands-on Campaign Execution: You can plan a campaign and also ship it.

  • Stakeholder Management: You align Product, Sales and Support without friction.

  • Tools: HubSpot is a must; the Atlassian suite is a plus.

  • Language: Excellent written and spoken English.

Mindset

  • Extreme Ownership: You take responsibility for results, not only for tasks.

  • Pragmatism: You choose the solution that works over the one that looks perfect.

  • Finisher Mindset: You bring projects across the line.

  • Builder Mentality: You enjoy creating structure where none exists yet.

Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto

  • Work Where You’re Best: In the US,we are a remote-first organization that prioritizes impact over office hours. While our roots are international, we empower our US team to design a workspace that fuels their best work—whether that’s a home office, a local café, or wherever you find your focus. You bring the talent; we provide the flexibility. Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. You have the option to work abroad for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.

  • Recharge & Unwind: We prioritize your well-being over a fixed tally of hours, which is why we offer a flexible, unlimited PTO policy and flexible sick days. Whether you need a long-awaited vacation, or time to recover from the unexpected, you have the autonomy to take the time you need to stay at your best.

  • Comprehensive Care: We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you and your family are fully covered. We complement our core healthcare with a broad range of additional benefits, offering a mix of company-sponsored coverage and voluntary options designed to protect your income and your household.

  • Multicultural & Inclusive Team: We thrive on diverse perspectives. Our international team fosters a culture of mutual respect and professional exchange, ensuring that fresh ideas and tolerance are at the heart of everything we build together.

  • Fuel Your Growth: We’re big on learning. You’ll get a dedicated education budget to explore new ideas and grow professionally.

  • Stay Active, Wherever You Are: Your wellbeing matters to us. Through FitOn, you’ll get access to a wide range of online fitness and wellness classes — from yoga and strength training to cardio and mindfulness — so you can stay active and recharge wherever you work.

What Matters to Us

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may refrain from applying for positions if they feel they don't meet all qualifications. We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested: we're excited to discover how your distinctive experience can enhance our team!

We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However, you identify. We believe in equal opportunities.

Compensation Range: $130K - $150K

jobs.excerpt: Strategia, Zgodność i Zarządzanie (Governance & Compliance) Współpraca z Dyrekcją przy budowaniu kultury i strategii bezpieczeństwa oraz adaptacji standardów korporacyjnych, w tym frameworku NIST.
jobs.description:
Strategia, Zgodność i Zarządzanie (Governance & Compliance)

Współpraca z Dyrekcją przy budowaniu kultury i strategii bezpieczeństwa oraz adaptacji standardów korporacyjnych, w tym frameworku NIST.

Zapewnienie zgodności organizacji z kluczowymi regulacjami rynkowymi i europejskimi (m.in. NIS2, CRA, RODO).

Opracowywanie polityk bezpieczeństwa, definiowanie i raportowanie wskaźników KPI do Zarządu oraz facylitacja komitetów sterujących ds. bezpieczeństwa.

Zarządzanie Ryzykiem i Architektura (Security by Design)

Opracowywanie i bieżąca aktualizacja mapy ryzyk cybernetycznych oraz realizacja adekwatnych mechanizmów kontrolnych (Kontrola N2).

Eksperckie wsparcie działu projektowego gwarantujące integrację wymagań bezpieczeństwa od wczesnych faz koncepcyjnych (Security by Design), w tym weryfikacja architektury i nadzór nad zlecanymi testami penetracyjnymi.

Operacje i Zabezpieczenia Techniczne (SecOps & Protection)

Projektowanie, wdrażanie oraz utrzymywanie platform zabezpieczających infrastrukturę, w szczególności rozwiązań klasy EDR/XDR, mechanizmów uwierzytelniania wieloskładnikowego (MFA) oraz firewalli.

Ciągła weryfikacja efektywności zabezpieczeń w ramach całej floty urządzeń (serwery, stacje robocze, urządzenia mobilne, aplikacje).

Kompleksowa realizacja procesu Vulnerability Management – od detekcji podatności, przez rekomendacje mitygacyjne, po nadzór nad wdrożeniem poprawek we współpracy z działem IT.

Monitorowanie i Reagowanie na Incydenty (Detection & Incident Response)

Analiza alertów z systemów bezpieczeństwa oraz koordynacja działań zewnętrznego centrum operacyjnego (SOC) w celu zapewnienia ciągłości monitoringu w trybie HNO (obsługa i reagowanie poza standardowymi godzinami pracy).

Kompleksowe zarządzanie incydentami bezpieczeństwa: identyfikacja, mitygacja zagrożeń oraz opracowywanie działań naprawczych w ramach procedury RETEX (analiza poakcyjna typu lessons learned).

Optymalizacja procedur reagowania na incydenty oraz projektowanie i koordynacja cyklicznych ćwiczeń kryzysowych.

Budowanie Świadomości (Awareness)

Kształtowanie świadomości zagrożeń poprzez realizację rocznych planów szkoleniowych dla całej organizacji, w tym koordynację symulacji phishingowych oraz modułów e-learningowych.

Transfer wiedzy i prowadzenie specjalistycznych warsztatów podnoszących kompetencje z zakresu bezpieczeństwa dla zespołów IT

Realizacja powyższych obszarów ma na celu zbudowanie proaktywnego modelu ochrony organizacji, minimalizację ryzyka cybernetycznego oraz zagwarantowanie najwyższych standardów bezpieczeństwa, adekwatnych do surowych wymogów regulacyjnych i operacyjnych. Rola stanowi centralny punkt kompetencyjny, łączący architekturę bezpieczeństwa z bieżącym reagowaniem na ewoluujące zagrożenia.

jobs.description:
About the Role
We're hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to run Top Nutrition Coaching’s paid acquisition day-to-day. Reporting to the VP of Marketing. You'll own the channels, the spend, the creative, and the landing pages that TNC's growth depends on. You will be in the ad accounts every day, making the calls on budget pacing, bids, audiences, creative rotation, and what gets tested next. You are not briefing an agency and reviewing their slides.
You’ll balance efficiency with scale, meeting customer acquisition cost targets while driving new customer growth. We’re looking for someone who can identify opportunities to improve conversion rates, test with rigor, and unlock growth through smarter optimization rather than defaulting to increased spend.
About What We Do
Receptive is a modern digital health platform dedicated to emotional wellness, mental clarity, and holistic health. Since our founding, we have helped over one million individuals access the right care at the right time by connecting them with trusted professionals who support their mental and physical well-being.
Licensed in all 50 states and serving more than 100,000 members each year, Receptive brings together leading brands across behavioral and lifestyle health. Our portfolio includes Pettable, ADHD Advisor, and Top Nutrition Coaching, which provides evidence-based nutrition care through virtual coaching and insurance-supported programs.
Grounded in clinical excellence and a people-first mission, we empower licensed providers with the autonomy, technology, and support they need to deliver accessible, personalized care.
Top Nutrition Coaching (TNC), a Receptive company, delivers insurance-covered Medical Nutrition Therapy through a national network of Registered Dietitians, in addition to a newly launched GLP-1 medication management service—real clinical care, billed through insurance, not a content app or a meal-plan subscription. This is a small team with real ownership. You will not be one of eight people on a paid media pod.

What You’ll Own & Do

  • Paid acquisition: You own strategy, execution, and daily optimization across Google, Meta, TikTok, and Bing.
  • Budget pacing and CAC: Own the daily trade-offs between scale and efficiency against a blended CAC target and a monthly new-client goal.
  • Landing page CRO and funnel testing: Own full-funnel conversion from ad to pageview to quiz completion and booking. Build and run a testing roadmap for landing pages, using AI-assisted page building to keep velocity high and keeping compliance guidelines in mind at every step.
  • Creative testing velocity: Drive the message × audience × format × platform testing loop, working with design on static ads and documenting insights we can continually iterate on.
  • Measurement and reporting:
    • Own the TNC reporting rhythm and be accountable for paid new clients, CAC, and funnel conversion.
    • Partner with our data team on event tracking and attribution so channel decisions rest on something more durable than platform-reported numbers.
    • Measure and weigh view-through conversions, incrementality, and cross-channel overlap in a compliance-heavy environment that doesn’t follow a traditional multi-touch model.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years in performance/growth marketing, with real depth in Google Ads and hands-on Meta and TikTok Ads experience. You've personally managed the spend—not overseen it, and not just executed someone else's plan.
  • You have DTC experience, ideally in health and wellness, telehealth, or another regulated and compliance-oriented category. Insurance-adjacent or subscription businesses are a plus.
  • You understand pacing, seasonality, and risk management on a real budget.
  • You make decisions and problem-solve with data. When a campaign underperforms, your instinct is to check the funnel and conversion signals before touching creative or bids. You know noise from signal, and when to let a test run versus cut it.
  • You've run A/B tests end to end—not just ad creative, but landing pages, funnel steps, and pricing. You've learned from tests that failed and can talk about what you did with that information.
  • You're fluent in attribution, including platform-reported, modeled, and self-reported, and you know which number to trust for which decision.
  • You’re comfortable giving creative direction. You can brief concepts, direct UGC and creator partnerships, and tell which ideas are worth producing before the spend proves it.
  • You understand unit economics, such as CAC, LTV, payback, contribution margin, and can explain to a finance lead why a spend increase is justified.
  • You communicate clearly to non-marketers and leaders who care about business outcomes, not CPM trends.
  • You’re comfortable building with AI. You've leveraged Claude Code for landing pages, generated your own ad creative, and built workflows that ship agents that do real work — reporting, test setup, the repetitive parts of the job.

Where You’ll Work & What You’ll Receive

Receptive is a remote-first company. Priority will be given to candidates in the East Coast or Central time zones.
The target base salary range for this role is $130,000 to $150,000 per year, depending on experience, expertise, internal pay equity, and other business considerations.
Full-time, US-based employees are eligible for comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage with generous employer contributions (Receptive covers 100% of the premium for an employee’s coverage), a 401k with 4% employer match, monthly wellness stipend, annual L&D budget, flexible time off, company holidays, and paid parental leave.

jobs.description:
Built's Mission: Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.

Built is the AI-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at getbuilt.com.

Built is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager, Data to lead our growing data organization. In this role, you will guide a high-impact group of engineers building the industry's first holistic real estate data engine that powers analytics, decisioning, workflow automation, and new product capabilities across our platform. You will lead the data engineering team responsible for building and operating foundational data capabilities across Built, including ingestion, modeling, governance, reliability, and self-serve analytics. Your team will enable product teams and business stakeholders to confidently use data to drive outcomes, while maintaining high standards for security, quality, and performance. This is a hands-on, player-coach leader who can set technical direction, grow talent, and deliver durable systems at scale, while partnering closely with Product, Analytics, and Engineering peers.

This is an opportunity to lead a team building core infrastructure that shapes the company's future. You will influence how Built captures, normalizes, and activates the most critical data in our industry, with autonomy, executive visibility, and room to innovate. If you enjoy building platforms, raising engineering maturity, and scaling both teams and systems, this role sits at that intersection.

Challenge

Real estate finance data is complex. It is high-volume, multi-source, time-sensitive, and often messy. The challenge is to build a data engine that is:

  • Trusted: accurate, governed, explainable
  • Fast: optimized performance and cost, low latency where it matters
  • Composable: clean models that scale with new products
  • Self-serve: enables Product, Analytics, and GTM teams
  • Reliable: observable, resilient, and operationally excellent

Responsibilities


Lead and grow the team

  • Hire and retain top talent and build a high-performance, inclusive culture
  • Establish strong delivery and operational rituals, including planning, retrospectives, and incident reviews

  • Drive a roadmap that balances foundational platform investments with product delivery needs

  • Bring strong judgment to tooling and build-versus-buy decisions across Snowflake, DBT, and Sigma

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in an engineering management role leading teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Direct experience leading a data engineering or data platform team specifically, not just general engineering management
  • Proven ability to scale teams and systems through hiring, process, architecture, and delivery
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Passion for fostering a culture of innovation, learning, and continuous improvement

jobs.excerpt: AboutThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role

Build and improve ML systems that power our AI-native applications.

Work on classification, retrieval, ranking, personalization and evaluation, taking ownership from model development to production deployment.

This role is for engineers who enjoy solving practical ML problems, improving model quality and shipping reliable systems used by real users.

Focus

  • Build and improve ML models for classification, ranking, retrieval and personalization.

  • Develop efficient classifiers and optimize model accuracy, precision, latency and cost.

  • Improve search relevance and context retrieval using embeddings, hybrid search and reranking.

  • Build personalization models that learn from user behavior while respecting privacy.

  • Develop evaluation pipelines, labeled datasets and metrics to measure model quality.

  • Fine-tune and adapt existing models when supported by sufficient data.

  • Build and maintain ML training, inference and deployment pipelines.

  • Debug production issues, monitor model performance and ship improvements based on real-world feedback.

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • Embeddings, vector search and ranking models

  • Production ML systems and inference pipelines

Ideal Experience

  • Strong foundations in machine learning and modern neural architectures.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production.

  • Experience in classification, ranking, retrieval, recommendation systems or personalization.

  • Understanding of model evaluation, experimentation and performance metrics.

  • Comfortable writing production-quality code and working with real-world datasets.

  • Able to balance model quality, latency, cost and reliability.

  • Strong ownership, problem-solving skills

Outcomes

  • ML models in production meet expected accuracy, relevance, latency and reliability targets.

  • Classification and ranking improvements deliver measurable gains in model quality.

  • Evaluation pipelines identify regressions and support reliable model releases.

  • Training, inference and data pipelines are robust, reproducible and maintainable.

  • Model improvements are driven by real-world feedback and measurable results.

  • Collaborates effectively with engineering and product teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, world-class teams. We are a high-talent-density, hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move quickly, balancing high-quality work with continuous learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put a truly magical product into the hands of our users.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted virtually and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us.

We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.

Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.

Location & Team Gatherings

Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016. We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.

We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture.

About this role

As a DCS and Automation Engineer on Intersect's Engineering team, you will design and own the unit and plant-level automation architectures that power our clean energy and infrastructure assets. You will serve as the technical authority for instrumentation & control system design, ensuring that individual power generation units, balance-of-plant equipment, and auxiliary systems integrate seamlessly into cohesive, higher-level supervisory control platforms and SCADA environments. Operating at the intersection of detailed automation design and capital project execution, you will uphold technical excellence across multi-asset portfolios.

In this role, you will partner closely with internal development, engineering, construction, and operations teams, as well as external EPCs and OEMs, to translate dynamic operational demands into resilient, automated control logic. Your work will directly enable high-reliability power dispatch, grid compliance, and operational flexibility across Intersect's growing fleet.

Team overview

This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition by delivering high-performance, utility-scale energy infrastructure. The Engineering team partners cross-functionally across development, construction, and operations to design and execute complex energy projects at scale. Joining this team means working at the intersection of technical excellence and real-world impact, contributing to projects that demand precision, collaboration, and innovation.

What you'll do

Architect Unit and Plant-Level Control Systems

  • Define and establish robust unit and plant-level DCS/PLC control architectures, hardware specifications, and network topologies for utility-scale power facilities.

  • Develop scalable standards for control narratives, sequence of operations, cause-and-effect matrices, and state-machine logic across generation assets.

  • Propose high integrity communication protocols and system architecture for remote control room access

  • Formulate machinery monitoring systems for online validation of assets by integrating into the DCS

Drive Supervisory Control and OEM System Integration

  • Lead the seamless integration of unit-level packaged controllers (reciprocating engines, gas turbines, BESS) into plant-wide DCS and higher-level supervisory SCADA networks.

  • Specify and configure deterministic industrial communication protocols (OPC UA, Modbus TCP, DNP3, IEC 61850) to ensure low-latency data exchange and reliable telemetry.

Oversee Technical Execution and Vendor Performance

  • Prepare / review procurement specifications for DCS, SIS, Plant Data Historian, Alarm Management system, and any control systems.

  • Serve as the primary engineering authority reviewing and approving instrumentation & control system deliverables from EPCs, OEMs, and system integrators.

  • Validate dynamic response, automated startup/shutdown sequences, and load-following capabilities during factory acceptance testing (FAT) and field commissioning.

Enable Cross-Functional and Long-Term Asset Alignment

  • Partner with process, mechanical, electrical, commissioning, and operations teams to align automation functional safety, cyber security, and operational workflows.

  • Identify fleet-wide automation enhancements to optimize asset efficiency, dispatch capability, and long-term operating performance.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in control systems engineering, plant automation design, and system integration within power generation or heavy utility-scale /Industrial environments.

  • Demonstrated mastery of unit/plant-level automation, including DCS architectures (e.g., Emerson Ovation, Yokogawa Centum, Siemens PCS7, ABB, Rockwell PlantAx), PLCs, and controllers for OEMs such as CAT, GE, Woodward and Solar.

  • Deep expertise in integrating unit controllers with higher-level supervisory SCADA and EMS platforms using OPC UA, Modbus, DNP3, and IEC 61850 protocols.

  • Proven experience defining and reviewing control engineering artifacts, including P&IDs, control narratives, I/O lists, Protection systems, API/ISO/IEE compliance knowledge, condition monitoring and historian setup, High speed data trap set up, HMI Screens, and cause-and-effect matrices for large capital projects.

  • Strong collaborative communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions across EPCs, OEMs, and internal multidisciplinary teams.

  • Commitment to technical rigor, operational safety, and sustainable execution, aligned with Intersect's core values of Equity, Humility, Authenticity, Long-run Value, and People Come First.

Equity: Beyond your salary, you’ll receive an Equity Grant, giving you a meaningful stake in our parent company.

Health & wellness: 100% premium coverage for you and your dependents on medical, dental, and vision

The Vendor Management Contracts Associate supports the end-to-end administration of vendor contracts and supplier records, ensuring contracts are accurately maintained, tracked, and managed in accordance with company policies and governance requirements. Working closely with Vendor Managers, Vendor Owners, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Operational stakeholders, the role provides contract lifecycle support, maintains contract documentation, and assists with renewal, compliance, and reporting activities. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage deadlines independently are essential.

​​Role and Responsibilities​

Contract Administration & Lifecycle Support

  • Support Vendor Managers and business stakeholders in the preparation, review, and administration of vendor agreements, statements of work (SOWs), amendments, renewals, and termination documentation.

  • Draft vendor contracts and contract amendments using approved templates and stakeholder-provided information.

  • Coordinate contract approval and execution processes, ensuring all required reviews and approvals are completed.

  • Monitor contract expiry dates, renewal windows, and notice periods, proactively highlighting upcoming actions to Vendor Managers and stakeholders.

  • Assist in tracking contract obligations, key milestones, and deliverables throughout the contract lifecycle.

Vendor Documentation & Governance

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date vendor records, contracts, agreements, and supporting documentation within company systems and repositories.

  • Ensure all executed agreements and associated documents are filed and maintained in accordance with document management standards, naming conventions, and governance requirements.

  • Support quality assurance reviews of vendor documentation to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with company policies.

  • Assist with audit requests, compliance reviews, and documentation retrieval activities.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Act as a point of contact for routine vendor contract administration queries and follow-up activities.

  • Coordinate communications between Vendor Managers, Vendor Owners, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and operational stakeholders as required.

  • Escalate contract, compliance, or vendor-related issues to the appropriate stakeholders for review and resolution.

  • Provide regular updates to the Vendor Management team regarding contract status, upcoming renewals, and outstanding actions.

Financial & Reporting Support

  • Coordinate with Finance regarding purchase orders, invoices, budget tracking, and vendor payment queries.

  • Support the maintenance of vendor spend, contract, and renewal reporting information.

  • Prepare regular reports, dashboards, and management information relating to vendor contracts, renewals, compliance activities, and vendor data.

  • Assist in the collection of information required for budget planning and vendor forecasting activities.

Process Improvement

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives relating to vendor management processes, contract administration, record management, and reporting.

  • Assist in maintaining contract templates, process documentation, guidance materials, and standard operating procedures.

  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, contract tracking, and administrative efficiency.

Specified Additional Responsibilities

Support and back up other team members with vendor management and onboarding activities as per the vendor management processes.

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Supply Chain, or related field. Basic knowledge in Legal area is a plus.

- Experience in contract administration, vendor management, procurement support, commercial operations, legal administration, or a related discipline.

- Understanding of contract lifecycle management principles and document control processes.

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in document preparation and record management.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.

- Experience maintaining contract records and managing documentation within databases or contract management systems.

- Collaborative and customer-focused.

- Highly organised with strong attention to detail.

- Proactive and willing to take ownership of assigned activities.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

- Demonstrates integrity and professionalism when handling confidential information.

- Committed to delivering high-quality work and continuous improvement.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

Clinical trials, safety studies, and audits make safe and innovative pharmaceutical-led care possible. As part of Ergomed Group, you help patients benefit so they experience more of life’s meaningful moments. Biopharmaceutical companies are our clients. Patients are our purpose.

Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.

The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Building Canada's Mortgage Ecosystem of the Future.
We're committed to creating a true Canadian champion.

About Us

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services.

With more than 1,300 team members across Canada, we're building Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future—and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.

Learn more at:


Life at Nesto Group

At Nesto Group, you'll be part of a collaborative organization where innovation, speed, trust, expertise, and continuous learning go hand in hand. Whether you're shaping strategy, supporting operations, building technology with best-in-class AI-driven tools, or serving customers, your work contributes to an ecosystem that's redefining the future of mortgage lending in Canada.

Discover the values that drive everything we do, every day. Join the Canadian Rocketship redefining the lending industry.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Where you sit.

You'll be embedded in the Product team, at the intersection of business operations and Nesto Cloud. Your closest partners will be Senior Salesforce Developers, who own the technical architecture, Apex and integrations, alongside stakeholders across sales, mortgage advisory, and operations.

Your job is to own the what and why. The developer owns the how. Together, you're the engine behind everything Salesforce at Nesto.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Own the platform. Shape the experience.

Salesforce Product Ownership

  • Own the Salesforce product roadmap from discovery through delivery, adoption, and iteration.
  • Translate requirements from sales, mortgage advisory, marketing, and operations into user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria your developer can build from immediately.
  • Manage the backlog and sprint cycles in close partnership with our Senior Salesforce Developers and engineering teams.
  • Drive user adoption and change management: people should want to use the tools you build.
  • Define and track KPIs for each feature; use data to continuously improve the platform.
  • Stay ahead of Salesforce's annual releases, evaluating new capabilities.

Cross-Platform Flexibility

  • Flex to adjacent platforms: customer portals, partner tools, or other user-facing SaaS, applying the same product discipline regardless of the underlying stack.
  • Partner with UX and design to ensure a coherent experience across every user touchpoint.
  • Bring a platform-agnostic mindset: the goal is always the best outcome for users, not loyalty to any one tool.

Market & User Intelligence

  • Run competitive analysis and market research to keep our platform strategy sharp and ahead of the curve.
  • Gather and synthesize user feedback through interviews, surveys, and usage analytics to make evidence-based decisions.
  • Communicate clearly and with conviction to stakeholders at all levels: from ops leads to the executive team.

AI-Augmented Ways of Working

  • Actively use AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Figma AI, etc.) to accelerate research, writing, analysis, and prototyping. Every day, not occasionally.
  • Model what high-leverage AI usage looks like and help your colleagues level up alongside you.
  • Evaluate Salesforce's native AI capabilities (Einstein, Agentforce) as part of your platform roadmap: know when to build vs. buy vs. enable.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The profile.

Required

  • 5-7+ years in product management, with at least 2 years directly owning a Salesforce environment.
  • Solid working knowledge of Salesforce's core clouds: Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud at minimum.
  • Enough platform fluency to hold a conversation with a Senior Salesforce Developer: you don't write Apex, but you deeply understand what it takes to build what you're asking for.
  • Strong analytical instincts: you use data to frame problems, prioritize features, and measure outcomes.
  • Excellent communicator who translates naturally between business stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Proven, active fluency with AI tools in your professional work.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce certifications: Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, or Service Cloud Consultant.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce integration patterns.
  • Experience managing non-Salesforce platforms.
  • Background in fintech, mortgage, or lending.
  • Exposure to UX research methods and user journey mapping.

YOU SHOULDN'T APPLY IF

Be honest with yourself.

  • You've never directly owned a Salesforce roadmap. Being adjacent doesn't count: we need someone who has done this.
  • You can't hold a technical conversation with a senior developer. You don't build, but you need to understand what you're asking others to build.
  • You think AI tools are a trend to watch rather than a lever to pull. We expect active, productive usage, not awareness.
  • You need a fully defined problem to get started. The best people here create the structure, they don't wait for it.
  • You're looking for a slow, consensus-driven environment. Uncomfortable ambition is one of our values, and we mean it.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

How we get to know each other.

  • Recruiter Screen – 30 minutes
  • Discovery Call with Director of Product – 30 minutes
  • Take-home Assignment followed by Presentation and Q&A – 60 minutes
  • Final Stakeholder Interview – 45 minutes
  • Criminal Record and Reference Checks + Offer

Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

  • Competitive Rewards — Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.
  • Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.

jobs.description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Remote (India) · Full-time

About the Company:

Aerobotics7 (A7) is a growing, stealth-stage startup building AI and robotics to solve some of the critical challenges on the planet. Small team, high ownership, real hardware in the field. We'll share more once we're talking.

Position Overview:

Own every ML system at A7 end-to-end - from limited real + synthetic datasets to models running in real time on the robot - as the only ML engineer, setting the technical direction for our next phase of development and deployment.

This is not a "train a model and hand it off" role. You build the data pipeline, the models, the evaluation, and the deployment stack. You define the ML roadmap and, as we grow, hire and lead the team behind it.

Key Responsibilities

  • The full ML lifecycle: custom model development, data to training to evaluation to edge/cloud deployment to monitoring to iteration.

  • Object detection and classification on hard, low-signal sensor data (radar, LiDAR, camera), including multi-sensor fusion.

  • Our synthetic data strategy: generation, sim-to-real domain gap, domain adaptation and randomization.

  • Real-time inference on-device (NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin) and at scale in the cloud.

  • ML infrastructure from scratch: experiment tracking, dataset/model versioning, reproducible training, evaluation harnesses.

  • The ML roadmap. You set priorities with the founders and are accountable for outcomes, not experiments.

Must-have

  • 5+ years applied ML shipping models into production, not research-only.

  • Deep, hands-on work with modern transformer-based detection: DETR family (Deformable DETR, DINO-DETR), self-supervised backbones (DINOv2), or equivalent and newer architectures. You can explain the tradeoffs and when to reach for each. Off-the-shelf YOLO fine-tuning or LLM-generated pipelines you can't defend line by line are not what we're looking for.

  • Low-data expertise: transfer learning, self-supervised / semi-supervised / few-shot, augmentation, active learning. You know how to get a strong model from a small labeled set.

  • Synthetic-data training: you've trained on simulated data and closed the sim-to-real gap in a real system.

  • Edge deployment: NVIDIA Jetson / AGX Orin, TensorRT, ONNX, quantization/pruning, latency and memory optimization.

  • PyTorch fluency and strong Python.

  • MLOps ownership: experiment tracking (W&B/MLflow), data/model versioning (e.g. DVC), reproducible pipelines.

  • Self-direction: comfortable as the only ML person, working through ambiguity, owning decisions.

  • Strong async written communication, and several hours of daily overlap with US Pacific time.

Strong plus

  • Ground-penetrating radar, radar/signal processing, or geophysics.

  • 3D / point-cloud ML.

  • Cloud training and serving (AWS or GCP).

  • C++ for edge/performance work.

  • ROS2 or robotics/perception exposure.

  • Track record of growing into a team lead.

Why this role is different

You are the ML function. What you build ships to a robot in the field, not a slide. You'll have datasets that don't exist anywhere else, hard problems worth solving, and the autonomy to solve them your way. If you want scope, ownership, and the chance to build an ML org from its first engineer up, this is that seat.

Logistics

  • Location: Remote, India-based.

  • Hours: Daily overlap with US Pacific time required.

  • Start: Immediate.

  • Compensation: ₹18-30 LPA CTC, based on skills and experience.

  • Equity: strong stock options based on eligibility, performance and tenure.

Note: This role sits under Aerobotics7 Inventions Pvt. Ltd., our Indian entity. Compensation is aligned to Indian market standards. Our parent company is US-based; this position is for candidates residing and working in India.

How to Apply

Apply in Dover (Aerobotics7/41e08db2-c5a4-4bb6-be52-36c81ed012cd?rs=42706078) using your resume plus a GitHub or portfolio link (required). If any question email us at . A short note on relevant work is welcome but optional. If your best work is closed-source, tell us what you built and what you owned.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Revenue Cycle Specialist - Orthopedic Care
Location: Remote

Reports To: SVP, Clinical Services

Who We Are

Icon Health is a leading provider of value-based musculoskeletal (MSK) care, collaborating with payers and providers to enhance outcomes and experience for individuals. The company partners with health plans and risk-bearing providers to assume accountability for reduced total cost of care. By combining technology-enabled MSK providers with proactive care coordination and decision support services, Icon Health delivers multidisciplinary, evidence-based care.

We founded Icon Health on the conviction that every patient should be genuinely delighted with their care experience. By prioritizing patient-centered practices, ensuring clear care goals across the entire clinical team, and placing clinicians at the heart of care delivery, we aim to transform a fragmented system into one that truly serves patients. Our model uses a team-based approach to care, integrating musculoskeletal expertise and primary care to achieve better patient outcomes.

At Icon Health, we foster a culture that embraces bold thinking, rapid iteration, and practical problem-solving. We seek team members who relish challenging the status quo and thrive in vertically integrated roles—where ideas can swiftly move from concept to execution without layers of red tape. Above all, we value individuals who are eager to roll up their sleeves, tackle obstacles head-on, and create innovative solutions that improve the lives of our patients and our clinical partners.

Who You Are

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Revenue Cycle Manager with deep expertise with multi state telehealth and in-person claim submission, copays, payment posting, insurance guidelines, and revenue cycle workflows that ensure we are reimbursed accurately and on time. More importantly the right candidate has deep expertise in medicare and medicare advantage regulations surrounding telehealth practices and compliance

End to End RCM Responsibilities include:

  • Effectively manage the billings and collections process to ensure that all billing/claims submissions are accurate and submitted within 5 days of the patient date of service (DOS), and that the initial claim denial rate is less than 5% of monthly claim submissions (i.e. Clean Claim Rate of 95%).
  • Effectively manage the payment postings process to ensure payments are accurately applied to patient accounts, and that payments received from the EOB are reconciled daily to bank account deposits. Unapplied payments at any point in time should be less than 5% of total payments received.
  • Effectively manage outstanding Accounts Receivable Balances to minimize A/R aged greater than 90 days, and attain average A/R days below 40 days.
  • Effectively manage the billing, collections, and coding staff (both in-house and outsourced) to ensure that company-wide objectives defined herein are achieved.
  • Stay up to date on regulatory and compliance rules for Medicare and Medicare Advantage payers
  • Track, analyze, and appeal payer claim denials through structured denial management workflows to recover lost revenue and identify systemic adjudication trends.
  • Monitor payer contract performance and fee schedules to audit for underpayments and ensure accurate reimbursement according to negotiated terms.
  • Calculate and collect up-front patient financial responsibility utilizing real-time eligibility tools.
  • Reconcile underpayments against specific payer contract fee schedules, auditing high-reimbursement cases to ensure contractual rates for supplies, procedures, and instrumentation are paid in full.
  • Ensure that all Reimbursements for medical services or supplies are provided to a qualified beneficiary, medically reasonable and necessary, performed by a qualified practitioner (within the scope of their practice) and coded accurately (procedures and diagnosis) in accordance with the documented medical record.
  • Determine the root cause of billing errors and act to prevent any recurrence, retrain on coding practices as needed and review policies and procedures for clarity of expectations and requirements.
  • Provide timely overpayment refunds to the payor in compliance with associated federal or state funded healthcare program payor requirements. Continuously enhance skills and knowledge in compliance coding and billing training to minimize potential risk of receiving improper payments.
  • Participate in coding reviews and monitoring of coding practices. Regularly participate in internal audits to verify that billing updates have been properly integrated and adhered to across all claims and address discrepancies with corrective actions as needed.
  • Stay up-to-date on coding, reimbursement, and regulatory changes to ensure accurate claims, compliance, and efficient revenue management.
  • Ensure that collections and accounts receivable (AR) management processes adhere to federal and state regulations, safeguard patient information, and maintain financial integrity
  • Maintain and enforce a billing and receivables framework that maintains compliance, ensures accurate reimbursement, protects patient privacy, and optimizes cash flow

What You’ll Bring

We are always looking for new team members who will add to our company’s DNA and have a strong passion for impact. None of the following are strict requirements, but they describe qualities and skills that will help a candidate be successful in this role:

  • Degree, certificate, or diploma in medical billing, health information management, or healthcare administration preferred
  • Completion of a medical billing training program preferred. Certified Professional Biller (CPB) a major plus.
  • Exceptional communication skills to interact with patients, healthcare providers, and insurance companies
  • Unmatched attention to detail to ensure claims are processed timely and correctly, and that payments are received.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively
  • Ability to use multiple digital tools for billing, record keeping and patient care directive

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment based upon age, color, handicap or disability, ethnic or national origin, race, religion, religious creed, gender (including discrimination taking the form of sexual harassment), marital, parental or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression.

This position is REMOTE

Important Notice: Protect Yourself from Recruitment Fraud
To ensure you are communicating with a legitimate Icon Health representative, please not

  • Verified Communication: All official emails from our team will only come from an @iconhealthco.com email address.
  • Live Interviews: We never hire based on text or chat alone. Our multi-stage interview process always involves several live conversations with our team members via phone and/or web conference.
  • Your Privacy: We will never ask for sensitive financial information, home office equipment fees, or payment at any point during the hiring process.

If you receive a suspicious request or an email from a different domain claiming to represent Icon Health, please do not engage

jobs.title: GTM Engineer- AI B2B Lead Generation & Automation
jobs.excerpt: PlanITROI is hiring a hands-on, elite, GTM engineer to build and run our AI-powered lead generation engine.
jobs.description:
PlanITROI is hiring a hands-on, elite, GTM engineer to build and run our AI-powered lead generation engine. You build the core AI agents first, then run the campaigns on them every day, turning enterprise buying signals into qualified sales conversations.

You might have started in outbound, SDR leadership, demand gen, or growth, then taught yourself to build the agents and automations that do the work. Or you're an engineer who learned B2B prospecting the hard way. Either way, you've personally built systems that booked real meetings, and you can show us how you have been successful.

If that's you, we would like to meet you!

About PlanITROI

For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has turned retired technology into financial value for enterprise organizations. Our services cover IT lifecycle management, repair, refurbishment, redeployment, remarketing, reverse logistics, and secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD).

We operate on reuse-as-intended-use: reuse before recycling, and recycling only when reuse isn't viable. PlanITROI is recognized in Gartner's ITAD Market Guide and is an IAITAM Platinum Sponsor.

Our mission is to maximize the financial value of technology while extending its useful life. Every device we recover creates value for clients and gets a second life as affordable technology.

Your mission

Build and run the AI-powered outbound engine that finds enterprise buying opportunities and turns them into qualified meetings and signed MSAs. Your agents will research 5,000+ enterprise accounts and reach 250,000+ contacts.

You own it end-to-end: signal detection, account intelligence, contact discovery, personalization, multichannel orchestration, CRM integration, experimentation, and measurement.

Build first, then run. You start by building a few core agents. Then you run the campaigns on them: launching and monitoring sequences, working reply queues, tuning messaging and targeting every week, protecting deliverability, and handing warm conversations to sales at the right moment. Expect most of your time to shift from building to running once the agents are live.

Who we sell to. Enterprise organizations with 5,000 to 11,000,000+ employees, mostly knowledge workers (80%+), complex buying committees, and an existing technology provider. Your challenge: find the right buyer, recognize the right moment, and give them a compelling reason to talk to PlanITROI.

Who you work with. You report to the Founder & CEO and the Chief Strategy Officer, and work closely with the VP of Marketing. No layers in between other than support.

What you'll build and own

  • Signal detection. Ingest, evaluate, and score buying signals such as tech refresh cycles, leadership changes, office moves, M&A, RFP activity, contract timing, job postings, and social activity. Trigger the right next action while the signal is fresh.
  • Buying committee intelligence. Identify high-fit ICP accounts, map buying committees, select the best 1 to 5 contacts per entry point, validate contact data, and track changes.
  • Personalization and challenger messaging. Combine account intelligence, signals, persona pain points, account history, and incumbent-provider context into relevant outreach at scale.
  • Multichannel orchestration. Run email, LinkedIn, voicemail drops, AI calling where appropriate, and human SDR follow-up as one system, with sequencing, timing, routing, and next-best actions.
  • Objection handling and follow-up. Respond intelligently to objections like "We already have a provider," keep conversational context, and escalate to humans at the right moment.
  • Performance and optimization. Measure results by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. Find what's winning, kill what isn't, and run the next experiment.

These are capabilities, not six separate agents. You design the architecture, build the agents, integrate the systems, and make them work together.

What you bring

This role requires a hands-on builder. You must design, build, and demo production AI agents yourself. You'll integrate tools like Salesforce, Apollo, and Clay, but using them isn't the role. Building the agents that run on top of them is.

You understand both sides: the engineering, and the B2B prospecting strategy that turns agents into a working revenue system.

Must-haves

  • AI agents that booked meetings. You've personally built and run AI agents or automated outbound systems that produced measurable B2B meetings, and you have the performance data to prove it.
  • Agent engineering. LLMs, tool calling, reasoning workflows, memory and state, multi-agent orchestration, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls, using LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, n8n, or comparable frameworks.
  • Coding and integration. Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, and custom integrations.
  • Enterprise prospecting. Intent signals, ICP scoring, buying committee mapping, enrichment, personalization, objection handling, and multichannel sequence design. Bonus if you've displaced incumbent providers.
  • GTM stack. Hands-on with tools like Salesforce, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6sense or Bombora, and AI calling or voicemail platforms.
  • Production operations at scale. Monitoring, debugging, CRM sync, deduplication, deliverability, compliance, and error handling for systems reaching 250,000+ contacts across email, LinkedIn, and voicemail without burning domains or accounts.

Nice-to-haves

  • A background in outbound, SDR/BDR leadership, demand gen, growth, or RevOps before moving into AI and automation.
  • Experience in IT services, ITAD, or computer hardware, hardware as a service

What success looks like

Your primary outcome is qualified enterprise meetings that meet defined ICP, persona, and business-need criteria. We also track:

  • Signal-to-meeting conversion. How well your agents turn buying signals into conversations and meetings.
  • Contact precision. Reaching the right decision-makers and buying committees.
  • Deployment velocity. How fast a campaign idea becomes a working agent and a live test.
  • Multichannel conversion. Replies, conversations, meetings, and opportunities by signal, persona, channel, and campaign.
  • System reliability. Data accuracy, deliverability, CRM integrity, routing, and compliance.
  • Learning rate. How quickly you find what isn't working, fix the root cause, and scale what is.

How we hire: show us, don't tell us

We hire on proof, not interviews alone. We're not interested in theoretical AI expertise or polished slides about what agents might do. If you qualify, we'll give you a real project to show us how you build.

  1. Live demo. Show us AI agents you personally built and deployed for B2B lead generation, and the results they produced.
  2. Build project. Build an outbound agent from a campaign premise we give you, using your own tools.
  3. Live technical session. Demo your build, work a live account, and walk us through your architecture.

Across these stages, be ready to show your architecture, decision logic, prompts, tools, and integrations; how your agents handle exceptions, incomplete data, failures, and human handoff; and real performance data such as meetings, pipeline, or conversion gains.

You won't need access to any PlanITROI system or need to buy software. Free tiers and trials are fine. Your work stays yours unless we hire you. If you show work from a past employer, please redact anything confidential.

Ready to build?

If you love hard technical problems and want to build something ambitious, bring your working agents, your results, and your drive.

Build the agents. Own the results. Help us grow.

About Us

Zoo is building the next generation of hardware design tools redefining how hardware products are designed, developed, and built. Our platform combines a modern, cloud-native CAD environment with AI-powered engineering workflows, helping teams design, iterate, and manufacture products faster than ever before. We are headquartered in Los Angeles, CA with both a local and remote team. We were founded and incubated by Embedded Ventures in 2021.

About You

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Systems Software Engineer who can take ownership of the reliability, automation, and evolution of our core systems. You’ll work across the stack, with a strong emphasis on backend, infrastructure, and system-level engineering, to strengthen the foundations that everything else runs on. This role is for someone who enjoys digging into complex systems, building the tooling and automation that keep them running smoothly, and stepping in anywhere (including the frontend) when something needs fixing.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, implement, and maintain core systems and services that support our platform’s reliability, performance, and scalability.

  • Develop integrations between our systems and external platforms (e.g., billing, CRM, authentication, analytics).

jobs.description:
Osborn Consulting is looking for an OpenRoads (ORD) Designer to join our Water Business Group, contributing to stormwater, drainage, stream, and landscaping design on large roadway, transit, and fish passage improvement projects around the Puget Sound region.  

Our ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise and hands-on experience using Bentley OpenRoads Designer to independently develop roadway drainage, stormwater facility grading, landscaping, and fish passage designs. The candidate also brings experience in team leadership, multidisciplinary coordination, standards development, QA/QC, and mentoring. In this role, you’ll partner with multidisciplinary teams to deliver accurate design models, plans, and construction documents that meet project and client standards.

You’ll be a key contributor in delivering thoughtful, high-quality solutions that strengthen our communities while working collaboratively to meet project goals, timelines, and budgets. 

About the Role

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with a highly skilled team of engineers and civil technicians/designers to deliver accurate, efficient, and high-quality design work. Your knowledge and responsibilities include:

  • Design Development — Demonstrate a high level of competency in developing designs and providing technical support to engineers.
  • Independent ORD Design — Create OpenRoads Designer (ORD) models independently under broad direction from project engineers or project managers.
  • Pipe Network Modeling — Build and edit ORD pipe networks using the OpenRoads Designer Managed Workspace at the direction of the engineer.
  • Alignment Design — Create and refine horizontal and vertical alignments within ORD.
  • Plan/Profile Sheet Production — Develop and edit plan and profile sheets in ORD.
  • Client Coordination — Coordinate with client CADD technicians throughout the project lifecycle to ensure consistency and alignment.
  • Standards & Workflow Development — Partner with Osborn Consulting’s Design Technology Manager to develop ORD standards, drawing production workflows, and best practices.
  • Quality Feedback — Provide feedback on design accuracy and completeness to the Project Manager and Lead Civil Technician.
  • Mentorship — Mentor junior CADD staff and contribute to professional development requirements.
  • QA/QC Participation — Support internal QA/QC reviews of CADD design and drafting to ensure accuracy, consistency, and efficiency.
  • Standards Compliance — Uphold CADD standards for Osborn Consulting, clients, and other governing entities.
  • Workflow Optimization — Help identify, refine, and implement project standards and workflows in collaboration with the Osborn Consulting’s Design Technology Manager.

About You

Our ideal candidate is well-organized, thorough, trustworthy, with excellent communication skills.   

To thrive in this position, you have the following qualifications: 

  • 10+ years drafting/design experience required in civil engineering industry. Prefer 4+ years of ORD experience. 
  • Strong proficiency with OpenRoads and InRoads. 
  • Experience with AutoCAD, MicroStation, ACC, & ProjectWise. 
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office programs. 
  • Proactive problem solver with attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy. 
  • Self-motivated, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.  
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and project deadlines, multitask, and prioritize
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively across teams while taking ownership of project coordination and technical delivery. 
  • Anticipate project needs and potential conflicts and work on resolution.

 It is a plus, but not required, to have these additional qualifications: 

  • WSDOT-approved OpenRoads Training Modules for storm and stream design 
  • Experience with WSDOT guidelines / procedures / plan preparation 
  • Knowledge of GIS terminology and experience importing GIS data for use in our design. 

Location

This position is remote for out-of-state (Washington State) candidates. For candidates based in the Bellevue/Seattle/Bellingham/Vancouver area, a hybrid schedule is preferred, with the opportunity to work from the office 2-3 days per week. 

About Osborn

Osborn Consulting is an employee-owned consulting firm providing civil engineering, landscape architecture, and urban design on public projects across Washington state. The power of these public projects surrounds our daily lives, from the sidewalks we stroll to visit our neighborhood park, to the confidence in knowing our homes are safe from flooding when heavy rain comes. Our team develops strong foundations of trust with cities, counties, and agencies to achieve more resilient and more sustainable communities. 

 

We have grown strategically over the last 20 years from a firm of one to a team of more than 100 motivated, hard-working, and creative individuals. Working for Osborn provides you the chance to learn new skills, follow your passions, and have fun along the way! 

 

What We Offer

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee health, performance, success, and ownership. (Stated benefits are for full-time regular positions. Temporary and part-time roles are eligible for limited benefits.)

 

  • Competitive pay, medical and dental insurance, a 401K plan with matching, PTO/holiday pay, health and fitness stipend, commute support, and profit sharing. 
  • A collaborative and fun environment with idea-sharing, learning, and curiosity. 
  • Training and mentoring. 
  • Opportunities for growth within the company. 

The expected compensation range for this position is $93,600-$114,400 annually and is dependent upon skills, experience, education, and geographical location. 

What We Value

Our new team member will be someone who aligns with our core values of Professionalism & Responsibility, Collaboration & Creativity, Health & Well-Being, Laughter & Fun, Relationships & Respect, Growth & Exploration. 

  

Our Diversity and Inclusion 

Osborn is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture.

Please note that this phone number and email are only for those individuals who would like to request an accommodation to apply for a job.

Phoenix, Arizona
