Two open positions · One starting now · One in August · Finland or Sweden · Remote-first

You've spent years being excellent at your craft. You've also spent years watching that craft get buried under tickets, approval chains, and decisions made by people who've never written a line of production code.

We get it. We built Roder because we were tired of it too.

Roder is an AI security and governance platform - a high-performance gateway that sits between organizations and every AI model they use, providing real-time threat detection, prompt injection prevention, traffic management, data sovereignty enforcement, and full audit trails. Think of it as the security layer that enterprises need before they can trust AI at scale.

We're building this in Rust. Fast, correct, and uncompromising - just like the security problems we're solving.

We're hiring two senior engineers. One position starts immediately. The other starts in August. We don't have two rigid role descriptions, because we believe the right people define the role - not the other way around.

The Role in a Nutshell

  • Permanent positions - one starting now, one in August

  • Remote-first - work from anywhere in Finland or Sweden. We meet in person occasionally, not constantly. When we do, we expect you there.

  • Salary - competitive, based on your experience. We won't win on pure salary against the big consulting factories, but we offer something they never will: a genuine stake in what we're building.

  • Equity - We want you to share in our success. Every employee joins our stock option program once they've successfully settled into their role. We have massive ambitions and are on a path to build something truly significant-this is a rare opportunity you won't find elsewhere to become a true part of Roder and reap the future rewards of our success.

What You'll Be Working On

Depending on your background and strengths, you'll take ownership across one or more of these areas:

  • Designing and building Rust-based backend services powering our AI security gateway - high-throughput, low-latency, production-grade

  • Architecting and maintaining networking and gateway infrastructure - Layer 7 routing, traffic management, rate limiting, multi-provider AI routing

  • Owning security engineering - prompt injection detection, ML-based threat models, content filtering, PII detection, data exfiltration prevention

  • Building and improving Kubernetes-based infrastructure - deployment pipelines, container orchestration, observability, resilience

  • Participating in technical decision-making from day one - architecture, tooling, development practices. No committee. No hierarchy to navigate. Your ideas land directly.

  • Driving our agentic development practices - we build with AI agents, we automate aggressively, and we expect you to be actively pushing this forward, not tolerating it

Who You Are

We're not looking for someone who fits a checklist. We're looking for a specific type of person. You probably recognize yourself here:

You must have:

  • Strong containerization experience - Kubernetes is our standard, Docker and equivalent experience works

  • Genuine comfort working in or learning Rust - you don't need to be a Rust expert on day one, but you need to be genuinely excited about it, not reluctant

You're the right fit if you:

  • Use AI tools as a natural part of how you work - not as a gimmick, not as a crutch, but as a genuine force multiplier

  • Are equally comfortable in security, backend, or infrastructure - or bring deep expertise in one and curiosity about the others

  • Prefer shipping over meetings

  • Have opinions about architecture and aren't afraid to voice them

This is not for you if:

  • You want a clear org chart to know whose approval you need

  • "Remote-first" to you means never meeting your teammates under any circumstances

What We Offer

  • Stock option program - all employees, no exceptions, starting after probation. You're not joining a payroll, you're joining the founding team in spirit.

Growth & Learning - from day one, no waiting

  • Dedicated time for learning, R&D, and personal development. It's built into your schedule from your very first week—not something you have to earn. Most importantly, it's not just an empty promise; we actively make sure it happens.

How We Work

  • Remote-first - your best work environment is your work environment

  • Occasional in-person meetups (we're a small team, it's rare but real)

  • Flat organization - founders have deep experience across IT, software, and security. Everyone's ideas get heard and processed. No idea goes into a black hole.

  • External monitor

  • Company phone

jobs.description:
Position Summary:

This role will be responsible for developing secure, compliant AI infrastructure and reusable frameworks that enable internal teams and external consultants to build and deploy AI agents for Operations, Human Resources, Admissions, and IT, while also supporting advanced LLM-driven clinical and client risk use cases integrated with Beacon’s EHR, eMAR, HRIS, CRM, and incident management systems.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

No supervisory responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Always be compliant with all company and regulatory policies and procedures.

AI Agent Platform & Framework Development

  • Design and maintain an enterprise AI Agent framework supporting:
  • Task automation
  • Data retrieval and summarization
  • Workflow orchestration
  • Human-in-the-loop approvals

• Build shared services including:

  • Prompt management and versioning
  • Tool and API integration layers
  • Authentication, role-based access, and audit logging
  • Enable safe agent execution with guardrails, validation layers, and escalation paths.

Consultant Enablement & Solution Support

  • Partner with internal teams and external consultants building agents for:
  • Operations (staffing, scheduling, census, compliance tasks)
  • Human Resources (onboarding, policy Q&A, training tracking)
  • Admissions and Sales (referrals, intake coordination, CRM workflows)
  • IT (service desk triage, asset management, automation)
  • Provide development standards, templates, SDKs, and reference architectures.
  • Review and approve agent designs for security, performance, and compliance.

Clinical AI & Client Risk Intelligence

  • Develop and support LLM-powered clinical and risk-focused solutions such as:
  • Behavioral and incident pattern analysis
  • Medication adherence and documentation quality monitoring
  • Early-warning indicators for client risk and escalation
  • Integrate AI outputs into clinical workflows, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Partner with clinical leadership to ensure interpretability and usability of AI insights.

LLM Engineering & MLOps

  • Implement and manage LLM integrations including:
  • Secure prompt pipelines
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using enterprise data
  • Model evaluation and drift monitoring
  • Deploy AI services using scalable cloud-native architecture (APIs, containers, CI/CD).
  • Optimize performance, cost, and latency across production AI workloads.

Data Integration & Platform Collaboration

• Work with Data Engineering to leverage:

  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Azure Data Lake
  • Power BI semantic models

• Integrate data from:

  • EHR and eMAR platforms
  • HRIS and payroll systems
  • CRM and Admissions platforms
  • Incident and Quality Management systems

Responsible AI, Security & Compliance

• Implement responsible AI practices including:

  • Bias detection and mitigation
  • Explainability and traceability
  • Model and prompt version control

• Ensure compliance with:

• HIPAA

  • State regulatory requirements
  • Internal security and data governance policies
  • Support audits and compliance reviews related to AI systems.

AI Strategy & Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to Beacon’s enterprise AI roadmap and standards.
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools, agent frameworks, and healthcare models.
  • Recommend architecture and vendor platforms to support scalable AI adoption.

Team Member Expectations:

  • Must be compliant with company and regulatory policies and procedures.
  • Participate and contribute to weekly, bi-week or monthly leadership calls. Be prepared to report

on applicable KPIs that best reflect the performance of your team.

  • Preserve and protect the privacy, confidentiality and security of all medical records, proprietary

and other confidential information relating to Beacon Specialized Living, its Individuals, Team Members, activities and affiliates, in accordance with all applicable laws (especially HIPAA) and contract terms.

  • Promote Beacon in a positive manner and lead by example, modeling our core values in everyday

behavior.

  • Monitors and corrects employee gossip, harassment, favoritism, and other negative social

workplace behaviors to ensure a positive and productive work environment.

  • Understand how to approach and communicate with everyone at all levels.
  • Treat everyone with dignity and respect while responding to their needs.
  • Maintain and sustain a safe community environment and workplace.
  • Apply trauma-Informed Care principals recognizing the presence of trauma symptoms and

acknowledging the role trauma may play in an individual’s life.

  • Promote trauma-informed care at all levels of the organization and help create a culture that is

sensitive to the feelings of our Individuals and avoid responding negatively to stigmas that they will never truly understand.

  • Follow Beacon’s policies, procedures, and manuals.
  • Cooperates with Beacon Specialized Living, the Department of Human Services (DHS) staff or any

other regulatory body during any inspection, investigation or inquiry.

  • Accept other duties as assigned.

Professional Conduct and Management Effectiveness: In addition to evaluating your work performance you will be evaluated for the following work

behaviors:

  • Job Knowledge: Depth and breadth of knowledge supporting our organization goals.
  • Quality of Work: Freedom from errors and mistakes, timeliness. Accuracy, quality of

work in general.

  • Quantity of Work: Work output of the employee.
  • Reliability: The extent to which the employee can be dependent upon to be available for

work, do it properly, and complete it on time. The degree to which the employee is reliable, trustworthy, and persistent.

  • Initiative and Creativity: The ability to plan work and to go ahead with a task without

being told every detail and the ability to make constructive suggestions.

  • Judgment: The extent to which the employee makes decisions which are sound. Ability to

base decisions on fact rather than emotion.

  • Cooperation: Willingness to work harmoniously with others in getting a job done.

Readiness to respond positively to instructions and procedures.

  • Compliance: Always be compliant with all company and regulatory policies and procedures.
  • Attendance: Faithfulness in coming to work daily and conforming to scheduled work hours.
  • Planning and Organizing: The ability to analyze work, set goals, develop plans of action,

utilize time, and delegate work as appropriate. Consider the amount of supervision required and the extent to which you can trust employees to carry out assignments conscientiously.

  • Directing and Controlling: The ability to create a motivating climate, achieve teamwork, train,

and develop, measure work in progress, and take corrective action.

  • Decision Making: The ability to make decisions and the quality and timeliness of those decisions.
  • Problem Solving: The ability to assess a problem, identify options or solutions, formulate a

plan, execute the plan, and achieve and sustain positive outcomes.

  • Embrace, support, and manage the business in accordance with Beacon’s Mission and Core

Values.

jobs.description:
About hireworks

hireworks is building a community of top talent in key international markets by unlocking unparalleled access to positions at leading U.S. based companies. As your employer, hireworks will ensure you have a seamless interview, onboarding, and employee experience - providing ongoing support and resources along the way. Established in 2023, hireworks is forging corp-to-corp relationships with leading U.S. based organizations looking to grow their teams with best-in-class talent around the world. Working with hireworks means unlocking access to a network of local peers and mentors and career opportunities through our client network.

About our Client

Our client is a Business Process Outsourcer (BPO) committed to fostering brand growth through outstanding customer experiences. They were founded by e-commerce pioneers who struggled to find an equally innovative customer service partner. Many companies view customer care as merely a cost center, but they believe it offers much more! If you enjoy delighting customers and leveraging data to provide valuable insights to clients, they could be your ideal workplace!

About the Position

As Tech Lead, Platform (Data & AI), you'll play a pivotal role in shaping our client's technology strategy as the company evolves into a more data-driven, AI-enabled business. This is a highly hands-on role (combination of hands on coding and leadership) where you'll own platform architecture, mentor a small engineering team, and build the scalable data infrastructure needed to power future AI-driven products and customer insights. You'll work closely with Product and Business leadership to make critical technical decisions, modernize existing systems, and identify opportunities to leverage data and AI to transform the customer experience.

What You'll Do

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership across software development, data, AI/ML, and cloud infrastructure, while managing and mentoring a small team of 3-5 engineers.

  • Own the technical architecture of the platform, establishing pragmatic frameworks and engineering practices.

  • Lead strategic build-vs.-buy decisions, evaluating whether capabilities should be developed internally, integrated through third-party platforms, or leveraged through emerging AI/ML services. Clearly communicate the associated technical, financial, operational, and strategic tradeoffs to Product and Business leadership.

  • Establish and evolve the data architecture, providing technical direction across data pipelines, integrations, data models, warehousing/lake infrastructure, and the systems required to make data reliable and accessible.

  • Identify and drive opportunities to apply AI/ML, including integrating AI capabilities into products and workflows, evaluating emerging technologies, and partnering with product/business stakeholders to turn AI opportunities into production-ready solutions.

  • Own and operate cloud-based systems across AWS and Google Cloud, making thoughtful decisions around infrastructure, scalability, cost, security, deployment, monitoring, and reliability.

  • Remain deeply hands-on, contributing code and technical implementation to the highest-impact areas while helping the team solve complex engineering problems.

  • Build for the next stage of the organization, anticipating how product growth, increasing data volumes, customer needs, and a growing engineering team will affect today's technical decisions.

About You

  • 7+ years of engineering experience, with at least 2-3 years in a senior technical leadership and/or people management capacity

  • Strong software engineering experience with TypeScript and Python or Java, as well as API design and microservices architecture

  • Experience making foundational architectural decisions in an early-stage or greenfield environment

  • Previous work with large scale datasets, ETL pipelines, or analytics platforms

  • Strong familiarity with cloud environments (AWS and/or GCP) and containerized infrastructure

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills - able to work effectively across product, engineering, and business teams

  • Ability to act as a player-coach: set technical direction and contribute hands-on while building out the team and establishing the processes that will scale with it.

  • Passion for technical documentation practices, including architecture diagrams, ADRs, and other artifacts that make technical decisions clear and maintainable.

  • Working knowledge of SOC 2 compliance requirements and security controls

Bonus Qualifications:

  • AI/ML and LLM fluency, including building AI/ML features into products.

  • Experience building platforms or tools for non-technical users, especially in AI/ML, automation, or workflow spaces

Benefits:
﻿hireworks is cultivating a growing community of top talent across LATAM. In addition to unlocking access to positions at top tier U.S. based companies, we offer a variety of benefits to enhance your experience:

  • Competitive Pay - compensation that reflects your experience and accomplishments

  • Remote Flexibility - work from anywhere in your home country: Colombia, Argentina or Brazil

  • Paid Time Off - ample vacation days to rest and recharge

  • Public Holidays - federal holidays are fully paid days off (in your local country)

jobs.excerpt: What We’re BuildingHoneycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do!
jobs.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:

The team builds observability for AI in Honeycomb. We help customers see what their agents are doing, what those agents cost, and where errors happen. We also give them insight into individual conversations so they can debug them. We're bringing LLM and agent observability together, and we own both the data foundation and the product experiences built on top of it. You'll work in a small, cross-functional group of engineers with a dedicated product manager and designer, shipping features customers use in production. If you want to define how people understand and debug AI systems, this is the team for you.

What you’ll do in the role:

  • Own end-to-end development of AI observability capabilities, from ingestion to in-product visualizations.
  • Architect and evolve the data model and infrastructure that let us observe agents and their ecosystems across the Honeycomb product.
  • Build systems that analyze and surface AI-specific signals, such as cost, token usage, errors, and anomalies.
  • Collaborate with product and design partners to make sure what we build is usable, intuitive, and unlocks meaningful user workflows.
  • Teach best practices for exploring and understanding AI system behavior across conversations and workloads.
  • Iterate through fast feedback loops and experimentation, and share both wins and failures.

What you’ll bring to the role:

  • Significant software engineering experience, with a record of shipping and owning features end to end.
  • Experience shipping customer-facing features at a SaaS company, beyond internal tooling.
  • Full-stack range, with proficiency in backend development (Go and/or Python) and frontend development (TypeScript and React).
  • A track record of working closely with product managers and designers.
  • Regular, hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day engineering work.
  • Experience being on call. You'd join our rotation after about 90 days.
  • A track record of navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving field where requirements shift and experimentation is a core part of the job.
  • Bonus: Experience building LLM or agent-powered features in production.
  • Bonus: Hands-on experience with observability tooling, such as OpenTelemetry.
Base Salary based on level of experience
$250,000—$280,000 CAD

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...
Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:
  • All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address
    • We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo.
  • Our recruiting process will never ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to:
    • Social security or tax identification numbers
    • Credit card numbers
    • Bank account information

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.
We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

Privacy Notice:

If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes.
For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice.
If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact . Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

jobs.excerpt: Who We ArePoint32Health is a leading not-for-profit health and well-being organization dedicated to delivering high-quality, affordable healthcare.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Point32Health is a leading not-for-profit health and well-being organization dedicated to delivering high-quality, affordable healthcare. Serving nearly 2 million members, Point32Health builds on the legacy of Harvard Pilgrim Health Care and Tufts Health Plan to provide access to care and empower healthier lives for everyone. Our culture revolves around being a community of care and having shared values that guide our behaviors and decisions. We’ve had a long-standing commitment to inclusion and equal healthcare access and outcomes, regardless of background; it’s at the core of who we are. We value the rich mix of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all of our colleagues, which helps us to provide service with empathy and better understand and meet the needs of the communities where we serve, live, and work.

We enjoy the important work we do every day in service to our members, partners, colleagues and communities. Learn more about who we are at Point32Health.

Job Summary

The Credentialing Specialist is responsible for ensuring all Point32Health affiliated physicians and other independent practitioners and allied providers are qualified to provide health care services to members in accordance with Point32Health’s policies and procedures, state laws and/or regulatory requirements (e.g., NCQA). Practitioners are recredentialed at least every three years or more frequently as required.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities/Duties – what you will be doing (top five):

  • Essential functions occur simultaneously, therefore, the employee must be able to appropriately handle each essential function, prioritize them, and seek assistance when necessary. These functions need to be performed on a consistent and regular basis, using good judgment. Requires the ability to learn and apply Point32Health policies consistently and seek out guidance when necessary.
  • Responsible for maintaining and processing physician and provider credentialing information for new and established health plan practitioners in accordance with Point32Health’s policies and procedures, state laws and regulatory agencies, including but not limited to:
  • Assessment of adequate and accurate information for participation in Point32Health, including a limited knowledge of provider contract information.
  • Accurate and timely entry of initial and existing credentialing applications into the credentialing information system (Cactus).
  • Verification through various sources of necessary licenses, board certification, etc.
  • Review and report of adverse information received through National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB), state and federal sanctions.
  • Retrieval of missing and/or expired information/documentation required for credentialing.
  • Act as resource for physician and provider questions relating to certification and/or credentialing process.
  • Identify for Credentialing Supervisor those issues of broader complexity or sensitivity that may require further action by a Medical Director or other outside source.
  • Daily, prepare files that Meet Credentialing Criteria for review by the Credentialing Compliance Coordinator and/or Supervisor and presentation to daily Medical Director file review.
  • Prepare files that may not Meet Credentialing Criteria for review by the Medical Directors and/or Senior Credentialing Specialist and/or Supervisor and presentation to the Quality-of-Care Committee (QOCC), including report of adverse information.
  • Daily, process all practitioners under the terms and conditions of the entities’ agreement, including files credentialed through a Certified Verification Organization (CVO).
  • Participate in task forces and/or other meetings as assigned and execute other responsibilities as assigned.
  • Other duties and projects as assigned.

Qualifications – what you need to perform the job

Certification and Licensure

Education

  • Required (minimum): High school diploma
  • Preferred: Bachelor’s degree

Experience

  • Required (minimum): 1-2 years of experience in healthcare field. Experience with personal computer.
  • Preferred: Experience with provider credentialing. Knowledge Word and Excel.

Skill Requirements

  • All information (written, verbal, electronic, etc.)
  • Ability to appropriately identify emergency situations and follow the appropriate protocol.
  • Must have the ability to maintain and manipulate a complex credentialing information system.
  • Must be able to prioritize multiple tasks and achieve deadlines.
  • Must have ability to adapt to changing environment.
  • Strong written and verbal skills are necessary.
  • Individual must possess initiative, judgement, exceptional organizational skills and keen attention to detail.
  • Must be able to work and process time-sensitive information.

Working Conditions and Additional Requirements (include special requirements, e.g., lifting, travel):

  • Must be able to work under normal office conditions and work from home as required.
  • Work may require simultaneous use of a telephone/headset and PC/keyboard and sitting for extended durations.
  • May be required to work additional hours beyond standard work schedule.

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Management retains the discretion to add to or change the duties of the position at any time.

Salary Range

$24.10 -$36.16

Compensation & Total Rewards Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position represents a range of salaries for this role and similar roles across the organization. The actual salary for this position will be determined by several factors, including the scope and complexity of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials, and experience of the candidate; as well as internal equity. As part of our comprehensive total rewards program, colleagues are also eligible for variable pay. Eligibility for any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits remains in the Company's sole discretion and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

Point32Health offers their Colleagues a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which currently includes:

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Retirement plans

  • Paid time off

  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance with additional buy-up coverage options

  • Tuition program

  • Well-being benefits

  • Full suite of benefits to support career development, individual & family health, and financial health

For more details on our total rewards programs, visit

We welcome all
All applicants are welcome and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Scam Alert: Point32Health has recently become aware of job posting scams where unauthorized individuals posing as Point32Health recruiters have placed job advertisements and reached out to potential candidates. These advertisements or individuals may ask the applicant to make a payment. Point32Health would never ask an applicant to make a payment related to a job application or job offer, or to pay for workplace equipment. jobs.description:
Software International (SI) supplies technical talent to a variety of clients ranging from Fortune 100/500/1000 companies to small and mid-sized organizations in Canada/US.

We have a Permanent or 12 month renewable contract as a Senior Mainframe Network System Programmer with our large consulting client, working on a long term project for one of Canada's largest banks. This could be an indefinite contract or a permanent role.

Role: Senior Mainframe Network System Programmer

Type: Permanent or Long Term Contract

Duration: 12 months to start + possible multiple extensions or a permanent role

Salary or Rate: approximately $180,000 - $230,000 + bonus as permanent employee or $110 - $135/hr + C2C - depending on overall experience

Location: Remote, Toronto, ON, Canada

As a Sr. Mainframe Network System Programmer, you are responsible for providing technical direction and subject matter expertise to ensure stable, reliable environments for complex sharing initiatives in compliance with established controls, standards, policies, and procedures. You will collaborate with and advise senior management, utilizing your solid understanding of business dynamics to analyze and protect test environment integrity and mitigate risks, present alternative solutions, and recommend solutions using available resources for complex initiatives with key dependencies. You will provide technical leadership, interpret complex information, and coordinate client, provider, and vendor relationships to meet and manage service expectations, aligned to best practices. In addition, you will help to develop the team to maximize individual contributions and professional growth, while functioning effectively with your colleagues.

The Network System Programmer role will be the subject matter expert for all mainframe related network architecture design requirements. The role will lead and implement all network hardware and software upgrades and testing exercises, and be the primary escalation point for mainframe incidents and OEM vendors for support. The role works closely with internal teams to understand cross-platform systems network connectivity requirements and ensures adherence to CIBC security Standards. The role will participate in annual Disaster Recovery planning and execution, provide on-call services to support mainframe systems availability, and be the escalation point for network incidents.

How you'll succeed

  • Technical Expertise you will leverage your solid technology expertise to review and analyze current client software and requirements to determine the most effective solution to include in business proposals; install, upgrade and customize ISV software tools in a multi-system z/OS mainframe environment, and help to ensure software and hardware remains current to avoid End of Support costs.
  • Effective Communication you will work to accomplish organizational goals that are consistent in supporting both IT and Business objectives, communicate effectively and patiently across technology teams to influence teams to adopt solutions to keep critical systems secure and operationally resilient. You will provide and document problem analysis, resolution, and prevention, designing procedures and best practice techniques, using IBM and ISV online tools for opening and managing problem report tracking and resolution. You will actively participate in periodic disaster recovery exercises, maintaining disaster recovery readiness of systems, and monitoring status of systems to proactively prevent issues from occurring.
  • Relationship Management You will collaborate with internal business partners in Application Development, Infrastructure, IT Operations, and IT Production Support to accomplish organizational goals that are consistent in supporting both IT and Business objectives. You will work directly with Hardware and Software vendors on solutions, build your network, and deepen existing relationships. You will leverage your verbal, written, and presentation communication skills to build strong partnerships, while influencing participants to mutually beneficial outcomes.

Who you are

  • You can demonstrate a minimum of 5 years' experience in Mainframe technology operating systems and specifically zOS Systems programming and configuring z/OS Communication Server. You also have knowledge or experience in:

Our lead program is a trispecific TCE with dual tumor antigen targeting for small cell lung cancer. We are looking for someone to own CMC for it end to end, from the handoff out of discovery through to IND.

This is a director-level role: hands-on and accountable for the work, not an executive building a function. The role reports on an interim basis to the Head of Research, pending the hire of the Chief Scientific Officer.

Responsibilities

  • Build one integrated CMC plan from development candidate nomination to first in human, and own the timeline inside it.
  • Run the CDMO selection as a competitive RFP rather than a negotiation with 1 vendor. The current field spans US, European and Chinese CDMOs, and the same package has to go to all of them so the quotes can be read against each other on a normalized basis.
  • Negotiate and manage the selected CDMO: cell line development, process development, analytical development, technology transfer, GMP drug substance and drug product, and stability.
  • Own quality for outsourced manufacture. We own no plant, so the quality agreement with the CDMO, batch record and deviation review, OOS handling, specifications, and the release and disposition decision on GMP material all sit with this role.
  • Own the CMC budget and forecast. The CDMO quotes in hand run into the high single digit millions, a significant share payable at order initiation, and vendors price schedule acceleration at a premium of roughly 20 percent. This role decides which of those line items are real and holds the forecast against the cash plan.
  • Own the analytical and release strategy, including the cell-based potency assay, which in our experience FDA asks for on a bispecific IND whether or not the CDMO quoted it.
  • Secure GLP tox material, which sits outside the current CDMO quotes, and own clinical supply downstream: labeling, packaging, comparator sourcing and shipment to trial sites.
  • Author and QC Module 3, build the CMC content of the pre-IND briefing package, and take part in the agency meetings that follow.
  • Flag the format-driven CMC risks early. The molecule is a multispecific, so correct chain pairing, product-related species and the purification strategy are live questions that should shape format selection rather than be discovered after it.

Qualifications and Experience

  • A PhD in a relevant discipline, or a BS or MS with at least 12 years in biologics CMC.
  • At least 1 biologic taken from development candidate to IND with the CMC package filed, ideally a bispecific or multispecific rather than a monoclonal.
  • Direct experience selecting and managing CDMOs, including writing the RFP and reading the quotes critically.
  • Quality fluency sufficient to negotiate a quality agreement and to make a release decision on outsourced GMP material.
  • Module 3 authoring or QC, and enough regulatory fluency to defend the CMC section in an agency meeting.
  • Comfort working with CDMOs in China alongside US and European options, and a clear view on the trade-offs.
  • Judgment on when to push a timeline and when to refuse one. We have been quoted anywhere from 6 to 13 months to a first GMP batch and we need someone who can tell which numbers are real.

What this role is not

A VP or head of function, a people manager, or a full-time hire on day 1. Depth on the work matters more than the title.

Company Culture

Collaboration, ownership and authenticity.

Terms

Consulting agreement to start, with a monthly hours cap, since there is 1 program today. Remote is fine and we have no geographic preference at this stage. As further programs reach the same point, the role is intended to convert to a full-time permanent position, which at that point would be co-located in San Francisco.

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge is growing from one product into a platform, creating new ways to serve health systems and reach different buyers. Each opportunity brings choices about the offer and the commercial motion that will make it work.

You will own those choices for a focused set of commercial priorities, from the first hypothesis through a tested recommendation. You will determine which buyers to pursue and build an offer around the problem they need to solve. Pricing and packaging will be central to that work, alongside the economic case and the path to a sale.

This is a senior individual contributor role on the Commercial Strategy team. You will do the analysis and write the first draft yourself, working closely with colleagues who bring product expertise and customer context. Your work should give leadership a clear decision and give the field an offer a buyer can understand and carry forward internally.

You will carry each body of work through an initial test and a clear handoff to the teams responsible for execution. The role requires commercial judgment and the ability to finish work that others can use.

What You'll Do

  • Setting direction

    • Recommend where we focus next and finish the work we choose. Compare opportunities against the resources and dependencies each requires. Agree on the decision to resolve and the handoff with the teams involved. Drive the work to a conclusion, raising unresolved choices early enough to keep it moving.

    • Own segmentation and targeting. Recommend which accounts we pursue for each offer, in what order, and through which buyer. Build cohort models from our own systems and public data, then translate them into prioritized account lists. Set proposed quarterly goals with Sales leaders, grounded in the opportunity and the capacity to execute.

  • Defining the offer

    • Shape new products and sales motions early. Work with Product and Finance while there is still room to influence the offer. Assess which segments to pursue and how to enter them, including opportunities to bundle capabilities or sell a standalone product. Define what we need to learn before committing further resources. This often means defining an offer for a buyer we haven't sold to before, where there is no existing pricing precedent.

    • Develop the commercial thesis for new offers. Define the target buyer and the problem worth solving, then recommend the package and pricing model. Explain how the offer gets bought and how it should evolve at expansion or renewal. Ground the recommendation in customer evidence and a model of the economics.

  • Aligning and launching

    • Translate pricing decisions into terms the business can apply. Partner with Deal Desk and Finance on the price book and approval rules. Make the intended tradeoffs clear, including when a commercial concession could unlock broader adoption or an expansion. Hand off guidance that can be applied consistently, and revisit it when results challenge the thesis.

    • Build and test the first commercial argument. Turn product capabilities into a buyer's reason to act, supported by a credible value case. Work with Sales and Partner Success to test it in customer conversations. Partner with Product Marketing and Enablement to turn the initial work into a repeatable field motion.

    • Close the evidence gaps behind a decision. Draw on Commercial Insights and conduct targeted buyer research where needed. Build the model yourself, making assumptions visible and showing how the recommendation changes under different scenarios. Distinguish demonstrated customer value from what still needs to be tested.

  • Reviewing and handing off

    • Use commercial results to recommend changes. Review pricing performance with Finance and Deal Desk, alongside what we are learning about adoption and buying behavior. Identify where the offer is working and where it needs to change. Bring a recommendation and the evidence behind it.

    • Recommend where we focus next and finish the work we choose. Compare opportunities against the resources and dependencies each requires. Agree on the decision to resolve and the handoff with the teams involved. Drive the work to a conclusion, raising unresolved choices early enough to keep it moving.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience developing commercial strategy for a complex B2B product, with work that reached customers and changed how the company sold. You can point to specific offers you defined that went to market, and to what happened to price, adoption or sales cycle afterward.

  • Hands-on pricing and packaging experience. You can explain the economics behind an offer and translate them into terms a buyer understands. You've set list prices, tiers or discount floors that a Deal Desk or sales team then applied, and you've changed a pricing model when the evidence called for it.

  • Experience pricing a product with no existing reference point, such as a new category, a new buyer or a new pricing unit, where you had to build the model from research instead of benchmarks.

  • Strong analytical skills. You can build a working model from incomplete inputs and identify which assumptions determine the recommendation. You work directly with account and usage data, combining it with external evidence to build actionable cohorts.

  • Clear writing that carries a skeptical reader through the reasoning. You produce a usable first draft and improve it through focused feedback.

  • Independent judgment. You take a position with the evidence available and change it when you learn something that warrants a different answer.

  • Ownership through completion. You have taken an ambiguous question through a decision and left other teams equipped to act.

  • The ability to influence across functions without owning every dependency. You can resolve competing priorities and surface decisions that need leadership involvement.

  • Curiosity about the product and the buyer's workflow. You learn enough about both to spot when an attractive idea will be difficult to buy or implement.

Bonus Points if

  • You have worked in healthcare technology and understand how health systems evaluate clinical or revenue cycle investments.

  • You have helped a company expand from a single product into a platform, or developed a commercial motion against an established incumbent.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

  • Full-Funnel Creative Strategy: Lead creative strategy across paid (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon), organic social (Instagram, TikTok), and retention (email, SMS, lifecycle), so every channel ladders up to one brand story.

  • Campaigns: Concept and lead the launch campaign and the large, integrated campaigns that follow, from the big idea through briefs, production, launch, and measuring what they actually did.

Give sharp, tactical feedback on design, pacing, and edit structure, and jump into Figma or an edit yourself when it's faster. This isn't the role for strategy-only folks.

You should apply if this sounds like you

WellQor is a patient centered, full-service psychological practice accessible online. We're a new model in care that marries the best of traditional and innovative approaches.

Our clinicians enjoy the full support of a treatment team, and our patients benefit from the full attention of a robust clinical organization.
The WellQor organization was founded to serve the needs of specialized populations. WellQor serves the needs of mature adults, and Wellfam serves the needs of teens and adolescents. Our providers understand the unique situational issues and clinical mental health challenges of each population.
Our practice is growing rapidly, and we owe our success to a family-oriented culture that puts people first. As a new provider, expect to feel loved, appreciated, and supported in a way that’s truly unique to WellQor.

And you won’t have to do it alone. We follow a care-team treatment model, which means clinicians are assigned to teams which they can connect with and consult for advice, institutional knowledge, and continued feedback. Clinicians collaborate with our Clinical Directors to develop treatment plans and obtain valuable feedback to ensure the best possible patient outcomes.

You will define your own availability, make your own schedules, and work according to your lifestyle. Some WellQor therapists work part time, and others carry full caseloads. Whatever your lifestyle demands, we’re here to meet you where you’re at.

You’ll own your client relationships end-to-end, drive predictable revenue growth, build connections across multiple stakeholders, and partner closely with Delivery to ensure Stitch’s work remains aligned with client priorities and creates measurable value.

The role requires lifecycle and relationship marketing experience to connect client customer-engagement priorities to the right strategies, technology, and Stitch services.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor by bringing strategic thinking, a clear point of view, and actionable recommendations across marketing, marketing technology, and marketing operations.

Job Title: Corporate Development Analyst Intern
Company: Solen Software Group
Location: Remote
Commitment: Full-time

About Solen Software Group

Solen Software Group is a long-term owner and operator of mission-critical B2B software companies. We acquire proven, profitable software businesses and partner with founders and management teams to build enduring market leaders. Unlike traditional private equity firms, Solen invests with permanent capital — focused on long-term value creation rather than short-term financial engineering.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly motivated intern to join our corporate development team and help us identify and evaluate acquisition opportunities. The role offers hands-on exposure to the early stages of the M&A process, from market research and target identification to financial analysis, initial opportunity assessment, and outreach to founders. As part of a lean team, you will work directly with Solen's M&A professionals, take ownership of meaningful projects, and contribute to real acquisition decisions. This is an opportunity for someone interested in M&A, strategy, and evaluating businesses to develop strong analytical and commercial skills in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research and map markets to identify potential B2B software acquisition targets.
  • Build and maintain databases of potential acquisition targets.
  • Gather and analyze financial and operational information on target companies.
  • Support the preliminary evaluation of companies and their strategic fit.
  • Monitor industry trends, market developments, and competitor activity.
  • Help develop and refine target selection criteria and acquisition strategies.
  • Prepare analyses and materials to support internal discussions on potential acquisitions.
  • Support outreach to founders, business owners, and intermediaries, and keep the M&A pipeline up to date.

Key Requirements

More than previous experience, we are looking for driven, intellectually curious people with strong analytical skills, initiative, and a genuine desire to learn.

  • Senior-year student or recent graduate in Business, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
  • Strong interest in M&A, corporate development, investment banking, private equity, or strategy.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to work with financial and operational data.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Excel.
  • Clear, structured written and verbal communication.
  • Advanced professional English, written and spoken (the interview process will be conducted in English).
  • High level of ownership, resourcefulness, and attention to detail.
  • Collaborative, professional, and comfortable working remotely in a dynamic environment.

Previous experience in investment banking, private equity, or corporate development is helpful but not required.

Solen-isms (How We Operate)

  • Ownership Mindset: We own the mission. We don't wait to be told. We lead, fix, and build as if it were ours. When problems arise, we run toward them, not away.
  • Benchmark to Best: We seek out excellence. We measure ourselves against the best and adapt quickly, always looking for the edge that moves us forward.
  • Openly Self-Critical: Leaders go first: they surface their misses early, ask for direct feedback, and turn “game film” into better decisions and better systems.
  • Disagree & Commit: Leaders disagree openly and constructively, regardless of title or tenure, because truth is how we avoid bureaucracy and benchmark to best.
  • Figureitoutiveness: Embracing challenges, fostering growth, and taking initiative, leaders thrive on hard work and high failure tolerance.
  • Mutual Elevation: Committed to growth, elevating teams, developing future leaders, and removing barriers to mastery and joy.
  • Learn-it-alls: Learn-it-alls, not know-it-alls, embracing failure as part of growth and progress.
  • Pioneering: Pioneering driven by opportunity, using first principles thinking and unbound by tradition or rules.
  • Will to Win: Leaders relentlessly pursue potential, reject mediocrity, and get what they tolerate.
  • Dialectical: We learn through conversation. We ask, listen, question, and evolve — valuing disagreement as a tool for alignment and deeper understanding.
  • Frugality: Achieving more with less, focusing on quality, long-term value, and company-wide responsibility.
  • Candor: We communicate with integrity, transparency, and respect in all conversations.
  • Kaizen: Kaizen is continuous improvement as a way of life. Leaders make hundreds of small upgrades that compound, turning lessons into standards and standards into durable systems.

Recruitment Disclaimer

logcat.ai is the AI engineering layer for the operating-system stack. We build agentic systems for Linux and Android devices: we ingest the diagnostic artifacts a device emits (bugreports, logcat, dmesg, modem traces, ramdumps, perfetto, pcap, CAN) and help device makers diagnose, remediate, test, and author features across their OS stack, grounded in their own BSP. Think Datadog and Cursor combined for the OS layer. A VC-backed startup with a small, senior team — you work directly with the founders.

We recently raised a $2.55M pre-seed. The product is scaling and the customer list is growing. The team is still small, so you'll own what you build.

Own the engine that turns every investigation into a compounding asset: the more the platform runs, the sharper it gets. This is applied ML systems, not research. If your goal is training foundation models from scratch and publishing, this is not the seat.

A note on location

Remote, with at least four hours of overlap with Pacific or IST. We don't track hours. We ask for the overlap because a lot of this work is debugging together in real time, and that doesn't work across a twelve-hour gap. If you're in Seattle or Bengaluru, we'd like to meet in person now and then. It isn't a requirement.

The bar

  • 10+ years of relevant engineering experience.
  • Production ML systems experience end to end: data pipelines, fine-tuning, eval, deployment.
  • Hands-on fine-tuning and distillation with open-weight models (Qwen, Llama-class).
  • Eval harness design for correctness-sensitive tasks, including trajectory-level evals for agentic and tool-use systems.
  • Inference deployment and scaling (vLLM or equivalent) on managed platforms.
  • Proficient in day-to-day work with CLI-based AI coding tools like Claude Code (or an equivalent). It's how the team operates, not a nice-to-have.

What you'll do

  • Instrument the product so every investigation, especially human-corrected ones, becomes structured training data.
  • Build the eval harness for diagnostic accuracy. Root-cause correctness has to be measured, not eyeballed.
  • Distill expensive deep-investigation runs into small, fine-tuned models that hold the quality bar at a fraction of the cost.
  • Deploy inference, including on-prem and airgapped SLMs for customers whose logs cannot leave their environment.

Bonus

  • Agent or tool-use systems.
  • Preference optimization (DPO/GRPO-style) and structured-output / function-calling fine-tunes.
  • On-prem or airgapped model deployment.
  • Retrieval over large heterogeneous corpora.
  • Systems or infra background.

What we offer you

  • A front seat as we scale. Customer calls, the roadmap, the pipeline, how the company is actually doing.
  • Top-of-market salary and founding equity. You'll own a piece of what you build.
  • The AI tools you need. We use AI across writing code, reviewing it, research, ops, and internal tooling. If something would help you work better, we'll get it.
  • Early ownership, and full visibility. We move fast, and you'll help decide where.
  • Comprehensive medical insurance for you and your family.
  • Start-up perks and flexible time off, the kind people actually take.
  • A small team that's easy to work with. People here like solving hard problems and helping each other out.

What to expect after you apply

  • Screening call with Head of People & Business Operations
  • Technical conversation with Co-founder/ Head of Engineering
  • Technical exercise with Co-founder/ Head of Engineering
  • Final conversation with CEO
  • References, then offer

In your application, tell us what you'd own here, and the hardest thing you've shipped in this domain.

jobs.description:
About Easy Dynamics Corporation

Easy Dynamics is a leading IT service provider specializing in cybersecurity, cloud computing, and risk management for federal agencies. Since 2006, we have partnered with our customers to design, build, and secure the systems that protect our people, places, and way of life. Our work is grounded in deep technical expertise, thoughtful problem-solving, and a clear understanding of the complex environments our customers operate in.

Our world-class team of engineers, consultants, and subject-matter experts are builders, problem-solvers, and trusted advisors who thrive on solving unique and ever-evolving digital challenges. We bring a hands-on, mission-focused approach to every engagement, delivering solutions that are built to last.

About the role

We are seeking an ICAM Operational Support Specialist to provide customer-facing Tier 2 and Tier 3 support on a federal Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) contract. This role resolves escalated identity and access issues across a SailPoint, Microsoft Entra ID, and GitHub environment, working directly with end users, application owners, and government stakeholders. The ideal candidate has hands-on identity and access management experience, is comfortable owning an issue through to resolution, and communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a fast-paced government contracting environment.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Tier 2 and Tier 3 identity, credential, and access issues escalated from Tier 1 helpdesk, resolving them directly with end users and application teams.
  • Investigate and resolve access provisioning, deprovisioning, and entitlement issues within SailPoint, including certification campaign errors, workflow failures, and connector or aggregation issues.
  • Troubleshoot authentication, single sign-on, conditional access, and identity federation issues within Microsoft Entra ID, including MFA enrollment problems, sign-in failures, and conditional access policy conflicts.
  • Log, track, and update all customer interactions and resolutions in ServiceNow maintaining accurate records for SLA reporting and audit purposes.
  • Perform root cause analysis on recurring or complex incidents and coordinate with engineering, security, and platform teams to implement permanent fixes rather than repeated workarounds.
  • Escalate systemic issues, policy gaps, or security concerns to program leadership and technical leads with clear, well-documented context.
  • Support identity lifecycle events, including onboarding, transfers, role changes, and offboarding, ensuring access is granted and removed accurately and on schedule.
  • Contribute to and maintain knowledge base articles, runbooks, and standard operating procedures to reduce resolution time on repeat issues.
  • Communicate proactively and professionally with end users and government customers, setting clear expectations and following through until an issue is fully resolved.
  • Participate in change management activities, testing, and validation for updates to SailPoint, Entra ID, or GitHub configurations that affect user access.
  • Support metrics reporting on ticket volume, resolution time, and SLA compliance for program status reviews.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in an operational support or service desk role within an identity, credential, and access management (ICAM) or IT security environment, including direct experience handling escalated (Tier 2/Tier 3) tickets.
  • Working experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including user and group management, conditional access, MFA, and SSO/federation troubleshooting.
  • Experience using a ticketing/ITSM system such as ServiceNow to manage, document, and resolve customer-reported issues against defined SLAs.
  • Strong customer service orientation, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical users and remain composed under pressure.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a federal government security clearance or suitability determination as required by the contract (Public Trust).
  • U.S. citizenship is required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a federal government ICAM program or FISMA-regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with identity governance frameworks such as NIST SP 800-63 (digital identity guidelines), FICAM, or Zero Trust identity principles.
  • Scripting or automation experience (PowerShell, Python) to support repetitive access or reporting tasks.

The salary range for this role: $90,000 - $115,000.

Easy Dynamics is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered for positions without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal state or local laws.

jobs.excerpt: Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!
jobs.description:
Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!

What do we do?💥

We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences.

Check out our ‘About Us’page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional.

Overview

Clariti is building a new product with a team that uses agentic development to move quickly. As a QA Engineer, you will help define how quality works across that process. You will shape the testing strategy, own the automation that backs it, and decide where testing effort will do the most good. You will work closely with developers, product, and AI-assisted tooling to keep quality high without slowing delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Shape quality from the start of each feature: work with product and engineering on acceptance criteria, testability, and definition of done before code is written.
  • Design and own the automated QA workflow for agentic delivery, from triage through test generation and execution reporting, and keep it reliable as volume grows.
  • Review AI-generated tests and code for correctness, gaps, and false confidence.
  • Probe beyond the written criteria, including edge cases, failure paths, data integrity, security, performance, and cross-system behavior, and feed what you find back into stories and the pipeline.
  • Keep coverage deliberate and efficient: map risk to tests, and prune generated or duplicate tests that add maintenance cost without adding confidence.
  • Design and maintain end-to-end and API automation with Playwright and TypeScript.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD quality gates so every change is verified before merge without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Track quality and efficiency metrics, such as escape rate, flake rate, acceptance-criteria coverage, suite runtime, and maintenance effort.
  • Triage failures across automated and human-written tests, find root causes, and fix the system so the same failure class doesn't recur.
  • Make technical quality decisions on architecture, test data, and environments.
  • Upskill the team on testing for agentic development, including how to specify work so that generated tests are useful.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in QA, SDET, or software engineering with a quality focus.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on Playwright automation with TypeScript or JavaScript.
  • Experience establishing or significantly shaping QA practices on a product, whether at a startup, scale-up, or new product team, and whether or not you were there from day one.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants and agentic tools in a real delivery workflow, with a clear view of where they are reliable and where human judgment is needed.
  • A quality-ownership mindset: you see quality across the whole system, raise concerns about unclear requirements early, and identify what needs testing without being told.
  • Exploratory and risk-based testing instincts: you find behavior nobody specified and judge which risks are worth the effort.
  • Ability to read and critically evaluate code, including code you did not write.
  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD test pipelines.
  • Solid grounding in Agile and test strategy, including risk-based planning, the test pyramid, and regression scope.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with one or more structured agentic development methodologies, and curiosity about how different teams practice them.
  • Experience designing evals or quality metrics for LLM- or agent-based systems.
  • Experience reducing test suite bloat or flakiness in a large automation codebase.
  • Experience with API testing tools (Postman, RestAssured) and contract testing.
  • Experience with Jira automation or test case management systems.

We invest in and empower our team members with competitive compensation packages, well deserved time off and benefits to keep you and your family healthy! *

💰 The base salary range for this role is expected to be between $75,000-$90,000 based on the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications while considering internal pay equity and our broader pay philosophy. 💰

If you have questions about compensation as we move through the process, we’re happy to discuss further.

*Benefits depend on employment type (full-time, part-time, contract, etc).

Things to Note 📝

Background checks - Because our customers trust us with sensitive information, we require all successful candidates to undergo comprehensive background checks before joining our team. We focus strictly on global sanctions and criminal offences that are directly relevant to employment at Clariti, and follow all applicable privacy and human rights legislation.

Travel- Although we operate as a remote company, all roles are expected to participate in occasional travel for in-person company-wide or departmental meetings, typically 1-2 times per year. Additional travel requirements specific to the role, if any, will be outlined in the job description.

We're committed to building an inclusive culture where our team members take ownership over projects, tasks, and outcomes; bring a growth mindset to drive continuous learning and self-development; have the ability to communicate courageously in a direct but respectful way; and are customer-focused by keeping the customer at the heart of decision-making. It’s the diversity of our team that helps us make better decisions, by leveraging the diversity in thought & experience across to create impactful solutions as we explore new paths & challenges as we grow. We’re working to create a workplace and team that is as diverse as the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

Questions? We are here to help

If you require accommodations in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in our hiring process for any reason, please direct your questions to and we’ll be happy to support you.

jobs.description:
Indigo is hiring a Senior Product Engineer to accelerate our work building organizing tools for progressive campaigns and organizations.

OUR MISSION

We believe that progressive campaigns focused on building sustained, authentic relationships with voters – rooted in voters’ material needs – are the key to systemic change in our country. In this moment of democratic backsliding and rising inequality, it’s particularly urgent that we deliver that kind of change.

To that end, we're building software and data products to help Democratic campaigns and progressive organizations run voter outreach programs that are genuinely responsive to people's needs and rooted in local communities.

WHAT IS INDIGO?

We build software and data products for Democratic campaigns and progressive advocacy organizations. We're a small team with a culture of autonomy, consistently challenging and varied work, and concrete opportunities for major impact. At the same time, our company has built partnerships with major organizations, allowing us to avoid the financial anxiety and growing pains that many similarly-sized startups face. It's a pretty great situation!

OUR PRINCIPLES

We have an opinion. Our products are strictly for Democratic campaigns and progressive organizations, and they're designed to help those users run substantively better programs and win more elections.

We believe in mutual respect. We've been lucky to build a team that consistently demonstrates kindness, humility, and integrity – toward each other and our users. Maintaining that culture is critical to delivering on our goals.

We value diversity. We'll need to collectively bring a range of lived experiences and backgrounds to meet the needs of the candidates and advocacy organizations we intend to serve.

We run a disciplined and focused operation. We aim to establish a business that's financially sustainable and whose products and roadmap are fully aligned with our mission.

We believe in the power of a small but mighty team. A group of passionate, independent, multi-talented builders can have more impact than much larger teams.

HOW WE BUILD

We're a human-driven, agents-forward engineering team. While everything we build is rooted in human-centered planning, design, architecture, and decision-making, coding agents have become an increasingly important part of our daily workflow. That said, we're very deliberate about how we use them. Agents have helped us to accelerate our work, but it’s also a major body of work to build appropriate skills, harnesses, and review systems to ensure the agents are doing what we want them to do, and doing it well.

THE ROLE

The person in this role will:

  • Turn ambiguous feature ideas into clear, well-scoped technical plans that both humans and agents can execute against
  • Make key architecture and design decisions
  • Work with a high level of autonomy and take ownership of major components of the product and code base
  • Ship lots of code
  • Collaborate with other engineers to build and maintain the scaffolding that makes agents effective in our codebase: context docs, skills, test harnesses, best practices, workflows, CI guardrails, and other tooling
  • Review code with rigor and a strong sense for which changes or decisions merit careful human attention and which can be safely delegated to agentic review
  • Help triage customer feedback and issues
  • Leverage large language models to boost the pace and quality of their work: faster development, more thorough code review, more comprehensive specs and mocks, etc.

Our product engineering team is responsible for developing and maintaining our web application (Matchbook) and its accompanying external API, as well as part of our data pipeline. Our stack includes React, GraphQL, Django, Postgres, dbt, BigQuery, and Google Cloud.

We don’t require familiarity with our specific stack, but you should have experience using a comparable modern web development stack in a production environment.

WHAT TO EXPECT

If you join our team, you'll be coding on day one, shipping code in week one, and directly contributing to the success of the progressive movement in this election cycle and beyond.

REMOTE ENVIRONMENT

Indigo is a remote organization with team members distributed around the United States. We'll hire the best people from anywhere in the country and support a remote working environment that's flexible, transparent, and trusting.

COMPENSATION

The salary for this role will be $170,000-$215,000 per year.

BENEFITS

  • Indigo covers 100% of health, dental, and vision coverage for employees and 80% for dependents
  • Employer-provided long-term disability and life insurance
  • 21 days of paid time off plus federal holidays
  • Unlimited sick leave
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave for parents of any gender, including adoptive parents
  • 401(K) match with immediate vesting

ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATIONS

We're generally looking for candidates with:

  • Demonstrated interest in and passion for progressive politics: we’re all here because we care deeply about our country and we believe that our work will play a critical role in the fight to defend democracy.
  • At least several years of experience as an engineer building a live product
  • Comfort working across a typical web stack, including the front end, back end / API, database, and infrastructure
  • Meaningful experience successfully leveraging coding agents and harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to strengthen and accelerate projects that have been deployed to customers at scale
  • A track record of designing clear technical plans and specs, and of decomposing large projects into work that can be delegated and verified
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills. In that vein, please write your cover letter in your own words (using an LLM for light copy editing is fine).
  • High emotional intelligence and empathy: the mutual respect and honesty underlying our relationships is our team’s greatest asset.
  • Some experience and comfort stepping a bit outside of your engineering role. We’re a small team with no formal product manager, designer, or UX researcher, and we expect our engineers to exercise end-to-end ownership and think through (and have an opinion on) the user-facing implications of every engineering decision.
  • Strong code review instincts: you can spot subtle bugs, weak abstractions, and quiet scope creep in code you didn't write.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment: we work reasonable hours and maintain a healthy work/life balance, but our development process moves quickly and our team members often wear multiple hats.
Salary: $170,000 – $215,000 / year

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
