We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
jobs.excerpt: The Senior Salesforce Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day configuration, administration, security, and continuous optimisation of DeterTech's Salesforce platform, ensuring it efficiently supports the organisation's commercial, operational, and customer objectives.
jobs.description:
The Senior Salesforce Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day configuration, administration, security, and continuous optimisation of DeterTech's Salesforce platform, ensuring it efficiently supports the organisation's commercial, operational, and customer objectives.

Serving as a senior subject matter expert for Salesforce, the role leads complex technical configuration, drives best practices in system setup, and works closely with business stakeholders to design scalable, user-friendly solutions.

The role balances advanced hands-on technical configuration with cross-functional business analysis, ensuring Salesforce maintains high standards of data quality, security, user adoption, and system stability as the business grows.

This is a remote role, although we value regular face-to-face collaboration. We would ideally like someone who can attend our Telford office around once a week if based locally, with a minimum expectation of a couple of office visits per month for those based further afield.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Operations
  • Act as the senior administrator for the Salesforce environment, ensuring platform stability, optimal performance, and operational alignment with business needs.
  • Support the execution of the Salesforce roadmap, identifying practical opportunities to enhance functionality, automation, and user experience.
  • Promote best practices in system administration, environment management (sandboxes), and user governance across the organisation.
  • Evaluate tri-annual Salesforce releases and new features, recommending relevant enhancements to internal stakeholders.
Configuration & Solution Design
  • Develop advanced platform configuration and customisation, including custom objects, fields, record types, complex Flows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.
  • Translate business and user requirements into scalable technical solutions that streamline workflows and enhance user productivity.
  • Proactively identify process bottlenecks and automate manual business activities using Salesforce Flow and standard platform tools.
  • Assist with third-party app integrations (AppExchange) and data management between Salesforce and connected business systems.
Business Partnership & Requirements Gathering
  • Collaborate closely with teams across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and IT to understand operational challenges.
  • Serve as a key technical contact for Salesforce enhancements, change requests, and optimisation projects.
  • Facilitate requirements-gathering discussions to turn business requests into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Provide constructive guidance to ensure proposed requests align with Salesforce best practices rather than over-customisation.

Data Governance, Security & Compliance
  • Maintain high standards of data hygiene, accuracy, and structural integrity across all Salesforce objects.
  • Manage user access, profiles, roles, permission sets, sharing rules, and security policies in alignment with company data protection standards.
  • Establish and execute routine audit procedures for data quality, permissions, and system maintenance.
  • Monitor overall system health, governor limits, and storage, proactively resolving issues or risks.
Reporting, Dashboards & Analytics
  • Design, build, and maintain robust reporting structures and executive dashboards to deliver operational and commercial visibility.
  • Support department leads with custom reports, data extracts, and analytical views to drive data-informed decision-making
  • Train users and managers on self-service reporting capabilities to increase data engagement.
User Support, Escalation & Capability Building
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex tier-2 and tier-3 Salesforce support queries and technical issues.
  • Design and deliver user training sessions and super-user enablement programs across business departments.
  • Create and maintain up-to-date system documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and end-user guides.
  • Champion platform adoption by actively gathering user feedback and resolving usability friction.

System Optimisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Regularly audit existing workflows, legacy configurations, and technical debt to simplify and streamline the platform.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives by contributing technical insights and executing hands-on build work.
  • Stay updated with emerging Salesforce technologies, certifications, and industry trends to continuously bring value to the organisation.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

  • Proven hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator in a commercial or corporate environment (typically 3–5+ years).
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) is required.
  • Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator (ADM-211) or Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder is highly desirable.
  • Additional certifications (e.g., Sales Cloud or Service Cloud Consultant) are an advantage.

Technical & Functional Skills
  • Deep hands-on expertise with Salesforce Flow Builder, Process Automation, Object Manager, and Security/Sharing Models.
  • Strong proficiency with data manipulation tools (Data Loader, DemandTools, or Workbench) and data governance techniques.
  • Proven track record of gathering requirements, writing clear documentation, and building declarative solutions without custom code where possible.
  • Experience managing sandboxes, deployment environments (Change Sets, DevOps Centre, or third-party deployment tools), and release management processes.
Behaviours & Key Attributes

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
User-focused mindset with a passionate approach to driving system adoption and user satisfaction.
Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
Proactive, collaborative team player who takes ownership of technical issues through to resolution.

Key Measures of Success
  • Platform Performance: Salesforce operates reliably, securely, and effectively to support business operations.
  • Business Adoption: High levels of user engagement, capability, and adoption across the organisation.
  • Continuous Improvement: Successful delivery of platform enhancements that improve efficiency and user experience.
  • Data Quality: High levels of data integrity, governance, and reporting accuracy.
  • Stakeholder Satisfaction: Positive feedback from business stakeholders and effective delivery of platform requirements.
  • Strategic Contribution: Salesforce capability evolves in line with organisational objectives and supports commercial and operational growth.

Description

The Senior Clinical Operations Manager (Sr. COM) is responsible for line management and performance oversight of Clinical Operations personnel, including Clinical Research Associates (CRAs), Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs), and other Clinical Operations roles. The Sr. COM ensures the delivery of high-quality, compliant, and efficient clinical monitoring and trial management services. This role provides strategic oversight, coaching, escalation support, and quality governance. The Sr. COM is also accountable for driving innovation, continuous improvement, and the adoption of technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.

This role will be perfect for you if:

  • You enjoy leading, coaching, and developing Clinical Operations professionals, while creating a collaborative and accountable team environment.
  • You are hands-on and quality-driven, and enjoy balancing resource management, clinical monitoring oversight, metrics, compliance, and proactive problem-solving.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, evolving CRO environment where you can bring new ideas, embrace technology and AI, and continuously improve the way Clinical Operations works.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the Senior Clinical Operations Manager must:

More specifically, the Clinical Operations Manager must:

  • Ensure that clinical monitoring and trial management activities of their assigned teams are performed to the Sponsor’s satisfaction, ensuring timely high-quality deliverables, within budget, and in accordance with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs), regulations, good clinical practices, and study-specific requirements.
  • Provide line management and performance oversight for Clinical Operations personnel, including Clinical Research Associates (CRAs), Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs), and other roles, ensuring they meet performance objectives aligned with departmental goals, study requirements, and company strategy, and taking appropriate remedial actions as required.
  • Support the hiring, onboarding, training, development, retention, and succession planning of Clinical Operations personnel, providing coaching and mentorship.
  • Assist in developing, delivering, and overseeing training programs and ensure consistent adoption of SOPs, tools, and systems.
  • Oversee resource planning and allocation across studies to ensure appropriate staffing and workload balance.
  • Track Clinical Operations metrics and monitor adherence to targets, including performance trends and capacity planning.
  • Ensure Clinical Operations activities are executed in accordance with approved study budgets and monitor utilization and financial performance.
  • Partner with Project Management and Finance to identify risks and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Perform or oversee Quality Assessment Visits (QAVs) and site visit report reviews.
  • Identify risks and quality issues and ensure implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Serve as escalation point for Clinical Operations teams, sponsors, and stakeholders· Drive innovation and continuous improvement, including adoption of technology and AI-enabled solutions.

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a field relevant to clinical research.

﻿Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of clinical research experience in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or CRO industry, including monitoring and senior operational oversight as a Clinical Operations Manager, Project Manager, Clinical Trial manager, or equivalent job role.
  • Good experience in the field of monitoring.
  • Experience in a CRO is an asset.

Knowledge and skills

  • Excellent oral and written English skills;
  • Excellent mastery of Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, Power Point);
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced evolving environment and establish good relationships with colleagues and sponsors;
  • Ability to liaise successfully with clinical project teams and other departments;
  • Quick learner, good adaptability and versatile;
  • Demonstrated interest and proficiency in innovation, digital transformation, and operational process optimization within clinical research;
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools and productivity platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, or similar technologies) to support daily work activities and improve efficiency;
  • Comfortable working in evolving environments and adapting to new technologies, systems, and industry practices;
  • Proven ability to lead change management initiatives and influence cross-functional teams;
  • Excellent leadership, judgement, and problem-solving skills;
  • Strong organizational, communication, time management and multi-tasking skills;
  • Travel up to 20% of the time;
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, applicable Health Canada, Food and Drug Administration (FDA), European Medicines Agency (EMA) regulations/guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Vacation, benefits, health allowance
  • RRSP or 401K
  • Yearly bonus structure %
  • Home-based position with teleworking allowance
  • Ongoing learning and development

Work location

This position is opened to candidates across Canada or the United States (home-based position).

Recruitment process: what to expect

  • As part of the recruitment process for this position you will meet various team members at Indero
  • The first interview will be conducted by Teams (30 minutes) and the second via video conference (1 hour)
  • The second interview includes a short presentation for which reasonable advance preparation is required (preparation is not timed and can be completed over a few days). You may think of it as one interview question for which you have the opportunity to develop a strong structured response that goes beyond the surface.

About Indero

Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology and rheumatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About LearneoLearneo is a platform of builder-driven businesses, including Course Hero, CliffsNotes, LitCharts, Quillbot, Symbolab, and Scribbr, all united around a shared mission of supercharging productivity and learning for everyone. We attract and scale high growth businesses built and run by visionary entrepreneurs. Each team innovates independently but has a unique opportunity to collaborate, experiment, and grow together, and they are supported by centralized corporate operations functions, including HR, Finance and Legal.


Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Affiliate Partnership Specialist to own and scale Quillbot's affiliate growth program end to end. You will drive partner recruitment, onboarding, and activation across a network of 2,000+ partners spanning product reviewers, comparison sites, creators, cashback platforms, and verified communities. You will optimize program performance, manage commercial terms, oversee quality control, and use structured analysis to improve CAC, ROAS, and partner ROI. You will partner with Creative, Product, Finance, and Legal to expand the partner ecosystem, enhance tracking and measurement, and ensure compliance and revenue quality. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct ownership of partner relationships, program operations, and performance growth.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute comprehensive affiliate marketing strategies to drive partner recruitment, activation, and revenue growth across QuillBot's global affiliate ecosystem.
  • Identify, recruit, and onboard strategic affiliate partners; negotiate and manage contracts, commission structures, and incentive programs to expand the network, drive performance, and maximize ROI.
  • Setup and manage affiliate relationships end to end, including tracking codes, promotional offers, payment reconciliation, and ongoing partner support to ensure activation, retention, and positive relationships.
  • Analyze affiliate performance across cohorts, geographies, and partner types, track and measure key metrics (conversion quality, revenue, CAC, LTV, fraud indicators) and present findings and optimization recommendations to senior management.
  • Manage commission spend within approved budgets and recommend reallocations based on partner performance, growth opportunities, and ROI.
  • Design and run structured tests across partner incentives, offers, audience segments, commission tiers, and campaign mechanics to optimize conversion rates and partner engagement.
  • Partner with Creative to build compelling promotional materials, and affiliate assets to support partner activation, campaign execution, and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product, Brand, Data, and Engineering teams to align affiliate initiatives with business objectives, optimize tracking and attribution, implement fraud detection, and improve measurement accuracy.
  • Stay informed about emerging trends, competition, technologies, regulatory changes, and best practices in affiliate marketing. Share insights and recommendations with internal stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bring 5+ years of hands-on affiliate marketing experience, preferably within a B2C subscription or consumer technology business.
  • Demonstrate success recruiting, onboarding, and scaling affiliate partner networks, managing partner performance, and making data-based commission and budget recommendations against acquisition, revenue, and ROI goals.
  • Bring deep hands-on experience with affiliate platforms and networks such as Impact, PartnerStack or comparable affiliate management systems.
  • Analytical judgment to diagnose partner performance changes, identify high-potential segments, prioritize optimization opportunities, and translate data into practical partner and program actions.
  • Understanding of attribution, fraud detection, and quality-control concepts and use measurement findings to inform partner recruitment, incentive design, and program decisions.
  • Work confidently with performance findings and recommendations clearly through dashboards, written updates, and structured presentations to internal stakeholders and partners.
  • Collaborate effectively across remote, cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product, Brand, Data, and Finance, manage multiple partner relationships and priorities with a high degree of ownership.
  • Bring experience recruiting, onboarding, and managing affiliate partners across international markets.
  • Have experience designing and analyzing structured tests or experiments to optimize partner incentives, offers, or conversion mechanics.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus
  • Medical coverage
  • Life and accidental insurance
  • Vacation & leaves of absence (menstrual, flexible, special, and more!)
  • Developmental opportunities through education & developmental reimbursements & professional workshops
  • Maternity & parental leave
  • Hybrid & remote model with flexible working hours
  • On-site & remote company events throughout the year
  • Tech & WFH stipends & new hire allowances
  • Employee referral program
  • Premium access to Quillbot

*Benefits and benefit amounts differ by region. A comprehensive list applicable to your region will be provided in your interview process.

This role is eligible for hire in India. Candidates must have existing authorization to work in India and must not require current or future company sponsorship for employment authorization.

We are a virtual-first company with employees primarily in the United States, Canada, and India. Our compensation approach is market-based and varies by location while ensuring fairness, consistency, and transparency.

The base pay for this role is determined by several factors, including:

  • Relevant professional experience
  • Skills and expertise
  • Scope and responsibilities of the role
  • Internal equity considerations

In addition to base salary, total compensation may include bonus, equity, and benefits. Eligibility depends on role, level, and location.

We are committed to equal pay for equal work, and all compensation decisions are made using consistent, gender-neutral criteria in alignment with pay transparency requirements.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don't apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. We strongly encourage you to apply if you're interested: we'd love to learn how you can amplify our team with your unique experience!

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Turn Business Challenges into Digital Experiences That Matter

Do you enjoy asking "why" before jumping to a solution?

Are you the person who can walk into a room full of stakeholders, uncover the real business problem, and translate complex requirements into actionable solutions for developers, architects, and product teams?

If so, we'd love to meet you.

At dentsu, we're looking for a Senior Business Analyst to help shape and deliver enterprise-scale digital experience solutions powered by the Adobe Experience Cloud. In this role, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to clients, leading discovery workshops, defining requirements, and partnering with cross-functional teams to bring digital experiences to life.

Why This Role Is Exciting

This isn't a role where you simply document requirements.

You'll have a seat at the table from day one, helping clients define their vision, challenge assumptions, resolve ambiguity, and develop solutions that create meaningful business value. You'll work alongside solution architects, UX designers, developers, QA teams, product owners, and business leaders to deliver innovative Adobe-powered experiences.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead Discovery & Shape Solutions

  • Facilitate stakeholder interviews, discovery workshops, and requirements-gathering sessions.
  • Uncover business needs and translate them into clear, actionable requirements.
  • Help stakeholders differentiate between business objectives, technical requirements, and solution preferences.
  • Drive conversations that move projects from ambiguity to clarity.

Drive Agile Delivery

  • Develop epics, features, user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
  • Own requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Partner with Product Owners and delivery teams to prioritize work and maximize value.

Be the Bridge Between Business and Technology

  • Collaborate with architects, developers, UX teams, QA teams, and stakeholders.
  • Evaluate business requirements against Adobe platform capabilities and constraints.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, gaps, and opportunities before they impact delivery.
  • Support testing, UAT, release readiness, and business validation activities.

What You'll Work With

You'll work across leading Adobe technologies, including:

  • Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Sites
  • Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Assets
  • Adobe Edge Delivery Services
  • Adobe Workfront
  • Adobe Content Hub
  • Adobe Dynamic Media
  • Other Adobe Experience Cloud solutions

What Makes You Successful

You thrive when:

  • Leading discovery workshops and stakeholder discussions.
  • Solving complex business problems.
  • Working in Agile environments.
  • Building relationships with both business and technical teams.
  • Turning ideas into clear user stories and executable requirements.
  • Driving projects forward without needing constant direction.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of Business Analysis experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM Sites and/or AEM Assets).
  • Strong Agile and Scrum experience.
  • Expertise with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience supporting QA, UAT, and release activities.
  • Proven ability to lead requirements discovery and stakeholder workshops.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and consulting skills.

Why dentsu?

At dentsu, you'll have the opportunity to work on enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives for leading brands while partnering with some of the brightest minds in experience design, technology, and innovation. You'll be empowered to influence solutions, drive strategic conversations, and make a measurable impact on the client experience.

Ready to help organizations turn business goals into exceptional digital experiences?

Apply today and become part of a team that's redefining what's possible with Adobe Experience Cloud.





At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office.

The annual salary range for this position is $78,000 - $110,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

Benefits available with this position include:

• Medical, vision, and dental insurance,

• Life insurance,

• Short-term and long-term disability insurance,

• 401k,

• Flexible paid time off,

• At least 15 paid holidays per year,

• Paid sick and safe leave, and

• Paid parental leave.

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com.

To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Medical and Scientific Communications
jobs.excerpt: Vera Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the pursuit of truth in science to transform medicine in autoimmune disease, starting with the kidney.
jobs.description:
Vera Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the pursuit of truth in science to transform medicine in autoimmune disease, starting with the kidney. Vera Therapeutics’ flagship commercial product is TRUTAKNATM (atacicept-vymj), a B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and A proliferation-inducing ligand (APRIL) inhibitor. Vera Therapeutics is evaluating multiple diseases where the reduction of autoantibodies through inhibition of BAFF and APRIL may prove clinically meaningful. Vera Therapeutics was founded in 2016 and is based in Brisbane, California. To learn more, visit .
At Vera, our values are the cornerstone of our culture and guide how we work together every day. We lead with empathy, act with an owner’s mindset, demand clarity, work without fences, and execute with urgency because patients are counting on us. From how we hire and develop our people to how we advance rigorous science, we are building a team committed to transforming medicine in autoimmune diseases, starting with the kidney.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Vice President, Medical and Scientific Communications, the Senior Director, Medical and Scientific Communications will lead the development and execution of Vera's publication and scientific congress strategy. Working in close partnership with the Vice President and with colleagues across Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Medical Affairs, and Commercial, this individual is responsible for ensuring that clinical and scientific data are communicated in a timely, accurate, consistent, and impactful manner across manuscripts, congresses, and other scientific communications, in alignment with the medical and scientific communication platform owned by the Vice President.

This is a highly cross-functional and hands-on role requiring both strategic leadership and strong executional capability. The Senior Director will work closely with Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, Regulatory, and Commercial to translate clinical development milestones, emerging data, and scientific priorities into an integrated, long-range publication and congress plan.

The successful candidate will bring exceptional scientific judgment, writing and editorial skill and the ability to identify inconsistencies or gaps in the scientific narrative across programs and materials. This individual serves as a steward of Vera's scientific story and partners across functions to build the scalable publication and congress infrastructure the pipeline requires.

Responsibilities

Strategy and Scientific Narrative

  • Lead the development of the long-range publication plan in partnership with Clinical Development, Biostatistics, and Medical Affairs, aligning data dissemination priorities with clinical development milestones and program strategy, for review and approval by the Vice President, Medical and Scientific Communications.
  • Build and maintain an integrated publication roadmap encompassing manuscripts, abstracts, posters, oral presentations, encore presentations, and other scientific communications.
  • Translate clinical development plans, data readouts, and key milestones into proactive publication and congress strategies, partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to establish publication priorities, sequencing, and timelines.
  • Anticipate future evidence and communication needs and evolve the publication plan as clinical programs and the external scientific landscape advance.
  • Develop and maintain publication-level scientific content and evidence-based messaging that apply the medical and scientific communication platform and bring proposed changes to the platform or core narrative to the Vice President for decision.

Publications and Congresses

  • Lead development of the scientific congress strategy in collaboration with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, and Commercial, mapping anticipated data releases to relevant congresses, coordinating planning and execution of abstracts, posters, and oral presentations, and maintaining awareness of major scientific meetings and competitive data.
  • Draft, edit, and critically review scientific content, including manuscripts, abstracts, posters, oral presentations, and scientific slide decks, ensuring materials accurately communicate the significance, limitations, and context of clinical findings and maintain a high standard of scientific rigor, clarity, and consistency.
  • Lead the end-to-end publication development process from concept and data availability through submission, presentation, publication, and post-publication activity, establishing timelines, milestones, roles, and responsibilities with cross-functional input.
  • Coordinate internal and external author review, including resolution of conflicting feedback and documentation of author contributions, and build productive working relationships with investigators and external authors.
  • Ensure publications comply with applicable standards and guidelines, including Good Publication Practice (GPP), ICMJE authorship criteria, company policies, and journal and congress requirements.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Clinical Development and Biostatistics to interpret clinical datasets, statistical outputs, tables, listings, and figures and translate them into high-quality scientific communications.
  • Engage early in the clinical development and analysis process to ensure planned data outputs support anticipated publications and congress submissions, and identify additional analyses that strengthen the scientific evidence base.
  • Serve as the scientific communications partner to Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, Regulatory, and Commercial, building alignment on data dissemination priorities, scientific messages, timelines, and deliverables, and influencing decisions without relying on direct authority.
  • Review cross-functional materials for consistency with the approved scientific narrative and underlying evidence.
  • Identify scientific communication risks, gaps, or inconsistencies and recommend solutions.

Operations and Vendor Management

  • Optimize Vera's publication planning and development processes, establishing efficient and scalable workflows, governance, templates, tools, and review processes, and identifying bottlenecks and opportunities to improve speed, quality, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Maintain the systems that track publication status, deadlines, dependencies, author reviews, and key decisions, and provide metrics and reporting that give the team and cross-functional leadership visibility into progress against the publication plan.
  • Coordinate the cross-functional publication planning committee, preparing materials and recommendations.
  • Manage external medical communications agencies, publication vendors, and freelance medical writers, setting clear expectations for scientific quality, deliverables, timelines, and spend, and providing active scientific and editorial direction that complements agency capability with internal scientific judgment.
  • Build and maintain publication and congress forecasts and manage delivery within the Medical and Scientific Communications budget held by the Vice President.

Travel: up to 30% for congresses, advisory meetings, and other business activities.

Qualifications

Required

  • Advanced scientific or clinical degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent) in a relevant discipline.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in scientific communications, medical writing, or publications within the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or medical communications industry, including at least 8 years of direct experience in medical writing and scientific publications and the development of peer-reviewed manuscripts and scientific congress presentations.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic publication plans for clinical-stage programs.
  • Strong understanding of clinical development and demonstrated ability to interpret clinical trial data, statistical analyses, tables, figures, and other data outputs.
  • Experience working directly with Clinical Development and Biostatistics to translate complex clinical data into scientific publications and communications.
  • Exceptional scientific writing, editing, and critical review skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear and compelling scientific narratives.
  • Demonstrated experience managing publication development and external author review.
  • Knowledge of Good Publication Practice (GPP), ICMJE authorship guidelines, and applicable publication standards and ethical requirements.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare compliance requirements governing medical communications, including relevant OIG, PhRMA, and EFPIA guidelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage external medical communications agencies and vendors.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced biotechnology environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and influencing skills with demonstrated ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams.

Preferred

  • Scientific training or research experience in nephrology, immunology, or a closely related discipline.
  • Deep scientific knowledge of nephrology, immunology, autoimmune disease, or related therapeutic areas, with experience in IgA nephropathy or related glomerular diseases a plus.
  • Experience developing long-range publication strategies that integrate clinical development milestones, statistical analyses, congress opportunities, and manuscript planning.
  • Experience supporting scientific communication platforms and core scientific narratives.
  • Prior people leadership experience within a publications or medical communications function.
  • Certified Medical Publication Professional (CMPP) credential.

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate combines scientific depth, strategic thinking, and exceptional execution. They are equally comfortable building a multi-year publication plan, discussing clinical and statistical outputs with physicians and biostatisticians, editing a manuscript, working through author comments, identifying an inconsistency in the scientific narrative, or holding an agency accountable for a critical deliverable.

This individual is intellectually curious, detail-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable operating with a high degree of ownership. Success in this role requires the ability to see the broader scientific story while maintaining rigorous attention to the data and details that support it, and to work in close partnership with the Vice President, who holds final decision rights on the scientific communication platform and on scientific accuracy.

Vera Therapeutics Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer.

Vera Therapeutics is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices and we strive to provide employees with total compensation packages that are market competitive. The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s geography, qualifications, skills, and experience.

For this role, the anticipated base pay range is
$220,000—$330,000 USD

At Vera, base pay is only one part of your total compensation package. The successful candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus, new hire equity, and ongoing performance-based equity. Vera Therapeutics also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k match, flexible time off, and a number of paid holidays.

Notice to Recruiters/Staffing Agencies

Recruiters and staffing agencies should not contact Vera Therapeutics through this page. All recruitment vendors (search firms, recruitment agencies, and staffing companies) are prohibited from contacting our hiring manager(s), executive team members, or employees.

We require that all recruiters and staffing agencies have a fully executed, formal written agreement on file.

Vera Therapeutics’ receipt or acceptance of an unsolicited resume submitted by a vendor organization to this website or employee does not constitute an actual or implied contract between Vera Therapeutics and such organization and will be considered unsolicited and Vera Therapeutics will not be responsible for related fees.

Fraud Alert

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are a top priority for us. At Vera Therapeutics, recruiters only direct candidates to apply through our official career page at .

Recruiters will always contact you using the domain of veratx.com. We will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information like social security numbers. If you are unsure if a message is from Vera Therapeutics, please email human resources.

CA Privacy Notice

Applicants residing in California should review our California Privacy Notice for Employees, Job Applicants, and Contractors, which describes the categories of personal information we collect, how we use it, and your privacy rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act: .

jobs.excerpt: AI Solutions DeveloperFull-time · Remote (US) P3 Adaptive is an AI and data consultancy built on Microsoft technologies: Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft 365, and Azure.
jobs.description:
AI Solutions Developer

Full-time · Remote (US)

P3 Adaptive is an AI and data consultancy built on Microsoft technologies: Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft 365, and Azure. We’re hiring a software engineer to build AI applications across client engagements, our own products, and reusable tools for our consultants.

In this role, you’ll partner with clients and the consultants who know their data, work through the problem together, and build the software that solves it, whether that’s an agent that answers questions about company data or an app that takes a repetitive task off someone’s plate.

Why this job is different

You'll know why you're building it. Every project starts with a client problem we think we can solve or a tool our own team needs. Each solution is built for that client's situation. If it stops making sense, we change course.

We're honest with clients. We don't sell anyone the wrong thing. Ever. When something isn't a good fit, we say so.

Direct client contact. You’ll be on the call with clients from the first conversation through go-live. Nobody in between translating requirements. Real conversations with real people about real problems.

AI is how we work. You'll use coding agents like Claude Code and Codex every day. They'll write a lot of the code. You pick the right tool for the job, decide what gets built, check that it works, and own what ships.

Remote, with a life. We're fully remote in the US and overlap for a few core hours on weekdays. Working faster doesn't mean working more. We mean it about having a life outside work.

What you'll actually do

The consulting work:

  • Leading client conversations to understand the business problem behind the request, then translating it into what to build.
  • Keeping projects on track: raising risks early, keeping each milestone demonstrable, and flagging scope changes the moment you see them.
  • Training client teams so they can own and run what you build.
  • Spotting the next problem worth solving for a client and bringing it to your account team.
  • Demonstrating solutions to colleagues and clients. You'll explain how they work, answer questions about their limitations, and discuss what's needed to put them into use.

The engineering work:

  • Building and maintaining AI applications and agents, taking features from a prototype through testing and deployment.
  • Connecting applications to Power BI semantic models, Fabric data, and other business systems through APIs, with appropriate sign-in and access permissions.
  • Investigating bugs and performance problems, checking AI responses against the underlying data, and improving application reliability.
  • Creating examples, templates, and documentation so other people can use and maintain what you build.
  • Trying new AI tools on practical problems and sharing what's worth using and why.

We're looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out and brings ideas of their own. You'll have support and code review from the team, with responsibility for the work you take on. Independent experimentation matters here, and so does knowing when to ask a question or work through a problem with someone else.

What you need

Consulting Skills

  • You care as much about business impact as technical polish.
  • You can translate a client’s frustration into a technical and human solve.
  • You’re comfortable presenting to a C-suite or a front-line manager, with the professional presence clients trust with their business.
  • Clear communication. You can explain a technical decision to another developer and describe what an application does to someone who doesn't write code.

Engineering Skills

  • Three or more years of software development experience, including maintaining applications after launch.
  • Experience building web applications with React and TypeScript, including connecting interfaces to APIs and working with application data.
  • Hands-on experience developing software with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex. You can provide useful context, guide the work, review changes, and verify the results.
  • Solid programming fundamentals. You're comfortable using Git, reading unfamiliar code, and tracing problems through an application.
  • An understanding of Power BI and Microsoft Fabric concepts, including how data is organized and modeled for reporting and analysis. Hands-on experience with these products is welcome but isn't required.
  • Familiarity with the Microsoft ecosystem and the basics of cloud services, authentication, and permissions.

Nice to have

Experience with Next.js, Python, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Graph, or MCP would be useful. Previous consulting work or experience building tools for other developers would also help.

What we offer

  • Base salary: $125-150k
  • Full benefits: Medical, dental, vision, life, 401k
  • Remote work: US-based team. Your home office wherever makes you happiest
  • Professional growth: Time built in to try new tools on real problems and share what you find. People here want to see you grow, and they'll jump in when you're stuck

Our values

We hire for the same five values in every role at P3:

  • Reliable. You do what you said you'd do, and what you ship keeps working.
  • Adaptable. The tools change every month. You change with them, and you change course when a project stops making sense.
  • Proactive. You flag a problem the moment you see it, and you fix the small things before anyone has to ask.
  • Invested. You care whether the client's business actually gets better.
  • Direct. You say plainly what works, what doesn't, and what you don't know yet.

About P3 Adaptive

We've been modernizing organizations' relationship with data since 2010. We pair deep technical skill with business sense, and we skip the deck theater and the jargon. Our teams are small, senior, and hands-on, and work doesn't pass through a chain of handoffs.

We're building on top of the AI wave. If you want to build the AI that changes how companies use their data, we're ready to meet you.

P3 Adaptive is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Period.

This position is open to people authorized to work in the United States. We don't sponsor work visas.

Salary: $125,000 – $150,000 / year

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role

Build and improve ML systems that power our AI-native applications.

Work on classification, retrieval, ranking, personalization and evaluation, taking ownership from model development to production deployment.

This role is for engineers who enjoy solving practical ML problems, improving model quality and shipping reliable systems used by real users.

Focus

  • Build and improve ML models for classification, ranking, retrieval and personalization.

  • Develop efficient classifiers and optimize model accuracy, precision, latency and cost.

  • Improve search relevance and context retrieval using embeddings, hybrid search and reranking.

  • Build personalization models that learn from user behavior while respecting privacy.

  • Develop evaluation pipelines, labeled datasets and metrics to measure model quality.

  • Fine-tune and adapt existing models when supported by sufficient data.

  • Build and maintain ML training, inference and deployment pipelines.

  • Debug production issues, monitor model performance and ship improvements based on real-world feedback.

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • Embeddings, vector search and ranking models

  • Production ML systems and inference pipelines

Ideal Experience

  • Strong foundations in machine learning and modern neural architectures.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production.

  • Experience in classification, ranking, retrieval, recommendation systems or personalization.

  • Understanding of model evaluation, experimentation and performance metrics.

  • Comfortable writing production-quality code and working with real-world datasets.

  • Able to balance model quality, latency, cost and reliability.

  • Strong ownership, problem-solving skills

Outcomes

  • ML models in production meet expected accuracy, relevance, latency and reliability targets.

  • Classification and ranking improvements deliver measurable gains in model quality.

  • Evaluation pipelines identify regressions and support reliable model releases.

  • Training, inference and data pipelines are robust, reproducible and maintainable.

  • Model improvements are driven by real-world feedback and measurable results.

  • Collaborates effectively with engineering and product teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, world-class teams. We are a high-talent-density, hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move quickly, balancing high-quality work with continuous learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put a truly magical product into the hands of our users.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted virtually and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Generative AI Associate(PHD) - Flexible Hours
jobs.excerpt: Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company.
jobs.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

At Innodata, we’re partnering with the world’s leading technology companies to build the future of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re on the lookout for smart, savvy, and curious Generative AI Specialist to join our global contributor community as part of our Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Demand program.

This is not a traditional full-time role. It’s a part-time, remote, flexible, project-specific opportunity designed for those who want to make a real impact—on their schedule. Whether you're a writer, linguist, educator, researcher, or just deeply passionate about language and logic, this role lets you contribute to cutting-edge AI development while maintaining control over your time.

You’ll be helping LLMs learn the intricacies of language and reasoning—not just how to write, but how to think. If you’ve ever dreamed of shaping the intelligence behind tomorrow’s technology, this is your chance.

This is more than just a gig—it’s a rare chance to help shape the future of AI from anywhere in the world, on your own terms.

What You’ll Own:

  • Rating/assessing the performance of AI models or algorithms based on their output or behavior through a set of evaluative questions.
  • Labeling elements of a piece of content rather than the content as a whole.
  • Assigning predefined categories or labels to items.
  • Evaluating the perceived quality and/or appropriateness of content
  • Generating labels to advance understanding of a concept, trend etc.
  • Creation of additional training data for machine learning models by applying transformations to the original data, such as modifying images (rotation, flipping, cropping), generating new text (paraphrasing, summarization), or altering audio/video signals (speed modification, pitch shifting) to reduce overfitting and increase dataset diversity.
  • Reviewing data and identifying whether or not a product feature works as intended based on the project's guidelines.
  • Labeling model outputs to identify if a piece of content is or isn't something. Examples: identify clickbait; identifying gaming videos; identifying branded content.
  • Ordering or ranking items based on a set of preferences or criteria.
  • Creating prompts or questions that will be used to generate responses from a language model or other AI system.
  • Projects that evaluate the relevance of content based on a relevancy scale (1-3, 1-5, etc.).
  • Generating responses to prompts or questions using a language model or other AI system.
  • Rewriting existing text while preserving the original meaning, often to improve clarity or style and adherence to guidelines.
  • Producing concise summaries of longer pieces of text or data.
  • Converting spoken language or audio content into written text.
  • Converting text or spoken language from one language to another.
  • Gathering and compiling various forms of data to be used for training, evaluating, or fine-tuning the AI models. This may include text, images, videos, audio files, or other types of digital content.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • PHD is required
  • Professional or Expert level proficiency (C1/C2) in English

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $25-$30 p/hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more on how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s guide at

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a recruitment scam, please report it to Innodata at and consider reporting it to the FTC at .

Decision Inc. is at the forefront of helping businesses make data-driven decisions through innovative technology. We're seeking a Senior FP&A Consultant to design and implement financial planning and analysis solutions that align with our clients' strategic goals.

Decision Inc. is a global digital partner that enables businesses to reinvent themselves to realise their full potential.

We deliver agility, resilience, and intelligence to any enterprise, enabling them to adapt quickly and thrive through innovation and opportunity. Our teams have engaged with more than 400 clients globally over the past 15 years, providing them with the expertise to build, operate, and optimise their digital businesses.

We achieve this by leveraging the world's best technology to drive our client's business ambitions forward into tomorrow's reality. These technologies include but are not limited to: Microsoft, SAP, Qlik, Snowflake, Alteryx, Automation Anywhere, and Workday Adaptive Insights.

What Will You Do?
