  • The Senior FP&A Consultant partners with the client to define both functional and technical requirements, ensuring the design and delivery of planning models that align with their strategic financial goals.
  • Facilitate client workshops to gather functional requirements, translate these into technical designs, and develop a comprehensive solution blueprint.
  • Define and develop system integration processes, ensuring seamless data flow from various source systems as per client requirements.
  • Implement, test, and optimize FP&A models to support business planning, budgeting, and reporting in line with the agreed solution design.
  • Compile all relevant documentation, including functional and technical specifications, blueprints, test cases (Unit and UAT), functional and technical design specifications, and training materials for the implemented solution.
  • Conduct quality assurance testing on solutions developed by other consultants to ensure adherence to project governance and standards.

  • Collaborate with project management to create project plans, track project status, identify issues, and assess risks and benefits.
  • Utilize your expertise in data modelling and structures to create effective financial reporting and analysis tools that address client KPIs.
  • Lead the setup, configuration, prototyping, and testing of FP&A systems, ensuring they meet the defined solution design.
  • Manage and mentor junior team members, providing technical guidance and ensuring high-quality delivery as both a technology expert and solution owner.

  • Leadership and Ownership: A proactive leader with a keen interest in managing teams and taking full ownership of project delivery.
  • FP&A Expertise: Minimum of 7 years of experience in FP&A or EPM (Enterprise Performance Management) systems with multiple full lifecycle implementations of planning and budgeting solutions.
  • Technical and Functional Knowledge: Strong understanding of FP&A systems from both the functional and technical perspectives, with experience in data modelling, structures, and database objects.
  • Advanced Excel Skills: Proficiency in Excel, with VBA experience being an advantage.
  • SQL Skills: Experience with SQL for data manipulation and modeling is beneficial.
  • Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills: Strong logical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with sound judgment.
  • Communication and Relationship Building: Excellent communication skills, especially in working with financial professionals to understand their budgeting and forecasting needs.
  • Mentorship: A desire and ability to mentor junior staff and explain complex technical concepts.
  • Ability to Learn: A quick learner, eager to grasp and apply new concepts and technologies.
  • Work Under Pressure: Ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience in FP&A Systems: Relevant experience in implementing and optimizing FP&A or planning solutions.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Organic search is one of Airbnb's largest and most efficient acquisition channels, and the rise of AI answer engines is reshaping how travelers discover places to stay, things to do, and trusted Hosts. This role sits at the intersection of growth marketing, content strategy, and emerging AI search behavior, partnering closely with product, engineering, content, and data science teams to make Airbnb the trusted source that search engines and AI models cite.

The Difference You Will Make

As Senior Growth Marketing Lead, SEO, AEO, GEO, you will own the strategy and day-to-day execution for how Airbnb shows up in Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and the assistants that come next. You are an execution-focused operator with a career built in SEO — you write your own SQL, size opportunities from raw data, and ship. Success in this role means measurable gains in organic visibility, rankings, AI citations, traffic, bookings, and downstream conversion, along with a measurement framework that proves the business value of organic channels. This is a chance to define what AEO and GEO mean for Airbnb and build the playbook others follow.

A Typical Day

  • Own the organic growth strategy and content roadmap across SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — covering technical SEO, content, on-site experience, and visibility in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity.
  • Manage internal content strategy for these acquisition channels: set priorities, briefs, templates, and quality standards for content and landing pages that drive organic and AI-referred traffic.
  • Run the channel hands-on — pull and analyze your own data in SQL, size opportunities, prioritize by impact, and drive launches and experiments from backlog to measured result.
  • Lead cross-functional relationships with product and engineering teams, embedding SEO and AEO best practices into web properties, app surfaces, and structured data.
  • Improve how well AI models understand Airbnb's listings, product, and policies so they represent Airbnb accurately and cite it as a source.
  • Build and evolve the measurement framework for SEO, AEO, and GEO — attribution models, leading and lagging indicators, dashboards, and revenue impact — including the ability to demonstrate the value of work that's difficult to attribute, such as preventive technical work or emerging AI channels.
  • Establish Airbnb's point of view on how AI-generated answers are reshaping travel discovery, and translate complex technical concepts into clear business narratives for senior leaders.

Your Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in SEO, including 2+ years in a senior/leadership capacity engaging with executives.
  • Strong SQL skills, writing your own queries to analyze crawl, log, search console, and conversion data without relying on analysts for core questions.
  • Proven track record of shipping SEO programs at scale and driving significant organic growth, from prioritization through launch and measurement.
  • Expertise in both technical SEO and content strategy, including site architecture, structured data, indexation, and content quality.
  • Working knowledge of how AI-powered search and answer engines operate (LLM-based retrieval, citation behavior, entity recognition), with a clear point of view on how to optimize for them.
  • Strong analytical foundation, comfortable with attribution challenges and building measurement frameworks that quantify the business impact of organic channels.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product, content, and data science teams to implement SEO and AEO improvements at scale, and a track record of developing and retaining high-performing teams.
  • Preferred: experience in a two-sided marketplace or travel business where listing, location, and user-generated content pages are major organic surfaces; background in international SEO across multiple markets and languages; experience building programmatic or product-led SEO at scale; early-mover experience in AEO/GEO visibility monitoring and optimization; hands-on skill with Python, BigQuery, or similar tools and log/crawl analysis at scale.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and progressive experience.

Your Location:

DCS—Energy
AECOM’s Energy practice provides a wide range of services from consulting and engineering design to energy engineering, energy procurement and construction (EPC) for power, energy efficiency, oil and gas, nuclear, and renewable energy clients. Our understanding of the big picture – and the interconnection between generation, distribution, storage, and the demand side of the meter – allows us to deliver holistic solutions that improve and modernize generation energy infrastructure. We connect knowledge and experience across our global framework to bring together a unique combination of engineers, planners, scientists, advisors, and project managers who advance energy solution and infrastructure to meet our varied Clients needs.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering and 6 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
  • Proven experience with site grading, drainage, roads, earthworks, and substation layout development and transmission access/alignment.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD or MicroStation for civil design and detailing.
  • Understanding of substation site planning, transmission/substation access requirements, and integration with electrical layouts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional Engineering license (P.E.)
  • 10+ years of relevant site civil experience with at least three of those years acting as project technical lead and/or engineer of record.
  • Strong knowledge of international civil and design standards (IEC, BS, IEEE, ANSI etc.).
  • Experience with construction supervision, site inspection, and commissioning support.
  • Knowledge of hydrological analysis tools, stormwater modeling, or civil 3D/BIM software.
  • Experience in GIS or AIS substation developments.
  • Familiarity with major utility or transmission operator standards.
  • Self-motivated
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Success in working with remote teams
  • Experience on full EPC, Design/Build projects from start to finish.
  • Owner’s Engineering experience
  • Experience with retrofit or brown field projects
  • Exposure to supporting renewable generation project

  • Sponsorship for US Employment Authorization is not available for this position.

About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

About the team

Every insight on AlphaSense is tied to a company. Reference Entity Data Services (REDS) owns the data that makes that possible: one trusted record for every company, connected across all the sources we bring in.

REDS turns records from many providers into one authoritative view, keeps it current, and supplies it to every part of the platform that depends on it, from search to company profiles. When that foundation is right, customers find the right company and trust what they see.

About the Role

As the Staff Quality Engineer dedicated to REDS, you will define how we prove our data is correct before it reaches customers. You will set the strategy, build the practice from the ground up, and work closely with engineering and product leadership to make quality a measurable part of how the team ships.

What You'll Do

  • Own the quality strategy for AlphaSense's company reference data, built on quality by design and automation by default.
  • Close test coverage gaps on our critical workflows: ingesting provider data, matching records, keeping identifiers stable over time, and delivering entity data and change events to the product teams that rely on them.
  • Define what "correct" means for company data, and build the golden datasets, labeled samples, and automated checks that prove it, including measuring match precision and recall and the tradeoff between false merges and false splits.
  • Set the quality measures and release standards the team uses to ship with confidence.
  • Build and grow scalable automation across our data, API, and event-driven interfaces, and decide what belongs at the unit, component, API, and E2E layers.
  • Anticipate data lifecycle risks such as provider data drift, schema changes, and late or conflicting records, and build regression coverage for them.
  • Partner with developers on test planning for new features, so automation is ready as the code is.
  • Use production signals to focus effort where it reduces the most risk to customers.
  • Bring AI into how the team designs, maintains, and triages tests.
  • Coach engineers and influence across teams to raise the quality bar.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in quality engineering, including setting strategy for complex backend or data platforms.
  • Hands-on experience designing and automating tests for backend and data systems, including API and contract testing, data pipeline validation, and event-driven or streaming interfaces (e.g., Kafka).
  • Strong skills in at least one programming language (such as Python, Kotlin/Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Ruby), and comfort working in unfamiliar codebases.
  • Deep expertise in test design across unit, API, and end-to-end layers, and judgment about where each belongs.
  • Experience validating data correctness at scale, ideally in matching, identity, or pipeline-driven systems.
  • A strong grasp of continuous delivery, CI/CD, and release quality gates.
  • A track record of using AI to speed up engineering and testing.
  • Proven ability to set direction on your own and influence without authority.
  • Clear, confident communication with technical and business stakeholders.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with data pipelines or data-operations tooling.
  • Hands-on E2E automation experience with Playwright
  • Experience with financial, company, or reference data.
  • Experience evaluating AI or LLM output.
  • BS/MS in a relevant technical field.

What we offer

  • Playing a part in the story of a fast-growing company
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Lunch and recreational benefits
  • Occupational health care

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered equity, and a generous benefits program.

$148,350—$203,550 USD

This role is ideal for a results-driven, creative, and collaborative leader with a strong B2B SaaS background who enjoys managing projects, documenting processes, analyzing performance, and optimizing the website for better user experience, conversion rates, and lead generation.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Design and execute a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with company objectives, target markets, and healthcare IT industry trends.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to define marketing goals, KPIs, and budgets.

AI-Focused Marketing Workflows

  • Design and implement AI-powered workflows for lead scoring, content generation, audience segmentation, chatbots, and campaign personalization.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools (including HubSpot's AI features) into the marketing stack, with clear guidelines for quality, brand voice, and HIPAA-conscious data use.

Data Science & Marketing Analytics

  • Apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and attribution modeling to forecast pipeline, identify high-value segments, and measure channel effectiveness.
  • Design and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across emails, landing pages, and website experiences, turning results into actionable recommendations.

HubSpot & Marketing Automation

  • Manage HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs), including automation workflows, processes, and data hygiene.
  • Analyze reports and dashboards in HubSpot to track KPIs, campaign performance, and ROI for stakeholders.

Campaign & Website Optimization

  • Build and manage the email marketing program from segmentation to execution.
  • Improve forms, email templates, landing pages, and website experiences to increase conversion rates and lead generation.

Project Management & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Manage marketing operations projects from initiation to completion, tracking progress, risks, and bottlenecks to stay on schedule and within budget.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service teams to integrate processes and document repeatable workflows.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Management, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in marketing, marketing operations, and project management, preferably in B2B SaaS.
  • Advanced expertise in HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs) and strong proficiency in marketing automation technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted marketing workflows (e.g., predictive lead scoring, AI content tools, chatbots, or personalization).
  • Strong analytical and statistical skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Advanced database management and data visualization skills.
  • Solid understanding of customer journey mapping and business processes.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple projects at once.
  • Strong communication skills, including knowing how to ask the right questions and turn answers into systems.

Preferred

  • HubSpot certifications (Marketing, Sales, Operations, or related).
  • Experience as a HubSpot trainer or in HubSpot customer support.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or R for marketing data analysis.
  • Experience with BI tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Familiarity with marketing attribution, predictive analytics, or machine learning concepts.
  • Experience marketing to healthcare providers or in health IT, with awareness of HIPAA considerations.

A Day in the Life

Your day blends strategy, systems, and data. You might start by reviewing HubSpot dashboards to check overnight campaign results and pipeline movement, then meet with Sales to refine how AI-driven lead scores route new leads to the right reps. Later, you could be building an automated nurture workflow that personalizes content by specialty, analyzing an A/B test on a demo-request landing page, or running a quick attribution analysis to show leadership which channels are actually driving booked demos. Along the way, you're cleaning up data, documenting processes so they can be repeated, keeping marketing projects on track, and testing new AI tools to see where they can save the team time without compromising quality.

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline and revenue growth: Measurable increases in marketing-qualified leads (MQLs), demo requests, and marketing-sourced revenue.
  • Conversion improvements: Higher conversion rates across the website, landing pages, forms, and email campaigns, validated through A/B testing.
  • AI-driven efficiency: AI and automation workflows in place that reduce manual work, improve lead scoring accuracy, and speed up campaign execution.
  • Data quality and insight: Clean, reliable HubSpot data and accurate dashboards and attribution reporting that leadership uses to make decisions.
  • Operational excellence: Marketing projects delivered on time and within budget, with documented, repeatable processes adopted across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service.

We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

***A quick note: some of our emails may be filtered into your spam/junk folder. Please check there regularly for any communications from us, including interview scheduling, next steps, and updates on your application. If you find one of our emails in spam, please mark it as “Not Spam” to help ensure future messages reach your inbox.***

Roofr is growing our Onboarding team, and we're looking for a Spanish-speaking Onboarding Manager to own the most important window in a customer's journey: the moment they sign to the moment they're live, confident, and getting real value from Roofr.

We onboard hundreds of new customers every month across multiple products. Many of them run established roofing businesses but are new to technology, which means the way you show up matters as much as what you know. This role is built for someone who thrives in high-volume environments, believes great onboarding creates the conditions for everything that comes after, and finds real satisfaction in watching a customer go from uncertain to capable.

Your goal is simple: help customers feel the difference Roofr makes in their business as quickly as possible, and make sure getting there doesn't feel overwhelming. We pay attention to two things to know we're on track: how much of what a customer set out to use in Roofr they're actually working with day-to-day, and whether they'd say the onboarding experience genuinely helped them. Those signals tell us where customers are thriving and where we can do better. They're our compass.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the full onboarding journey for net-new Roofr customers, from supporting them through Account Setup and training through to a clean handoff to their Customer Success Manager.
  • Manage multiple concurrent onboardings in a high-volume environment, balancing dedicated 1:1 sessions with scalable, group-based training.
  • Guide customers through Roofr in a way that’s practical, confidence-building, and tailored to their unique business workflows, goals, and level of technical experience.
  • Drive customers to a clear graduation milestone: they're live, self-sufficient, and ready for handoff to their Customer Success Manager..
  • Work closely with the Account Setup Team as an onboarding consultant, ensuring Roofr is configured to reflect each customer's real needs and lay the foundation for strong adoption.
  • Deliver engaging live training sessions and group webinars that drive real adoption, not just familiarity.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Account Management, Retention, Product, and the Customer Success team to surface friction, close gaps, and ensure every handoff is clean.
  • Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of Roofr's onboarding playbook, building something that scales, not just something that works today.
  • Act as a trusted guide during a high-stakes window, helping customers prioritize, build good habits, and set themselves up for long-term success in Roofr.

What You'll Bring to the Role:

  • Fluent in Spanish (written and spoken)
  • 2+ years of experience in customer onboarding, customer success, or enablement within an SMB, B2B, or SaaS environment
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment
  • Strong communication and presentation skills across live calls, video meetings, email, and webinars
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and adapt your approach based on customer goals, maturity, and engagement level
  • Proven ability to manage customer needs while making thoughtful, outcome-driven recommendations
  • Comfort demonstrating product value and guiding customers toward broader adoption and better business outcomes
  • High ownership mentality with the ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities, and follow through consistently
  • Exceptional organization, time management, and attention to detail to deliver a reliable, high-quality onboarding experience

Who You Are:

  • A true customer advocate
  • Highly organized and results-oriented
  • Detail-obsessed (in the best way)
  • You know how to adapt your approach depending on who’s in front of you.
  • You are always looking for ways to improve and scale what works
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new tools quickly

Resource that will work with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, IT, and OEMs’ to ensure networking standards and requirements are followed. Aid in the development and continuous improvement of current Electrical standards and best practices. This role is remote with travel and support to all sites within the network wherever the need may be, with primary focus to initially be in the Chicagoland area. jobs.excerpt: Senior Director, Payments — Remote (US)EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform providing vertically tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention.
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Payments — Remote (US)

EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform providing vertically tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Across EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell, EverCommerce provides business management software, embedded payment acceptance, and customer engagement solutions designed around the needs of service-based businesses.


The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Director, Payments to help shape and execute the next phase of growth for EverCommerce’s payments business. This is a senior, highly cross-functional leadership role responsible for translating our payments strategy into products, capabilities, and commercial outcomes across the EverCommerce portfolio. The Senior Director will work across product, engineering, go-to-market, customer experience, operations, data, and our individual software businesses to identify opportunities, establish priorities, and drive execution.

The ideal candidate combines deep payments expertise with strong product and commercial instincts. You understand how payments create value within vertical SaaS platforms and can move comfortably between strategy and execution—from identifying a market opportunity or customer problem to defining the solution, aligning stakeholders, launching the capability, and measuring the resulting business impact.

You will bring significant experience in integrated and embedded payments, SaaS, APIs, payment facilitation, merchant acquiring, and the broader payments ecosystem. Just as importantly, you will be a strong business leader who can simplify complex problems, influence across organizational boundaries, and build alignment around the opportunities that matter most.

What You’ll Do

Drive Payments Strategy and Growth

  • Help define and execute the payments strategy across EverCommerce, with a focus on sustainable revenue growth, customer value, and competitive differentiation.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities across the payments customer lifecycle, including enablement, merchant acquisition and onboarding, activation, retention, wallet share, pricing, and monetization.
  • Translate market, customer, competitive, and financial insights into clear priorities and executable plans.
  • Own business outcomes associated with payments initiatives, including adoption, processing volume, revenue, retention, customer experience, and profitability.
  • Develop business cases and recommendations for new products, capabilities, partnerships, and investments.

Lead Payments Product and Commercialization

  • Define customer, merchant, partner, and developer needs and translate them into differentiated payments capabilities.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to establish roadmaps and prioritize investments based on customer and business value.
  • Drive the evolution and adoption of key payments capabilities, including card and ACH acceptance, recurring payments, invoicing, surcharging, mobile and in-person payments, onboarding, APIs, and other emerging payment experiences.
  • Drive embedded finance solution strategy and growth including instant payouts, merchant lending, consumer financing, and issuing
  • Help shape the future of PaySimple and EverCommerce’s broader payments platform, including how payments capabilities are delivered across internal SaaS solutions and external partners.
  • Ensure new capabilities have clear commercialization, adoption, and measurement plans—not simply technical launch plans.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Operations to improve adoption and utilization of both new and existing payments capabilities.

Represent the Customer and the Market

  • Develop a deep understanding of merchants, SaaS partners, developers, and end customers and the problems they are trying to solve.
  • Establish effective feedback loops with customers, partners, sales teams, customer experience teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape and emerging trends across embedded payments, merchant acquiring, vertical SaaS, payment facilitation, and financial technology.
  • Use quantitative and qualitative data to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and make informed investment decisions.
  • Understands and can drive ecommerce and card present acceptance in EMEA, ANZ, and LATAM markets.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

  • Lead complex initiatives that span Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Finance, and Data.
  • Create clarity around objectives, ownership, milestones, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Build alignment across business units and functional teams that may have different priorities and operating models.
  • Identify execution risks and remove barriers that prevent teams from delivering customer and business outcomes.
  • Establish clear metrics and operating rhythms to track progress and hold teams accountable for results.

Build and Develop High-Performing Teams

  • Lead, coach, and develop payments and product talent, creating an environment characterized by high standards, strong ownership, curiosity, and collaboration.
  • Attract and develop high-performing team members as the payments organization evolves.
  • Set clear expectations and create accountability for both individual and team outcomes.
  • Foster strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Operations, and other functional organizations.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, product management, or related businesses, with significant experience in integrated or embedded payments.
  • Deep knowledge of the payments ecosystem, including merchant acquiring, processors, gateways, payment facilitators, card networks, ACH, and payments risk.
  • Demonstrated experience building, launching, commercializing, or scaling payments products and capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS and API-based products and the role payments can play within vertical software platforms.
  • Proven ability to translate strategy into execution and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience driving revenue growth, adoption, retention, processing volume, or other commercial payments metrics.
  • Strong financial and analytical capabilities, including experience developing business cases and understanding the economic drivers of a payments business.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in matrixed organizations.
  • Strong executive communication skills and the ability to communicate complex payments concepts clearly to technical, commercial, and executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive decisions without relying solely on organizational authority.
  • Strong talent assessment, coaching, and team-development capabilities.
  • High intellectual curiosity and a willingness to dive deeply into customer problems, data, economics, technology, and operational processes.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with payment facilitation, embedded payments, or payments-as-a-service models.
  • Experience serving SMB customers and/or vertical SaaS businesses.
  • Experience with merchant onboarding, underwriting, risk, fraud, and payments operations.
  • Experience working with payment processors, acquiring banks, card networks, and other financial-services partners.
  • Experience managing or influencing P&L performance.
  • Familiarity with modern product, analytics, and delivery tools.

What Success Looks Like

  • Success in this role means turning payments strategy into measurable results. You will help EverCommerce:
  • Increase adoption and penetration of payments across our software portfolio.
  • Improve merchant activation, retention, and wallet share.
  • Deliver payments experiences that create measurable value for our customers.
  • Bring new payments capabilities to market faster and with stronger commercial adoption.
  • Make better investment decisions using customer, market, operational, and financial data.
  • Build greater alignment between our payments organization and the SaaS businesses we support.
  • Create a scalable payments platform and operating model capable of supporting EverCommerce’s long-term growth.

Where

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams across the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are accustomed to working remotely across different time zones.

This role can be based anywhere in the United States. If you’re close to one of our offices, you may work in-office or remotely. Candidates must be eligible to work without sponsorship. This role may require periodic travel to EverCommerce offices and other locations across North America.


Benefits & Perks

  • Flexibility to work in-office, remotely, or hybrid within your country of employment
  • Robust health and wellness benefits
  • Continued investment in professional development
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible and generous paid time off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

Compensation

The target base compensation for this position is $210,000–$250,000 USD per year in most U.S. locations, along with a performance-based bonus. Final compensation is determined based on factors including location, market conditions, and the candidate’s experience and expertise.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!


EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. jobs.description:
About Builders

Builders is a non-partisan movement of millions, uniting Americans across lines of difference - grounded in the belief that curiosity, compassion, courage, and creativity can move us beyond division. Founded by Daniel Lubetzky, our community spans 5M+ citizens, 650M video views, and 400+ movement partners including José Andrés, Katie Couric, Adam Grant, Lonnie Ali, and Karl Rove. Through a growing ecosystem of content, tools, partnerships, and activations, we turn civic engagement into meaningful action - empowering people to participate, collaborate, and deliver real-world impact to enact lasting change.

About the Position

Builders has built something rare: a highly engaged, cross-partisan community who are actively leaning in. The infrastructure is there. The audience is real. Now we need a strategic digital leader who knows how to take it to the next level as part of our forward-thinking Marketing team.

The Director of Digital Strategy sits at the center of four interconnected priorities: social strategy, paid media, audience insights, and platform growth. Developing and executing strategies across every platform that deepen engagement with our existing community while systematically expanding our reach to new audiences. That means owning how Builders shows up and scales across every channel - from Instagram and TikTok to YouTube, where there is a significant opportunity to build a strong, engaged presence - while ensuring every campaign and content decision is grounded in data and driving measurable results.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who is equally at home in the data as they are in the cultural conversation. You know what makes audiences grow, what makes them stay, and what makes them act. You understand how platforms work - algorithmically, culturally, and commercially - and you bring the analytical rigor and creative instinct to turn that knowledge into compounding results. Critically, you don’t just measure digital performance: you own the insights function across campaigns, serving as the connective tissue between strategy and execution and ensuring the organization always knows how its work is landing.

Reporting to the CMO, you will partner closely with the Creative Director and the Editorial Director to ensure digital strategy, content, and communications are integrated and moving at the speed of culture. This is an opportunity to cultivate and shape how one of the most important civic movements and communities grows - and to build the systems that make that growth sustainable.

Responsibilities

Social Media Strategy & Community Building

  • Own Builders’ social media strategy across all platforms - setting the vision, standards, and playbooks that guide how the team shows up, engages, and grows across every channel. Develop platform-specific strategies that reflect how audiences actually behave on each channel.
  • Lead and develop the social media team, fostering a culture of creativity, experimentation, and accountability to both quality and performance.
  • Prioritize community quality over vanity metrics, developing strategies that build a highly engaged, loyal audience rather than chasing follower counts, and setting the organizational standard for what meaningful engagement looks like.
  • Develop and execute a creator strategy that spans ideological diversity - finding credible voices on both the left and right who can authentically carry cross-partisan, solutions-oriented stories.
  • Lead YouTube strategy as a significant growth opportunity - developing a channel vision, content framework, and growth plan that builds Builders’ presence into a meaningful destination for civic storytelling and community engagement.
  • Stay ahead of platform algorithm changes, emerging formats, and cultural trends - translating shifts in the landscape into concrete recommendations the team can act on quickly.

Paid Media Strategy

jobs.title: Deal Desk Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Based in Washington, D. C. , Quorum is a fast-growing software company and is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals across the corporations, non-profits, associations, and governmental end-markets.
jobs.description:
Based in Washington, D.C., Quorum is a fast-growing software company and is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals across the corporations, non-profits, associations, and governmental end-markets. Quorum allows users to manage stakeholder engagement, launch grassroots advocacy campaigns, and track legislative activity at all levels of government, including federal, state and local.

Quorum provides mission-critical solutions to public affairs professionals for their work in Congress, all 50 state legislatures, major U.S. cities, the European Union, and 30+ countries around the globe. Quorum serves over 2,000 customers globally including over 50% of the Fortune 100, and has over 350 team members across the globe. The company recently acquired Capitol Canary, a market leader in grassroots advocacy software.

As our Deal Desk Specialist, you will be the go to expert and leader on configuring, pricing, quoting, and closing deals for Quorum’s client subscriptions, bringing together colleagues from across the organization to establish and apply consistent rules and make the sales process more efficient. You will be responsible for ensuring that Quorum delights our clients by providing an accurate, transparent, and timely contract review and approval process, and that our sales team performs at a high level by efficiently selling and closing deals that serve our clients’ needs and Quorum’s business goals.

What You'll Do

  • First week: You'll learn Quorum’s products and pricing rules as well as the ins and outs of Quorum’s Salesforce-based Quote and Subscription Agreement processes, gain exposure to our client’s perspective on our contract workflow, and get to know Quorum’s tight-knit Sales Operations team, which is a unit of the Business Development function headed by our Chief Sales Officer.

  • First month: You will begin to advise sales team members on the configuration and pricing of deals and review sales documentation when deals close to verify accuracy of information including, but not limited to, contract terms, billing information, pricing, and consistency with company policies.

  • First 6 months: You will learn the context necessary to support the Deal Desk Analyst during high-volume periods to complete technical risk assessments and review draft Quotes in Salesforce. You will take ownership of Quorum’s complete product price list. You will centralize and modify deal close workflows to improve the accuracy, transparency, and timeliness of Quorum’s deal process for our team members, clients, and vendors. You will conduct a Quality Assurance Audit on 100% of active client subscriptions and vendor agreements. Through this process, you will document and remediate any errors identified (e.g., contract covers a 366 day “annual” period instead of a 365 day “annual” period, contract references outdated technical specifications, etc.).

  • First year: You will also work with sales, customer success, finance, and product to build the foundational processes for a high-performing Deal Desk that can quickly review and close high-value new logo and renewal customers with unique circumstances (e.g., special pricing, product commitment, etc.).

About You

  • You consider attention to detail to be one of your signature strengths. In a room full of 1,000 professionals, you would feel comfortable raising your hand to indicate that you are in the Top 5% in terms of overall attention to detail—and your previous colleagues would agree!

  • You have honed the ability to creatively apply logic and business standards to solve an unfamiliar problem.

  • You are comfortable making sense of technical, legal, and procurement jargon and navigating commercial processes.

  • You have some professional experience working with commercial contracts in a business environment or working on or adjacent to a Sales Operations team with a Deal Desk function.

  • You care deeply about being a part of building an inclusive, supportive, and diverse team environment.

  • You will stand out if you have experience with Federal contracts or have a Federal certification (e.g., DAWIA), security clearance, or military background.

  • You will stand out if you have experience working with Salesforce CPQ and/or revenue management software, such as SaaS Optics or NetSuite.

  • You are a superstar if you have previous experience in a Deal Desk role.

About the Sales Operations Team

  • We take pride in keeping the metaphorical train on its track at a high-growth start-up.

  • We are the resident subject matter experts on business operations—our team covers sales operations, and finance.

  • We believe that precedent is not best practice—we are constantly striving to improve our own workflow. In doing so, we live by Quorum’s growth principles to Take the Lead and Own the Execution.

  • We pay attention to the details and have pride in the work we do, knowing that our team helps provide peace of mind to our team members, clients, and vendors.

  • We're close as a company—we work together, spend time together, and value each others' ideas and input.

Our Work Environment

  • We are a remote-first team with flexible work options: work remotely, or you may choose to come into our office in Belo Horizonte.

  • Our team loves to spend time doing fun things outside of the office - both together and remote, which we call Quorum Fun events. Past Quorum Fun events have included apple picking, yoga, virtual art classes and wine tasting.

If you'd like to learn what it's like to have a real impact at a fast-growing company that is changing the way the advocacy process works, drop us a line. We'd love to talk to you!

Compensation

This is a full time CLT Opportunity.

Benefits

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • Standard Brazil holidays plus additional company-wide days off for team members to rest and recharge

  • Free Subscription to the Calm App

  • Free Subscription to LinkedIn Learning to support professional development

  • Invest in Yourself Days - one designated day per quarter is dedicated to your professional development!

  • Monthly Work from Home Stipend

  • Mental and Dental Care by SulAmérica

  • Virtual and in-person team events

  • Mental Health stipend

  • Alelo Food Voucher

  • In company English classes

  • Inclusion & Diversity Affinity Groups to support belonging

Please submit your resume in English.

We comply with all requirements for US government federal contractors issued by the OFCCP, IFR, and the terms of our government contracts.

Description

Projects Managers with experience in Dermatology and/or Rheumatology are crucial to the success of Clinical Trials managed by Indero. They are the main point of contact internally as well as externally, ensuring all activities and deliverables are completed on time, on budget, and as expected.

Great project managers go further than creating project plans and following up on tasks. They show leadership to help project teams focus on objectives and deliver results.

This role will be perfect for you if:

  • You want to work for a mid-sized CRO that works on significant multisite trials, including Global Phase III projects
  • You are looking to position yourself in an environment where you can grow your career alongside the company

IMPACT AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Client interactions

  • Serve as primary contact for the Sponsor
  • Provide efficient and timely updates on trial progress
  • Lead client calls effectively

Project planning

  • Oversee and actively participates in the preparation of project deliverables such as; study plans, protocol, informed consent form, electronic case report form (eCRF), tables/listings/figures (TLFs), clinical study report.
  • Participate in the planning and conduct of the Investigator’s Meeting.

Quality and risk management

Project budget and timelines

  • Identify out of scope activities for change orders.
  • Proactively manage operational aspects of the clinical trial including trial timelines, budget, resources and vendors. Coordinate tasks and deliverables from all functional departments involved in the project.
  • Communicate effectively with study team members, functional departments, and senior management.
  • Manage and report on recruitment status and highlight initiatives needed to meet recruitment timelines.

Project team leadership

  • Lead the core project team which may include: Associate Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Project Assistants.
  • Ensure all team members have adequate training on the project.
  • Work closely with vendors and the following internal teams to ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed on time, according to plans and according to applicable standards: Site Selection, Regulatory Affairs, Data Management, Clinical Monitoring, Biostatistics, Scientific Affairs.

Requirements

IDEAL PROFILE

Education

  • B.Sc. in a relevant discipline

Experience

  • At least 7 years of industry experience, including a minimum of 5 years leading multi-center clinical trials (phase II-III)
  • Experience leading concurrent multi-centered clinical trials with budgets in excess of $3M USD
  • Experience managing dermatology trials

Knowledge and skills

  • Good problem-solving abilities
  • Strong ability to carry out different projects and work under pressure while meeting timelines
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

Work location

Note that this opening is for a home-based position in Germany

Regular travel, which may include overnight trips and / or international travel is required as part of this role.

Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.

jobs.title: Voice AI Engineer
jobs.excerpt: IntroFor this position we are only looking for candidates located in Greece, Germany or Austria.
jobs.description:
Intro

For this position we are only looking for candidates located in Greece, Germany or Austria.

Nairon GmbH is a Swiss startup building AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls for businesses. Our platform runs real-time conversations over the phone and on the web, connected to our customers' telephony and business tools. We value clear communication, thoughtful engineering, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Join us as we continue to develop tools that make a difference.

Tasks

As a Voice AI Engineer at Nairon GmbH, you will make our agents sound fast, natural and reliable in live calls. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Improving turn-taking: when the agent speaks, waits, yields or gets interrupted, including voice activity and end-of-turn detection.
  • Cutting end-to-end latency across speech recognition, language models and speech synthesis, and making provider failover seamless.
  • Optimising how we use LLMs in conversation: prompting, tool calls, streaming and speculative or parallel requests.
  • Serving our own speech models (STT and TTS) on GPUs, measuring throughput and time to first audio.
  • Fine-tuning speech and language models for our customers' languages and voices.
  • Building evaluation: test calls, benchmarks and quality metrics that tell us when a change really helps.

Requirements

Experience:

A senior or strong mid-level engineer with production experience in real-time audio, conversational AI or ML model serving.

Technical Skills:

Required:

  • Strong Python, including asyncio and streaming pipelines.
  • Hands-on work with speech (STT, TTS, VAD) and LLM APIs in latency-sensitive systems.
  • Model serving on GPUs, for example with vLLM or similar, and the basics of batching and memory limits.

Nice to have:

  • LiveKit Agents, pipecat or WebRTC.
  • Fine-tuning (LoRA or full) of speech or language models.
  • Audio signal processing such as echo cancellation or noise suppression.
  • German, or experience with German-language speech data.

Communication:

  • English proficiency is essential, both written and spoken, as it is the working language for all positions.

Soft Skills:

  • You measure before and after, and trust numbers over impressions.
  • Ownership of a problem from the first bad call to the fix in production.

Benefits

  • Flexible Work Setup: Work fully remotely or from a co-working space — whichever suits you best.
  • Equipment Provided: Company laptop and phone provided for all employees.
  • Collaborative Environment: Join a small, agile team where your contributions have a direct impact.
  • Growth Opportunities: Work across the whole voice stack, from model serving to the conversation the caller hears.

Closing

If you want to make AI conversations feel human on a real phone line, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Research Data Scientist
jobs.excerpt: Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company.
jobs.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

We are looking for a highly skilled Research Data Scientist – GenAI/LLM to join our AI/LLM Delivery Unit and work on research-driven AI/ML initiatives involving Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP, multimodal AI, model evaluation, and AI data.

The role combines strong research and analytical capabilities with hands-on AI/ML expertise, requiring the candidate to design experiments, develop evaluation methodologies, analyze complex datasets, build research prototypes, and translate research findings into practical AI/ML solutions.

The ideal candidate will have a strong research orientation, excellent statistical and analytical skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with researchers, data scientists, AI/ML engineers, domain experts, and client-facing teams.

What You’ll Own:

AI/ML & Generative AI Research:

  • Conduct independent and collaborative research in Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, multimodal AI, machine learning, model evaluation, and AI data.
  • Formulate research questions and translate complex AI/ML problems into structured research methodologies and experiments.
  • Design, execute, and analyze experiments to evaluate and improve AI/ML models and solutions.
  • Build analytical models, prototypes, and research pipelines using Python and relevant ML frameworks.
  • Stay current with emerging research, methodologies, papers, and developments in GenAI, LLMs, NLP, multimodal models, and AI evaluation.

LLM & Model Evaluation:

  • Develop and implement LLM evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation criteria.
  • Evaluate models for accuracy, robustness, bias, hallucination, reasoning, relevance, response quality, and other performance dimensions.
  • Conduct model benchmarking, error analysis, comparative analysis, and performance evaluation.
  • Work on areas such as RAG, SFT, RLHF/DPO, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, embeddings, and LLM optimization, as applicable.
  • Identify model and data gaps and recommend improvements to enhance model performance and reliability.

Data Science & Statistical Research:

  • Collect, clean, analyze, and interpret large and complex structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Perform EDA, statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, significance testing, correlation analysis, sampling, and error analysis.
  • Develop data-driven insights and identify patterns, trends, and relationships relevant to AI/ML research.
  • Apply appropriate statistical and quantitative methodologies to validate research findings

AI Data & Dataset Development:

  • Develop and evaluate datasets, sampling methodologies, taxonomies, annotation frameworks, data quality frameworks, and evaluation criteria for AI/ML models.
  • Analyze data quality and identify issues affecting model performance.
  • Collaborate with annotation, data engineering, and AI/ML teams to improve AI training and evaluation data.
  • Translate data and research findings into actionable recommendations for improving AI system

Research & Innovation:

  • Contribute to research papers, technical reports, whitepapers, patents, benchmarks, internal publications, and other research outputs, where applicable.
  • Identify opportunities to apply emerging research and technologies to real-world AI and data challenges.
  • Explore new methodologies, models, datasets, and evaluation approaches to improve AI capabilities.
  • Contribute to capability building and innovation within the AI/LLM practice

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Work closely with researchers, data scientists, AI/ML engineers, data/annotation teams, domain experts, and delivery teams.
  • Present research findings, analytical insights, and technical recommendations to senior technical stakeholders.
  • Translate complex research and technical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Where required, participate in client-facing technical discussions and presentations and help translate business requirements into AI/ML solutions.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computational Science, or a related discipline.
  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree from IITs, NITs, or other premier engineering/research institutions is strongly preferred.
  • 4–7 years of hands-on research experience in AI/ML, Data Science, NLP, Generative AI, LLMs, or related areas.
  • Strong demonstrated research experience with the ability to independently formulate research questions, design experiments, analyze results, and communicate findings.
  • Demonstrated research track record through research publications, patents, conference presentations, open-source contributions, or significant AI/ML research projects.
  • Candidates with publications in reputed conferences/journals and a strong academic/research profile will be preferred
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Strong hands-on experience with NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and preferably PyTorch/TensorFlow.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Machine learning algorithms
    • Statistics and experimentation
    • Data analysis and feature engineering
    • Model evaluation and performance metrics
    • Hypothesis testing and statistical inference
  • Hands-on exposure to LLMs, NLP, Generative AI, and multimodal AI.
  • Experience with one or more of RAG, LLM evaluation, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, SFT, RLHF/DPO, embeddings, or model benchmarking.
  • Experience working with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Familiarity with Git and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is desirable.

The expected salary range for this position is $160,000 - $185,000 p/year, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Entwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) - Remote, 4-Tage-Woche
jobs.excerpt: IntroDu möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert?
jobs.description:
Intro

Du möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert? Du denkst Systeme vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche, konzipierst gern technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass sie am Ende auch so umgesetzt werden? Dann bist du als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) / Senior Webentwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) beim Händlerbund genau richtig!

Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert. Von der Erstellung rechtlicher Inhalte über Vertrags- und Prüfprozesse bis hin zu Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsfragen. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. Ziel ist es, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in verlässliche, verständliche und effiziente digitale Workflows zu überführen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten, die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte.
  • Ownership für die Umsetzung: Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Projekt von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live ankommt. Aufgaben schneiden und priorisieren, Fortschritt im Blick behalten, technische Entscheidungen treffen und Blocker aus dem Weg räumen.
  • Anleitung & Wissenstransfer: Fachliche Führung weiterer Entwickler im Projekt durch klare technische Vorgaben, Pairing und Code Reviews im Backend wie im Frontend. Wissen über Architektur und Entscheidungen landet im Team und in der Dokumentation, nicht nur bei dir.
  • Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder.
  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.
  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.
  • Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.

Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.
  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.
  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.
  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.
  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.
  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.

Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)
  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)
  • Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen
  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen
  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)

Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.
  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.
  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Du bereitest den Stand eines Projekts für technische und nicht-technische Beteiligte verständlich auf, auch dann, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft.
  • Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt.
  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.
  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.

Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of RoleThe Director, Sourcing & Procurement – R&D Clinical Operations and Supplies will serve as business partner supporting sourcing strategy, contracting, and governance activities across Summit’s Clinical Operations organization and global clinical trial portfolio. This individual will report to the Head of Procurement. The role is responsible for supporting the selection, contracting, and oversight of key clinical service providers, including CROs, central laboratories, imaging vendors, eCOA and other eClinical technology providers, patient recruitment and retention suppliers, investigator payment providers, specialty service vendors, and clinical trial supply partners. The position may also support clinical supply and logistics-related procurement activities, helping ensure the timely and cost-effective delivery of materials and services required to execute global clinical studies. The breadth of this role provides significant exposure across the end-to-end clinical development lifecycle and the opportunity to influence sourcing strategy, supplier performance, and operational execution across the clinical portfolio.

Working closely with Clinical Operations, R&D, Clinical Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, and other cross-functional stakeholders, this individual will help drive vendor strategy, optimize study-related spending, improve sourcing and contracting processes, mitigate supplier risks, and establish effective governance models with critical suppliers. As Summit continues to grow and expand its clinical development portfolio, this role will have opportunities to support additional R&D and Commercial procurement categories and contribute to broader procurement transformation, process improvement, and vendor management initiatives across the organization.


Role And Responsibilities

  • Serve as a lead/procurement business partner to Clinical Operations, providing strategic sourcing and commercial guidance throughout study planning, startup, execution, and closeout.
  • Develop and execute category and supplier strategies across Clinical Operations, Clinical Trial Supplies, and related R&D categories, balancing quality, compliance, service continuity, speed, and total cost.
  • Lead end-to-end competitive sourcing activities across CROs, central laboratories, imaging, eCOA and eClinical technology, IRT/RTSM, patient recruitment and retention, investigator payments, specialty clinical services, logistics, and clinical trial supply vendors.
  • Partner with Clinical Operations, R&D, and Clinical Supply Chain to translate study requirements, timelines, enrollment assumptions, and supply needs into effective sourcing plans and fit-for-purpose vendor solutions.
  • Provide commercial insights, market intelligence, benchmarking, bid analysis, and supplier recommendations to support study feasibility, budgeting, vendor selection, and executive decision-making.
  • Lead negotiation and review of MSAs, SOWs, work orders, rate cards, pricing models, service levels, and other commercial terms in collaboration with Legal, Finance, and business stakeholders.
  • Support financial oversight of outsourced clinical services by reviewing study budgets, change orders, scope modifications, forecasts, and supplier invoices to improve cost transparency, challenge unsupported charges, and identify savings or cost-avoidance opportunities.
  • Establish and facilitate vendor governance for strategic clinical and supply partners, including business reviews, performance scorecards, KPIs and SLAs, issue escalation, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement plans.
  • Proactively identify and help resolve supplier risks affecting study execution, including performance concerns, capacity constraints, timeline impacts, supply continuity, logistics dependencies, quality events, and contract compliance.
  • Contribute as a procurement generalist to broader enterprise priorities, including process standardization, sourcing tools, spend analytics, supplier rationalization, AI and automation projects, and other procurement transformation initiatives.

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills

  • Minimum BA/BS degree or relevant graduate degree preferred
  • Minimum of 10+ years of experience in a Procurement/Vendor Management or Finance environment in a pharmaceutical, CRO/ biotech company or worked in a clinical R&D operations setting with a CRO/Sponsor company
  • Good understanding of the drug development R&D process is important
  • In-depth understanding of clinical trial-related execution of large global studies, including CROs, central labs, imaging, drug supply, CMC vendors, and ancillary suppliers. Oncology experience preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of GCP, ICH, and regulatory expectations governing outsourced clinical activities
  • Demonstrated ability to multi-task, prioritize, and independently solve problems in a rapidly changing environment
  • Proficient user of standard MS Office suite (e.g., Word, Excel), experience using electronic document management systems (e.g. Veeva Vault, etc.), and document review tools desirable
  • Strong computer and database skills and experience with procurement or contract management systems (e.g., Ariba, Coupa, etc.)
  • Attention to detail, accuracy and confidentiality with clear and concise oral and written communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Critical thinking, problem solving, ability to work independently
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally, manage competing priorities, and operate in a fast-paced, high growth organization

jobs.description:
Werden Sie selbstständiger Überführungsfahrermit DriiveMe Partner

Erhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.

👉Registrieren Sie sich hier, um auf die Aufträge zuzugreifen:

DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.

Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe, um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar und viele weitere.

In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.

Worin besteht ein DriiveMe-Auftrag?

Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

  1. Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

  2. Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

  3. Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

  4. Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

  5. Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

  6. Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

  • Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

  • Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

  • Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

  • Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

  • Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

Wie viel verdiene ich?

Ihr Umsatz hängt davon ab, wie viele Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

Jeder Auftrag hat eine eigene Vergütung, die sich nach der Strecke, der Anzahl der Kilometer und der Komplexität des Transports richtet.

Bevor Sie einen Auftrag buchen, kennen Sie alle wichtigen Informationen: Abholort, Zielort, Vergütung und Bedingungen. Sie entscheiden frei, welche Aufträge Sie annehmen möchten.

Gesuchtes Profil

Um DriiveMe Partner beizutreten, sollten Sie idealerweise:

  • über eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis verfügen;

  • selbstständig sein oder bereit sein, selbstständig tätig zu werden;

  • zuverlässig, pünktlich und sorgfältig sein;

  • die Verfahren zur Abholung und Übergabe der Fahrzeuge einhalten;

  • verfügbar sein, um gelegentliche Aufträge in Ihrer Region oder in anderen Teilen Deutschlands durchzuführen.

Die Registrierung der Fahrer erfolgt zentral über die offizielle DriiveMe-Seite.
