From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

Make an Impact as a Regional Finance Manager at Worldwide


As a Regional Finance Manager, you'll play a critical role in ensuring strong financial governance, compliance, and operational excellence across multiple countries within your region. Your expertise will help maintain the integrity of financial operations while providing valuable insights that support business performance and informed decision-making.


Working closely with regional leadership, outsourced service providers, and global finance teams, you'll help drive accurate financial reporting, strengthen controls, and support statutory and regulatory compliance. You'll also have the opportunity to influence process improvements, enhance efficiencies, and contribute to finance transformation initiatives that support business success across the region.


Where You'll Work


This is a remote role open to candidates based in Serbia. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.


No travel is required for this role.


What You'll Do


  • Ensure financial activities across the region comply with corporate policies, accounting standards, statutory requirements, and local regulations.
  • Oversee regional financial operations and support accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities.
  • Review financial reporting outputs, resolve accounting issues, and maintain alignment between local statutory and corporate reporting requirements.
  • Coordinate with external accountants, tax advisors, auditors, and service providers to support statutory reporting and tax compliance obligations.
  • Partner with regional management teams to deliver financial analysis, insights, and recommendations that support business decisions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including Legal, Tax, Treasury, HR, and Operations on matters affecting financial performance and compliance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes through standardization, automation, enhanced controls, and operational efficiencies.
  • Support finance transformation projects, system enhancements, and the adoption of best practices across the region.
  • Monitor and manage the performance of outsourced finance, accounting, tax, audit, and advisory service providers.

What You'll Bring


  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CPA, CIMA, or equivalent) and/or a relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • 5-8 years of experience in Finance or Accounting roles, including statutory accounting and financial reporting responsibilities.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting standards, and internal control frameworks.
  • Experience interpreting and applying regulatory, tax, and statutory accounting requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience working within regional, international, or multinational environments, with exposure to multi-country compliance preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver results across several countries or business units.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Proficiency in English, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, and financial systems or accounting software.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

jobs.description:
Software International (SI) supplies technical talent to a variety of clients ranging from Fortune 100/500/1000 companies to small and mid-sized organizations in Canada/US.

We have a Permanent or 12 month renewable contract as a Senior Mainframe z/OS Hardware Programmer with our large consulting client, working on a long term project for one of Canada's largest banks. This could be an indefinite contract or a permanent role.

Role: Senior Mainframe z/OS Hardware Programmer

Type: Permanent or Long Term Contract

Duration: 12 months to start + possible multiple extensions or a permanent role

Salary or Rate: approximately $180,000 - $230,000 + bonus as permanent employee or $100 - $130/hr + C2C - depending on overall experience

Location: Remote, Toronto, ON, Canada

As a Sr. Mainframe z/OS Hardware Programmer, you are responsible for providing technical direction and subject matter expertise to ensure stable, reliable environments for complex sharing initiatives in compliance with established controls, standards, policies, and procedures. You will collaborate with and advise senior management, utilizing your solid understanding of business dynamics to analyze and protect test environment integrity and mitigate risks, present alternative solutions, and recommend solutions using available resources for complex initiatives with key dependencies. You will provide technical leadership, interpret complex information, and coordinate client, provider, and vendor relationships to meet and manage service expectations, aligned to best practices. In addition, you will help to develop the team to maximize individual contributions and professional growth, while functioning effectively with your colleagues.

In this role, you will be responsible for the Design, Deploy and Support of Mainframe Hardware Infrastructure including CPUs, Coupling Facilities, DASD, Tape systems and their related connections, management consoles and encryption devices. The job will perform Mainframe Hardware configuration, Hardware Problem determination, and work with vendors to support changes. Continually acquire and maintain knowledge of, hardware components, features, and tools that support Mainframe processing.

How you'll succeed

  • Technical Expertise you will leverage your solid technology expertise to review and analyze current client software and requirements to determine the most effective solution to include in business proposals; install, upgrade and customize ISV software tools in a multi-system z/OS mainframe environment, and help to ensure software and hardware remains current to avoid End of Support costs.
  • Effective Communication you will work to accomplish organizational goals that are consistent in supporting both IT and Business objectives, communicate effectively and patiently across technology teams to influence teams to adopt solutions to keep critical systems secure and operationally resilient. You will provide and document problem analysis, resolution, and prevention, designing procedures and best practice techniques, using IBM and ISV online tools for opening and managing problem report tracking and resolution. You will actively participate in periodic disaster recovery exercises, maintaining disaster recovery readiness of systems, and monitoring status of systems to proactively prevent issues from occurring.
  • Relationship Management You will collaborate with internal business partners in Application Development, Infrastructure, IT Operations, and IT Production Support to accomplish organizational goals that are consistent in supporting both IT and Business objectives. You will work directly with Hardware and Software vendors on solutions, build your network, and deepen existing relationships. You will leverage your verbal, written, and presentation communication skills to build strong partnerships, while influencing participants to mutually beneficial outcomes.

Who you are

  • You can demonstrate a minimum of 10 years' experience in Mainframe technology operating systems and specifically zOS Systems programming with z series Mainframe servers.
  • You also have strong knowledge and experience with z/OS concepts and facilities as well as TSO/ISPF functions, JCL, SAS, MICS, REXX and CLIST programming.

jobs.description:
Devenez chauffeur indépendant avec DriiveMe Partenaire

Accédez à des missions rémunérées de convoyage de véhicules partout en France, avec une organisation flexible et des frais de route pris en charge.

👉 Inscrivez-vous ici pour accéder aux missions :

DriiveMe est la plateforme leader européen du convoyage de véhicules. Chaque mois, plus de 20 000 missions rémunérées sont proposées à notre communauté de chauffeurs et convoyeurs indépendants partout en France.

Les grands acteurs de l’automobile font confiance à DriiveMe pour déplacer leurs véhicules : Stellantis, Aramisauto, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar, et bien d’autres.

Partout en France, des centaines de sociétés ont besoin de déplacer des véhicules d’un point A à un point B. Elles publient chaque jour leurs besoins sur DriiveMe afin de proposer ces missions à la communauté DriiveMe Partenaire.

En quoi consiste une mission DriiveMe ?

C’est simple : en tant que chauffeur indépendant, vous conduisez un véhicule d’un point A vers un point B. Voici comment ça fonctionne :

  1. Vous créez votre compte sur

  2. Vous accédez aux missions disponibles dans votre région.

  3. Vous consultez le trajet, la rémunération et les conditions de chaque mission.

  4. Vous réservez en quelques clics les missions que vous souhaitez réaliser.

  5. Le jour de la mission, vous récupérez le véhicule au point de départ et le livrez au point d’arrivée.

  6. Une fois la mission terminée et validée, vous recevez votre paiement automatiquement sous 10 jours.

Pourquoi devenir chauffeur indépendant avec DriiveMe Partenaire ?

  • Complément de revenus : chaque mission est rémunérée, avec un prix connu à l’avance.

  • Organisation flexible : vous choisissez librement les missions que vous souhaitez effectuer.

  • Frais de route pris en charge : carburant et péages sont remboursés selon les conditions de la mission.

  • Plateforme simple et intuitive : consultation, réservation et suivi des missions en ligne.

  • Missions partout en France : de nouvelles opportunités sont publiées chaque jour.

Combien suis-je rémunéré ?

Votre chiffre d'affaires dépend du nombre de missions que vous choisissez de réaliser.

Chaque mission dispose d’une rémunération spécifique, définie selon le trajet, le nombre de kilomètres et la complexité du transport.

Avant de réserver une mission, vous connaissez les informations essentielles : lieu de départ, lieu d’arrivée, rémunération et conditions de prise en charge. Vous êtes libre de réserver uniquement les missions qui vous conviennent.

Profil recherché

Pour rejoindre DriiveMe Partenaire, vous devez idéalement :

  • disposer d’un permis B valide ;

  • être indépendant ou prêt à le devenir ;

  • être sérieux, ponctuel et rigoureux ;

  • respecter les procédures de prise en charge et de livraison des véhicules ;

  • être disponible pour réaliser des missions ponctuelles dans votre région ou ailleurs en France.

jobs.description:
Salesforce QA Analyst

Location: Remote – South America

Why this Role Matters:

At Greenbox Capital, technology powers the financial workflows that help us serve small businesses quickly, accurately, and reliably. As a Salesforce QA Analyst, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring our Salesforce platform and connected applications are stable, scalable, and ready to support the business as we grow.

You’ll work across both manual and automated testing, with a strong focus on building and maintaining robust end-to-end automation using Playwright. You’ll validate complex Salesforce solutions spanning multiple business areas, identify risk before it reaches production, and help embed quality throughout our software development lifecycle.

Because our Salesforce environment supports business-critical financial workflows, integrations, and customer-facing processes, this role requires someone who understands that accuracy, data integrity, traceability, and strong regression protection matter.

This role reports to the QA Lead and Engineering Manager and partners closely with Salesforce Architects, Engineers, Product Management, QA, and Technology leadership.

What Success Looks Like:

Here’s how your time might break down (actual time can shift depending on business needs):

  • Reliability: Complete and accurate manual and automated QA coverage aligned with sprint commitments.
  • Efficiency: Accurate estimation, thoughtful effort allocation, and reliable execution of testing activities.
  • Quality: Strong regression protection and reduction of post-release defects.
  • Automation: Expansion and maintenance of reliable end-to-end automated test coverage.
  • Release Confidence: Early identification of defects, risks, dependencies, and edge cases before they reach production.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

Build Quality in from the Start

  • Review business requirements, technical designs, acceptance criteria, and user stories to identify test scenarios, gaps, dependencies, edge cases, and potential risks before development is complete.

Own Manual & Automated Testing

  • Develop and document comprehensive test plans and manual and automated test cases for Salesforce and connected applications.

Strengthen Our Delivery Process

  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish reliable regression and smoke-test execution as part of the software delivery lifecycle.

Partner Across Technology

  • Collaborate closely with Salesforce Architects, Engineers, Product Managers, QA peers, and Technology leadership.

You’re a Strong Fit if You:

  • Are naturally curious and willing to dig into how and why a system behaves the way it does—not simply whether a test passes or fails.
  • Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Think beyond the happy path and instinctively look for edge cases, dependencies, and potential points of failure.
  • Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Are organized, accountable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in an Agile environment.
  • Thrive in a remote, globally distributed team and adapt well as priorities and business needs evolve.
  • Bring a growth mindset and actively look for ways to improve testing, automation, processes, and overall product quality.
  • Take ownership of quality rather than waiting for someone else to identify a problem.

What You’ve Done Before:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of QA experience, including at least 1 year focused on Salesforce applications.
  • Hands-on experience testing Salesforce platforms, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and custom applications.
  • Professional experience within fintech, lending, banking, payments, or another financial-services organization is required.
  • Experience with automated end-to-end, regression, integration, and API testing.
  • Experience validating REST APIs, request/response payloads, business rules, and integration behavior.
  • Experience working within Agile software development teams.
  • Experience incorporating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience using source control systems such as Git.

Tools and Expertise You’ll Bring:

  • Hands-on experience with Playwright for automated end-to-end testing.
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, defect management, regression strategies, and risk-based testing.
  • Strong Salesforce testing knowledge across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and custom applications.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD workflows.
  • Experience with API and integration testing.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, and test-planning skills.
  • Strong time-management skills and the ability to deliver high-quality work in a remote environment.

What to Expect from Our Interview Process

We believe in a respectful, efficient, and transparent hiring experience. Here’s what you can expect:

Step 1: Initial Interview with People & Culture (30 minutes)

Step 2: Hiring Manager Interview (1 hour)

Step 3: Role-Specific Assessment or Panel Interview (1 hour)

Step 4: Final Interview or Leadership Chat (1 hour)

Step 5: Offer & Background Check

If it’s a mutual fit, we’ll move forward with background check and present a competitive offer. We aim to complete this process within 2–3 weeks from your first conversation with us.

Benefits:

💸 Competitive Contractor Pay – We value strong technical talent and compensate accordingly.

🏡 Remote Work – Work remotely from South America while collaborating with a distributed Greenbox team.

🚀 Meaningful Technical Impact – Help shape the quality and reliability of Salesforce systems supporting critical financial workflows.

🧠 Smart, Supportive Teammates – Work alongside curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems and building better systems.

💚 A Culture Built Around How We Work – Our core values guide how we make decisions, collaborate, and deliver: Wear Green First, Pull the Thread, Move the Needle, Courage Over Comfort, Think Bold, Win Together, and Own the Outcome

jobs.description:
logcat.ai is the AI engineering layer for the operating-system stack. We build agentic systems for Linux and Android devices: we ingest the diagnostic artifacts a device emits (bugreports, logcat, dmesg, modem traces, ramdumps, perfetto, pcap, CAN) and help device makers diagnose, remediate, test, and author features across their OS stack, grounded in their own BSP. Think Datadog and Cursor combined for the OS layer. A VC-backed startup with a small, senior team — you work directly with the founders.

We recently raised a $2.55M pre-seed. The product is scaling and the customer list is growing, but we're still small enough that everyone here shapes what comes next, including you.

You'll build the robotics substrate adapter alongside a lighthouse ROS team. This is the test of whether the core generalizes to a substrate outside our existing expertise, so scope is tight and outcome-driven.

This is a scoped, deliverable-based contract with a path to a full-time role.

A note on location

Remote, with at least four hours of overlap with Pacific or IST. We don't track hours. We ask for the overlap because a lot of this work is debugging together in real time, and that doesn't work across a twelve-hour gap. If you're in Seattle or Bengaluru, we'd like to meet in person now and then. It isn't a requirement.

The bar

  • 10+ years of relevant engineering experience.
  • ROS 2 in production, including DDS internals (Fast DDS / Cyclone DDS), discovery, and QoS behavior.
  • ros2_control, Nav2, or MoveIt.
  • Robotics bringup on Jetson / L4T.
  • TF2 and multi-sensor time-sync / calibration.
  • Proficient in day-to-day work with CLI-based AI coding tools like Claude Code (or an equivalent). It's how the team operates, not a nice-to-have.

What you'll do

  • Ingest and reason over robotics artifacts: rosbags (including MCAP), DDS discovery and QoS logs, ros2_control / Nav2 / MoveIt failures.
  • Diagnose Jetson / L4T boot and platform issues.
  • Handle the spatial and timing layer: TF2, sensor calibration, time synchronization.

Bonus

  • Real-time Linux (PREEMPT_RT).
  • ros2_tracing / LTTng.
  • End-to-end robot bringup done solo.
  • Multi-sensor platform integration.

What we offer you

  • A front seat as we scale. Customer calls, the roadmap, the pipeline, how the company is actually doing. What you build carries your name on it, and the scope grows faster than the org chart does.
  • Top-of-market salary. You're early enough that the ownership is real, not decorative. We'll walk through the full picture on the first call, and this shouldn't be a guessing game.
  • AI, all the way down. We use it for everything: writing code, reviewing it, research, ops, internal tooling. Any tool that unblocks you, we buy. If you already work this way, you'll feel at home in a day.
  • Your calls to make, from week one. Architecture, tooling, how the work gets done. These aren't consultations here.
  • Support while you make them. The founders are hands-on. You own the decision but you don't make it alone.
  • A lean team, senior, and kind in a way that's rare at this pace. People share what they know and help before they're asked. It's the part of this job we're proudest of.

What to expect after you apply

  • Screening call with Head of People & Business Operations
  • Technical conversation with Co-founder/ Head of Engineering
  • Technical exercise with Co-founder/ Head of Engineering
  • Final conversation with CEO
  • References, then offer

In your application, tell us what you'd own here, and the hardest thing you've shipped in this domain.

jobs.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a Staff Compiler Performance Engineer to set the technical direction for Falcon performance. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. You will decide where the next significant performance gains come from, lead the design of the optimizations that deliver them, and make sure the compiler architecture supports the product roadmap.

You will be the senior technical voice on a distributed team of compiler experts and a key partner for runtime, GC and product teams.

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

  • Define the performance strategy for Falcon: identify the largest opportunities across benchmarks and customer workloads and turn them into a technical roadmap
  • Lead design of complex, cross cutting optimizations in the optimizer and code generator, and of the interfaces between the compiler, the runtime and the garbage collector
  • Make architectural decisions on the Falcon optimization pipeline, compile time budget and tiering strategy
  • Lead enablement of Falcon on new hardware platforms and new Azul products
  • Mentor senior engineers, review critical designs and code, and set standards for performance methodology and validation
  • Represent Azul in the LLVM community: drive upstream design discussions and contributions that benefit managed language compilers

What You'll Bring (aka Experience, Skills)

  • 8+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers
  • Track record of technical leadership: owning the design of major compiler components or optimization frameworks used in production
  • Expert C++ skills and experience in large, long lived codebases
  • Deep expertise in compiler optimization and code generation, with a clear view of the tradeoffs between peak performance, compile time, warmup and code size
  • Expert performance analysis skills down to the microarchitecture level

mate. is your AI growth teammate, the eCommerce data network that agentically turns customer intelligence into revenue.

mate finds it, Checkmate goes and gets it. Checkmate is the distribution network, with 100M+ shoppers and 12B+ live intent signals. mate is the AI layer built on top of it: it resolves anonymous visitors, spots the revenue a brand is missing, and builds and executes the campaigns to capture it.

We're looking for someone to own how we show up in the world. Consumer social, community, creators, events, and the written stuff that makes people pay attention.

Two brands, one machine.

mate. is the B2B side. It's an AI growth teammate for eCommerce brands. mate knows who a brand's shoppers are and when to reach them, then builds and runs the campaigns that convert them. 600+ brands work with us, including Everlane, Brooklinen and Malbon.

The relationship in one line: mate finds it. Checkmate goes and gets it.

jobs.title: CX Lead, Diagnostics & Quality
jobs.excerpt: About LifeforceWe are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health.
jobs.description:
About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Role Overview

    Lifeforce is hiring a CX Lead, Diagnostics & Quality. This is a hybrid role with two main jobs. You'll own quality assurance for the entire CX team, and you'll lead the diagnostics program, including our lab, phlebotomy, and requisition partners. You'll also stay hands-on in the queue, working tickets and handling escalations.

    On the quality side, you'll own the CX QA program in Rippit (formerly MaestroQA) across every team that handles member contacts in Zendesk by email, SMS, and phone: Diagnostics Operations, Rx Operations, Billing, General Support, and Clinical CX. Clinical CX handles clinically related requests that don't need a licensed clinician, such as dosing logistics and follow-up after telehealth visits, and hands off to our internal RN and clinical teams when a clinician is needed. The program is in place today. You'll run it day to day: auditing interactions yourself, giving agents feedback through scorecards, and tracking how each team is performing. You'll also make the program better, with broader coverage through automation, sharper reporting, and feedback that changes how the team works.

    On the diagnostics side, you'll manage our relationships with lab, phlebotomy, and related partners. You'll find issues, escalate them through the right partner, and follow them through to resolution. As Lifeforce opens physical centers through franchise partners, you'll also help unblock center teams when they run into diagnostics issues. The RNs at each center are the primary point of contact, and you'll back them up.

    This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Customer Experience Manager. You'll work closely with CX leadership, Diagnostics, Clinical Operations, the internal RN team, and our partners.

Key Responsibilities

    Quality Assurance (about 40%)

    Conducting QA

  • Audit member interactions every week across Diagnostics Operations, Rx Operations, Billing, General Support, and Clinical CX, covering email, SMS, and phone. Score them in Rippit against our CX scorecards.

  • Give each agent feedback through completed scorecards, with specific examples of what went well and what to change.

  • Score for accuracy, communication, empathy, ownership, documentation, and policy adherence. For Clinical CX, also check whether contacts that need a clinician are triaged and handed off to the RN or clinical team correctly.

  • Meet review coverage targets by agent and team so everyone is reviewed on a consistent schedule.

  • Escalate critical errors and member-impacting issues to CX leadership right away.

  • Partner with the CX Manager on individual and team coaching, using QA results and examples from reviews.

    • Tracking performance

  • Track QA performance by agent, team, and channel. Report results and trends to CX leadership on a regular cadence.

  • Analyze QA results alongside CSAT to spot recurring knowledge, process, and compliance gaps. Separate individual performance issues from training, documentation, tooling, or process gaps.

    • Improving the program

  • Own the CX scorecards, rubrics, review assignments, sampling approach, and workflows in Rippit. Keep them aligned with current Lifeforce processes and policies.

  • Run regular calibration sessions so scoring stays consistent across reviewers and CX leadership.

  • Find and implement automation where it makes sense, such as AI-assisted scoring, risk-based sampling, automatic flagging, and automated reporting. Check automated results against human review before relying on them.

    • Diagnostics Program & Partner Management (about 40%)

  • Own day-to-day relationships with our lab and phlebotomy partners.

  • Track partner performance, raise issues, and drive them to resolution.

  • Track the diagnostics metrics that shape the member experience, including redraw rate, turnaround time, requisition and order errors, and blood draw CSAT, and act when they drift.

  • Run diagnostics error checks and the Clinical Redraw Tracker, and flag issues that affect members.

  • Run a weekly review of partner trends and follow up on open items.

  • Track diagnostics tech issues with Product and Engineering, and communicate to the team when fixes or changes go live.

  • Support center teams and RNs at franchise partner locations when they run into diagnostics issues.

  • Coordinate diagnostics support for special events and partner initiatives.

  • Prepare and distribute weekly Quality and Diagnostics reporting for CX leadership.

    • Queue & Escalations (about 20%)

  • Work the Zendesk queue directly across channels, including email, SMS, and phone, to stay close to members, systems, and workflows.

  • Handle complex diagnostics escalations, and provide phone support across the queue, which will make up about half of this time.

  • Serve as the go-to resource for the CX team on diagnostics workflows and unusual cases.

  • Monitor Zendesk and diagnostics Slack channels for emerging issues and trends.

    • Documentation & Enablement

  • Keep Guru, Help Center articles, macros, and Zendesk materials current, especially when QA findings point to a gap.

  • Partner with CX leadership on new-hire quality readiness and ongoing up-training.

What Success Looks Like

    In your first 90 days: get up to speed on Rippit and take over day-to-day QA reviews and scorecard feedback across all five teams. Set baseline scores, coverage, and team performance tracking, and run your first calibration cycle with CX leadership. Take over day-to-day management of our lab and phlebotomy partner relationships, and set a baseline on the core diagnostics metrics. Get weekly Quality and Diagnostics reporting running on a regular cadence.

    In your first year: every CX team is reviewed on a consistent schedule, scoring is calibrated across reviewers, and a meaningful share of review volume is screened or sampled through automation, with accuracy checked against human review. QA findings are driving documentation, training, and process changes. Diagnostics partner issues are caught and escalated early, and redraw rate and turnaround time are trending in the right direction.

Qualifications

    Required

  • 3–5 years of customer support or CX experience, including time in a lead, QA, or senior agent role.

  • Hands-on experience running or contributing to a QA program, including rubric-based scoring, calibration, and giving feedback.

  • Experience managing vendor or partner relationships, including escalating issues and following them through.

  • Comfortable communicating verbally by phone and video with internal teams, external partners, and members as a regular part of the role.

  • Strong Zendesk experience across email, SMS, and phone.

  • Comfortable with data: tracking metrics, building reports, spotting trends, and explaining what they mean.

  • Clear written and verbal communication with internal teams and external partners, including delivering direct, constructive feedback.

  • Organized and able to balance scheduled QA work, partner follow-up, and queue work in the same week.

  • Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

    • Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, telehealth, or lab services.

  • Experience with Rippit, MaestroQA, or a similar QA platform, including setting up scorecards and reporting.

  • Experience using automation or AI tools in a QA workflow.

  • Familiarity with lab ordering, requisitions, or mobile phlebotomy.

  • Experience with Guru, Slack, and an order management system.

Traits for Success

  • Pairs every finding with a recommendation.

  • Gives direct, specific feedback that peers take seriously, without formal authority.

  • Can tell when a problem is a person, a process, or a partner, and treats each one differently.

  • Persistent with partners and comfortable following up until an issue is actually closed.

  • Keeps the member experience in view in every review and escalation.

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where products and processes keep changing.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment

  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment

  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance

  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.

Werden Sie selbstständiger Überführungsfahrermit DriiveMe Partner

Erhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.

DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.

Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe, um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar und viele weitere.

In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.

Worin besteht ein DriiveMe-Auftrag?

Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

  1. Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

  2. Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

  3. Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

  4. Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

  5. Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

  6. Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

  • Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

  • Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

  • Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

  • Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

  • Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

Wie viel verdiene ich?

Ihr Umsatz hängt davon ab, wie viele Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

Jeder Auftrag hat eine eigene Vergütung, die sich nach der Strecke, der Anzahl der Kilometer und der Komplexität des Transports richtet.

Bevor Sie einen Auftrag buchen, kennen Sie alle wichtigen Informationen: Abholort, Zielort, Vergütung und Bedingungen. Sie entscheiden frei, welche Aufträge Sie annehmen möchten.

Gesuchtes Profil

Um DriiveMe Partner beizutreten, sollten Sie idealerweise:

  • über eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis verfügen;

  • selbstständig sein oder bereit sein, selbstständig tätig zu werden;

  • zuverlässig, pünktlich und sorgfältig sein;

  • die Verfahren zur Abholung und Übergabe der Fahrzeuge einhalten;

  • verfügbar sein, um gelegentliche Aufträge in Ihrer Region oder in anderen Teilen Deutschlands durchzuführen.

Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Aldevron, one of Danaher's 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives, and we're all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You'll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher's system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact - innovating at the speed of life.

At Aldevron, we deliver world-class CDMO services that accelerate the development of groundbreaking therapies. Our mission is to be the engine of innovation for genomic medicine pioneers. As a member of our team, you'll help bring life-changing innovations to life - impacting millions around the world. We bring together deep scientific expertise, an unwavering commitment to quality, and a collaborative spirit to drive progress. Whether you're launching your career or bringing years of experience, we value the unique perspective you bring. Join us and become part of a mission-driven team advancing science and unlocking human potential - one discovery at a time.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Senior Program Manager, Plasmid DNA is responsible for leading Aldevron's most strategic and complex plasmid DNA programs, with a primary focus on marketed products, commercial supply, and late-phase clinical programs progressing through process validation, Process Performance Qualification (PPQ), regulatory readiness, and commercial launch.

This role serves as the senior client-facing program leader for assigned programs and integrates commercial agreements with technical and operational execution. The Program Manager ensures alignment across scope, schedule, quality, supply continuity, financial performance, regulatory expectations, and customer commitments throughout validation, PPQ, launch preparation, recurring commercial supply, and lifecycle management.

The Program Manager partners closely with Business Development, Legal, Contracts, Project Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Technical Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership to convert contractual commitments into executable plans, resolve complex issues, protect Aldevron's business interests, and build durable strategic client partnerships.

This position reports to the Vice President, North America Sales and is part of the Program Management Organization located in Fargo, ND and will be fully remote.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Lead Program and Project Execution: Lead highly complex, multi-program portfolios across strategic accounts, owning end-to-end delivery across multiple concurrent projects with significant revenue, risk, and cross-functional dependencies, ensuring alignment with timelines, budgets, and KPIs.
  • Cultivate Strategic Client Relationships: Own and influence senior-level client relationships and account strategy, acting as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, navigating escalations, and shaping program direction and long-term partnership outcomes.
  • Internal Team Alignment and Development: Drive enterprise-wide alignment and decision-making, leading cross-functional teams through ambiguity, resolving competing priorities, and influencing outcomes across functions and leadership levels.
  • Ensure Operational Excellence and Governance: Establish and maintain program governance structures, track project metrics, forecast capacity, and provide regular updates to senior leadership on project status, risks, and opportunities. Translate master service agreements, statements of work, supply and quality agreements, amendments, and change orders into executable operating requirements, and partner with Business Development, Legal, Contracts, and Finance to assess feasibility, manage scope change, support negotiations, and protect Aldevron's commercial and contractual position.
  • Support Business Growth and Continuous Improvement: Responsible for overall program health, capacity strategy, business growth, including forecasting demand, identifying risks, leading proposals and renewals, and influencing account expansion and continuous improvement initiatives.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • B.S. or B.A. required. Advanced degree in scientific field strongly preferred (e.g. molecular biology, biology, biotechnology, biochemistry)
  • Prefer 7+ years of experience in a client-facing role as a project, program, or account manager within the life sciences, with preference for 5+ years in a GMP-regulated CDMO environment
  • Experience managing programs and contracts in a regulated biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or medical device related field required
  • Working knowledge of plasmid DNA manufacturing and its use in cell and gene therapy, gene editing, mRNA, vaccines, or other genomic medicine applications; strong preference for late phase/commercial drug product experience.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to forecast risks and implement sustainable solutions.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • An advanced degree in a scientific, engineering, legal, project management, or business discipline, or a program or project management certification such as PMP.
  • Direct program leadership for commercial or late-phase plasmid DNA programs through process characterization, technology transfer, process validation, PPQ campaigns, regulatory inspections, commercial launch, recurring supply, or post-approval lifecycle management.
  • Experience managing strategic accounts, cross-site programs, long-term supply agreements, capacity reservation models, demand planning, forecast commitments, pricing protections, change-order mechanisms, termination provisions, executive governance, or commercial supply continuity.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time, including travel to the Fargo, ND site and client locations, with overnight travel based on business and customer needs.

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer, AI-Driven Detection & Response
jobs.excerpt: About FullscriptWe’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better.
jobs.description:
About Fullscript

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Staff Security Engineer to define and drive Fullscript's defensive threat detection, incident response, and AI-assisted SecOps capability across our cloud infrastructure, identity, endpoints, and application ecosystems.

This role sits at the technical core of our Security function. You will architect modern detection systems, leverage AI/ML to automate SecOps workflows, and establish defensive testing practices for AI threat vectors. Partnering with Engineering and Platform teams, you will ensure our detection and response capabilities scale with Fullscript's fast-growing, AI-first infrastructure.

The ideal candidate has owned enterprise-scale detection engineering and incident response end-to-end. You are a pragmatic, forward-thinking engineer who excels at designing AI-augmented SOC workflows, conducting targeted AI defensive testing, and converting threat telemetry into automated, high-precision detection and response systems.

What You'll Do

Detection Engineering & Defensive Strategy

  • Set the multi-quarter technical direction for detection and response, and drive it across Security, Platform, and Engineering teams.

  • Architect, author, and maintain advanced detection logic across SIEM, cloud infrastructure, identity systems, endpoint protection, and AI/ML pipelines.

  • Establish detection coverage and defensive controls against emerging AI and agentic threat vectors (e.g., prompt injection, tool misuse, and data exfiltration patterns).

  • Own the full rule lifecycle, from authoring and testing through tuning and retirement, and measure it against concrete signals: detection coverage, precision (false-positive rate), and time-to-detect.

  • Create and maintain dashboards and reporting that give leadership visibility into alert volume, response times, and trends over time.

AI-Augmented Security Operations & Automation

  • Design and deploy AI-assisted investigation workflows that leverage LLMs and automated agents to accelerate triage, context enrichment, and threat containment.

  • Build and extend internal security tooling to support identity resolution, cross-source log correlation, and natural-language querying over security telemetry.

  • Automate the handoff between detection tooling and our ticketing system so investigations move from alert to resolution with minimal manual work.

Incident Response & Investigations

  • Lead and support security investigations end-to-end, from initial triage through containment and resolution.

  • Mentor Security Operations team members and set the standards the team builds against, including rule quality, detection-as-code practices, and investigation rigor.

  • Partner with relevant teams across the business to investigate and remediate security escalations surfaced from Customer Support, Customer Delivery, and internal teams.

  • Maintain and improve response playbooks based on lessons learned from real investigations.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to respond to security incidents outside business hours.

AI Defensive Testing & Validation

  • Threat model new and existing systems, including AI agents and services, to identify what could go wrong, what we would need to see to catch it, and how we would respond.

  • Lead defensive testing, purple-teaming, and adversarial validation exercises to test alert fidelity and evaluate detection resilience against AI-driven threats.

  • Partner with Platform and Engineering teams to ensure new AI services and features expose necessary logging and telemetry for effective security monitoring.

  • Evaluate authorization and access-control changes for security-relevant blast radius, and drive remediation with the engineering teams that own the affected systems.

Threat Intelligence

  • Operationalize threat intelligence into actionable detections and tracked follow-up work.

  • Coordinate indicator of compromise (IOC) blocking across endpoint, network, and web layers.

What You Bring to the Table

  • 8+ years of experience in detection engineering, incident response, or security engineering, with demonstrated leadership in shaping organizational security strategy.

  • Practical experience incorporating AI tooling into SecOps workflows, along with familiarity with detection strategies for AI-specific threat vectors.

  • Strong scripting/automation skills (Python, JavaScript, or similar) and experience building workflows in a SOAR-style or workflow automation platform.

  • Experience managing security controls as code (e.g., Terraform), with changes made through peer review rather than manual console changes.

  • Experience securing cloud environments (AWS preferred) and modern SaaS/identity stacks.

  • Hands-on incident response experience: triage, investigation, containment, and postmortem/playbook development.

  • Working knowledge of adversary tradecraft (MITRE ATT&CK) and the ability to translate it into practical, tuned detections rather than noisy alerts.

  • Proven ability to partner directly with engineering and infrastructure teams to define telemetry and control requirements for systems you don't own.

  • Excellent written communication. This role regularly turns investigation findings into clear, factual updates for technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

Bonus if You Have

  • Experience contributing to or building from open detection content, such as Sigma rules or community rule repos.

  • Experience collaborating with red/purple-team exercises to validate detection coverage.

  • Experience supporting a healthcare, regulated, or otherwise highly sensitive-data environment.

  • Relevant certifications (GCIH, GCFA, GCTI, GCDA, or equivalent practical experience).

What we can offer you:

  • Generous PTO and competitive pay
  • Fullscript’s RRSP match program for financial health
  • Flexible benefits package and workplace wellness program
  • Training budget and company-wide learning initiatives
  • Discount on Fullscript catalog of products
  • Ability to work Wherever You Work Well*
    • *Our Wherever You Work Well philosophy means Fullscript teammates get to pick their own office — whether that’s in-office, at home, or a bit of both 🐶🏡

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

What to Know Before You Apply

We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.

A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.
Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at .
All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.
We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.

Catena is the universal API for fleet telematics data. About the Role

At Catena Clearing, you will own the core infrastructure powering our universal telematics data platform. Catena ingests, normalizes, and delivers high-frequency GPS, sensor, and HOS data from millions of vehicles across hundreds of distinct ELD integrations in real time. In this role, you will lead the technical vision for our cloud infrastructure, distributed event pipelines, and developer tooling—ensuring our platform maintains sub-second API response times, fault tolerance, and 99.99% uptime as our data volume explodes.

Responsibilities

  • Core Platform Architecture: Lead the long-term technical strategy and architectural roadmap for Catena's high-throughput infrastructure, setting system design standards that balance scale, security, and velocity.

  • High-Volume Ingestion & Streaming: Architect and scale distributed event-streaming systems (e.g., Kinesis, Kafka) capable of processing millions of concurrent telemetry pings, location updates, and webhook deliveries without data drop-off.

  • Integration Frameworks: Design standardized abstractions, API gateways, and microservice patterns that empower product teams to rapidly build, test, and deploy new ELD and telematics integrations.

  • Infrastructure as Code & Cloud Operations: Own our cloud footprint (AWS), container orchestration, and IaC (AWS CDK) to maximize resilience, dynamic scaling, and cloud spend efficiency.

  • Observability & Reliability Engineering: Drive company-wide telemetry, distributed tracing, alerting, operational runbooks, and incident management protocols (SLIs/SLOs) to minimize MTTR across all critical data processing paths.

  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Champion engineering excellence through architectural reviews (RFCs), establish production standards, and actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across the platform organization.

Qualifications & Tech Stack

  • Experience: 8+ years of software, platform, or infrastructure engineering experience, with 2+ years operating in a Staff-level or principal technical leadership capacity.

Position Overview

As a Research intern at Autodesk Research, you will explore and apply novel technologies and techniques to empower our customers in designing and building a better, safer, and more sustainable world. Working with a multidisciplinary research team across AI, spatial computing, AEC, and human perception, you’ll develop and evaluate methods that interconnect different representations of the built environment within immersive, editable world models. Possible research directions may include exploring editing non-traditional 3d geometries such as gaussian splats, building multi-layered spatial representations of architectural spaces (simulations, physics, rendering, reality capture), and controlling 3d modeling and design environments and processes with agentic workflows.


You’ll build research prototypes and explore how this work could inform future Autodesk design workflows.

jobs.excerpt: At Murj, we do what we love and love what we do! Murj was founded in 2014 to solve a problem witnessed first-hand.
jobs.description:
At Murj, we do what we love and love what we do!

Murj was founded in 2014 to solve a problem witnessed first-hand. Founder and CEO, Todd, worked with cardiology practices as an implantable cardiac device sales representative for Medtronic. He watched clinicians struggle to manage these sophisticated devices using outdated and inadequate tools. Having previously worked in product management at Apple, Todd knew that brilliant design can profoundly impact the user experience -- so why not design a better way to care for patients with implantable devices?

In Murj, Todd created an enterprise SaaS cardiac device management software solutions company that reimagines and transforms patient care through thoughtful design and a passion for quality and a commitment to customer satisfaction. Today, Murj continues this transformative innovation with intuitive, elegant, and imaginative technology solutions that improve the lives of cardiac care professionals and their patients.

What Murj offers.

Murj is for people seeking a fast-paced, ever-changing environment surrounded by a supportive team that works hard and strives for innovation and professionalism, with a steady diet of humility and camaraderie.

Every employee is treated like family, with love, respect, and responsibility. The individual and collective success of every employee is at the forefront of what we do and believe.

And in joining Murj, you are joining a community that believes in evolution and promotion from within; there is a high degree of opportunity for progression, creativity, and ownership.

From your first day at Murj, you are eligible for full medical, dental, and vision insurance along with an open vacation policy, more than 10 annual company holidays, and competitive compensation and equity participation, and a 401(k) after 3 months of service.

How We Work at Murj

Murj is the right place for people who excel in fast-paced, dynamic environments. Murj embodies a high-performance culture where every team member is expected to exceed expectations and take ownership beyond their role to drive our collective success.

Employees should be comfortable working independently and taking initiative to identify and address needs. This proactive approach is essential to thriving at Murj.

We believe in working hard together, with a shared sense of purpose and drive. We’re not afraid to ask tough questions, and we support each other in reaching for bold new ideas.

Let us leave you with this.

If this role sounds intriguing - we encourage you to apply. And we encourage applicants to embrace new challenges, as the right fit at Murj is often more about the person and the challenges they seek, not just what they have accomplished in the past.

About The Role.

As an SQA Engineer at Murj, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our enterprise SaaS cardiac device management platform. Working closely with Engineering and Product teams, you will focus on end-to-end functional testing, user-level workflow validation, and exploratory testing to safeguard clinical data integrity, interval tracking, and EHR interoperability. You will serve as the advocate for our clinical users, ensuring that every software update delivers a seamless and highly reliable experience for healthcare providers managing life-saving cardiac devices.

What You’ll Do.

  • Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and manual test cases covering functional, end-to-end, regression, and usability testing.
  • Validate complex clinical workflows, including patient data processing, transmission triaging, billing interval tracking, and discrete HL7/FHIR EHR data integration.
  • Perform non-code-level (black box) functional validation to simulate real-world clinician and administrator usage patterns across the application.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to review requirements, refine user stories, and ensure complete test coverage prior to product releases.
  • Identify, document, and track software defects thoroughly using issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira), working alongside developers to verify fixes and ensure high-quality software output.
  • Partner with Customer Support to investigate, reproduce, and triage reported production bugs or customer-escalated application issues.
  • Participate in release readiness evaluations and sign-off processes for web application deployments and feature updates.

What Makes You a Great Fit.

  • You have an uncompromising commitment to quality and detail, recognizing that behind every software feature are clinicians and cardiac patients who depend on accurate data.
  • You demonstrate strong analytical thinking and curiosity, actively probing for edge cases, unexpected user paths, and system failure modes.
  • You take full ownership over software quality, proactively identifying gaps in requirement specifications or test coverage without waiting for direction.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance environment, navigating shifting priorities with adaptability and a solution-oriented mindset.

What You Bring.

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance with a strong focus on manual/black box testing of web applications and SaaS platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience testing complex workflows, cross-browser performance, and data integration layers.
  • Solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and experience working within Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
  • Proven ability to write clear, concise, and structured test plans, test scenarios, and bug reports.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and strong written and verbal communication abilities.

Nice To Haves.

  • Experience testing healthcare software, clinical software workflows, or medical device data systems.
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR) and HIPAA/PHI compliance regulations.
  • Experience using Jira or similar test management and issue tracking platforms.
  • Basic knowledge of API testing tools (e.g., Postman) for validating data movement across endpoints.

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days).

  • First 30 Days: You’ve completed onboarding, gained a strong foundational understanding of Murj’s clinical workflows and system architecture, and integrated into sprint rituals. You are executing existing test cases and participating in release regression cycles.
  • By Day 60: You are independently writing comprehensive test cases for new feature requests, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to clarify requirements, and triaging production bugs with Customer Support.
  • By Day 90: You are a trusted authority on software quality across the Murj platform. You have identified and filled gaps in test coverage, streamlined regression testing cycles, and consistently advocate for optimal user experience and system reliability.

Travel expectations:1-10%: Minimal to no travel; maybe a few meetings or events.

Committed Staff is seeking 2–3 Mid-Level QA Automation Engineers to join a fast-growing

will be embedded in a product engineering team responsible for ensuring quality across web

applications, APIs, and AI-driven features.

quality-first culture, and grow your expertise in AI-assisted QA methodologies.

Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end automated test suites using Playwright.

Collaborate with developers and product managers to define acceptance criteria and test

plans.

Leverage AI-powered QA tools and methodologies to improve test coverage and efficiency.

Identify, document, and track defects through their full lifecycle.

Participate in sprint ceremonies including planning, refinement, and retrospectives.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

2–4 years of experience in QA automation roles.

Solid hands-on experience with Playwright (TypeScript or JavaScript preferred).

Understanding of software testing methodologies: unit, integration, E2E, and regression.

Experience writing and maintaining test cases for web applications.

Familiarity with REST API testing (Postman, REST Assured, or similar).

Experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Good communication skills in English (written and spoken).

NICE TO HAVE

Experience with AI-assisted QA tools (e.g., Testim, Mabl, Applitools, or LLM-based test

generation).

Knowledge of performance or load testing tools (k6, Artillery, Locust).

Exposure to mobile testing (iOS/Android via Playwright or Appium).

Background in automotive, IoT, telematics, or SaaS products.

Familiarity with accessibility testing standards (WCAG).

Experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, Gherkin).

TECH STACK & TOOLS

Testing: Playwright, Postman, REST Assured

Languages: TypeScript / JavaScript (primary), Python or Java (a plus)

CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or CircleCI

AI QA Tools: Testim, Mabl, Applitools, or equivalent (preferred)

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive salary in USD (based on experience and location).

100% remote position with flexible working hours.

Long-term engagement with a stable, growing client.

Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and telematics technology.

Supportive, collaborative team culture.

Professional development and learning opportunities.

HOW TO APPLY

If you are passionate about quality engineering and want to work in a product where your impact is

visible from day one, we want to hear from you. Please send your resume and a brief note about

your Playwright experience to our recruiting team at Committed Staff.

  • Availability to travel abroad (no more than 1-2 times per year for about 1 week), if needed.

Senior level

Highly skilled professional with vast knowledge in specific areas (e.g. Business Analysis, Product Management), capable to do complex tasks or solve problems that do not have routine solutions, able to anticipate issues / risks and address them in a positive manner facilitating their resolution / mitigation; mentors and offers guidance to others;

jobs.description:
At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. About the role

In this role, you will drive cutting-edge custom Machine Learning Accelerator (ASIC) technology that powers high-demanding, large-scale AI applications and global cloud infrastructure. You will leverage your design and verification expertise to evaluate complex digital designs, with a specific focus on ML compute architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

You will focus on ASIC development, validation, software, tools, and methodologies, pushing the boundaries of chip development and hardware-software integration. As a Senior Engineer, you will own cross-functional workstreams focused on end-to-end hardware-software integration and validation to demonstrate hardware, software, and system functionality and performance. You will serve as a key bridge between specification, design, and verification teams, as well as compiler and performance teams across the ML compute IP ecosystem.

Work Environment

Fully remote role. Flexible schedule with participation in team ceremonies and cross-functional collaboration.

As a qualified expert, You will

  • Review chip specifications and designs, developing integration plans with software and system partners while coordinating hardware/software delivery.
  • Lead the bringup of ML compute features, integrating and validating complex hardware/software designs, including third-party IPs. Develop validation firmware to verify hardware functionality.
  • Execute hardware-software co-simulation methodologies leveraging RTL, emulation, and field-programmable gate array (FPGA) environments. Utilize architectural simulators and performance models to correlate results.
  • Design validation tests and microbenchmarks to verify IP functionality and performance. Author comprehensive test plans in coordination with cross-functional teams including Design, Design Verification (DV), Firmware, and Architecture.
  • Own debug discussions with Design/DV/Software/Architecture teams and help root cause functional failures and performance issues throughout the product development cycle. Improve validation coverage and sign-off processes for high-quality tapeout and production deployment.

We’re looking for you if you have

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in two of the following: computer architecture, embedded firmware, ASIC design or verification, or the integration and enablement of first/third party IPs.
  • Experience in hardware/software integration and validation.
  • Experience with register-transfer level (RTL) development, design verification, and evaluation.

Bonus Points

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • 4 years of experience with C++/Python software design principles.
  • Experience integrating complex hardware/software systems in accelerators.
  • Experience developing firmware for embedded systems or accelerators.
  • Experience in debugging firmware using simulation tools.
  • Knowledge of real-time operating system (RTOS) internals.

What’s in it for You

Reveal great tech solutions

Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling clients growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships with our clients.

Work fully remote around the globe, or in a hybrid work model from our office hubs which are equipped with everything needed for comfortable work. Enjoy a flexible working schedule and create work and rest balance for yourself. Empower yourself with a stable workload and a stable income, focusing on lasting cooperation and high-performance culture.

Diventa conducente professionale con DriiveMe Partner

DriiveMe è la piattaforma leader europea nel trasferimento di veicoli. Ogni mese vengono proposti più di 20.000 incarichi retribuiti alla nostra community di autisti con partita iva in tutta Italia.

I grandi operatori del settore automobilistico si affidano a DriiveMe per spostare i loro veicoli: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar e molti altri.

In tutta Italia, centinaia di aziende hanno bisogno di spostare veicoli da un punto A a un punto B. Ogni giorno pubblicano le loro richieste su DriiveMe per proporre questi incarichi alla community DriiveMe Partner.

In cosa consiste un incarico DriiveMe?

È semplice: come autosta con partita iva, guidi un veicolo da un punto A a un punto B. Ecco come funziona:

  1. Crei il tuo account sudriiveme.com.

  2. Accedi agli incarichi disponibili nella tua zona.

  3. Consulti il tragitto, il compenso e le condizioni di ogni incarico.

  4. Prenoti in pochi clic gli incarichi che desideri svolgere.

  5. Il giorno dell’incarico, ti presenti al punto di partenza, ritiri il veicolo e lo consegni al punto di arrivo.

  6. Una volta convalidato l'incarico, ricevi automaticamente il pagamento nel primo periodo utile tra le tre scadenze mensili previste ogni 10 giorni

Perché diventare autista con partita iva con DriiveMe Partner?

  • Entrate aggiuntive: ogni incarico è retribuito, con un compenso noto in anticipo.

  • Organizzazione flessibile: scegli liberamente gli incarichi che desideri svolgere.

  • Spese di viaggio rimborsate: carburante e pedaggi sono rimborsati secondo le condizioni dell’incarico.

  • Piattaforma semplice e intuitiva: consultazione, prenotazione e gestione degli incarichi online.

  • Incarichi in tutta Italia: ogni giorno vengono pubblicate nuove opportunità.

Quanto posso guadagnare?

Il tuo fatturato dipende dal numero di incarichi che decidi di svolgere.

Ogni incarico prevede un compenso specifico, definito in base al tragitto, al numero di chilometri e alla complessità del trasporto.

Prima di prenotare un incarico, conosci tutte le informazioni essenziali: luogo di partenza, luogo di arrivo, compenso e condizioni di presa in carico. Sei libero di prenotare solo gli incarichi che ti interessano.

Profilo ricercato

Per entrare a far parte di DriiveMe Partner, idealmente devi:

  • avere una patente di guida valida;

  • disporre di partita iva o essere disposto ad aprirla;

  • essere serio, puntuale e preciso;

  • rispettare le procedure di ritiro e consegna dei veicoli;

  • essere disponibile a svolgere incarichi occasionali nella tua zona o in altre parti d’Italia.

About Veriff

Veriff guarantees trust for some of the largest consumer platforms in the world. We're known for identity verification, but that is only where we started. About Navista

We believe in the power of community oncology to support patients through their cancer journeys. As an oncology practice alliance comprised of more than 40 sites, Navista provides the support community practices need to fuel their growth—while maintaining their independence.

What Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) contributes to Cardinal Health

Practice Operations Management oversees the business and administrative operations of medical practices.

Revenue Cycle Management manages a team focused on a series of clinical and administrative processes that healthcare providers utilize to capture, bill, and collect patient service revenue. The revenue cycle shadows the entire patient care journey and begins with patient appointment scheduling and ends when the patient’s account balance is zero.


Position Summary

The Coordinator, Financial Counseling is responsible for supporting patients and providers by ensuring accurate financial clearance, patient education, and identification of financial risk prior to services being rendered.

This role plays a critical part in the Revenue Cycle by improving reimbursement outcomes, minimizing financial risk, and enhancing the patient experience through proactive and transparent financial communication.


Responsibilities


Financial Counseling & Patient Support

  • Review daily schedules to identify patients requiring financial clearance.
  • Educate patients on expected financial responsibility, including:
    • Deductibles
    • Copayments
    • Coinsurance
    • Out-of-pocket maximums
  • Provide clear, compassionate communication regarding treatment costs and payment expectations prior to TOS.
  • Assist patients in understanding their financial obligations prior to services.

Financial Risk Identification

  • Evaluate potential financial risks associated with scheduled services, including:
    • Coverage limitations
    • Medical necessity concerns
    • Frequency limitations
    • Out of Network Benefits and coverages
  • Proactively identify accounts that may result in patient balance or denied claims.
  • Escalate high-risk accounts to leadership or appropriate teams for review.

Denials Prevention & Support

  • Collaborate with clinical and administrative teams to reduce the risk of claim denials.
  • Support resolution of pre-service financial issues that may impact reimbursement.
  • Assist in identifying trends related to financial risk and patient responsibility.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate documentation of all financial discussions with patients.
  • Ensure all notes are clear, complete, and compliant with organizational standards.
  • Protect patient confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA standards.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with clinical and administrative teams to ensure alignment on patient financial readiness.
  • Communicate effectively with internal teams to support accurate and timely revenue cycle processes.
  • Provide exceptional customer service with empathy, professionalism, and respect.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrate strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Maintain consistent attendance, punctuality, and teamwork.
  • Support additional duties and projects as they are assigned.

Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of insurance and benefits and patient Financial Assistance Programs
  • Strong understanding of oncology treatment pathways
  • Familiarity with high-cost oncology drugs, infusion services and specialty pharmacy billing preferred
  • Working knowledge of diagnosis driven financial impact (metastatic vs early stage treatment cost difference) preferred
  • Experience with billing systems and interpreting EOBs
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills
  • Ability to navigate multiple systems with ease, i.e. EMR, Registration/PMS systems, VOB systems, verifying Auth and Financial clearance with minimal direction from supervisor(s) and leadership.
  • Critical thinking and ability to think outside the box, adapt to process and workflow changes easily.
  • Experience in oncology or specialty care preferred

  • Background in financial counseling or patient-facing financial roles

  • Effectively applies knowledge of job and company policies and procedures to complete a variety of assignments
  • In-depth knowledge in technical or specialty area
  • Applies advanced skills to resolve complex problems independently
  • May modify process to resolve situations
  • Works independently within established procedures; may receive general guidance on new assignments
  • May provide general guidance or technical assistance to less experienced team members
