Position Summary

The AI Risk and Governance Lead is responsible for establishing, implementing, and overseeing the organization's AI governance framework, ensuring artificial intelligence solutions are deployed responsibly, ethically, securely, and in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

This role serves as the critical bridge between Legal, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), Cybersecurity, Privacy, Internal Audit, Technology, Data Science, and Business teams to ensure AI solutions align with enterprise risk tolerance and regulatory expectations.

The AI Risk and Governance Lead translates emerging AI regulations, ethical principles, and risk requirements into practical, scalable guardrails that enable responsible innovation rather than create barriers to business value. The role will establish governance processes, operationalize regulatory requirements, and ensure AI risks are proactively identified, assessed, monitored, and managed throughout the AI lifecycle.

Primary Responsibility

Serve as the enterprise lead for AI Risk and Governance by translating evolving AI regulations, risk management frameworks, and responsible AI principles into practical governance controls, standards, and operating procedures that enable safe, compliant, and scalable AI adoption across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

AI Governance Strategy

  • Develop and maintain the enterprise AI governance framework, policies, standards, and operating model.
  • Establish governance processes across the AI lifecycle, including development, acquisition, deployment, monitoring, and retirement.
  • Lead governance committees and facilitate executive-level discussions regarding AI opportunities, risks, and compliance obligations.
  • Define roles, responsibilities, decision rights, and accountability mechanisms for AI oversight.

Regulatory and Framework Operationalization

  • Operationalize emerging AI regulations and industry-leading frameworks, including:
    • EU AI Act
    • NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF)
    • Responsible AI and industry best practices
  • Translate regulatory and ethical requirements into practical controls, standards, review processes, and implementation guidance.
  • Monitor emerging AI legislation, regulatory developments, and enforcement activities and assess organizational impacts.

Key Responsibilities (Continued)

AI Risk Management

  • Design and implement enterprise AI risk assessment methodologies and governance controls.
  • Lead AI risk assessments with a particular focus on high-risk, regulated, customer-facing, and business-critical use cases.
  • Identify, assess, mitigate, and monitor risks including:
    • Bias and fairness risks
    • Privacy and data protection risks
    • Cybersecurity risks
    • Intellectual property and copyright risks
    • Regulatory compliance risks
    • Model performance and reliability risks
    • Reputational risks
    • Third-party and vendor risks
  • Develop and maintain an enterprise AI risk tiering model to classify use cases and determine governance requirements based on risk exposure.
  • Maintain inventories of AI systems, models, and use cases.

Key Responsibilities (Continued)

Responsible AI and Controls

  • Establish standards and procedures for:
    • Human-in-the-loop review and oversight
    • Transparency and explainability
    • Bias testing and fairness assessments
    • Model monitoring and drift detection
    • Data retention and governance
    • Intellectual property protection
    • AI incident management and escalation
    • Ongoing performance monitoring and validation
  • Ensure responsible AI principles are embedded into AI design, development, deployment, and monitoring activities.
  • Review and challenge high-risk AI use cases and provide governance recommendations.

Vendor AI Governance

  • Evaluate third-party AI solutions, vendor-provided AI capabilities, and embedded AI tools through a risk, compliance, privacy, cybersecurity, and legal lens.
  • Establish AI vendor due diligence, assessment, and monitoring procedures.
  • Partner with Procurement, Legal, Security, and Privacy teams to assess risks associated with external AI technologies and suppliers.

Key Responsibilities (Continued)

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary liaison across Legal, ERM, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Internal Audit, Technology, Data Science, and Business functions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to integrate AI governance requirements into existing risk and control frameworks.
  • Advise business leaders and project teams on AI-related risks, regulatory obligations, and governance requirements.
  • Promote risk-informed decision-making while enabling innovation and business outcomes.

Assurance, Audit, and Compliance

  • Partner with Enterprise Risk Management and Internal Audit to establish AI assurance processes and governance reviews.
  • Support internal and external audits of AI controls and governance programs.
  • Develop control testing, monitoring, and remediation processes to assess governance effectiveness.
  • Track and oversee remediation of identified AI-related risks and control gaps.

Key Responsibilities (Continued)

Monitoring, Reporting, and Metrics

  • Develop key performance indicators (KPIs), key risk indicators (KRIs), dashboards, and governance reporting.
  • Provide regular updates to executive leadership, governance committees, and risk oversight bodies.
  • Monitor compliance with AI governance standards and risk management requirements.

Training and Change Management

  • Develop and deliver AI governance, responsible AI, and risk awareness programs.
  • Foster a culture that balances innovation with accountability and regulatory compliance.
  • Drive adoption of governance processes and responsible AI practices across the enterprise.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Law, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in risk management, governance, compliance, audit, cybersecurity, privacy, data governance, or related disciplines.

    • Model governance and model risk management
    • AI regulations and governance frameworks (including EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF)
  • Strong executive communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to travel regionally as needed 5% of the time

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Platform Team, you will develop and operate Alpaca’s authentication, authorization, and Identity Provider (IdP) systems - the systems that handle user login, access control, and secure access across our APIs, customer products, and internal tools.

We are looking for experienced engineers who are comfortable owning services end to end: API design, data modeling, deployments, and production debugging. Most of your time will be spent writing Go (backend services, gRPC/REST APIs, shared client libraries), with meaningful work in React/TypeScript for auth-related UI, and occasionally Java for identity-provider extensions. You will also work with Helm charts, analyze logs and metrics, manage deployments, and help other teams to integrate with our services.

Things You Get To Do

  • Build and improve authentication-related experiences in customer and partner web applications, including login, permissions, and credential management.
  • Develop and maintain the platform’s authentication, authorization, and IdP services.
  • Create and evolve shared libraries and SDKs.
  • Integrate with identity providers and keep login and access policies working reliably across products.
  • Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot identity services in production.
  • Help modernize legacy authentication patterns as the platform evolves.
  • Own work end to end, from requirements through delivery and follow-up.
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams on identity and access integration.
  • Maintain high code quality, write tests, and participate in code reviews.
  • Help investigate incidents and bugs, including on-call rotation.

Who You Are (must-haves)

  • You have 5+ years of experience writing code in strongly-typed languages, with at least one year of experience in Go.
  • You have experience building web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • You have worked with relational databases before - we use PostgreSQL, but we are not particularly picky about this one as long as you have a solid grasp on the fundamentals.
  • You have worked at a startup before - you thrive in ambiguous environments, embrace changing priorities, know when to balance technical debt with speed, and proactively tackle whatever needs to get done without relying on pre-existing processes or documentation.
  • You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.
  • You have worked at least 3 years on systems at scale.

Who You Might Be (nice-to-haves)

  • You know what a JWT token is, and how OpenID Connect and SAML work. Maybe you even heard about Keycloak, or have worked on authentication systems before.
  • You have experience with role-based access control.
  • You have built or maintained OpenAPI-driven HTTP APIs.
  • You are familiar with Kubernetes and Helm.
  • You have experience with Java.
  • You understand how Kafka works - maybe you even worked with Redpanda before.
  • You have experience with Grafana’s observability stack - Prometheus, Tempo and all the rest. You might have even written a PromQL query for a new alert once or twice.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer / Implementation Engineer

Remote, Montreal, QC, Canada. Full time.
Must be located in QC, Canada. Travel up to 25 percent: team meetings, customer site visits when a customer asks for one, and occasional industry events.

About CWS

CWS builds and runs the security and cloud infrastructure companies depend on. We design, deploy, tune and operate production platforms across Montreal, QC, Canada: SIEM onboarding and detection engineering, cloud identity and access, edge and firewall platforms, security programs, data protection, and secure cloud environments built as code. We do not hand off at go-live. We run the managed service on top of what we build, so the systems we deploy stay tuned and defensible.

We work through technology partners and directly with customers. Every engineer here works directly with the founders and owns a real customer outcome from day one.

Role & Responsibilities

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own the customer engagement end to end: you scope the work, architect the solution, build and configure it, prove it holds up, and hand over a system the customer's team can run without you. You are both the engineer and the person accountable for the result.

You carry one to three engagements at a time, spanning cloud and infrastructure delivery (AWS, Google Cloud, infrastructure as code, networking, edge and firewall platforms) and security delivery (tool implementation, tuning, and assessments).

  • Deploy, configure and integrate security and cloud platforms in customer environments, and prove they work before you hand them over.
  • Plan and run your engagements: milestones, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and a weekly status the customer can read in two minutes.
  • Raise risks early, and bring options and a recommendation with them.
  • Write the as-built documentation and runbooks, run the knowledge transfer, and train the customer's team so they can operate without you.
  • Contribute to managed-service work on platforms we run: health checks, tuning, and renewal assessments.
  • Help scope new work: effort estimates, technical input to statements of work, and kickoff material.
  • After each engagement, write down what changed between the plan and what it took, and turn it into an asset the team reuses.

Qualifications

  • Three to five years in security engineering, DevSecOps or platform engineering, or software engineering, including at least one year delivering into environments you did not own.
  • Hands-on AWS, and working knowledge of Azure or Google Cloud: identity, networking, compute, storage, logging.
  • Networking you can troubleshoot: DNS, routing, VPN, firewalls, load balancing, TLS.
  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) and version control as daily habits.
  • Python or TypeScript at a level where you build your own tooling.
  • Security fundamentals across identity, endpoint, network and cloud posture, and the ability to explain a finding to a non-technical owner.
  • Clear written and spoken English. You write your own status updates, as-builts and runbooks.
  • Comfort working on your own. You take an ambiguous problem, break it down, decide what to build and what to configure, and ask for help early when you need it.

You do not need to match every line. If you meet most of them and you learn fast, apply.

Nice to have:

  • Certifications: a cloud provider certification (security specialty preferred), a firewall or edge platform certification, a SIEM or security operations certification, CISSP, Security+ or a GIAC certification, or Kubernetes.
  • Delivery experience in a consulting, professional services or managed security firm, where you owned a schedule and a customer relationship.
  • French, spoken and written. Part of our delivery is in French.
  • Detection engineering or security automation.
  • Compliance context: SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS.

Compensation and benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • Dedicated mental health days
  • Performance bonuses
  • Learning and certification stipend
  • Home office equipment

jobs.title: Marketplace Pricing Scientist (6 months contract)
jobs.excerpt: About the roleOur dynamic pricing is rule-based today — conditional logic on surface signals like weather and supply-demand ratios.
jobs.description:
About the role

Our dynamic pricing is rule-based today — conditional logic on surface signals like weather and supply-demand ratios. It works, but it's rigid, and we think it's leaving money on the table.

Our platform team is strong on data engineering and business analysis. What we don't have in-house is the applied economics or algorithmic depth to work out which pricing models are actually right for us. Other platforms have solved versions of this already. We want someone who can tell us which approach fits, prove it on our data, and hand it to our engineers to build.

6-month contract, fully remote and open to candidates anywhere, reporting to the Director, Platform.

What you will deliver

  • A read on our existing pricing logic, with a number on the revenue and matching efficiency we're currently giving up
  • A shortlist of approaches — mechanism design (VCG-style allocation), algorithmic search (optimal tree search, MCTS), predictive and ML pricing models — weighed against our data maturity, latency limits and commercial goals
  • A recommended model, tested offline on GoGoX order and supply data, with the assumptions and failure modes spelled out
  • An experiment design for live testing, including guardrails against cannibalising users or driver-partners, and the metrics that call it a win
  • A handover pack our data engineers can build from, plus an honest view of what we'd need to hire or train for to own this long term

Who you are

  • 5+ years applying economic or optimisation modelling to pricing, matching or incentives in a live two-sided marketplace — ride-hailing, logistics, delivery, travel or e-commerce
  • Comfortable across mechanism design, causal inference (diff-in-diff, regression discontinuity, synthetic control), demand elasticity and structural modelling, and modern ML approaches to pricing
  • Strong in Python and SQL, and happy working in production data next to engineers rather than handing over a paper
  • Master's or PhD in Economics, Operations Research, Statistics or similar — or the industry track record that stands in for it
  • Pragmatic about constraints. You recommend what works with the data and engineering we have, not what's most elegant
  • Can explain the economics to a commercial audience. We can't act on a recommendation we can't interrogate
  • Fluent spoken Cantonese

Inside Sales Manager – B2B Akquise, 20 – 25 Stunden (100% Remote) (m/w/d)

In dieser Position sind Sie verantwortlich für die Betreuung unserer Kund in Ihrem Verkaufsgebiet, wobei Sie aktiv telefonischen Kontakt (Inbound und Outbound) pflegen.   • Die administrative Abwicklung der Aufträge erfolgt durch eine regelmäßige Dokumentation Ihrer Aktivitäten in unserem CRM/ERP-System
  • Zudem verwalten Sie unser Beschwerdemanagement und bieten kundenorientierte Lösungen

So sichern Sie höchste Standards als Telesales Mitarbeiter
Bei CWS-Hygiene glauben wir, dass es entscheidend ist, dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch kulturell zu uns passen. Sie haben eine Leidenschaft für Dienstleistungslösungen, wollen die oder der Beste sein und bringen eine hohe Einsatzbereitschaft mit.

  • Ihr Geschick beim Ermitteln von Kundenbedürfnissen zeichnet Sie aus und Sie bezeichnen sich selbst als Kommunikationstalent mit Schwung und Ausdruckskraft
  • Ihre Arbeitsweise ist stets kunden- und serviceorientiert, und Sie haben Freude am Telefonieren
  • Solide MS-Office-Kenntnisse und Offenheit für neue IT-Systeme ergänzen Ihr Profil optimal
  • Zudem setzen wir ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse voraus

Was haben wir Ihnen zu bieten?

Bei CWS-Hygiene zu arbeiten bedeutet, Teil eines dynamischen und herausfordernden Umfelds zu sein, in dem kein Tag wie der andere ist. Als Teil eines großen europäischen Unternehmens haben Sie die Möglichkeit, viel zu lernen und sich stetig weiterzuentwickeln. Unsere Grundwerte: Der Kunde steht an erster Stelle, wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, werden jeden Tag besser, übernehmen Verantwortung und streben nach Erfolg.

Ihr Einsatz und Ihre Verkaufserfolge bestimmen also direkt Ihren Verdienst
  • Gratis Heissgetränke sowie Essensgutscheine

Über CWS Hygiene:
Mit innovativen, nachhaltigen und digitalisierten Servicelösungen sorgt CWS Hygiene für Gesundheit, Sicherheit und Schutz am Arbeitsplatz und im öffentlichen Raum. Die Komplettlösungen umfassen Hand- und Toilettenhygiene von kleinen Waschräumen bis zu großen Sanitäranlagen sowie saubere Eingangs- und Ausgangsbereiche mit Matten in Gebäudekomplexen, öffentlichen Gebäuden und Industrieanlagen. CWS Hygiene steht für Nachhaltigkeit: Dank seines Mietmodells bietet das Unternehmen seinen Kunden eine sogenannte "Kreislaufwirtschaft" und engagiert sich so für eine gesündere und sicherere Zukunft. About Mosai

Mosai™ is the intelligent care coordination platform that brings together the fragmented pieces of healthcare into a clear, connected picture. Like a mosaic, our platform unites data, people, and processes so providers can make better decisions, coordinate care in real time, and deliver improved outcomes. With Mosai, home-based care organizations can thrive in value-based care while giving every patient the right care, in the right place, at the right time. Learn more at​

Position Summary

Mosai is looking for a Senior Clinical Informaticist to be the clinical conscience of its AI and help drive AI-assisted health care at home. Working with data scientists and ML engineers, this person will own the clinical ground truth used to train and evaluate models, including what gets labeled, how it gets labeled, and whether outputs are safe and correct for nurses, therapists, and hospice teams to use.

As the first hire in the clinical informatics function, this hands-on senior leader will create annotation guidelines, label and adjudicate data, build gold-standard datasets, and lead clinical evaluation of models and LLM-based features. The role brings knowledge of how care is delivered and documented at home into the data and logic used by Mosai's AI, while helping build the clinical informatics team.

Job Duties:

  • Own clinical annotation: design labeling schemas and versioned guidelines for clinical notes, OASIS items, diagnoses, medications, wounds, functional status, and other home health and hospice concepts.
  • Label and adjudicate data directly; engage appropriate in-house clinical resources, resolve annotator disagreements, make final clinical calls on edge cases, and build and maintain core gold-standard datasets for data science models.
  • Work with MLOps and data science teams to report and monitor model performance and respond to drift in key accuracy metrics.
  • Measure inter-annotator agreement using standard metrics, such as Cohen's or Fleiss' kappa; run calibration sessions, audit samples, and improve annotation guidelines and workflows.
  • Evaluate model predictions and LLM-generated text for accuracy, completeness, hallucination, bias, and clinical safety.
  • Design evaluation rubrics and help define clinical criteria for release of traditional ML and LLM-based models.
  • Translate home health and hospice workflows, including start of care, recertification, resumption of care, discharge, hospice admission, and IDG, into structured data, rules, and features.
  • Map clinical concepts to ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, OASIS, and hospice HOPE data elements; support EHR integration, including HomeCare HomeBase, using HL7 and FHIR.
  • Define clinical data quality checks, document provenance and dataset versions, and apply HIPAA, minimum-necessary, and de-identification practices to labeling work.
  • Support development of AI capabilities by demonstrating how skilled clinicians perform the same tasks.
  • Partner with product and engineering on clinical requirements, pre-release validation, post-release model monitoring, and clinician feedback loops.
  • Recruit, train, and mentor clinical annotators and junior informaticists as the program grows.

Minimum Requirements

  • Active, unrestricted clinical license as an RN (BSN or equivalent), Physical Therapist, Occupational Therapist, or Speech-Language Pathologist.
  • At least five years of clinical experience, including meaningful time in home health and/or hospice.
  • At least four years in clinical informatics, such as informatics nursing, clinical analysis, clinical data abstraction, or quality, aligned with recognized standards such as the ANA Nursing Informatics Scope and Standards of Practice or AMIA health informatics core competencies.
  • Core informatics competencies in clinical workflow analysis, data governance and quality, the system lifecycle (requirements, testing, validation, and go-live), and clinical decision support or quality measure logic.
  • Working understanding of how traditional supervised and unsupervised machine learning and LLM-based models are trained and refined.
  • Hands-on OASIS expertise, including the current OASIS-E data set and guidance manual.
  • Working knowledge of ICD-10-CM coding and home health payment and quality programs, including PDGM, HHVBP, and Home Health Quality Reporting.
  • Experience with clinical data labeling, annotation, or chart abstraction, ideally supporting machine learning or analytics teams.
  • Comfort with clinical terminologies, including SNOMED CT, LOINC, and RxNorm.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and PHI de-identification methods, including Safe Harbor and Expert Determination.
  • Precise, consistent judgment and ability to explain clinical reasoning clearly to non-clinicians.

Work Environment

Remote or hybrid (Jacksonville/Nashville), as indicated in the role type above.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Informatics certification, such as ANCC Informatics Nursing (NI-BC, formerly RN-BC), HIMSS CPHIMS or CAHIMS, AMIA ACHIP, or AHIMA CHDA.
  • Master's degree in nursing informatics, health informatics, or data science.
  • Home health certification, such as COS-C, HCS-D, or HCS-O.
  • Experience evaluating LLM output, building evaluation rubrics, or conducting clinical red teaming.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices in health care, including bias and fairness testing, human-in-the-loop review, and model documentation.
  • Experience with annotation tools, such as Label Studio, Prodigy, or Labelbox, and basic SQL or Python.
  • Experience with HomeCare HomeBase or another home health or hospice EHR.
  • Familiarity with hospice documentation and quality reporting, including HOPE, HQRP, and CAHPS Hospice.

About Code3

Code3 is an integrated marketing agency, powering business growth for digital disruptors and Fortune 500 leaders alike. Our power is at the intersection of Connections, Creative and Commerce – that’s what is in our DNA. By harvesting insights and utilizing audience data, we work with our clients to develop scroll-stopping content and creative that performs and elevates the brands we work with across all digital media platforms.

Our people are energized by challenges and sprint to find unorthodox solutions. We plan, activate and measure as one team, and we’re not afraid to push boundaries and test our way to success. Coders are Relentless, Gritty, Nimble humans who are always striving to be better.

With teams across the U.S., you’ll find more than a job at Code3. You’ll find a place to grow, make an impact, and do your best work alongside a team that’s invested in your success.

The Opportunity

Code3 is looking for a dynamic Director, Commerce Strategy & Client Partnerships to lead commerce and digital marketing strategies for high-profile clients across Amazon, Walmart, Target, Instacart, and other marketplaces and retail media networks. This leadership role sits at the center of our integrated Connections, Creative, and Commerce model—driving marketplace growth through retail strategy, media, content, and creative innovation.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise across commerce ecosystems, including Amazon Vendor Central and Seller Central, Walmart Marketplace and Walmart Connect, Target Roundel, and other omnichannel retail environments. This person understands how retail readiness, content optimization, media investment, and operational excellence work together to drive measurable business growth.

What you’ll do:

Client Leadership & Strategy Across Channels

    • Serve as the senior strategic advisor to key clients across Amazon, Walmart, Target, Instacart, and other marketplaces and retail media networks, as well as Meta, Google, TikTok, and additional paid media channels.
    • Lead integrated commerce strategies that connect retail readiness, marketplace operations, paid media, organic search visibility, and creative performance to drive revenue growth and market share.
    • Develop and present marketplace growth plans, annual strategies, media recommendations, retail event plans, and executive business reviews.
    • Guide clients on Vendor Central and Seller Central best practices, including catalog management, merchandising, promotions, content strategy, and inventory considerations.
    • Partner with commerce, media, and creative teams to optimize PDPs, Brand Stores, A+ Content, and creative assets for discoverability, conversion, and retail performance.
    • Oversee retail readiness initiatives including PDP audits, SEO and keyword strategy, ratings and reviews management, assortment strategy, and conversion optimization.
    • Advise clients on deals, coupons, Prime Day, seasonal planning, and other marketplace growth opportunities.
    • Align organic marketplace performance with paid retail media investments to maximize efficiency and incremental growth.

Team Collaboration & Internal Alignment

    • Translate client feedback into actionable next steps that help teams meet and exceed expectations.
    • Collaborate with Finance and Practice leaders to support profitability goals through effective resourcing, pricing, and SOW management.
    • Define clear expectations and cross-functional needs to drive successful client outcomes.

Performance Leadership & Business Growth

    • Lead teams responsible for activation, commerce strategy, and creative execution to ensure accounts perform against business goals and growth targets.
    • Monitor marketplace trends, search visibility, competitive activity, and category dynamics to identify optimization opportunities.
    • Evaluate retail media, marketplace sales, and conversion performance using dashboards, reporting tools, and commerce analytics platforms.
    • Identify portfolio growth opportunities through expanded marketplace support, media investment, content optimization, and integrated channel strategies.
    • Serve as a trusted partner to senior client stakeholders by delivering strategic insights and forward-looking commerce recommendations.

Who will love this role:

  • A passionate commerce marketer who enjoys building strategies for both growing and established brands.
  • A collaborative team member who thrives in the fast pace of agency life.
  • A proactive problem solver who anticipates challenges and recommends solutions.
  • An exceptional presenter who can communicate analytical insights in a clear and engaging way.
  • A curious learner who stays ahead of trends in commerce, digital marketing, and technology.

You should have:

  • 7+ years of experience in digital commerce, retail media, and marketplace strategy across Amazon, Walmart, Target, Instacart, and other retail ecosystems.
  • Deep expertise in Amazon Vendor Central and/or Seller Central, including catalog management, retail readiness, merchandising, and promotional strategy.
  • Strong understanding of PDP optimization, marketplace SEO, A+ Content, Brand Stores, ratings and reviews strategy, and conversion-focused content best practices.
  • Experience managing deals, coupons, Prime Day strategy, tentpole retail activations, and promotional planning across marketplaces.
  • Expertise in retail media and paid media platforms including Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Roundel, Google, Meta, TikTok, and other commerce media channels.
  • Strong understanding of how creative, content, retail operations, and media work together to influence marketplace growth.
  • Experience with commerce analytics and measurement solutions used for forecasting, performance evaluation, media planning, and business strategy.
  • Proven leadership managing complex client relationships, integrated commerce strategies, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate marketplace insights and performance findings clearly and strategically.

The position also offers a bonus based on company and client success.

The base salary range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. Certain positions may also be eligible for a bonus, with eligibility and details discussed during the recruitment process. For candidates that are based in California, we encourage you to review this important information for California residents here. For best results, open the link in a new tab.

Salary Range
$139,500—$157,500 USD

Working at Code3

At Code3, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to do their best. We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package, meaningful opportunities for growth, and a culture that’s collaborative, inclusive, and—most importantly—human.

Here’s what you can expect as a Coder:

  • Remote-first workplace designed to support flexibility and connection
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, plus a generous retirement program
  • Thoughtful parental leave and return-to-work program
  • Flexible Time Off, sabbatical opportunities, paid holidays, quarterly Company “Recharge” Days, and a holiday closure in December
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities to help you grow your skills and career

A Few Things to Know

All candidates who receive an offer will be required to successfully complete a background check.

Want to get to know us a little better? Check out Life at Code3 to learn more about our people, culture, and what it’s like to be a Coder.

Our Interview Process

During this first call, we’ll get to know you, learn more about your experience, and talk about what you’re looking for in your next opportunity. We’ll also explore alignment with our company and values, and depending on the role, we may ask a few technical or role-specific questions. From there, the process can look a little different depending on the role. You can expect to meet several members of the team and, for some positions, complete a skills assessment such as a Take-Home Assignment or Live Exercise. We’ll make sure you know what to expect every step of the way. Your Talent Acquisition partner will walk you through the full process during your initial conversation.

Inclusive Workforce

At Code3, we’re committed to creating a culture where people from all backgrounds feel welcome, supported, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. jobs.excerpt: Head of Product Location: Remote About This Opportunity Purple Squirrel Enterprises has been supporting startups and global firms through growth, change, and expansion for 19+ years.
jobs.description:
Head of Product
Location: Remote

About This Opportunity
Purple Squirrel Enterprises has been supporting startups and global firms through growth, change, and expansion for 19+ years. We provide flexible HR and recruiting solutions that allow leaders to focus on strategy while we handle people operations — and this search is no exception.

We are exclusively engaged by a high-growth health technology company to help them identify and hire exceptional product leadership talent for this role. We are embedded directly with their leadership team, have deep knowledge of the company, the culture, and what it takes to succeed here — and we will be your dedicated recruiting partner from first conversation through offer.

This is not a blind submission. When you apply, you are working with a team that knows this opportunity inside and out and will advocate for you every step of the way.

💜 If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply. We will be in touch promptly.
Applications submitted directly to our client will be redirected back to Purple Squirrel Enterprises. To be considered for this role, all candidates must apply through this posting.

About Our Client
Our client builds software and connected hardware that makes medication management safer for vulnerable populations in group homes, supported living, assisted living, behavioral health, and long-term care. In these settings, a large share of medication administration is handled by non-clinical staff working from paper, spreadsheets, and memory.

Their platform combines eMAR+ software, Smart Medboxes, emergency kits, and gamified self-medication tools into one connected system that prevents errors before they happen rather than documenting them after. They support providers, state agencies, and pharmacy partners across 20+ states, and recently won the first statewide medication management contract of its kind in the United States.

Their results so far:
  • 48% reduction in medication errors
  • 39% increase in compliance
  • 69% improvement in audit-ready documentation
💜 This company was built around a cause that is both personal and urgent. That authenticity shows in how they operate, who they hire, and what they build. If you are looking for work that matters — this is it.

A Note on Title, Reporting Line & Scope
Our client is posting this role as Head of Product, but the final title, reporting structure, and scope will be shaped by the experience and leadership level of the person they hire. Depending on your background, this could ultimately be structured as VP of Product or other. Reporting line will most likely be directly to the CEO, though for a more foundational-level hire it could sit under Engineering leadership instead. These specifics — along with compensation — will be part of the conversation as we get to know your experience and how it maps to what they need.

This is intentional flexibility, not indecision: our client is committed to bringing in the right level of leadership for where they are today and where they're headed.

About the Role
Our client is looking for a Head of Product to own product strategy and execution and to build the Product function from the ground up. You will lead a team of two today — a Product Lead and a Product Specialist — with real influence over the type, number, and pace of hires as the team grows.

This is a startup, and this function is being built rather than maintained. You will have real ownership, very little inherited process, and a direct line to executive leadership. Product has been driven by the leadership team to date, and they are committed to a deliberate, unhurried handoff of that ownership to you — including knowledge transfer, context on customers and commitments, and hands-on support while you take the reins. You will not be handed a backlog and left to guess.

They are building toward empowered product teams, where leadership sets priorities and outcomes and teams have real autonomy to discover how to achieve them. You and engineering leadership will define how Product and Engineering work together — engineers here are product-minded and deeply involved in how the product takes shape, and the handoff model is intentionally not prescriptive.

Their product operates in a regulated, high-stakes environment. A missed dose is a patient safety event, not a support ticket, and their customers are audited by state agencies whose requirements differ state by state. Product judgment here means understanding what actually happens in a group home at 7am during a shift change, not what looks good in a spec.

As with all leaders at this company, you'll need to be both hands-on and strategic — that combination is core to their culture. Priorities, travel, and schedules shift with the pace of a growing company and its leadership team, so you'll need to bring your own ideas, act autonomously when needed, and stay a strong team player at the same time. Communication — proactive, reactive, and yes, sometimes over-communication — is essential in an environment like this.

What You'll Do

Own the Roadmap
  • Own product strategy and the roadmap across the full surface area: software, connected hardware, and pharmacy/EHR integrations. Publish it so the company can see what is coming and why
  • Bring a point of view on where the platform should go over the next 12–24 months, and make the case for it
  • Weigh patient safety, HIPAA, and state-by-state regulatory requirements from the start rather than retrofitting them
  • Treat reporting, audit trails, and business intelligence as first-class product — audit-ready documentation is a primary reason customers choose this platform
Lead Discovery
  • Spend real time with caregivers, house managers, administrators, nurses, and state agency stakeholders — observing workflows rather than consuming feedback secondhand
  • Distinguish recurring needs from individual feature requests, and explain the difference to Sales and Customer Success
  • Design for three very different users: administrators (oversight/audit), caregivers (speed/clarity mid-shift), and the individuals receiving care
  • Design into existing routines rather than around them — usability is a safety requirement here, not a preference
  • Set the bar for product definition: clear problem statements, acceptance criteria, and edge-case thinking Engineering can build from without guesswork
Build the Function
  • Establish how product gets practiced: how problems get framed, how discovery happens, how decisions get made, how outcomes get measured
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Product team, and shape the hiring plan — including roles that don't exist yet — as scope expands
  • Keep Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Operations aligned on priorities and support strategic accounts and state-level opportunities where product credibility matters
Work With AI
  • Set the standard on AI rather than delegate it — use tools like Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent agentic environments to explore the codebase, work with data, and build functional prototypes
  • Establish these practices across the Product team and coach your people into them
  • The goal is better-informed decisions about scope and value — not handing engineering a flashy prototype to productionize
You do not need to be a software engineer, and you will have strong engineering partnership. You do need to be willing and able to build.

What This Role Is Not
This is not a purely strategic or advisory position, and it is not a roadmap-maintenance or backlog-management role. You will be the most senior product person in the company, with no layer between you and the problem. If you're looking to set direction and hand execution to a team of PMs, this isn't the right fit today. If being close to customers, requirements, and shipped software is what you've been missing, it likely is.

What Success Looks Like
  • Ownership Established: You've taken clear, visible ownership of the roadmap and the leadership team trusts your judgment on what's next and why
  • Discovery in Motion: You are spending real time with caregivers, administrators, and state stakeholders — and using what you learn to shape decisions, not just validate them
  • Function Taking Shape: Product process, definition standards, and team rhythms exist where little or none did before
  • Team Growing With Intention: You have a clear point of view on team structure and hiring, and the team feels coached, not just managed
  • Trusted Cross-Functionally: Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success see you as the person who keeps priorities clear and aligned across the company

What We're Looking For

Required
  • 6 - 8+ years in product management, including end-to-end ownership of a roadmap covering discovery, definition, and delivery — not solely execution of a roadmap someone else set
  • Experience leading product people, including hiring and onboarding rather than only managing an inherited team
  • A track record of shipping B2B SaaS in close partnership with Engineering
  • Experience building product process where little or none existed
  • Strong discovery skills: customer interviewing, problem validation, prototyping, and experimentation
  • Experience with products where the buyer and the user are different people
  • Practical, frequent use of LLMs in day-to-day work
  • Comfort working with data directly, strong written communication, and judgment to decide with incomplete information
  • Willingness to travel occasionally, up to roughly 15%, for customer/facility visits, team meetings, and industry events
Nice to Have
  • Experience in healthcare technology, IDD services, assisted living, behavioral health, long-term care, or medication management, or another regulated environment
  • Experience with enterprise, government, or state agency customers, including procurement and reporting requirements
  • Experience shipping products that combine software and connected hardware
  • Experience with integration-dependent products (HL7, JSON, REST APIs, pharmacy management systems, EHRs)
  • Experience scaling a Product function from a small team, or shipping products/internal tools personally prototyped using AI-assisted development
Personal Attributes
  • A builder — your instinct when you have an idea is to make something and test it
  • Low ego, strong point of view — you advocate hard and change your mind when the evidence changes
  • Comfortable with ambiguity
  • Intellectually curious about why, not just what was requested
  • Energized by the mission — many affected by this product cannot advocate for themselves

Compensation & Benefits
  • Base salary: $183,000 – $225,000, depending on experience, skill set, and the ultimate scope/level of the role (Head of Product, VP of Product, or other) — final title and comp will be calibrated to the candidate
  • Potential Equity participation
  • 100% company-paid medical coverage (base plan)
  • Dental & vision available
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Company-paid life, AD&D, STD & LTD insurance
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (wellness, personal use, and company swag)
  • Flexible PTO + company holidays
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment
  • 💜 Mission-driven work with real impact on vulnerable populations


Why This Role — And Why Now
  • Real problems, real stakes — your work directly affects patient safety for a population that often cannot advocate for itself
  • True ownership — you'll build the Product function, not inherit one
  • Direct access to leadership — a real seat at the table, with influence over team structure and roadmap
  • High-growth trajectory — recent statewide contract win signals significant expansion ahead
  • Authentic mission — 💜 this company was built around a cause that matters
Working With Purple Squirrel Enterprises
We are exclusively engaged by this client — meaning we are not one of many agencies submitting resumes. We are their dedicated recruiting partner, embedded in their process, and we know this role inside and out.

Here's what that means for you as a candidate:
  • A dedicated PSE point of contact throughout the entire process
  • Advocacy with the hiring team to make sure the role is mutually beneficial
  • Preparation for each interview stage so you can put your best foot forward
  • Honest, timely feedback at every step
  • Support through offer negotiation to ensure the outcome is right for you and the company
  • Deep experience navigating complex hiring processes to get great candidates across the finish line
Our client is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. They welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Support Representative
jobs.excerpt: For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions.
jobs.description:
For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions. From agriculture to energy to weather intelligence, our proprietary Operational Decisioning Platform transforms raw data into decision-grade insights—enabling companies to optimize supply chains, ensure market stability, and safeguard infrastructure against disruption. We don’t follow trends—we set the standard for precision, trust, and operational impact.

DTN is at an exciting inflection point. Building off a foundation of financial strength, profitability, and industry trust, we’re accelerating growth and expanding our global footprint. Our purpose-built solutions—powered by AI and honed by decades of vertical expertise—are helping some of the world’s most significant enterprises thrive amid operational constraints and uncover new opportunities in a fast-changing world.

Job Description:

Position Summary:


DTN is seeking a customer-focused, technically curious Technical Customer Support Specialist to provide front-line and advanced technical support for our Energy products, customer integrations, data delivery, and transaction-processing workflows.


In this role, you will take ownership of customer issues from initial intake through investigation, troubleshooting, escalation, testing, resolution, and customer confirmation. You will work with customer-specific configurations, file routing, automated reports, transaction processing, data formats, and FTP/SFTP delivery, using available support tools, system logs, test environments, and product knowledge to identify and resolve technical challenges.


You will collaborate closely with Customer Support, Operations, Development, Product Management, Implementation, Mapping, Account Management, customer IT teams, and third-party providers to deliver effective resolutions and clear, timely communication.


The ideal candidate is an independent problem solver who can work with incomplete information, manage competing priorities, protect sensitive customer data, accurately document technical findings, and translate complex technical information into understandable, customer-facing communication.


Department: Customer Support – Energy
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reports To: Customer Support Leadership


What You Will Be Responsible For:


Customer Support and Case Ownership

  • Monitor and respond to customer requests received through phone, email, online chat, and assigned support case queues.
  • Own technical support cases throughout the complete lifecycle, from initial intake and investigation through resolution, follow-up, and customer confirmation.
  • Provide accurate, timely, professional, and customer-appropriate communication throughout the support process.
  • Independently advance cases, coordinate appropriate resources, and confirm successful outcomes rather than simply routing customer requests.
  • Manage multiple active support cases while prioritizing work based on customer needs, business impact, and operational urgency.
  • Distinguish among product questions, customer configuration issues, software defects, implementation requests, and product enhancement requests, ensuring each is addressed or routed appropriately.

Technical Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution

  • Investigate and troubleshoot issues involving DTN Energy product behavior, transaction processing, file delivery, customer configuration, automated reporting, and data integrations.
  • Use available support tools, system logs, databases, file repositories, delivery records, and test environments to reproduce, validate, and resolve reported problems.
  • Review and troubleshoot structured data and file-delivery workflows, including CSV, XML, EDI, FTP, and SFTP processes.
  • Investigate customer-specific processing issues, data-format discrepancies, routing problems, and automated delivery failures.
  • Work directly with customer technical teams and third-party providers to clarify technical requirements and troubleshoot system integration issues.
  • Reproduce reported issues when possible, evaluate findings, and validate corrective actions before closing customer cases.
  • Apply structured troubleshooting techniques and sound technical judgment when investigating incomplete or ambiguous information.

Customer Configuration and Data Integrity

  • Perform authorized customer configuration changes involving data routing, recipients, report delivery, account settings, and customer-specific processing options.
  • Validate configuration changes and resulting system outputs before case closure to reduce the risk of incorrect, incomplete, duplicated, or misrouted customer data.
  • Exercise strong attention to detail when handling customer configurations, production-related changes, and business-sensitive information.
  • Follow applicable security, privacy, confidentiality, and data-handling requirements when accessing customer information or making production-related changes.
  • Apply appropriate change discipline and verification procedures to maintain data accuracy and operational reliability.

Incident Management and Cross-Functional Escalation

  • Recognize potential production incidents and escalate issues appropriately based on severity, customer impact, and business risk.
  • Provide timely customer updates during incidents and confirm service restoration before concluding the support process.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Development, Product Management, Mapping, Implementation, Account Management, and other internal teams to determine appropriate resolution and escalation paths.
  • Prepare effective technical escalations that include supporting evidence, business impact, troubleshooting history, and a clearly defined requested action.
  • Collaborate with customer IT teams, third-party integration providers, and internal technical resources to resolve complex issues.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment when determining whether issues require additional technical expertise, operational intervention, or product-level investigation.

Documentation, Knowledge Sharing, and Continuous Improvement

  • Accurately document customer interactions, technical investigations, troubleshooting steps, configuration changes, findings, and resolutions within the designated case-management system.
  • Maintain clear and consistent case records that support follow-up, escalation, reporting, and knowledge sharing.
  • Create and maintain troubleshooting documentation and share lessons learned from recurring or complex customer issues.
  • Identify patterns in recurring support issues and recommend improvements to monitoring, documentation, technical tooling, and support processes.
  • Contribute to the development of team knowledge and support capabilities through documentation, collaboration, and the sharing of technical insights.
  • Continuously expand knowledge of DTN Energy products, technical integrations, data workflows, and customer business processes.

What You Will Bring to the Position:


  • High school diploma or equivalent; additional education or relevant technical experience is valued.
  • Experience in customer support, technical support, software support, or a related customer-facing position.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate technical or operational problems, organize incomplete information, and identify practical next steps.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple active cases, prioritize based on customer and business impact, and maintain accurate follow-up.
  • Strong attention to detail when working with customer configurations, data routing, system outputs, and production-related changes.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Customer Support, Operations, Development, Product Management, Implementation, and Account Management teams.
  • Ability to clearly and consistently document work, technical findings, customer interactions, and resolutions in a case-management system.
  • Customer-focused judgment, professionalism, and a commitment to delivering timely, accurate, and effective support.
  • Technical curiosity and the ability to apply structured troubleshooting methods to complex or unfamiliar problems.
  • Demonstrated ownership, prioritization, accountability, and follow-through throughout the customer support lifecycle.
  • Sound judgment regarding data accuracy, confidentiality, security, and production change management.
  • Ability to make appropriate escalation decisions and communicate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing skills.
  • Ability and willingness to learn complex products, technical systems, and energy-industry workflows.

What Will Make You Stand Out:


  • Experience troubleshooting software applications, data workflows, transaction-processing systems, or system integrations.
  • Familiarity with structured data formats and delivery technologies, including CSV, XML, EDI, FTP, and SFTP.
  • Understanding of file naming conventions, folder structures, and automated data-delivery processes.
  • Experience reviewing application or system logs, processing history, delivery records, and structured input or output files.
  • Experience reproducing technical issues and validating solutions in testing and production-support environments.
  • Experience using Salesforce or another customer case-management platform.
  • Experience working directly with customer IT teams or third-party system integration providers.
  • Experience within the Energy industry, including familiarity with pricing, terminals, sites, invoices, bills of lading, allocations, suppliers, buyers, or sellers.
  • Familiarity with customer-specific data configurations, transaction workflows, automated reporting, or production support processes.
  • Experience identifying recurring technical issues and contributing to improvements in support documentation, monitoring, or troubleshooting practices.

What You Can Expect from DTN:


  • Competitive Salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible working hours
  • Remote work model (position dependent)
  • Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans
  • 6% 401K matching
  • Unlimited access to 13k+ courses via learning platform to support employee career advancement
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Compensation:

The targeted hiring base pay range for this position is between $20.50 and $27.00 per hour. DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time. The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.


About DTN:

DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. With more than 1,200 employees globally, DTN serves the companies that feed, fuel, and protect the world.

At DTN, we value clarity,trust, and action. We’re a team of problem-solvers, outcome-drivers, and industry nerds who believe that precision matters – and that mission is at the core of what we do.

  • Trust Built: We earn it. We keep it. We protect it. Our neutrality, precision, and integrity are non-negotiable.

  • Confidence-Driven: We help customers move with clarity and conviction. We bring the data and operational knowledge leaders need to act.

  • Built for Industry: We speak operations because we come from operations. Our expertise is forged in fuel terminals, fields, flight paths, and forecasts.

  • Future-Forward: We see what’s coming- and we’re ready. We help customers lead through change with smarter decisioning.

Recruitment Fraud Notice:

DTN is aware of incidents where external parties have impersonated our organization, issuing fraudulent communications and/or job offers. Please be advised that all legitimate communication from DTN will come from an official @dtn.com email address. Any offers are extended directly by our Talent Acquisition team following a formal interview process.


If you receive a suspicious message or offer claiming to be from DTN, please do not engage. Contact our Talent Acquisition team at to verify the legitimacy of any communication. Report any fraudulent messaging as phishing or spam.

jobs.excerpt: About Checkmate and Mate.  🛍 📲Checkmate is a multichannel offers network loved by 100M shoppers and hundreds of leading brands.
jobs.description:
About Checkmate and Mate. 🛍 📲

Checkmate is a multichannel offers network loved by 100M shoppers and hundreds of leading brands.

mate. is your AI growth teammate, the eCommerce data network that agentically turns customer intelligence into revenue.

mate finds it, Checkmate goes and gets it. Checkmate is the distribution network, with 100M+ shoppers and 12B+ live intent signals. mate is the AI layer built on top of it: it resolves anonymous visitors, spots the revenue a brand is missing, and builds and executes the campaigns to capture it.

The combination is rare: a consumer product shoppers love and an AI growth engine brands depend on.

We work with leading brands like Everlane, Brooklinen, and Malbon, and we're backed by Google Ventures, Mantis VS, Fuel Capital, and others.

Role Overview 💼

We're hiring a Front End Engineer to own the UI of Checkmate's shopper-facing products: our mobile app and desktop browser extension. You'll pair day to day with our Product Design Lead, turning product ideas and designs into polished, intuitive interfaces that shoppers use every day.

This is a UI-focused seat on a small team that ships quickly. If you care about how a feature feels as much as whether it works, and you'd rather get a first version in front of shoppers than wait on a perfect spec, this is your seat.

Please note: this role is a US-based role only and we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

What You'll Do ⚡

Build the Shopper Experience

  • Build and ship UI across the Checkmate mobile app and desktop browser extension, the two places shoppers find and use their offers
  • Turn designs into production UI that matches them down to the spacing, type, and motion
  • Own the details that make a product feel finished: loading, empty, and error states, transitions, and interaction feedback

Partner with Design and Marketing

  • Work side by side with our Product Design Lead to go from idea to shipped, prototyping in code when that's faster than a mockup
  • Partner with our Head of Marketing to bring launches, campaigns, and new offer experiences to life in the product quickly
  • Speak up with a better approach when something will look, feel, or perform worse than it could

Make the Extension Feel Right Everywhere

  • Build extension UI that shows up cleanly on top of thousands of retailer sites, without breaking the page or getting in the shopper's way
  • Ensure the extension experience fits seamlessly within a shopping journey for our millions of users
  • Keep the app and extension fast, lightweight, and consistent across browsers and devices

Grow the Component System

  • Build and maintain shared, reusable components so new features come together quickly and look consistent across every surface
  • Help set our front-end standards through code reviews, accessibility, and performance
  • Use AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and the like) to move faster while keeping full ownership of quality

Requirements

Who You Are 🧬

  • You have a strong eye for UI, and you notice when something is a few pixels off, a beat too slow, or just doesn't feel right
  • You start with the user’s problem and you care deeply whether what you shipped works well and looks appealing
  • You'd rather ship a first version and iterate than spend weeks polishing a PR
  • You love building closely with designers and marketers, and people find you easy to work with
  • You use AI tools thoughtfully to move faster without dropping quality

What You Bring 🎒

  • 3-5 years building production front-end, with a portfolio of shipped consumer UI we can see, use, or dig into
  • Strong skills in TypeScript and React
  • Experience shipping UI for mobile apps and/or browser extensions in React Native
  • Solid fundamentals in responsive layout, animation, accessibility, and front-end performance
  • A track record of building reusable components that other engineers enjoy using
  • Clear communication with designers, marketers, and engineers, in writing and in reviews
  • Bonus: App Store and Google Play release experience, Chrome extension (Manifest V3) experience, motion and animation chops, or time at a consumer shopping or rewards product

Why This Role Matters

Our app and extension are where shoppers meet the Checkmate network: where the right offer shows up at the right moment and a shopper decides to buy. Every one of those moments runs through the UI. Make it fast, clear, and a little delightful, and shoppers save more, brands win more, and the whole network grows. On a team this size, that work is yours to own.

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits 💸

  • Competitive base salary
  • Equity in a fast-growing, venture-backed company
  • Competitive medical/dental/vision/other healthcare coverage
  • 4 weeks PTO + health days
  • 401k plan
  • Monthly stipend for fitness/wellness activities
  • Company retreats and team get togethers 2x a year 🏝
  • Remote-first culture (preference for those near major cities - NYC, LA, SLC, Miami, Chicago, etc.)

Why This Role Matters:

What You’ll Do:
