jobs.title: Level 3 Escalation Projects Engineer - Remote
jobs.excerpt: Since 2004, OSIbeyond has delivered managed technology and cybersecurity services on a founding principle: outstanding technical expertise, matched by an exceptional customer experience.
jobs.description:
Since 2004, OSIbeyond has delivered managed technology and cybersecurity services on a founding principle: outstanding technical expertise, matched by an exceptional customer experience. Today, that commitment is delivered through OSIbeyond ONE, our integrated technology platform that unifies IT operations, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365, cloud, automation, AI, and expert support into a single, continuously managed environment. The platform is built on a clear operating philosophy: Automation First. AI Enabled. People Powered.

Within that model, the overwhelming majority of routine service requests are resolved by automation, with the Level 2 (Human Support) team confirming AI-extracted parameters and initiating workflows. What remains is, by definition, the hard part: the intermittent fault that spans identity, network, and application layers; the migration that touches every user in an organization; the server, firewall, or hybrid cloud dependency that no runbook anticipated. The Level 3 Engineer is where that work lands, and where it gets solved.

This is the senior engineering seat in Technical Services. The Level 3 Engineer is the escalation authority for the Level 2 team, the engineer who scopes, leads, and delivers client infrastructure projects, the steward of OSIbeyond’s own internal infrastructure, and a working partner to the Automation Engineering team in deciding what gets automated next. Every escalation resolved here is also studied here: the engineer is expected to ask whether a class of problem should ever reach a human again, and to help design the workflow, detection, or self-healing logic that ensures it does not.

The position spans a range of seniority. Engineers at the earlier end of that range concentrate on resolving the most complex escalations and executing pre-scoped project work to a high standard. Engineers at the senior end own project scoping and delivery, direct the work of peers on complex migrations, design architecture, and carry a larger share of automation design and technical leadership. Compensation and scope of ownership grow with demonstrated expertise and impact within the position.

This position is suited to a technically accomplished engineer who has outgrown ticket volume and wants ownership of the difficult, consequential work: complex escalations, infrastructure and project delivery, and the engineering of automation that lifts an entire team. The successful candidate combines deep Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows Server, and network expertise with sound judgment under pressure, disciplined documentation, and the professionalism to represent OSIbeyond in front of client leadership during a high-stakes incident or a major project cutover.

About the Role:

The Level 3 Engineer resolves the complex, high-priority, and urgent escalations that exceed the scope of automation and the Level 2 team; scopes, leads, and delivers client technology projects; designs, deploys, and maintains client infrastructure across on-premises, Microsoft 365, and Azure environments; and completes the internal projects and maintenance that keep OSIbeyond’s own infrastructure and operations secure and current.

The engineer owns the escalation queue end to end. Each escalation is triaged for business impact, diagnosed to root cause rather than symptom, resolved within service level commitments, and documented so that the resolution becomes reusable knowledge, an updated procedure, or a specification for new automation. Where an automated workflow has failed or produced an unexpected result, the Level 3 Engineer is the engineer who determines why, corrects the environment, and works with Automation Engineering to harden the workflow.

On the project side, the Director of Engineering leads discovery and scoping, and the engineer takes the work from there through delivery: solution design, detailed implementation plans, cutover execution, post-project validation, and client-facing training on what was delivered. Projects range from server, network, and identity deployments to tenant and data migrations and cloud modernization. The engineer prepares the detailed directions that allow peers to execute project tasks reliably, and manages scope, schedule, and client communication throughout.

Across all of this work the engineer uses OSIbeyond-approved AI assistants to accelerate diagnostics, scripting, planning, and documentation, and holds every AI-assisted output to the same standard of verification as any other engineering work. The Level 3 Engineer also raises the technical ceiling of the team through mentorship, peer review, and the on-call rotation. Performance is measured against escalation quality and timeliness, SLA adherence, project delivery, client satisfaction, documentation standards, and the volume and value of automation the engineer helps bring into production.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Escalation Resolution & Advanced Troubleshooting (≈35%)

  • Own the escalation queue: accept complex, high-priority, and urgent tickets escalated from the Level 2 team or generated by automation exceptions, and resolve them within service level commitments
  • Perform structured root cause analysis across identity, endpoint, server, network, cloud, and application layers; correct the underlying condition rather than the presenting symptom
  • Diagnose and resolve failed or unexpected automation outcomes, restore the affected environment, and document the failure mode for Automation Engineering
  • Lead the technical response to client-impacting outages and coordinates with the Security Operations Center for security incidents, following documented incident response procedures
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with client stakeholders, including leadership, throughout high-impact incidents, setting expectations and providing accurate status until resolution
  • Recognize when an escalation requires vendor engagement, Automation Engineering, or the Director of Engineering, and escalate without delay
  • Participate in the support desk phone call queue when Level 1 and Level 2 engineers are in calls

Project Delivery & Infrastructure Engineering (≈30%)

  • Deliver client technology projects, managing schedule, risk, and stakeholder communication from kickoff through closeout
  • Design, deploy, and maintain physical and virtual servers, storage, and backup and continuity platforms across client environments
  • Configure and maintain firewalls, switching, wireless, VPN, and secure remote access in accordance with OSIbeyond security standards
  • Administer and architect Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Azure environments, including conditional access, single sign-on and identity federation, SharePoint and Teams governance, and hybrid identity
  • Plan and execute tenant, mail, file, and server migrations, including discovery, cutover planning, execution, and post-migration validation; prepare detailed, step-by-step directions that peers can execute reliably
  • Plan and deliver client-facing technology training and knowledge transfer related to completed projects
  • Complete internal projects and scheduled maintenance that support OSIbeyond’s own infrastructure and operations, applying firmware, patching, and configuration changes under appropriate change control
  • Contribute to system and network architecture designs, hardware and licensing recommendations, and client technology roadmaps

Automation & AI Enablement (≈20%)

  • Analyze escalation, ticket, and project patterns to identify work that should be automated, and author clear, testable specifications for new or expanded automation workflows
  • Convert resolved escalations and repeatable project tasks into automation-ready standard operating procedures, decision logic, and knowledge base content that AI and automation can act upon
  • Review automation exception logs, tune thresholds and guardrails, and recommend self-healing or preventive detection where recurring failures are observed
  • Develop and maintain PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, and KQL scripts and queries that extend the automation platform, standardize project execution, and accelerate investigation
  • Apply OSIbeyond-approved AI assistants to diagnostics, ticket history searches, scripting, project planning, and documentation, verifying all AI-assisted output before it is acted upon or delivered

Technical Leadership & Mentorship (≈15%)

  • Provide technical direction to peers assigned to project tasks, reviewing their work for quality and completeness
  • Mentor Level 2 engineers through escalation walk-throughs, shadowing, and structured feedback that builds their diagnostic depth and reduces future escalations
  • Perform peer review of complex changes, migration plans, and client-facing technical documentation prepared by the team
  • Maintain and improve the technical knowledge base, standard operating procedures, and client environment documentation so that they remain accurate, complete, and actionable
  • Participate in the escalation on-call rotation and serve as the senior technical point of contact during assigned periods
  • Contribute to technical training, engineering standards, and continuous improvement initiatives across Technical Services

General Responsibilities

  • Provide high-quality written and verbal customer service in every client interaction
  • Meet all key performance indicators and notify the Director of Engineering promptly when workload or circumstances place a KPI or project milestone at risk
  • Accurately track and document all work in the ticketing and project systems with detail sufficient for a peer to resume the work without additional context
  • Set up and support physical hardware through the use of local “smart hands” OSIbeyond engineers
  • Support peers and contribute to a collaborative, accountable team culture
  • Perform other duties as assigned

SUCCESS METRICS:

  • Escalation resolution time and KPI adherence across all assigned tickets
  • Root cause quality: escalations closed with documented cause and corrective action, measured by recurrence rate
  • Project delivery against agreed scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards, including client sign-off and post-project satisfaction
  • Quality and reliability of implementation plans and peer directions, measured by execution errors and rework on project tasks
  • Automation contribution: specifications submitted, workflows validated, and automation adopted into production, with the resulting reduction in human-handled tickets and manual project steps
  • Automation exception resolution time and accuracy of exception analysis
  • Health and currency of internal OSIbeyond infrastructure, including completion of scheduled maintenance
  • Client satisfaction with incident handling, project delivery, training, and technical communication
  • Mentorship impact: measurable improvement in Level 2 resolution rates for previously escalated issue types
  • Documentation quality and completeness of ticket notes, root cause analyses, project records, procedures, and client environment documentation
  • On-call responsiveness and resolution quality during assigned rotation periods

SECURITY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Complete training for and maintain awareness of cybersecurity risks, including insider threat, and the appropriate handling of CUI and other regulated data
  • Treat client data and OSIbeyond data as sensitive, and do not disclose, release, or otherwise transfer it outside of OSIbeyond or client environments without written permission
  • Follow cybersecurity requirements as described in the Employee Handbook and other OSIbeyond policies
  • Immediately follow incident response procedures when a security incident or concern is identified
  • Design and implement client and internal infrastructure in accordance with OSIbeyond security baselines and applicable client compliance requirements, including CMMC and NIST SP 800-171
  • Assist with the escorting or monitoring of visitors when working onsite

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • Four or more years of progressive experience in systems engineering, infrastructure administration, or escalation support, with the most senior engineers in the position typically bringing seven or more; managed service provider experience is strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-layer escalations and client-impacting incidents through to root cause and resolution
  • Hands-on delivery of infrastructure projects such as server deployments, firewall implementations, identity architecture, or tenant and data migrations; experience scoping and leading such projects end to end is expected at the senior end of the position

Infrastructure & Platform Skills

  • Expert administration of Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, conditional access, identity federation and single sign-on, and audit logging
  • Strong Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and NTFS and DFS permission design; working knowledge of hybrid identity synchronization
  • Virtualization and storage administration (Hyper-V or VMware), and backup and business continuity platforms
  • Firewall, switching, wireless, VPN, and routing configuration and troubleshooting; solid grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, and network security
  • Microsoft Azure and Intune administration, including virtual machines, networking, device management, and compliance policies
  • Email security and spam filter administration, and security incident response in coordination with a SOC

Project & Automation Skills

  • Ability to produce a project implementation plan and cutover schedule, manage risk and stakeholder communication, and close out with validation and training
  • Ability to write detailed, unambiguous technical directions that peers can execute without supervision
  • Proficiency in PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; working knowledge of KQL or comparable query languages
  • Ability to decompose a resolved escalation or repeatable project task into decision logic, parameters, and guardrails suitable for automation
  • Experience validating or troubleshooting the output of automation and orchestration platforms (Tines or comparable), RMM scripting, or infrastructure-as-code
  • Effective, verified use of AI assistants for diagnostics, scripting, planning, and documentation

Professional Skills

  • Composed, authoritative communication with client stakeholders and leadership during high-impact incidents and project cutovers
  • Disciplined documentation and ticket hygiene; ability to produce clear technical writing and deliver training for both engineers and non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, direct, and raise the capability of less experienced engineers
  • Self-management appropriate to a remote, escalation- and project-driven role with on-call responsibilities

Additional Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience supporting clients subject to CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, or similar regulatory frameworks
  • Prior contribution to automation development, detection engineering, or platform standardization in an MSP environment
  • Formal project management training or certification (CompTIA Project+, PMP, or equivalent)
  • Experience with Azure landing zones, infrastructure-as-code, or zero trust network architecture

KNOWLEDGE & CERTIFICATIONS

Tooling Environment: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Azure administration portals; Windows Server and hypervisor management; firewall and network management platforms; remote monitoring and management; backup and continuity platforms; Tines automation; Autotask professional services automation (ticketing and projects); IT documentation platform; Microsoft Teams for internal collaboration; OSIbeyond-approved AI assistants.

Required Certifications (or attainment within the first six months)

  • Microsoft MS-102: Microsoft 365 Administrator
  • Microsoft AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft SC-300: Identity and Access Administrator
  • Microsoft MD-102: Endpoint Administrator
  • CompTIA Security+ or CompTIA Network+
  • Vendor firewall certification (Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto PCNSA, or equivalent)
  • CompTIA Project+ or PMP

Position:

jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client is an AI-native product company built to replace how billions of people manage their digital lives — starting with email, notes, and task tools that were never designed to be AI-native. It's backed by multi-million-dollar investment and built remote-first from day one, with a clear target: cut the time it takes users to get everyday things done by roughly 90%. That means solving the problems most AI products avoid — long-running workflows, persistent context, and reliable behavior under real-world, non-deterministic conditions. The team is small and high-talent-density by design, not by necessity, and moves at a pace that matches the scale of what it's building.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll turn model capability into real product behavior. You'll own problems end-to-end — from shaping model behavior, to building the systems around it, to making sure it holds up in production. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, systems, and product: making AI actually work for users, not just in demos.

What You'll Work On

  • Build and ship AI features end-to-end (model system user experience)

  • Design and iterate on prompts, tools, memory, and agent workflows

  • Turn raw model outputs into structured, reliable, predictable behavior

  • Debug issues across the full stack — model, orchestration, infra, UX

  • Optimize for latency, cost, and production reliability

  • Develop lightweight evaluation frameworks to measure real-world performance

  • Work closely with product and engineering to turn ambiguous problems into working systems

Requirements

  • Strong foundation in machine learning and modern neural network architectures

  • Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or deploying ML models

  • Ability to write clean, production-quality code

  • Comfort working across abstraction layers — model, infra, product

  • Strong problem-solving skills in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • A bias toward shipping, iteration, and continuous improvement

Tech Stack

Python · PyTorch / JAX · LLMs (OpenAI-style APIs, LLaMA, Qwen, etc.) · inference/serving (e.g. vLLM) · vector DB

What Success Looks Like

  • ML models in production meet accuracy, latency, and reliability targets

  • Production issues are found quickly, debugged effectively, and root-caused

  • Data pipelines, training loops, and inference systems stay robust, reproducible, maintainable

  • Effective collaboration with engineers, product, and research to ship reliable ML-powered features

  • Iteration is driven by real-world signals and measurable improvement

What to Expect

The best products in the world are built by small, world-class teams. Decisions are made collectively, at rapid speed — balancing high-quality shipping with fast learning. You'll be expected to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently.

Compensation and benefits are competitive and vary by location; the package includes base salary and equity, discussed openly with you as part of the process.

If there's a fit, expect 3–4 interviews total, followed by a prompt, transparent decision.

jobs.description:
Werden Sie selbstständiger Überführungsfahrermit DriiveMe Partner

Erhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.

👉Registrieren Sie sich hier, um auf die Aufträge zuzugreifen:

DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.

Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe, um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar und viele weitere.

In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.

Worin besteht ein DriiveMe-Auftrag?

Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

  1. Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

  2. Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

  3. Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

  4. Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

  5. Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

  6. Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

  • Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

  • Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

  • Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

  • Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

  • Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

Wie viel verdiene ich?

Ihr Umsatz hängt davon ab, wie viele Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

Jeder Auftrag hat eine eigene Vergütung, die sich nach der Strecke, der Anzahl der Kilometer und der Komplexität des Transports richtet.

Bevor Sie einen Auftrag buchen, kennen Sie alle wichtigen Informationen: Abholort, Zielort, Vergütung und Bedingungen. Sie entscheiden frei, welche Aufträge Sie annehmen möchten.

Gesuchtes Profil

Um DriiveMe Partner beizutreten, sollten Sie idealerweise:

  • über eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis verfügen;

  • selbstständig sein oder bereit sein, selbstständig tätig zu werden;

  • zuverlässig, pünktlich und sorgfältig sein;

  • die Verfahren zur Abholung und Übergabe der Fahrzeuge einhalten;

  • verfügbar sein, um gelegentliche Aufträge in Ihrer Region oder in anderen Teilen Deutschlands durchzuführen.

Jetzt registrieren

jobs.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

At Innodata, we’re partnering with the world’s leading technology companies to build the future of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re on the lookout for smart, savvy, and curious Generative AI Specialist to join our global contributor community as part of our Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Demand program.

This is not a traditional full-time role. It’s a part-time, remote, flexible, project-specific opportunity designed for those who want to make a real impact—on their schedule. Whether you're a writer, linguist, educator, researcher, or just deeply passionate about language and logic, this role lets you contribute to cutting-edge AI development while maintaining control over your time.

You’ll be helping LLMs learn the intricacies of language and reasoning—not just how to write, but how to think. If you’ve ever dreamed of shaping the intelligence behind tomorrow’s technology, this is your chance.

This is more than just a gig—it’s a rare chance to help shape the future of AI from anywhere in the world, on your own terms.

What You’ll Own:

  • Rating/assessing the performance of AI models or algorithms based on their output or behavior through a set of evaluative questions.
  • Labeling elements of a piece of content rather than the content as a whole.
  • Assigning predefined categories or labels to items.
  • Evaluating the perceived quality and/or appropriateness of content
  • Generating labels to advance understanding of a concept, trend etc.
  • Creation of additional training data for machine learning models by applying transformations to the original data, such as modifying images (rotation, flipping, cropping), generating new text (paraphrasing, summarization), or altering audio/video signals (speed modification, pitch shifting) to reduce overfitting and increase dataset diversity.
  • Reviewing data and identifying whether or not a product feature works as intended based on the project's guidelines.
  • Labeling model outputs to identify if a piece of content is or isn't something. Examples: identify clickbait; identifying gaming videos; identifying branded content.
  • Ordering or ranking items based on a set of preferences or criteria.
  • Creating prompts or questions that will be used to generate responses from a language model or other AI system.
  • Projects that evaluate the relevance of content based on a relevancy scale (1-3, 1-5, etc.).
  • Generating responses to prompts or questions using a language model or other AI system.
  • Rewriting existing text while preserving the original meaning, often to improve clarity or style and adherence to guidelines.
  • Producing concise summaries of longer pieces of text or data.
  • Converting spoken language or audio content into written text.
  • Converting text or spoken language from one language to another.
  • Gathering and compiling various forms of data to be used for training, evaluating, or fine-tuning the AI models. This may include text, images, videos, audio files, or other types of digital content.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a humanities specialization is required. Advanced degrees are strongly preferred (Master’s or PhD)
  • Professional or Expert level proficiency (C1/C2) in English

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $15 p/hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Data Collection Lead, AI/ML Data Programs
jobs.excerpt: Every breakthrough AI model depends on high-quality data.
jobs.description:
Every breakthrough AI model depends on high-quality data. Behind every reliable computer vision system, multimodal model, or AI-powered application is a complex process of collecting, validating, and delivering the data that makes it work.

Someone has to turn client requirements into practical collection strategies, mobilize the right people and resources, and make sure every dataset meets the standards it was built for.

That someone could be you. Our client is looking for a Data Collection Lead to own the execution of AI data collection projects from initial planning through final delivery. This isn't just about gathering data. It's about building reliable collection workflows, solving operational challenges, and delivering the quality and coverage that AI innovation depends on.

Why This Opportunity Matters

AI companies need more than large datasets. They need the right data, collected under the right conditions, with the right participants, devices, environments, and quality controls.

One project might require thousands of images or hours of video. Another might involve multilingual speech recordings, egocentric video, sensor-based data, or specialized datasets collected across specific geographic and demographic groups. Each comes with its own operational challenges, timelines, and quality expectations.

This role exists to make those projects happen. As Data Collection Lead, you'll translate client requirements into actionable plans, coordinate freelancers and external vendors, establish collection methodologies, and manage quality from pilot to final delivery.

Your work directly influences project success. When collection processes are well designed, resources are properly coordinated, and quality issues are addressed early, projects move faster and clients receive data they can trust. This is an ownership-driven operational leadership role where your decisions have a direct impact on delivery.

About Our Client

Our client combines human expertise with machine efficiency to deliver high-quality annotated data and AI data collection services at scale. They help AI companies obtain the data they need to develop, train, and improve intelligent systems.

Their work spans a range of AI applications, data modalities, and specialized collection requirements, supporting projects that demand accuracy, scalability, and reliable execution.

As AI data requirements become increasingly complex, the ability to design practical collection methodologies and manage distributed resources becomes essential. Our client offers an environment where operational ownership, problem-solving, and continuous improvement contribute directly to the success of AI programs.

What You'll Own

  • End-to-end project delivery. You'll manage assigned data collection projects from initiation through final delivery, translating client requirements into structured plans, timelines, milestones, and execution workflows.
  • Collection strategy and methodology. You'll design practical collection approaches based on project objectives, defining participant profiles, geographic coverage, devices, environments, metadata requirements, and quality criteria.
  • Pilot execution and scaling. You'll run pilot collections where necessary, assess results, identify operational gaps, and refine methodologies before scaling production.
  • Freelancer and vendor coordination. You'll identify, evaluate, and coordinate freelancers, field resources, communities, agencies, and external vendors based on capability, availability, cost, reliability, and quality.
  • Resource and capacity planning. You'll ensure the right people and resources are available when needed, monitor performance, and adjust resource allocation as project requirements evolve.
  • Data quality and validation. You'll establish quality-control workflows, validate collected data against client specifications, identify recurring issues, and manage corrective actions, rejections, and recollection when required.
  • Client communication and stakeholder alignment. You'll communicate directly with clients about requirements, progress, risks, feasibility, and operational challenges, turning feedback into clear actions for internal teams and external resources.
  • Risk and issue management. You'll monitor project commitments, dependencies, costs, and delivery risks, resolve operational bottlenecks, and escalate concerns early with practical recommendations.
  • Processes that scale. You'll document methodologies, build reusable SOPs, templates, and checklists, and continuously improve collection workflows to make future projects more efficient and reliable.
  • Stronger AI data operations. You'll help strengthen our client's AI's ability to execute increasingly complex data collection programs across different domains, geographies, and data modalities.

Requirements

You'll thrive in this role if you've already managed data collection or operational projects from planning through delivery and understand what it takes to turn complex requirements into executable workflows.

You'll do especially well if you bring 3–5 years of experience in project management, data operations, or a related field, with direct exposure to egocentric AI data collection projects. You understand that successful collection requires more than recruiting participants or gathering files. It demands careful planning, consistent execution, quality validation, and disciplined project tracking.

If you've worked on image and video collection, speech and audio recording, multilingual datasets, computer vision, multimodal data, or LLM and generative AI projects, you'll have a strong foundation for this role. Experience with Human-in-the-Loop operations and AI/ML data requirements is a significant advantage.

You're comfortable coordinating distributed teams and external resources, evaluating vendors, and mobilizing people quickly when project demands change. You know how to balance quality, cost, timelines, and feasibility without losing sight of the client's objectives.

You also communicate confidently with clients. When requirements are unclear or unrealistic, you ask the right questions, explain the implications, and recommend workable alternatives. You identify root causes rather than repeatedly fixing the same problems, and you build systems that make execution more consistent over time.

Most of all, you take ownership. You're resourceful when facing unfamiliar challenges, structured under pressure, and proactive about risks. You don't wait for every instruction to be spelled out; you figure out what needs to happen and make it happen.

A Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field rounds out the profile.

Benefits

  • End-to-end ownership. You'll have meaningful responsibility for how data collection projects are planned, organized, executed, and delivered.
  • Exposure to diverse AI programs. You'll work across different data modalities, industries, geographies, and collection challenges, expanding your experience in AI data operations.
  • A direct impact on AI development. Your work will help provide the high-quality datasets that AI companies need to build and improve their models.
  • Room to improve and innovate. You'll have the opportunity to develop reusable methodologies, improve operational workflows, and strengthen the organization's data collection capabilities.
  • Cross-functional collaboration. You'll work directly with clients, internal teams, freelancers, and external vendors, building valuable experience across the AI data delivery ecosystem.
  • Professional growth. You'll deepen your expertise in project leadership, distributed resource management, data quality, and AI/ML operations as the business takes on increasingly complex programs.
  • Remote flexibility. The role is fully remote, giving you the flexibility to work from your location while collaborating with a globally distributed team.

Ready to Lead the Data Behind AI?

If you're excited about owning complex data collection projects, solving operational challenges, and building processes that deliver reliable results at scale, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the AI industry.

Our client is looking for someone who can take initiative, manage competing priorities, and turn ambitious collection requirements into successful deliveries. If you have the operational experience, problem-solving mindset, and ownership mentality to make that happen, apply now.

jobs.title: Acquisition Manager (Paid Media & Ecommerce)
jobs.excerpt: Revenue team · Reports to the Head of Revenue · Remote first The roleArc makes precision engineered aluminium and titanium cases for the devices people use most, sold as an object rather than an accessory.
jobs.description:
Revenue team · Reports to the Head of Revenue · Remote first

The role

Arc makes precision engineered aluminium and titanium cases for the devices people use most, sold as an object rather than an accessory. The business has grown quickly on one hero product, trades worldwide with the US and UK as its core markets, and reaches most of its customers through paid media.

The role has two halves, and they are equally important. The first is buying the traffic: performance media is the largest single investment in the business and the primary engine of new customer growth. The second is trading the website that converts it. Arc's site is where almost every commercial decision lands, and it is the place with the most immediate headroom: how the range is presented and explained, how launches are executed, how the delivery and service proposition is shown, and how well the whole journey converts.

This is the first dedicated internal owner of both. You will not be buying media day to day, and you will not be building pages. You will set the strategy, trade the site week to week, direct our agency and development partners, and build the measurement that lets Arc invest with confidence. It suits someone who wants to own a channel outright and shape how it runs.

What you are accountable for

  • The cost and volume of new customer acquisition: how efficiently Arc converts media investment into new customers, in every market it trades in.

  • The performance media investment: how it is planned, allocated across markets, and phased across a trading year with pronounced peaks.

  • Trading the website: the site as a commercial asset. How it converts, how the range is presented, and how well it performs through the moments that matter.

  • The quality of acquisition measurement: the definitions, the reporting and the confidence the business can place in them.

  • The contribution of our agency and development partners: the output we get, the value we receive, and how the relationships develop.

What you own

Trading the website

  • The commercial performance of the site: what is featured, where it sits and when it changes

  • Homepage, landing page and collection merchandising, and how the range is sequenced and presented

  • Product page effectiveness, including how well the product is explained and sold to someone meeting the brand for the first time

  • Onsite search, navigation and product discovery

  • Basket and checkout performance, and removing friction through to purchase

  • Making the delivery, shipping and service proposition visible at the points where it influences a decision

  • Launch readiness and execution on site, so that major product moments land properly in every market

  • Promotional execution on site, and working with operations on availability and stock messaging

  • The weekly trading rhythm: reviewing performance, reacting to what is and is not selling, and feeding that back into media

Conversion, testing and development

  • The optimisation roadmap with our CRO partner, and the discipline to reach conclusions rather than abandoning tests midway

  • Test hypotheses and prioritisation, based on where the commercial opportunity actually sits

  • Prioritising the development backlog with our web partner, and being the commercial voice in that relationship

  • Site performance reporting: conversion by market and device, funnel drop off, and page level performance

Media strategy and investment

  • The annual and quarterly media plan across paid social, paid search and emerging channels

  • Allocation between markets, and the case for shifting investment toward the strongest returns

  • Phasing across the year, capitalising on the launch windows that concentrate demand and buy most efficiently

  • The balance between generating demand and capturing it, including growing search in line with the branded demand the brand is already creating

Agency direction

  • Setting the brief, the targets and the reporting rhythm

  • Weekly performance conversations and quarterly business reviews

  • Shaping account structure, campaign architecture and audience strategy

  • Assessing value delivered and guiding how the partnerships develop

Account structure and creative deployment

  • How campaigns are built, and how to get the most from the auction

  • How creative is deployed, rotated and refreshed

  • The concept pipeline: how much genuinely new creative is produced, and how often

  • Briefing the brand and influencer side, and being clear about what performance needs

  • Tracking discipline, so that the data arriving is clean and comparable

Measurement and attribution

  • The acquisition reporting pack: what is measured, how often, and for whom

  • Consistent metric definitions, so that trends can be trusted over time

  • Building an incrementality testing programme, and interpreting it rigorously

  • Reconciling platform reported performance with orders the business banks

  • Maintaining an agreed acquisition cost ceiling by market

New channels

  • Evaluating channels Arc does not yet use, building the case, designing the test and making the recommendation either way

Where this role starts and stops

This role owns the journey up to and including the first purchase, and the website that carries it. The majority of Arc's traffic is new to the brand, so the site's primary commercial job is converting people who do not yet know it. Trading and conversion are acquisition measures, and whoever is accountable for the cost of a customer needs control of the page that converts them.

The Retention Manager owns the customer database and the lifecycle after purchase. Where the two meet:

  • Onsite merchandising and cross sell modules: you own what appears on site and how the range is sequenced. Retention owns cross sell through lifecycle messaging.

  • Email and SMS capture on site: Retention owns the mechanic and the offer. You own placement and its effect on conversion.

  • Audiences built from customer data: Retention owns the segments. You own how they are applied in platform.

  • Paid activity aimed at existing customers: you execute it, measured jointly on repeat revenue rather than acquisition cost.

  • Pages for returning and logged in customers: Retention briefs the requirement. You own the roadmap and build priority.

  • Promotional offers: you own acquisition offers. Retention owns lifecycle offers. Policy is set with the Head of Revenue.

Crossover is expected and healthy. Where ownership is not obvious, the test is simple: which measure moves if this works, and who is accountable for it. The Head of Revenue settles anything genuinely ambiguous.

Working with our partners

  • Partners: campaign build and day to day buying. You: strategy, and the plan the buying serves.

  • Partners: bid, budget and audience management in platform. You: investment allocation by market and by season.

  • Partners: platform reporting and recommendations. You: deciding which recommendations are acted on.

  • Partners: producing performance creative variants. You: setting the creative brief and securing supply.

  • Partners: running optimisation tests. You: hypotheses, prioritisation and interpretation.

  • Partners: building and maintaining the site. You: deciding what gets built, in what order, and why.

How the role is measured

Targets are set with the Head of Revenue and reviewed quarterly.

  • Cost per new customer, by market, against an agreed ceiling

  • New customers acquired per unit of media investment

  • Cost of sale, meaning media as a proportion of net revenue

  • Contribution after media

  • Site conversion rate, by market and by device

  • Revenue per session, and the gap between markets

  • Add to basket and checkout completion rates

  • Average order value on first orders

  • Trading performance through launch windows

  • Channel mix, and how well investment tracks where demand sits

  • Incrementality tests designed, completed and acted upon

  • Volume of genuinely new creative concepts tested

  • Optimisation tests completed and concluded

Practical terms

  • Reporting line: Head of Revenue

  • Level: Manager, with a clear route to Head of as the channel and team grow

  • Location: Remote first. UK or European time zones, with a quarterly in person meet up

  • Team: Agency and development partners from the outset, with additional headcount planned as the channel matures

  • Salary: £40,000 to £55,000 base salary, dependent on experience

Requirements

The calibre we are looking for

  • Has owned a paid social and paid search budget at meaningful scale in a direct to consumer or ecommerce business, and been answerable for its performance

  • Has traded an ecommerce site commercially: merchandising, conversion and launch execution, rather than simply briefing a developer and waiting

  • Genuinely numerate. Can build and defend an acquisition cost and contribution model, can tell when platform reporting has drifted from commercial reality, and understands incrementality well enough to design and interpret a test

  • Has directed a performance agency rather than worked alongside one. Has set targets, shaped structure and held partners to account constructively

  • A self starter who is comfortable building process in a small, fast moving team

Useful, but not essential

  • Premium or considered purchase categories, where price is not the lever

  • A strong conversion optimisation or experimentation background

  • Shopify or a comparable platform, hands on

  • Launch driven or highly seasonal demand

  • Marketplace advertising

  • Hands on experience with an incrementality or media mix tool

Dropzone’s mission is to scale cybersecurity beyond human limits, and augment every single human security engineer/analyst with an army of AI security specialists. Humans alone cannot sufficiently protect our digital future, and AI augmentation is the only way for defenders to reclaim the high ground. We are an award winning company disrupting the $200B+ cybersecurity market.

We are venture-backed, and our team has a rare blend of deep experience across cybersecurity, AI/ML, and SaaS product development. Join us if you want to be on the ground floor of using Gen AI to transform cyber defense. Learn more at.

About the role

In this role, you will work across strategic customer accounts to help Dropzone become more trusted, accurate, and embedded in day-to-day security operations. You will work directly with customers, TAMs, Product, Engineering, and security stakeholders to understand each customer’s workflows, policies, escalation paths, exceptions, analyst expectations, and operational goals.

This is not a traditional implementation manager role, and it is not a replacement for the TAM. The TAM remains the primary owner of the customer relationship and account management motion. The FDE is not the primary account manager or ticket triage owner. Instead, the Forward Deployed Engineer provides deeper technical and operational support behind the scenes and, when appropriate, directly with customers during onboarding, optimization, large-scale pilots, or high-priority account work.

You should expect direct customer interaction in this role, especially with strategic customers during onboarding, optimization, and ongoing tuning work. You should also be comfortable operating behind the scenes with TAMs, Product, and Engineering to review investigations, identify tuning opportunities, build and deploy customer-specific configurations, refine response workflows, and measure whether Dropzone is becoming more useful, trusted, and sticky inside the customer’s SOC.

You will also help create continuity from pre-sales discovery through post-sales operationalization for strategic customers, especially where understanding the customer’s environment early can improve the long-term customer experience.

What you'll do

  • Support strategic customer accounts as a technical and operationalization-focused resource.
  • Partner with TAMs to help customers operationalize Dropzone without replacing the TAM as the primary account owner.
  • Lead or support technical discovery for strategic customers, strategic pilots, and high-profile accounts.
  • Review Dropzone investigations to identify tuning opportunities, outcome alignment gaps, workflow friction, and areas where customer trust can improve.
  • Draft and refine tuning recommendations based on each customer’s specific environment, workflows, policies, and analyst expectations.
  • Configure response workflows, notifications, escalation paths, and customer-approved behaviors.
  • Translate customer SOC practices into precise, approved Dropzone behavior.
  • Help customers identify functional alternatives or product-supported paths before escalating product gaps.
  • Open and document internal support or product cases when customer needs cannot be met through existing functionality.
  • Produce tuning, efficacy, and operationalization reports for strategic accounts.
  • Track impact through analyst feedback, outcome disagreement trends, benign resolution trends, tuning coverage, workflow adoption, and customer trust indicators.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to escalate product gaps with clear evidence and customer context.
  • Build repeatable playbooks for customer tuning, operationalization, and long-term maintenance.
  • Maintain clear boundaries between strategic operationalization, standard support, incident response, and custom development.

What success looks like

  • Strategic customers trust Dropzone outcomes faster.
  • Customers move from initial deployment to meaningful operational use more smoothly.
  • Customer-specific SOC practices are reflected consistently in Dropzone.
  • Analysts spend less time validating repetitive investigations.
  • Response workflows and escalations are mapped to approved customer outcomes.
  • TAMs have a strong technical partner who can drive tuning, investigation review, and operationalization work.
  • Product and Engineering receive clearer field signal with customer evidence and operational context.
  • Strategic operationalization becomes repeatable, measurable, and scalable.
  • Dropzone becomes stickier and more embedded in strategic customer environments.

Requirements

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Core AE, you will be helping our largest and most strategic enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and requires working in PST or MST timezone.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $100k+ ARR transactions
  • Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships
  • Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast paced environment
  • Willing and comfortable traveling to meet customers on a monthly basis

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)
  • Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$222,400—$278,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. jobs.excerpt: WHO WE AREThe PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month.

Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for, and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result.

Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment.

We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us.

THE ROLE

Interdependence is seeking a strategic, entrepreneurial Director of M&A to partner closely with executive leadership in driving the firm's growth through strategic acquisitions across the B2B PR, marketing, and digital agency sectors.

This is a highly proactive, hands-on role focused on identifying acquisition opportunities, developing targeted outreach and marketing strategies, and building relationships with targe acquisitions. We're looking for someone who understands the B2B landscape, knows how to generate interest and build a pipeline of qualified acquisition targets, and can help move opportunities from initial outreach through acquisition.

The ideal candidate combines strong B2B marketing expertise with a hunter mentality, exceptional relationship-building skills, and an entrepreneurial approach to growth. You'll serve as a trusted partner to executive leadership, helping expand Interdependence's capabilities, client portfolio, and market presence through strategic acquisitions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

M&A Marketing & Acquisition Strategy

  • Develop and execute targeted marketing and outreach strategies to identify and attract potential acquisition targets across B2B PR, marketing, and digital agencies.
  • Build and manage campaigns designed to engage agency founders, owners, and executive decision-makers.
  • Leverage B2B marketing channels, including paid advertising, email marketing, LinkedIn, and content, to generate qualified acquisition opportunities.
  • Develop compelling messaging and positioning that communicates Interdependence's value proposition to prospective acquisition partners.
  • Research industry trends, competitors, and emerging agency capabilities to identify strategic acquisition opportunities.

Acquisition Sourcing & Relationship Development

  • Proactively identify and pursue acquisition targets across the B2B PR, marketing, and digital agency sectors.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified acquisition prospects through targeted outreach, networking, and marketing initiatives.
  • Establish and nurture relationships with agency founders, owners, and executive leaders.
  • Identify off-market acquisition opportunities through proactive prospecting and industry research.
  • Lead initial conversations with prospective acquisition targets and assess their interest in potential partnerships or acquisitions.

Acquisition Pipeline & Performance

  • Develop and manage an acquisition marketing funnel, from target identification and initial engagement through qualified opportunities.
  • Establish KPIs to measure outreach effectiveness, qualified acquisition leads, pipeline growth, and conversion.
  • Analyze campaign and prospecting performance to optimize targeting, messaging, and channel strategies.
  • Maintain accurate acquisition pipeline reporting and provide regular updates to executive leadership.
  • Partner with leadership to evaluate prospective acquisition targets based on business performance, service capabilities, client portfolios, and strategic fit.

Strategic Growth & Executive Partnership

  • Serve as a strategic partner to executive leadership in developing and executing Interdependence's acquisition growth strategy.
  • Support acquisition discussions, relationship development, and due diligence in partnership with leadership and external advisors.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the firm's B2B capabilities, industry expertise, and market presence through acquisitions.
  • Develop scalable processes and strategies to strengthen acquisition sourcing and pipeline development.
  • Bring forward new ideas, market intelligence, and recommendations to accelerate growth.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of experience in M and A / acquisitions in B2B.
  • Understanding of acquisition sourcing, business development, and M&A processes; direct experience supporting acquisitions required.
  • Strong prospecting and relationship-building skills, with experience engaging founders, owners, and senior executives.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a hunter mentality and strong sense of ownership.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE

🏡 100% Remote, Forever - Work from anywhere in the world while you enjoy the flexibility of your fully remote workplace. Skip the annoying commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth.

🩺 Comprehensive Health Benefits - Choose from three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus dental and vision coverage to support your health and well-being.

💰 Retirement Savings - Save for the future with our 401(k) program, including a company match that is increasing further to 3% in 2027.

🌴 Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid vacation, sick time, 11 company holidays, a floating holiday, and Summer Fridays to recharge and spend more time doing what you love.

👶 Paid Maternity Leave - We support growing families with paid maternity leave, giving new moms dedicated time to recover, bond with their baby, and return to work with confidence.

📈 Career Growth - As one of the nation's fastest-growing strategic integrated marketing and communications firms, we're committed to helping ambitious people like you grow. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, lead from every level, and build a career with meaningful real impact.

🌟 Supportive, Collaborative Culture - We set high standards, celebrate big wins, and work together to achieve exceptional results. You'll join a team that's collaborative, entrepreneurial, and committed to helping one another succeed.

About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.

What you'll own

    Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem

    Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    Mentor and elevate the craft

    As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

    You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.

What we're looking for

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust

    Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

    You think in systems

    You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

    You bring strategy to life through Design

    You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

    You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

    You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

    You influence without authority

    You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

    You bring depth of experience

    You'll likely have:

  • 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

  • Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

Why join OLX

    OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

    As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

    This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

    If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.

Hiring Process

    First Stage
    Portfolio & Design Leadership
    This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.

    Second Stage

    In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

    Third Stage
    Executive Partnership & Business Impact
    This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.

Threecolts is a software suite built for consumer brands, helping them recover revenue, operate more efficiently and grow across major retailers and marketplaces.

Alongside this, we’re building and scaling newer products, including AI Operator and Retail 365, while continuing to grow our portfolio of subscription products across our customer base.

Who We Are

We’re a global team of 340 people across 33 teams, having grown through 24 acquisitions. We operate with a flat structure, giving people real ownership and the ability to move quickly.
