jobs.excerpt: Our VisionWe believe in a world where everyone, regardless of their country’s wealth or frontiers, enjoys access to medicines and healthcare when they need it.
jobs.description:
Our Vision

We believe in a world where everyone, regardless of their country’s wealth or frontiers, enjoys access to medicines and healthcare when they need it.

Our Mission

We work tirelessly to remove access barriers faced by patients and caregivers across Low and Middle-Income Countries (LMICs) when seeking quality medicines and quality healthcare.

Who We Are:Accelerating access to medicines for all

Imagine a world where critical medicines are within reach, affordable, and synonymous with quality, no matter where you are. That is the world we're building with our unique, demand-aggregation model that unites healthcare providers across LMICs. At the heart of our identity is a single, resolute commitment: to build a future where geography and income never stand between any individual and life-saving medicines. Our platform isn't merely a space for transactions, we unlock affordable access to medicines by aggregating demand across healthcare providers. We also help manufacturers build a sustainable and reliable global access strategy.

Our business focuses on low- and middle-income countries and strengthens the purchasing power of these markets to ensure the supply of cost-effective, high-quality medicines.
We partner exclusively with authorized, high-quality pharmaceutical companies and certified caregivers to accelerate sustainable access to medicines.

About the Position:

Axmed is building a B2B marketplace that changes how quality medicines are procured across low and middle income countries (LMICs), alongside logistics SaaS and trade financing that connect healthcare providers, governments, NGOs and pharmaceutical manufacturers through one data-driven platform. Every product moving through that platform has to be safe, genuine and handled to the right standard. This role exists to make that a guarantee rather than an aspiration.

Reporting to the Chief Operations Officer, you will own quality assurance strategy and execution across Axmed's marketplace operations. You will set the direction for the Quality Management System globally, hold ultimate accountability for compliance across every jurisdiction Axmed operates in, and represent Axmed's quality and compliance posture to regulators, clients and partners. The system you build is digital-first: controls embedded in platform workflows rather than static documents, routine checks automated, and AI and data applied so the team focuses on judgement and expertise. You will build and lead the Quality function as it scales, starting with the Quality Lead.

What you'll own

  • Own quality strategy and the QMS: define and continuously evolve Axmed's global Quality Assurance Programme and QMS strategy, aligned to GMP/GDP standards and WHO MQAS requirements in every jurisdiction Axmed operates in, designed digital-first with controls embedded in platform workflows.

  • Spearhead the Axmed Platform eQMS: run in-platform daily quality assurance, including organisation and product qualification, validation and QA release, and keep evolving the eQMS to meet changing business and regulatory needs, prioritising automation of manual review steps.

  • Pioneer AI and frontier practice in quality: set the vision for how AI and data are applied, including automated dossier and CoA screening, anomaly detection across supplier and batch data, AI-assisted document review and continuous rather than periodic monitoring. Pilot quickly, validate rigorously, and position Axmed as a reference for modern quality assurance in emerging markets.

  • Lead and develop the Quality function: build and manage the team as it scales, set objectives, and grow an AI-literate function where people focus on judgement while routine checks are automated.

  • Hold final accountability for audit governance: own and run the risk-based internal and external audit programme, using data signals to target audits in line with SOPs.

  • Lead external inspections and supplier audits: act as lead for client and regulator inspections, and run GMP/GDP audits of Axmed's suppliers, including remote and hybrid approaches supported by platform data.

  • Own enterprise-wide risk: maintain the company-level Risk Register, report exposure and mitigation status to the COO and ELT, and build leading indicators that surface emerging risk early.

  • Govern CAPA, deviations and recalls at policy level: manage deviation and complaint handling, the CAPA programme and product recall management in line with SOPs, acting as ultimate Responsible Person for recalls where required, with end-to-end traceability that supports rapid, targeted recall execution.

  • Own multi-jurisdiction compliance: ensure quality and compliance practices meet local regulatory requirements in each market of operation.

  • Design and run the annual QC sampling programme: a risk-based model driven by supplier, product and market data rather than uniform coverage.

  • Partner across Regulatory Affairs, Commercial and Technology: drive SOP adherence, continuous self-inspection and regular reviews of programme effectiveness, and co-own the product roadmap for quality features on the Axmed platform.

  • Represent Quality in commercial and regulatory decisions: provide quality and compliance input at ELT level on new market entry, seller and manufacturer onboarding, and product decisions.

  • Build a culture of quality: champion quality and compliance as a company-wide discipline, sponsoring training, coaching and continuous improvement across internal teams and marketplace sellers, including through digital learning.

What we're looking for

Skills

  • Strong working knowledge of GMP/GDP and pharmaceutical or medical device procurement quality systems, particularly WHO MQAS, plus working command of stringent regulatory authority expectations (EMA, Swissmedic, FDA).

  • Direct experience of prequalification, supplier qualification and product recall management.

  • Experience owning and evolving a full electronic Quality Management System (eQMS), including documentation, SOPs and records.

  • Audit leadership: running external GMP/GDP audits and internal audit programmes, with a track record of hosting and passing regulatory or client inspections.

  • Fluent in applying data and AI to quality work: comfortable specifying automation and AI-assisted controls. Prior deployment of such tooling is a strong advantage.

  • Ability to translate regulation into simple, usable processes and decisions that non-quality colleagues can follow.

Experience

  • 10+ years in quality assurance in supply chain or manufacturing in pharma and/or med tech, including operating at a global or multi-country level.

  • Proven track record leading or building a quality function, not only executing within one. Prior Head or Director of Quality Assurance, or equivalent seniority, preferred.

  • Experience running or coordinating QC testing programmes in pharma or med tech.

  • Experience in emerging markets, and with multi-country supply chain and regulatory compliance.

  • Experience managing people and reporting into an Executive Leadership Team or C-suite level function.

  • Familiarity with the health procurement or global health supply chain sector (for example QUAMED, PFSCM, IDA Foundation, GDF, UNICEF, UNFPA or similar) is a strong plus.

  • Practical experience using AI tools to improve quality or compliance workflows, with clear judgement on validation and on where human review must remain.

  • A pharmacy degree (Bachelor of Pharmacy, Pharm.D. or an equivalent recognised qualification).

Traits

  • Strategic and pragmatic in equal measure: able to set a multi-year quality vision and also decide what "good enough for now" looks like in a growing company.

  • Comfortable operating in a lean, remote-first startup environment with limited internal infrastructure and a team spread across time zones.

  • Credible and calm in front of regulators, executives, clients and suppliers; influences without needing authority.

  • Builder and innovator mindset: energised by creating structure where little exists, by developing people, and by using technology to do quality differently.

Right to Work: As an early-stage company, we are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship or relocation support. For this reason, candidates must already have the legal right to work in the country where they are based.

What is in it for you?

At Axmed, we believe in creating a supportive and rewarding environment where our team can thrive. Here’s what we offer:

  • Unlimited PTO: Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance.

  • Monthly wellness allowance: Prioritize your health and well-being with extra support.

  • Paid parental leave: Time off to bond with your new family member without any added stress.

  • Flexible working hours: Enjoy the freedom to structure your workday in a way that suits your lifestyle.

  • Annual off-site retreats: Connect with the team and build lasting relationships during our company retreats.

  • Fully remote work: Work from anywhere in the world and join our distributed team.

  • The opportunity to make a difference: Be part of a mission-driven company working to improve healthcare equity.

  • Competitive salaries: We offer a compensation package that reflects your skills and experience.

  • Plenty of room for growth: We believe in nurturing talent and offering opportunities for professional development and advancement.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Payroll Analyst I is an entry-level individual contributor responsible for full-cycle payroll processing for assigned populations, entities, or states, and for providing Tier 2 payroll support. This role performs pay calculations, owns reconciliations, supports payroll tax compliance and reporting, and resolves employee and manager cases escalated from Tier 1 through the ServiceNow ticketing platform. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own end-to-end payroll processing for assigned employee populations, legal entities, or states/countries across multiple pay frequencies.

  • Reconcile payroll to the general ledger, validate funding requirements, and research and clear variances prior to close.
  • Review and validate quarterly and annual tax filings and unemployment returns; partner with the tax service provider to resolve agency notices.
  • Administer multi-state and local tax setup, including reciprocity agreements and remote-work tax implications; audit benefit deductions, retirement contributions, and leave accruals.
  • Own the Tier 2 ServiceNow queue: resolve escalated pay, tax, garnishment, and deduction cases within SLA, with complete documentation.

  1. 1–3 years of progressive multi-state/country payroll processing experience.
  2. Solid knowledge of federal, state, and local wage and hour law, payroll taxation, garnishment administration, and year-end requirements.

  4. Intermediate Excel skills, including pivot tables, advanced lookups, conditional formulas, and reconciliation of large data sets.
  5. Experience reconciling payroll to the general ledger and researching wage and tax variances.
  6. Experience resolving escalated cases in a service management platform (ServiceNow strongly preferred); proven track record maintaining confidentiality.

KEY SKILLS

  • Analytical and research skills for resolving complex pay and tax discrepancies

jobs.description:
About Accenture
Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com


As a Deal Architect at the Senior Manager level, you lead the commercial shaping of large to mid-sized Global Capability Center (GCC) pursuits across an industry group. You own the proposition: what we are selling, why the client should care, and how the deal is structured so it works for them and for Accenture.


You are the commercial face of the pursuit in front of the client. You run proposition workshops, present the value case, and defend the deal structure in negotiation, working alongside the Sales Leader rather than in place of them.

In this role you will:


  • Own large to mid sized deals end to end commercially, from qualification through to signature
  • Support the Managing Director and Associate Director on the largest pursuits, owning defined commercial workstreams
  • Build the commercial narrative and value architecture that shows why Accenture's integrated model is the right answer for this client, now
  • Set the pricing envelope and deal structure, then brief the Solution Architect to build against it and review what comes back
  • Bring Technology, Finance, Talent, Supply Chain and delivery partners into one coherent offer rather than a set of components
  • Identify and develop new pursuit opportunities within your industry group, working with Sales and Client Groups to progress them through qualification
  • Coach Managers on mid sized and smaller deals, reviewing their commercial output before it reaches the client

You will work closely with four counterparts on every pursuit:

  • Sales, who owns the client relationship and the contract
  • The Solution Architect, who designs the solution and owns its economics
  • Commercial and Pricing, who build and validate the pricing model
  • The Delivery Organization, which brings the capability and mobilizes after signature

Here's What you Need:

  • Minimum 8 years' experience in commercial deal shaping, solution architecture, management consulting or pursuit leadership
  • Minimum 3 years' experience on large managed services, outsourcing or Global Capability Center (GCC) transactions
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Demonstrated experience owning a commercial proposition through to close, including pricing and contracting structure

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below.
We anticipate this job posting will be posted until 11/24/2026.

jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewVoted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Human-Centered Design (HCD) Manager to bridge the gap between user needs and technical execution. You will lead qualitative research, map user journeys, build interactive prototypes, and run usability tests to ensure our products are intuitive, accessible, and impactful for the physicians, clinical staff, billers, front-desk teams, and patients who rely on them every day. In a clinical setting, a confusing screen costs a provider time, adds to burnout, and can affect patient safety, so this role carries real weight. You will thrive here if you love sitting with users in their actual workflows, can turn messy observations into clear direction, and can defend design decisions with evidence.

Key Responsibilities

User Research

  • Conduct contextual inquiries, interviews, field observations, and surveys with physicians, clinical staff, billers, and patients to uncover explicit and latent needs.
  • Partner with account managers and support teams to surface usability pain points from client feedback and support tickets.

Synthesis & Strategy

  • Translate research into personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and system workflows across clinical, operational, and billing processes.
  • Present insights to product and executive leadership to shape roadmap priorities.

Ideation & Prototyping

  • Facilitate cross-functional design workshops and build low- to high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Design AI-powered features (AI charting, AI agents) that keep clinicians in control and make AI output easy to review and correct.

Usability Testing

  • Plan, moderate, and analyze formative and summative usability tests to iterate on designs before and during development.
  • Evaluate safety-critical workflows such as medication management and e-prescribing, and support ONC Safety-Enhanced Design testing.

Collaboration & Governance

  • Partner with product managers, business analysts, and engineers in Agile/Scrum teams to maintain design integrity from concept through release.
  • Uphold accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508) and HIPAA-safe research practices across all products.

Leadership

  • Build and scale WRS Health's HCD practice, including research operations, templates, and standards.
  • Mentor designers and researchers, and coach teammates on human-centered methods.

Qualifications

Required

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Human-Factors Engineering, Interaction Design, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3 to 6+ years of professional experience in HCD, UX design, or user research, including enterprise or regulated-industry experience.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in prototyping software (Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD), qualitative research methodologies, usability testing frameworks, and Agile/Scrum delivery flows.
  • Accessibility: Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG standards and how to apply them in practice.
  • Core Competencies: Strong empathy, verbal storytelling, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to defend design decisions with data.
  • A portfolio or case studies demonstrating end-to-end research, synthesis, prototyping, and measurable impact.

Preferred

  • Experience designing for EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, telehealth, or other health IT products.
  • Familiarity with clinical workflows and terminology across ambulatory specialties.
  • Knowledge of ONC Safety-Enhanced Design (user-centered design and summative testing) requirements, NISTIR 7804, or ISO 9241-210.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted or automation features, including human-in-the-loop review patterns.
  • Prior experience leading or mentoring designers/researchers, or building a design function from the ground up.
  • Experience with remote research and unmoderated testing tools and product analytics platforms.
  • Clinical background or prior work in a medical practice setting.

A Day in the Life

Your days move between the field, the whiteboard, and the prototype. You might start by joining the product team's stand-up to flag a research insight affecting an upcoming sprint, then sit in (virtually or on-site) with a specialty practice to watch how the front desk, medical assistants, and physicians actually work, noting the workarounds they've built and where the screens slow them down. Later, you could be synthesizing those observations into an updated journey map, facilitating a workshop with product managers, engineers, and billing specialists to sketch solutions, or moderating a usability test of a new AI charting feature to see how a clinician reviews and trusts AI-drafted notes. Before the day ends, you refine prototypes in Figma based on what you learned, check designs against accessibility standards, share prioritized recommendations with product leadership, and make time to coach the designers and researchers on your team.

Success Metrics

  • Measurable usability gains: Improved task success rates, time-on-task, error rates, and System Usability Scale (SUS) scores for redesigned workflows, including fewer clicks and less documentation time for key clinical tasks.
  • Research-driven roadmap: Consistent monthly contact with users across specialties, with a clear, visible share of roadmap items originating from or validated by HCD research.
  • Fewer usability issues post-release: Decline in usability-related support tickets, rework, and post-launch design defects.
  • Accessibility and certification compliance: New and updated features meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards at release, and ONC Safety-Enhanced Design documentation is completed on time.
  • Adoption and satisfaction: Higher feature adoption (including AI features) and improved client satisfaction or NPS for redesigned areas.

Job Details

  • Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.excerpt: memodio is a digital health application (DiGA) fighting forgetfulness and dementia 🧠 Our app is prescribed by doctors, fully reimbursed by German statutory health insurance, and recommended by leading medical associations.
jobs.description:
memodio is a digital health application (DiGA) fighting forgetfulness and dementia 🧠 Our app is prescribed by doctors, fully reimbursed by German statutory health insurance, and recommended by leading medical associations. In a clinical trial with 140 participants, we showed that it measurably improves memory performance, everyday independence, and quality of life. More than 10,000 people already trust memodio.

We've been on the market for over five years. So we have the speed and ownership culture of a startup, without the chaotic early days: a validated product, paying reimbursement partners, and real users who notice when we ship something good. Now we're growing the engineering team.

Where you sit: anywhere in the world. We're a small distributed team, not a company with a remote policy bolted on. The one requirement is overlap: at least four hours of your working day between 09:00 and 18:00 Berlin time, because we solve problems together, not by throwing tickets over a wall.

How you join us: as an employee or as a freelancer, whichever fits your situation better. Tell us which you'd prefer when you apply.

Tasks

Our core product is live and helping thousands of people, but it's far from finished. A big part of this role is evolving the existing app to better fit the people who actually use it: adults aged 50+, often dealing with early-stage cognitive decline. Every improvement you make has a direct, visible effect on someone's day.

Beyond the core product we're building new and adjacent products, including ones with AI capabilities. If working with LLMs excites you, there's real room to shape that. If it doesn't, that's fine too.

How the role works

You won't get finished designs and implementation specs to execute. You'll get problems, context, and user needs and the freedom to figure out the best solution. That's deliberate: it's where the creativity and the ownership live. It also means the job asks you to think about what to build, not only how.

Today our CTO is hands-on in the codebase, supported by a part-time engineer. You'd join as the next full-time engineer on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.

Day to day

  • Frontend: evolve our Flutter app (iOS & Android), with a strong focus on good UX and usability for people aged 50+
  • Backend: design and build our Node.js APIs and services for new features
  • Product: work closely with our medical and product colleagues: your voice matters in what we build and how
  • Quality: help us keep code review, testing, and engineering standards at the level a regulated medical product demands
  • Optional: if DevOps interests you, there's room to shape our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and deployment but it isn't the core of the job

Requirements

What you bring

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, and we care far more about what you've actually shipped than about the number. Show us something you built
  • Flutter/Dart skills, or a proven ability to ramp up fast (e.g. coming from React Native or native mobile)
  • Working knowledge of Node.js and building APIs, you don't have to be equally strong on both ends, but you can't be mobile-only
  • You work well remotely and asynchronously. This is a distributed role on a tiny team. You write clearly, you post updates without being asked, you unblock yourself, and you don't go quiet for two days
  • At least four hours of daily overlap with 09:00–17:00 Berlin time (CET/CEST)
  • You're comfortable working from underspecified problems. As a small company we can't hand you full designs and implementation plans — you'll need to ask the right questions, propose solutions, and make calls. In return, you get creative freedom
  • A self-directed, structured way of working, you thrive with a lot of ownership and little supervision
  • Dedication: we don't do inhumane startup hours, but when it matters - a release, a deadline, a critical fix
  • Fluent English, written and spoken. German is a plus, not a requirement

Nice to have, not required

  • Interest or experience in software security, our product passed an intense security audit and we intend to keep that bar high
  • Experience with accessibility, or with building for older users
  • Experience with DiGA, medical devices, or other regulated environments
  • Startup or consultancy background
  • DevOps experience (CI/CD, cloud infrastructure)

You are probably not right if

  • You need a large team around you. For now it's you, a hands-on CTO, and a part-time engineer. Specialists to hand things off to come later, you'll help hire them
  • You're looking for greenfield-only work. A big part of this job is improving a live product with real users and real constraints
  • You need someone to hand you tickets, or a manager checking in daily. Remote and self-directed is the whole shape of this role
  • You see your scope as highly specialised. We need technical solutions for internal tooling here and there too. If touching a HubSpot integration feels beneath you, this isn't the right place

Benefits

What we offer

  • Purpose: your code measurably helps people — clinically proven, prescribed by doctors, reimbursed by statutory health insurance
  • Real ownership: as the next full-time engineer, you'll own features end to end and have a direct say in how we build
  • Stability with startup energy: 5+ years on the market, revenue from reimbursement partners
  • Genuinely remote, genuinely worldwide: work from wherever you're based, with flexible hours around a light overlap window. Our office in Potsdam is there if you ever want it
  • Your choice of setup: employment or freelance, whichever suits you
  • No office politics: a small, focused team where the energy goes into the product, not into positioning
  • Straight talk: you've just read our salary range and a list of reasons not to apply. That's how we operate internally too

If you have any questions, please don't hestitate to reach out :)
The initial phase will be a short questionnaire, followed by a small project and 1-2 live interview rounds.

  • Learn one seat away from closing - By partnering closely with experienced AEs, you'll see how enterprise deals are navigated from first conversation to signed customer. For people who aspire to become Account Executives, this role is designed as a launchpad—not a stop.

jobs.description:
Associate Account Executive

The Associate Account Executive plays a key role in driving CTC’s growth by managing a portfolio of eCommerce brands and uncovering opportunities to expand each partnership. This individual builds strong, trust-based relationships with clients, ensuring seamless delivery while identifying ways to increase value through new initiatives and strategic recommendations. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates with clarity and confidence, and brings a proactive, sales-minded approach to growing revenue and strengthening long-term client relationships.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

YOU SET THE STANDARD

The Associate Account Executive is responsible for driving revenue growth within their existing book of business by identifying, developing, and closing opportunities that expand the client partnership. This role combines strategic account management with proactive sales execution ensuring each client realizes the full potential of CTC’s services while the Associate Account Executive meets or exceeds defined monthly and quarterly upsell targets. Success in this role is measured by the ability to deepen client engagement, increase total account value, and consistently uncover new ways for CTC to deliver measurable business impact. The Associate Account Executive will:

  • Deliver on Revenue Accountability: Consistently meet or exceed upsell and renewal targets, contributing to both individual and company-wide revenue objectives.
  • Own the Upsell Pipeline: Maintain an active pipeline of expansion opportunities across the assigned client portfolio, accurately forecasting revenue and tracking progress toward monthly and quarterly sales goals.
  • Identify Growth Opportunities: Analyze account performance, client objectives, and market trends to pinpoint where CTC’s additional offerings (such as new channels, creative solutions, or strategic programs) can drive incremental ROI.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (Channel Leaders, TikTok Shops, Strategy, Creative, and Email) to design and deliver data-driven proposals that align client growth goals with CTC’s service capabilities.
  • Lead Strategic Conversations: Communicate new strategies, present performance insights, and position upsell opportunities as natural extensions of client success.
  • Proposal & Contract Ownership: Prepares accurate proposals, scopes, and contracts that align client needs with CTC’s services and internal guidelines.

YOU ARE DRIVEN TO INCREASE VALUE

The Associate Account Executive is responsible for developing deep, trust-based relationships with key client stakeholders, positioning CTC as an indispensable strategic partner in their growth journey. This role requires a balance of relational intelligence and business acumen, ensuring that every client interaction builds confidence, drives clarity, and reinforces CTC’s commitment to delivering measurable results. Success in this area means maintaining proactive communication, anticipating client needs, and collaborating cross-functionally to resolve challenges with speed and professionalism. The Associate Account Executive will:

  • Maintain a Client First Approach: Act as a trusted advisor and advocate, ensuring every upsell initiative strengthens the client’s overall results, satisfaction, and long-term partnership value.
  • Anticipate and Address Needs: Maintain a pulse on client goals, concerns, and market dynamics to identify risks early and provide proactive solutions before issues escalate.
  • Collaborate to Solve Challenges: Work closely with internal teams (including Strategy, Creative, Email, and Operations) to troubleshoot and resolve client challenges swiftly, ensuring alignment between client priorities and internal execution.
  • Integrate AI into Daily Workflow: Use AI tools to improve preparation, uncover account insights, and work more efficiently while demonstrating curiosity, accountability, and the ability to adapt quickly.

YOU CREATE AN ENVIRONMENT OF EXCELLENCE

The Associate Account Executive sets the tone for operational excellence across every client engagement, ensuring that communication, execution, and collaboration meet the highest professional standards. This role demands precision, accountability, and an unwavering commitment to quality. Creates an environment where both clients and internal teams can thrive. Success in this area is measured by the consistency, clarity, and care brought to every interaction, deliverable, and outcome. The Associate Account Executive will:

  • Demonstrate professionalism and attention to detail: Deliver high-quality work across every touchpoint, ensuring communication is clear, organized, and complete. Every interaction reflects CTC’s standard of excellence.
  • Take ownership and deliver on commitments: Manage priorities with accountability, meet deadlines reliably, and see projects through from concept to completion. Drives forward progress and resolves challenges with initiative and integrity.
  • Model excellence for others: Set an example through preparation, responsiveness, and follow-through, elevating the performance of peers and reinforcing a culture of trust and excellence across the team.
  • Pursue continuous improvement: Seek feedback, identify opportunities to enhance workflows or communication, and consistently refine approaches to make CTC’s client experience stronger, faster, and more impactful.

What Success Looks Like

Owning Expansion and Renewal OpportunitiesYou independently manage expansion and renewal opportunities from discovery through proposal, objection handling, negotiation, and close, consistently turning client needs into additional revenue for CTC.

Cross-Functional Service FluencyYou build strong relationships with internal departments, develop a clear understanding of their services and capabilities, and confidently connect client needs to the right CTC solutions.

Client Retention and Renewal ReadinessYou maintain a clear understanding of client satisfaction, contract timing, and delivered value, working with account strategy leads to address risks and position accounts for successful renewals.

What You’ll Bring To The Table

  • Significant experience identifying, developing, and closing expansion opportunities within existing client relationships. This is a top requirement; if you haven’t owned sales conversations and closed revenue, this role isn’t for you
  • 2+ years of experience in account management, client success, or consultative sales with responsibility for revenue growth and retention
  • Ability to lead a structured sales process from opportunity identification and discovery through proposal, objection handling, negotiation, and close
  • Strong CRM discipline. You maintain accurate records, manage next steps, keep deal stages current, and provide clear visibility into the pipeline
  • Experience preparing proposals, scopes, and contracts that connect client needs with clear business value
  • Strong understanding of eCommerce, including customer acquisition, retention, merchandising, promotions, and the factors that drive profitable growth. Experience and knowledge of paid advertising platforms (Meta, Google, AppLovin, and more), email/sms marketing, Shopify, and TikTok commerce (TikTok Shop, TikTok ads)
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple accounts and sales opportunities with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to adapt to new services, sales processes, platform changes, and revenue goals

THE DETAILS

MANAGEMENT

  • This role reports directly to the VP of Client Success, with a focus on managing relationships and expanding contract value within a defined book of CTC clients.

ORIENTATION

  • This role is primarily client-facing, responsible for developing strong relationships with key brand stakeholders and serving as their trusted partner. The Associate Account Executive will collaborate closely with internal service teams and drive the expansion conversations from start to finish.

COMPENSATION

SALARY RANGE

  • $60,000 to $70,000 base salary, annually
    • This is prior to any benefits
    • Bonus | $65k in annual bonus ($130k OTE) based on individual upsell and client retention performance attainment

ABOUT US

At CTC, we are fixated on building the next generation of legendary brands and the people who will lead them.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing this mission, we organize all of our decisions — from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money — in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone. They're challenging.

In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

For those who resonate with the following values, CTC has proven itself to be a remarkable place to grow and thrive.

  1. We Set the Standard

  3. We Create an Environment of Excellence

We’ll come alongside you and care for you in your pursuits by offering full-time permanent CTC employees:

  • TIME OFF | When you’re at CTC, you’re firing on all cylinders. To make that possible, we offer a Flexible Time Off policy where you will coordinate with supervisor to take time away from the office for rest, travel, and variety of others things that are important to you!

jobs.excerpt: EADTrust es una empresa española con 17 años de vida y un equipo de 30 personas especializada en servicios cualificados de confianza (firma electrónica, sellado de tiempo, certificados digitales) bajo regulación europea eIDAS / eIDAS 2.
jobs.description:
EADTrust es una empresa española con 17 años de vida y un equipo de 30 personas especializada en servicios cualificados de confianza (firma electrónica, sellado de tiempo, certificados digitales) bajo regulación europea eIDAS / eIDAS 2. Algo más de la mitad del equipo se dedica diariamente a desarrollo, infraestructura y cumplimiento. Trabajamos con bancos, despachos jurídicos, administraciones públicas y operadores regulados.

Buscamos un especialista con experiencia sólida para operar, automatizar y asegurar la plataforma cloud que soporta las aplicaciones de uno de los proyectos más importantes de la empresa, desplegada principalmente en AWS y con cargas en Oracle Cloud (OCI). La persona asumirá la gestión íntegra de la plataforma tras un periodo de traspaso de varios meses en colaboración con el proveedor actual, trabajará con autonomía en la operación diaria y en las mejoras incrementales, y escalará al responsable de Infraestructura las decisiones de arquitectura y las dudas de mayor complejidad. El objetivo de este rol es llevar la plataforma a un nivel de estabilidad, seguridad y cumplimiento homogéneo con los estándares de la compañía y mantenerlo a lo largo de la siguiente etapa de crecimiento. Trabajarás de manera estrecha con las 5 personas del equipo de infraestructura y con el equipo de desarrollo.

Tareas y responsabilidades principales:

  • Operar y mantener la plataforma cloud (AWS y OCI).
  • Administrar cargas serverless y clústeres de Kubernetes gestionados.
  • Gestionar API gateways (Kong) y la integración de las aplicaciones con el proveedor de identidad corporativo (Okta).
  • Mantener la infraestructura como código con Terraform y los pipelines de despliegue con GitLab CI y ArgoCD (GitOps).
  • Operar las bases de datos PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis y la mensajería (RabbitMQ): mantenimiento, copias de seguridad y pruebas de restauración.
  • Gestionar la observabilidad (Prometheus, Grafana) y el alertado; responder a incidentes y realizar análisis de causa raíz.
  • Gestionar identidades y accesos (IAM) en ambas nubes y aplicar las políticas de seguridad y cumplimiento de la compañía.
  • Documentar la plataforma: runbooks, diagramas y procedimientos operativos.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de desarrollo y coordinarse con proveedores externos.

Requisitos imprescindibles:

  • Experiencia práctica con AWS en producción: VPC y redes, EC2, EKS, IAM, S3, Route53, balanceadores.
  • Administración de Kubernetes: upgrades, grupos de nodos, RBAC, ingress controllers y troubleshooting de pods y red.
  • Terraform: módulos, estado remoto, gestión de varios entornos.
  • CI/CD: pipelines de infraestructura y aplicaciones con GitLab CI o similar.
  • Linux y redes: administración de sistemas, routing, VPN, TLS y certificados, DNS, firewalls.
  • Scripting: Bash y Python (o lenguaje equivalente) para automatización.
  • Observabilidad: Prometheus y Grafana o herramientas equivalentes.
  • Más de 3 años operando infraestructura cloud en producción (incidentes, actualizaciones, migraciones), con responsabilidad directa sobre al menos un entorno productivo.

Certificación deseable:

  • AWS SysOps Administrator, CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), AWS Solutions Architect Associate.

Lo que ofrecemos:

•Salario competitivo según experiencia.

  • Plan de carrera técnico (no es obligado crecer a roles de gestión).
  • Trabajo con un dominio técnico no trivial: criptografía, regulación europea, infraestructura QTSP.
  • Equipo pequeño con autonomía real, sin capas innecesarias.

• Modalidad de trabajo: remoto 100 %.

  • Incorporación estructurada y paquete de beneficios atractivo.

  • Lead modernization efforts across IBM i, RPG, and modern technology platforms while preserving customer stability and business continuity.
  • Establish engineering standards, development methodologies, and governance processes to improve quality, predictability, and delivery performance.
  • Partner with Product Management, Client Services, Professional Services, Sales, and Business Unit leadership to align development priorities with customer and business needs.
  • Develop and maintain multi-year product and technology roadmaps across the LocalGov portfolio.

  • Oversee development capacity planning, resource allocation, and prioritization across competing initiatives and product lines.
  • Use AI development tools personally and daily, and champion their use across the organization - including GitHub Copilot, Project Bob, large language models, and agentic coding tools - holding a current, practical command of what they can and cannot do rather than relying on secondhand reporting.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs that measure outcomes rather than activity - cycle time, development throughput, escaped defect and escalation rates, delivery predictability, customer satisfaction, and development cost as a percentage of revenue - and report AI delivery maturity and the business outcomes it produces on a recurring executive cadence.
  • Own the LocalGov AI delivery-maturity roadmap across all eight product lines, applied stage by stage across the software lifecycle rather than as a single business-unit rating, and deliver against the maturity targets agreed with executive leadership.

  • Apply AI directly to the IBM i and RPG estate - legacy code comprehension, documentation generation, and modernization analysis - as a primary mechanism for preserving knowledge held by an aging and retiring RPG skillset.
  • Build the tooling and training program that moves engineers from AI-assisted work, to AI-directed work, to supervised agent execution, and give them the access and time to get there.
  • Lead strategic modernization and transformation initiatives including cloud adoption, customer-facing AI solutions, and automation efforts.
  • Ensure appropriate architecture, security, compliance, and technical governance practices are maintained across all products.
  • Serve as the executive escalation point for critical development issues and strategic customer initiatives.
  • Develop succession planning and knowledge preservation strategies for aging legacy technology skillsets.
  • Manage OpEx Financial Forecast for R&D department to include monthly forecast updates, reporting on Monthly Business Unit Review Calls, & attendance/participation Annual Businesss Strategy Meeting.
  • Attendance to key customer events in markets where large-scale development motions are occurring

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive software development leadership experience.

  • Demonstrated experience leading software modernization initiatives involving both legacy and modern technology platforms.
  • Experience managing geographically distributed development teams and cross-functional technical organizations.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and engineering best practices.
  • Experience with enterprise software delivery, product strategy, and technical roadmap development.
  • Proven ability to align technology investments and development priorities with business objectives and customer needs.
  • Demonstrated experience driving organizational change and technology transformation initiatives.
  • Experience implementing or leading AI-assisted development practices, automation initiatives, or engineering productivity improvements.
  • Demonstrated hands-on use of AI development tools in daily work, with a clear point of view on where they help, where they fail, and how quickly that is changing.
  • Experience raising an engineering organization's way of working from individual AI assistance toward agentic, human-on-the-loop delivery, including the governance and validation that makes it safe.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, stakeholder management, and executive leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with IBM i, AS400, RPG, COBOL, or legacy platform modernization initiatives.
  • Experience with local government, public sector, ERP, tax, financial, records management, or government technology solutions.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Project Bob, LLMs, or similar technologies.

  • Provide production support; lead incident response and root cause analysis; participate in a shared on-call rotation for production systems, including support outside standard business hours per team schedule; mentor engineers and uphold sound engineering practices

  • Streaming & events: Kinesis, Kafka, REST publish, SNS/SQS fan-out, DLQ handling, checkpointed consumers, multi-language event SDKs
  • Observability & ops: Splunk, Kibana, Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry; Jira, Slack
  • Agentic AI: LLM agents, MCP, RAG and vector retrieval, spec-driven development, evaluation and CI quality gates for production AI
  • Security & access: OAuth, Entra ID, OPA and policy-based access control

jobs.description:
DeterTech's purpose is giving greater peace of mind to people and communities, every day, and clear, well-documented solutions are how we make sure our Salesforce platform keeps pace with the business. This role supports the Salesforce Technical Lead by turning conversations and requirements into properly analysed and documented solutions, while also being hands-on enough to contribute directly to configuration and build.

This is not a purely functional Business Analyst role: you'll be comfortable moving between stakeholder conversations, solution documentation and hands-on Salesforce configuration, giving the Technical Lead more time to focus on the areas where specialist technical input matters most.

ABOUT DETERTECH

DeterTech is a security technology company operating across six countries, with principal UK sites in Prestwick and Telford. We predict, deter and detect risk on behalf of the people and communities we serve. Our values – Committed, Inclusive and Ambitious – shape how we work every day: we are accountable and deliver excellence; we collaborate and build trust; and we never stop learning while winning in the right way.

This is a remote role, although we value regular face-to-face collaboration. We would ideally like someone who can attend our Telford office around once a week if based locally, or a couple of office visits per month for those based further afield.

Key Responsibilities

1. Requirements and discovery
• Gather requirements through stakeholder interviews and workshops.

• Support the Salesforce Technical Lead during discovery and design.

• Partner closely with BPO stakeholders (including Sales, Customer Success, Field Operations, and Finance) to understand their day-to-day challenges, operational bottlenecks, and strategic needs.

• Facilitate process discovery workshops to map out processes and collaborate with the Technical Lead to define efficient, scalable future-state ('to-be') solutions.

2. Analysis and documentation
• Produce clear process maps, requirements documentation and solution designs.
• Translate business requirements into Salesforce functional/technical requirements.
• Independently follow up with stakeholders to close gaps and ambiguities.
• Write well-structured, detailed user stories in Jira, complete with clear business value statements, functional specifications, wireframes or mock-ups where helpful, and unambiguous acceptance criteria.
• Work closely with the Technical Delivery Manager during backlog refinement and sprint planning to ensure stories meet the team's 'Definition of Ready' before entering active development sprints.

3. Hands-on configuration
• Build appropriate elements of agreed solutions directly within Salesforce.
• Support testing and validation of delivered solutions alongside the QA/Test Analyst.
• Deliver configuration and lightweight automations (such as custom fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, and straightforward Salesforce Flows), freeing the Technical Lead and Senior Administrator for complex architecture and deep technical build.
• Collaborate with the QA / Test Analyst to walk through user stories, clarify expected behaviour and edge cases, and assist with functional validation in sandboxes prior to release.
• Partner with the Senior Salesforce Administrator to prepare change communications, end-user guidance, and support materials to drive smooth user adoption.

4. Solution governance and continuous improvement
• Work within the architectural guardrails, data model standards, and best practices established by the Salesforce Technical Lead, avoiding over-customisation or technical debt.
• Regularly review system adoption, gathering user feedback after releases to identify opportunities to simplify workflows and improve the user experience.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Essential
• Proven requirements gathering and stakeholder interviewing skills.
• Excellent process mapping, requirements and solution documentation skills.
• Able to independently follow up with stakeholders to close gaps and ambiguities.
• Able to translate business requirements into Salesforce functional/technical requirements.
• Hands-on Salesforce configuration capability – this role needs to build, not just document.
• Comfortable supporting the Technical Lead during discovery and design.
• Experience working as a Business Analyst, Solution Analyst, or functional consultant within a Salesforce environment.
• Hands-on ability to configure core Salesforce elements (custom objects, fields, validation rules, record types, and basic Flows).
• Experience writing clear user stories with formal acceptance criteria within an Agile team.

Job Description:

Peckham Inc. - Clinical Services Operational Specialist


Important Information:

Wage: $16.97 per hour plus a Health & Welfare benefit of $5.42 per hour

Shift: Monday - Friday, 8:00a.m. - 4:30p.m.

Location: Must be located in the state of Kentucky, USA

SUMMARY

The Clinical Services Operational Specialist (CSOS) provides operational support within assigned departments or teams by accurately processing and maintaining electronic records, researching and resolving complex record or system issues, and supporting effective workflow management. This position prioritizes and monitors workloads based on business needs, communicates research findings, and provides guidance to peers and other stakeholders as appropriate. The Operations Specialist collaborates with team members and leadership, cross-trains across multiple functions, processes communications and claims as needed, and may support peer training, mentoring, special projects, and other operational assignments.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Accurately prepare and/or processes electronic records to and from workflows by verifying, entering, organizing, sorting, and routing to appropriate locations
  • Conduct research to resolve unique and complex errors or issues with records and/or systems
  • Communicate with others based on research findings
  • Provide guidance to others based on research findings
  • Monitor, track, and/or communicate workload status to appropriate staff
  • Create and/or process incoming and/or outgoing communication
  • Cross train to multiple functions or workloads
  • Prioritize functions or workloads depending on business need and/or direction
  • Collaborates and communicates with peers and leaders
  • Process live claims using applicable computer systems as needed
  • Mentor and/or train peers as needed
  • Accept other jobs/duties as assigned

  • High School Diploma or equivalent  
  • At least 18 years of age
  • U.S. Citizen  
  • Proficient in the English language with oral and written communication skills sufficient to facilitate clear and accurate information exchanges with customers
  • Ability to pass a thorough background check screening (credit and criminal history) to determine fitness for a federal security clearance

  • Computer and keyboarding skills sufficient to record information accurately and efficiently, with demonstrated proficiency in data entry and the ability to maintain focus and accuracy
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, problem-solve, and effectively adapt to a fast-paced environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job, the individual will be required to multitask. The employee will also be required to:

  • Speak, listen, read, and use a computer simultaneously during their scheduled shift

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Individuals are required to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team. The tasks of the call center are repetitive in nature. For remote work, employees must maintain a quiet, dedicated workspace that is free from distractions and suitable for professional customer interactions. The overall noise level is generally moderate in a typical work setting. The work environment characteristics described are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Individuals will be on the phone from their remote office for most of their scheduled shift. Peckham will provide a computer, monitor and headset and the employee will provide workspace and internet connectivity that meets minimum requirements.

Candidates must successfully pass and maintain all required security and background checks applicable to the position and/or contract. Employment is contingent upon successful completion and ongoing maintenance of all required security and background checks, which may be conducted at hire and on an ad hoc basis as required. All required security and clearance checks are completed at no cost to the candidate.

jobs.description:
Webflow Developer & Digital Experience Specialist

  • Location: Remote, India (Dedicated overlap with U.S. working hours)
  • Experience: 3–5+ years overall (3+ years hands-on Webflow development)
  • Department: Marketing

About the Role

Koantek is looking for a hands-on Webflow Developer & Digital Experience Specialist to own the development, design, and continuous evolution of our digital presence. Sitting within the Marketing team, this role bridges Webflow development and UI/UX design to translate our brand and go-to-market priorities into responsive, intuitive digital experiences.

We need a candidate who goes beyond executing pre-made designs. You will take business or marketing requirements, independently recommend effective digital layouts, and build them. Deep expertise in B2B cloud technology or digital marketing isn't required on day one—what matters most is high visual standards, technical curiosity, and the ability to turn complex tech concepts into clean web experiences.

Key Responsibilities

1. Webflow Development & Website Ownership

  • Own the development, maintenance, performance, and accessibility of Koantek’s Webflow platform.

  • Build responsive landing pages, solution pages, CMS collections, forms, and reusable components.

  • Write custom HTML/CSS and JavaScript where needed to extend native Webflow functionality.

  • Manage site integrations, cross-browser compatibility, and CMS architecture for maximum scalability.

2. UI/UX & Digital Design

  • Apply visual hierarchy, typography, and responsive UX principles to build polished digital user journeys.

  • Independently design end-to-end page structures and layouts without relying on fully developed mockups.

  • Maintain brand consistency across all digital touchpoints while optimizing site structure and navigation.

3. Website Optimization & Marketing Support

  • Partner with Marketing to build high-converting campaign landing pages, event pages, and GTM experiences.

  • Support technical SEO best practices (metadata, accessibility, page speed) and analytics setup (GA4/tracking).

  • Provide auxiliary design support for visual assets and client-facing Google Slides presentations.

4. AI Execution & Collaboration

  • Utilize modern AI and automation tools to accelerate design iteration, code workflows, and web production.

  • Collaborate closely with U.S.-based stakeholders during dedicated overlap working hours.

Requirements

Core Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of professional experience building and managing Webflow websites.

  • Strong Portfolio: 2–3 live Webflow projects demonstrating both UI/UX design and development ownership.

  • Technical Mastery: Deep knowledge of Webflow CMS, animations, responsive design, and basic HTML/CSS/JS.

  • Design Capability: Solid grasp of layout, typography, whitespace, user journeys, and accessibility standards.

  • Execution: Proven ability to translate ambiguous business briefs into complete, functional web pages.

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written English communication for seamless U.S. stakeholder alignment.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Webflow frameworks like Client-First or Relume.

  • Working knowledge of SEO (Google Search Console), GA4, GTM, or marketing automation (Zapier/Make).

  • Prior experience in B2B SaaS, cloud, data, AI, or IT professional services environments.

Portfolio Requirement

When applying, please submit links to 2–3 Webflow websites or digital experiences you personally created. Include a brief note for each detailing:

  1. What you personally designed

  2. What you personally built in Webflow

  3. What parts of the project you owned end-to-end

jobs.title: Assistant Professor (Full-Time), Public Health, GuidedPath
jobs.excerpt: Assistant Professors are full-time employed faculty who provide a variety of educational services to degree, certificate, and non-degree learners.
jobs.description:
Assistant Professors are full-time employed faculty who provide a variety of educational services to degree, certificate, and non-degree learners. Assistant Professors are responsible for meeting the expectations and requirements of Capella University while establishing and maintaining effective relationships with learners, colleagues, staff, and administration. Assistant Professors are able to perform well in all key accountabilities of the role, are nimble and flexible and expected to be able and willing to take on essential roles and other duties as needed, within the department, school or university. Assistant Professors ensure that learners receive quality educational experiences consistent with stated course outcomes as well as HLC and any program accreditation standards. They provide high-quality, impactful, and inclusive experiences that deliver exceptional learning outcomes. Capella values the scholarly-practitioner model and expects Assistant Professors to continue learning and development through participation in scholarly activities or professional practice in the discipline. Among the responsibilities that Assistant Professors are expected to perform include: teaching (online), mentor and committee work (graduate level only), and contributing to curriculum development. Assistant Professors also participate in school governance through faculty committees and may participate in a variety of other activities based upon the university’s needs and the faculty member’s unique skill set.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Teaching and Instruction – Assistant Professors are highly engaged instructors in the courses and residencies they teach. They are sought out by learners and consistently exceed set expectations for faculty who teach courses at Capella. Assistant Professors use course data to constantly improve their individual teaching performance and contribute regularly to the improvement and refinement of the courses they teach. Regularly reviews course feedback and implements change to continually strengthen performance and enhance learner experience.
  • Doctoral Mentoring – Assistant Professors are highly knowledgeable about established dissertation and doctoral capstone processes and resources. They interact effectively with learners, develop strong relationships and offer guidance. They have demonstrated success in chairing and serving on doctoral committees. Assistant Professors facilitate highly interactive dissertation and capstone courserooms and their learners are supported to timely completion of the dissertation or capstone product.
  • Curriculum and Course Development – Assistant Professors are knowledgeable in the Capella course development process and have demonstrated the ability to work successfully with cross functional partners across Capella to plan and deliver high-quality course and curriculum in the area of their expertise. Participates in the design development and continuous improvement of courses and course materials including course plans, objectives, and outcomes, teaching aids, competency-based assessments, and authentic assessment tools. Ensure sensitivity diversity and inclusiveness in curriculum design, course content, and study materials as needed.
  • School and University Governance – Assistant Professors regularly demonstrate leadership roles in school and university governance. They willingly assume school and university committee roles as active participants and are effective in driving the positive impact of these governance structures. They are the role models and leaders among faculty and serve as peer mentors.
  • Professional Service and Practice – Assistant Professors are active in contributing their professional knowledge and skills to the needs of their local communities and within their professional network affiliations. They carry the “Capella Brand” and mission to their local regions and communities. Research and Scholarship – Assistant Professors stay current in their scholarly field(s) and demonstrate expertise through writing, speaking and conference attendance.
  • Leadership through Team Engagement – Assistant Professors are expected to take on essential roles and other duties as needed, within the department, school or university. Bringing their unique skills and perspectives, Assistant Professors regularly contribute to departmental leadership whether it be through specific roles, active contribution of innovative ideas, or taking on challenging tasks. All full-time faculty are depended on, and relied upon, for immediate and unplanned needs and must be nimble and adjust to changes as they occur. These roles may include specialized assignments such as faculty and cross functional staff meetings, commencement, residencies, Capella-sponsored faculty development, problem resolution, faculty orientation/mentoring, webinar facilitation, course revisions, etc.
  • Additionally, some Assistant Professors may have certain “areas of emphasis” where a greater degree of leadership is expected and include such as specialized responsibilities or coordinating functions in support of the school’s educational goals such as Learner Management, Research and Advising, Program Development and Advising, Field Education, Accreditation or support of B2B partnership efforts. Responsibility areas and specific assignments are based on the needs of the school and capabilities of the faculty member. Faculty assignments and areas of emphasis may vary significantly from school to school; however, the position is structured to ensure the faculty member is able to contribute optimally to essential teaching and related support services to learners.

Job Skills:


Teaching and Assessment and/or Doctoral Mentoring:

Refers to the ability to enable learner academic progression, provide guidance, and enhance learner experience.

  • Understand and apply Capella’s competency-based education model that aligns program outcomes, competencies, assessments, and reports with external standards and Capella educational philosophy to improve learning.
  • Convey and share content knowledge and relevant professional experience in the discipline.
  • Facilitate learner acquisition of course and/or research competencies aligned with their program.
  • Consider learner differences and appreciate the diversity of experience and interpretation among students.
  • Effectively assess and document learner knowledge, skills, and dispositions through formative and summative feedback.
  • Monitor learner progress and achievement and refers students to additional resources as needed.
  • Display cultural awareness and sensitivity to learner differences and seek information about strengths, needs, and interests of the learner to provide personalized support.
  • Engage students in effective, timely, and relevant interactions and nurtures a learning community that cultivates a spirit of trust, interaction, and learning.
  • Effectively manage key online course and/or advanced doctoral processes and tools.
  • Provide a timely, visible, consistent, and responsive presence in the courseroom and/or mentoring process, and communicate appropriately and respectfully.
  • Encourage learner engagement consistent with the learner code of conduct and support the free exchange of ideas.

Research and Scholarship:

These activities advance teaching and mentoring as well as professional development. Activity varies by person and field. Meeting research and scholarship requirements as defined by external accreditors, where appropriate. Schools may identify focus areas of research, specific conferences, or professional journals.

  • Scholarship for applying innovative teaching methods, especially those that can be empirically validated as having a positive impact on learner success (e.g., course success, continuation, graduation).
  • Submit proposals and/or present at workshops or conferences (internally and externally).
  • Showcase original/innovative work/exhibition.
  • Maintain an active research agenda.
  • Attend professional development events, attain continuing education credits, and pursue additional credentials.
  • Present research (whether applied or teaching-focused).
  • Submit paper and/or publish at industry-recognized channels.

Professional Service and Practice:

Includes external-facing activities related to students, institution, profession, and/or community. Activities increase the service of the institution and strengthen its external reputation. Meeting professional service and practice requirements as defined by external accreditors, where appropriate. In most situations, the activities are with reduced fee/pro bono/honorarium.

  • To students: Career and well-being advising, leading student organizations, guidance on learning and projects outside of courseroom, learner-facing webinars.
  • To institution: Providing support for institutional activities with external audience (e.g., presentations for employer partners, job fairs, representing the institution at conferences).
  • To profession: Leadership in organizations or professional associations, advocacy for the advancement of the profession and communities served, organize professional conferences.
  • To community: Sharing knowledge with the public, volunteer for community-based events with their expertise (e.g., volunteering at clinics for underprivileged communities).

Governance and Leadership:

Include internal-facing activities to increase the effectiveness of the institution, the school, and faculty practice.

  • Active participation in appropriate program, department, school, or university committees, providing expertise and perspectives to advance university and school’s strategic direction.
  • Active participation in faculty staff meetings, Capella-sponsored faculty development, and other faculty-focused events (e.g. CU Faculty Virtual Conference), including sharing best practices, providing personal expertise via different communication channels, promoting better community support among peers, etc.
  • Serve as SMEs in course and program development; support for accreditation efforts; and serve in pilot groups for innovation projects at program, school, or university levels.
  • Identify and orchestrate the proactive management of curriculum content quality and currency. Demonstrate expertise in evaluating and coordinating the ongoing assessment of content to ensure its relevance, accuracy, and up-to-date nature.
  • Take on additional, challenging projects to serve the needs of the school or university in support of student success.
  • Provide mentorship, feedback, and guidance to other faculty members when appropriate.

Performance Criteria:

Satisfactory performance of teaching and/or mentoring activities based on the university faculty expectations is required and will be reviewed as part of the annual plan of work and review process.


Work Experience:


  • Expertise in biostatistics, epidemiology, policy analysis, or program evaluation is required.
  • Experience with how to conduct and oversee public health research is required.
  • Two or more years teaching is required. Teaching in an online setting is preferred.
  • A strong background in qualitative research methods, GIS mapping, financial management, or project management is a plus.
  • Teaching experience in higher education is preferred.
  • Experience mentoring doctoral students is preferred.
  • Experience writing curriculum is preferred.
  • Knowledge of CEPH accreditation standards and CEPH curriculum development experience is preferred.
  • Membership/affiliation in an educational leadership organization on a national, regional, and/or local level.
  • Demonstrated commitment to service and practice in the field of educational leadership.
  • Experience with leadership through team engagement.
  • Evidence of supporting learner success and a commitment to quality teaching outcomes.
  • Ability to contribute through teaching and/or service to the diversity, cultural sensitivity, and excellence of the academic community.
  • Experience presenting at professional conferences on a national and/or local level.
  • Experience with scholarly writing and use of APA 7th edition.


Education:

  • A doctoral degree in public health is required.
  • All degrees must be conferred and from a regionally accredited institution. Copies of required certificates and licenses and unofficial transcripts for all graduate degrees with the institution and conferred degree and date must be attached.

Other:


  • Must be able to travel occasionally should a business need arise. For most roles travel would not be common. Travel may involve plane, car or metro. In accordance with ADA policies, reasonable accommodations regarding travel limitations can be provided. Travel will be more common for roles such as Account Executives (25 - 50%), senior leaders (10 – 20%) or all levels of Capella Faculty (5 – 10%).
  • Ability to work onsite in Corporate or Campus location (in a typical office environment) may be required based on role. If so, this would include being mobile within the office, including movement from floor-to-floor using elevators or stairs.
  • If offsite or hybrid role, must have access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at a remote location.
  • Faculty and Federal Work Study roles require access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role role (including computer, privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at a remote location.
  • This role may require lifting, however reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with our ADA policies.
  • Must be able to meet critical thinking and problem-solving aspects aligned to job duties, as well as effectively communicating with co-workers.
  • Must be able to work more than 40 hours per week when business needs warrant. Accommodations related to schedule may be considered.Able to access information using a computer.
  • Other essential functions and marginal job functions are subject to modification.

Work Location Details:

Many of our positions, including this role, are designed to be remote "home office" settings.

Employees working out of a home office are responsible for providing appropriate and safe office space, office furniture and organization, communication tools, and related items. These include:

  • Arranging for high speed internet connection, printer and a dedicated phone line for business use. Specifics regarding expense coverage and reimbursement vary based on individual position categories. The University will not provide office equipment or on-site set up assistance.
  • The environment must be free from distractions and enable a highly productive and professional work environment.
  • As with on-site positions, our off-site positions require that the majority of the time will be spent using a telephone, PC and monitors.
  • There are minimal lifting requirements unless otherwise noted.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.


$84,000-$87,000 is the expected starting pay for this position. This offer is based on current budgetary guidelines and the additional factors outlined below.

SEI offers a comprehensive package of benefits to employees scheduled 30 hours or more per week. In addition to medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans, SEI employees may take advantage of well-being incentives, parental leave, paid time off, certain paid holidays, tax saving accounts (FSA, HSA), 401(k) retirement benefit, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, tuition assistance as well as entertainment and retail discounts. Non-exempt employees are eligible for overtime pay, if applicable.

Careers - Our Benefits, Strategic Education, Inc

SEI is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture where individuals can grow their careers and contribute fully. We strive to attract talent with broad experiences, skills and perspectives. We welcome applications from all. While it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the pay range at SEI, we offer a competitive salary. The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate may vary depending on multiple factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal pay equity. Our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to discuss your interest in joining SEI. The expected salary range for this position is below.
