jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

The Employment Law Team at Pinterest provides strategic, practical counsel to the People Team and business leaders on workforce decisions across the employee lifecycle. We are looking for an experienced Senior Lead Counsel with a strong background in advising on complex employment matters to join our team. The position will serve as a trusted legal partner to the People Team and business leaders across Pinterest, helping navigate matters ranging from recruiting and organizational change to employee relations, compensation, benefits, and contingent workforces. This role will play an important part in enabling business objectives, managing legal and reputational risk, supporting Pinterest's values and culture, and helping build scalable policies and processes for a global workforce.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as a trusted senior advisor to executives, People Team leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders on complex employment matters, such as workforce strategy, organizational change, global mobility, employee relations, accommodations, leaves, classification, and contingent workforces.
  • Independently assess complex and ambiguous legal and business risks, synthesize competing considerations, and provide decisive, practical recommendations aligned with Pinterest’s objectives.
  • Lead the development and implementation of employment-related agreements, policies, guidelines, and other legal documents and operating practices.
  • Develop and lead complex, cross-functional employment-law initiatives, including compliance programs, policy rollouts, process improvements, training, and other strategic People Team priorities.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to identify emerging risks, set priorities, secure resources, and drive alignment and accountability across interconnected workstreams.
  • Manage significant employment disputes, litigation, agency investigations, and regulatory matters; develop practical resolution strategies that balance legal, business, employee-experience, and reputational considerations.
  • Manage outside counsel relationships, budgets, and legal work to budget, maintaining appropriate quality, efficiency, and strategic oversight.
  • Monitor developments in employment law and translate them into clear, actionable guidance, policies, training, and scalable business practices.
  • Act as an AI-forward legal partner by identifying responsible opportunities to use AI to improve legal research, risk spotting, workflow efficiency, knowledge management, and service delivery, while applying sound judgment regarding confidentiality, accuracy, bias, transparency, and human oversight.

What we're looking for:

  • JD and active bar admission, with a minimum of 10 years of experience handling complex employment matters in a law firm or in-house environment; California or New York bar admission preferred.
  • In-house experience in a fast-paced organization is preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of U.S. employment law and experience advising senior business and People leaders on high-impact, complex matters.
  • Exceptional judgment and decision-making skills, including the ability to assess ambiguity, balance competing considerations, and make timely recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and executive-influence skills, with the ability to explain complex legal issues clearly and build trusted partnerships.
  • Proven ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional initiatives and drive alignment and accountability across stakeholders.
  • Strong experience negotiating and managing employment litigation, agency investigations, regulatory matters, and outside counsel relationships.
  • AI-forward mindset, including the ability to evaluate and responsibly apply AI tools to legal work and scaling efficiency.
  • Impeccable integrity, discretion, resilience, and commitment to an inclusive environment.

Relocation Statement:

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement

  • We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration approximately 1-3 times per year and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

jobs.description:
Physical AI Field Delivery Engineer (Computer Vision/Edge AI/ROS2) – Remote EEA (50% Travel)

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a rare engineering role that sits at the intersection of AI, robotics, and industrial operations — and actually ships into the real world. You’ll be designing and deploying Physical AI solutions in environments like manufacturing plants, energy infrastructure, logistics hubs, and smart facilities, working directly with customers from discovery through to production. If you’ve built computer vision or edge AI systems that run on physical hardware in industrial settings — not just in notebooks — and you’re comfortable leading technical workshops as much as writing optimised inference code, this is the scope you’ve been looking for.

The role is remote-first within the EEA, with approximately 50% travel to client sites across Europe.

PROJECT & CONTEXT

You’ll work as a Field Delivery Engineer on Physical AI initiatives — spanning computer vision, robotics, edge computing, and industrial IoT — for customers in sectors such as manufacturing, energy, transportation, logistics, and smart infrastructure. Engagements run from requirements gathering and PoC through to full production deployment and ongoing optimisation. You’ll collaborate with solution architects and engineering teams, lead customer-facing workshops, and own the technical delivery of production-grade AI applications leveraging cameras, LiDAR, drones, robotics platforms, and edge computing hardware. Contract runs until 31 March 2027, starting ASAP.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Experience

  • Hands-on engineering background in computer vision, robotics, edge AI, or industrial IoT — with demonstrable production deployments in real-world environments
  • Fluent English — written and spoken, at both customer-facing and executive presentation level
  • Available and willing to travel across Europe approximately 50% of the time
  • Based within the European Economic Area (EEA)

Computer Vision

  • Production-grade experience with OpenCV, object detection frameworks, and video analytics pipelines
  • Model development and optimisation for inspection, tracking, anomaly detection, and real-time inference

Machine Learning

  • Hands-on model development with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow for vision and perception tasks
  • Understanding of model lifecycle management and operational performance monitoring

Edge AI & Embedded ML

  • Deployment and optimisation of AI workloads on NVIDIA Jetson platforms
  • Experience with TensorRT for inference optimisation and ONNX for model portability
  • Edge-to-cloud architecture design for scalable AI operations

Robotics & Autonomous Systems

  • Development and integration using ROS / ROS2 for real-world industrial applications
  • SLAM for autonomous navigation and localisation
  • Sensor-driven AI for autonomous perception and decision-making

Industrial IoT & Sensor Integration

  • Integration of cameras, LiDAR, telemetry, and PLCs in operational environments
  • Sensor fusion and real-time data acquisition for edge-to-cloud pipelines
  • Familiarity with industrial automation protocols: OPC-UA, MQTT, SCADA

Programming

  • Strong proficiency in Python and C++ for AI system development and optimisation

Customer & Delivery Skills

  • Ability to lead requirements gathering, technical discovery workshops, PoC execution, and executive presentations
  • Comfortable translating business challenges into AI solution designs and articulating business value to non-technical stakeholders

NICE TO HAVE

  • Sector experience in manufacturing, steel, mining, energy, or industrial automation
  • Experience with robotic vision systems, drones, or autonomous inspection platforms
  • Digital Twins and simulation — NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim
  • MLOps practices and tooling: Docker, Kubernetes, Azure AI
  • Background in drone operations or autonomous monitoring systems in industrial environments

About Builders

Builders is a non-partisan movement of millions, uniting Americans across lines of difference - grounded in the belief that curiosity, compassion, courage, and creativity can move us beyond division. Founded by Daniel Lubetzky, our community spans 5M+ citizens, 650M video views, and 400+ movement partners including José Andrés, Katie Couric, Adam Grant, Lonnie Ali, and Karl Rove. Through a growing ecosystem of content, tools, partnerships, and activations, we turn civic engagement into meaningful action - empowering people to participate, collaborate, and deliver real-world impact to enact lasting change.

About the Position

The media landscape has fundamentally changed - and Builders needs someone who not only knows that, but is already living it. We’re looking for a communications professional who has mastered the brass tacks of traditional PR - the pitch, the placement, the press release, the relationships - and who also sees clearly where media is heading and knows how to operate there.

Reporting to the Editorial Director and CMO, you will be the engine behind Builders’ day-to-day earned media operation - driving coverage across traditional outlets, independent media, and creator platforms alike. You think in audiences, not just outlets. You use technology to move faster and smarter. And you bring a point of view on where the media ecosystem is going - not just where it has been.

This is an ideal role for a PR professional who has done the foundational work and is ready to help define what modern communications looks like for one of the most important civic movements in the country.

Responsibilities

Earned Media & Pitching

  • Own the daily pitch operation - proactively identifying story angles, drafting sharp pitches, and relentlessly following up to secure coverage across national media outlets and key regional markets (most notably, Texas).
  • Monitor the news and culture cycle in real time to spot reactive opportunities where Builders’ voice, insights, or programs can be inserted credibly and quickly.
  • Draft compelling press releases, media advisories, op-ed drafts, and story memos that make it easy for journalists to say yes.
  • Develop and maintain a robust media list across national political, civic, and cultural beats.
  • Treat creators as a core earned media channel - identifying, vetting, and building relationships with podcasters, newsletter writers, YouTube channels, and social creators whose audiences align with Builders’ mission and reach demographics traditional press doesn’t. Managing execution in collaboration with the Social team.

Media Relationships

  • Build and maintain genuine, trust-based relationships with journalists, producers, editors, and bookers across print, digital, broadcast, and podcast platforms.
  • Serve as a consistent, reliable point of contact for media - responding quickly, providing useful background, and positioning Builders as a go-to source for cross-partisan civic stories.
  • Identify and cultivate relationships with emerging media voices and non-traditional platforms where Builders’ message can reach new audiences.
  • Support the placement and preparation of Builders spokespeople and Movement Partners for media appearances, interviews, and contributed content opportunities.

Technology & Tools

  • Leverage AI tools actively across your workflow - pitch drafting, media research, coverage analysis, and contact list building - staying ahead of emerging PR tech.
  • Own the team’s media monitoring and outreach stack (Muck Rack, SmartSuite, TVEyes) - maintaining lists, tracking coverage, and generating regular performance reports to sharpen strategy.
  • Use social listening and trend-monitoring tools to identify story opportunities early and keep Builders positioned to move quickly when moments arise.
  • Bring a continuous improvement mindset to the comms tech toolkit - evaluating new tools, testing what works, and making recommendations to the Editorial Director.

Strategy & Collaboration

  • Contribute to messaging and communications frameworks - both providing input on strategy, and running the execution.
  • Partner with the Editorial Director to align earned media efforts with the broader editorial calendar, newsletter content, and organizational priorities.
  • Collaborate with programs, partnerships, and community teams to surface stories, data, and voices worth pitching.
  • Support crisis and rapid-response communications as needed, helping to draft reactive statements and coordinate media inquiries under pressure.

Requirements

Required

  • 5- 7 years of PR or communications experience, with the majority of your time spent in earned media - pitching, placing, and managing press.
  • A proven pitching track record: you can point to placements you drove in national or major regional outlets, and you know what made them land.
  • Ability to build relationships with political, civic, lifestyle, or national news reporters
  • Sharp, fast writing: you can draft a pitch, a press release, or a reactive statement that is clean, on-brand, and compelling without heavy editing.
  • Deep familiarity with the national political and media landscape - you know the beats, the outlets, and the reporters who cover civic life.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment where priorities shift and no two days look the same.
  • An instinct for what’s newsworthy - you read the news constantly and can immediately spot the angle that connects a story to Builders’ mission.
  • An overall technology-forward mindset - you proactively seek out tools that make you faster and smarter, and you bring that curiosity to the rest of the team. Including fluency with the modern PR tech stack - media monitoring, outreach, AI tools, and measurement platforms are part of your daily workflow, not a learning curve.
  • Collaborative spirit and genuine enthusiasm for Builders’ cross-partisan mission - you understand that reaching both sides of the aisle is a feature, not a constraint.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with the Texas political and media landscape - knowledge of key outlets, reporters, and civic players is a genuine plus.
  • Existing relationships with creators, podcasters, or newsletter writers in the political, civic, or culture space.
  • Experience in nonprofit, advocacy, or civic sector communications.
  • Familiarity with op-ed placement and thought leadership development.
  • Experience supporting executive spokespeople or public figures in media contexts.

Business Wire, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is the global market leader in press release distribution and regulatory disclosure. We are on a mission to redefine how organizations connect with their audiences - and that’s just the beginning!
Organizations, large and small, depend on us to accurately publicize market-moving news and multimedia, and generate social engagements that develop interactions with their target audiences.

About the Role

The Senior Systems Engineer is a senior member of the Corporate IT team responsible for the design, administration, security, automation, and continuous improvement of Business Wire's hybrid infrastructure across on premises, virtualized, and cloud environments.

This role provides technical leadership across Windows Server, Active Directory, Entra ID, VMware, AWS, endpoint management, identity services, and infrastructure operations. The Senior Systems Engineer serves as a key escalation point for complex technical issues, drives modernization initiatives, improves operational maturity through automation and standardization, and partners closely with Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Service Desk, and business teams to ensure reliable and secure technology services.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical direction, lifecycle management, and operational health of Windows infrastructure platforms.
  • Establish standards, configuration baselines, and operational practices across infrastructure services.
  • Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives across Windows, VMware, AWS, identity platforms, and endpoint management systems.
  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements that increase reliability, security, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents and operational issues.
  • Lead major incident response efforts and coordinate cross-functional technical teams during business-impacting outages.
  • Drive root cause analysis and ensure permanent corrective actions are implemented.
  • Design, administer, and optimize Windows Server environments and hybrid identity services.
  • Manage Active Directory, Entra ID, Group Policy, identity synchronization, and authentication services.
  • Maintain and support VMware vSphere, ESXi hosts, vCenter, and associated infrastructure components.
  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure services, including EC2, IAM, networking, monitoring, and storage services.
  • Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, load balancing, certificate services, and core infrastructure dependencies.
  • Lead audit remediation efforts, access reviews, evidence collection, and infrastructure control improvements.
  • Partner with Information Security to improve vulnerability management, identity governance, and infrastructure security controls.
  • Design and implement automation solutions using PowerShell, Infrastructure as Code, APIs, and cloud-native tooling.
  • Eliminate manual processes through automation, orchestration, and workflow improvements.
  • Develop repeatable deployment, maintenance, patching, and compliance standards.
  • Maintain infrastructure documentation, architecture diagrams, standards, and operational runbooks.
  • Mentor engineers, administrators, and Service Desk personnel through technical leadership and knowledge transfer.
  • Collaborate across Infrastructure, Security, Service Desk, DBA, Applications, and vendor teams to improve operational maturity and service reliability.

What You'll Need

  • 8+ years supporting enterprise infrastructure environments as a Systems Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or senior technical resource.
  • Deep expertise with Windows Server, Active Directory, Entra ID, Group Policy, and hybrid identity environments.
  • Advanced VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong AWS infrastructure experience including EC2, IAM, networking, and cloud operations.
  • Experience leading infrastructure projects from design through implementation.
  • Experience serving as a senior escalation point during business-critical incidents and outages.
  • Strong PowerShell automation and scripting capabilities.
  • Experience with vulnerability remediation, patch management, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • Experience performing audit remediation, access reviews, compliance documentation, and regulatory support activities.
  • Strong knowledge of DNS, DHCP, networking fundamentals, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, automation frameworks, or configuration-management practices.
  • Ability to evaluate technical risk, make sound operational decisions, and balance short-term needs with long-term strategy.
  • Strong written communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation and respond effectively during major incidents.
  • Experience with monitoring or SIEM tools (Splunk, CloudWatch, OpenSearch) is a plus.
  • VMware, Microsoft, Entra ID, AWS certifications is a plus.
  • Prior experience in audit-driven or highly regulated technical environments is a plus.

What We Offer

  • The base salary range for this position is $130K to $135K/year. Offered salary will be determined by several factors, including but not limited to: applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with geographic market data. Business Wire reserves the right to modify this salary range at any time.
    • Business Wire’s total rewards include:
  • Ability to work remotely
  • Excellent health benefits that begin on your first day of employment
  • $100 monthly fitness allotment, a tuition reimbursement program, and enhanced mental health resources
  • 401(k) plan with generous company match, and annual profit sharing contribution (subject to company performance)
  • PTO, Floating Holidays, Wellness Day Off, Birthday Day Off, and more!
A pre-employment background check will be required after the acceptance of an offer. Business Wire is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and other similar state laws and local ordinances, and its internal policy, Business Wire will also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Product Owner (Cloud and Platform) - HL7/DICOM
jobs.excerpt: The Product Owner, Universal Gateway, owns the backlog for the single ingress and egress layer that carries DICOM studies and HL7 messages into and out of Intelerad's cloud platform, serving IntelePACS, InteleArchive, InteleShare VNA, InteleViewer, and InteleOrchestrator.
jobs.description:
The Product Owner, Universal Gateway, owns the backlog for the single ingress and egress layer that carries DICOM studies and HL7 messages into and out of Intelerad's cloud platform, serving IntelePACS, InteleArchive, InteleShare VNA, InteleViewer, and InteleOrchestrator. Universal Gateway replaces today's product-specific gateways, relays, and edge servers with one standardized service for DIMSE and DICOMweb traffic, HL7 routing and normalization, authentication, and multi-tenant isolation. This is a hands-on, technically deep role: the Product Owner works day-to-day with platform engineering, SRE, and Hosting teams, and ensures that what gets built is reliable enough for clinical imaging workflows where downtime directly affects patient care.

Acting as the primary connection point between the Product Manager's vision and the development team's execution, the Product Owner combines deep knowledge of DICOM, HL7, and healthcare integration with hands-on agile delivery experience on platform or infrastructure products. Success in this role depends on sound day-to-day judgment: making trade-off decisions that keep delivery aligned to the broader product strategy set by Product Management and business leaders. This is not a generalist Product Owner role. Candidates should bring direct, hands-on experience with medical imaging interoperability, integration engines, or healthcare connectivity infrastructure. In your application, please describe a specific DICOM, HL7, or healthcare integration problem you owned and how you resolved it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog for Universal Gateway, writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria for DICOM DIMSE (C-STORE, C-FIND, C-MOVE, Storage Commitment, MWL), DICOMweb (STOW-RS, QIDO-RS, WADO-RS), HL7 v2 inbound and outbound messaging, and pathology whole slide imaging (WSI) ingestion.
  • Partner daily with engineering and design throughout the development lifecycle — refinement, sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives — making timely trade-off decisions on scope, sequencing, and priority, and escalating strategic or financial trade-offs to the Product Manager or Director as needed.
  • Define and validate non-functional requirements, including failover SLA, RTO/RPO, multi-AZ high availability, and throughput and latency targets by modality (CR through large CT, mammography, and WSI), and confirm delivered features meet them along with DICOM PS3.4 conformance and the published DICOM Conformance Statement.
  • Gather and synthesize input from Sales, Customer Success, Support, and customers to inform backlog refinement, and support the Product Manager with market research, competitive analysis, and feature-level requirements.
  • Track and report on sprint and release progress, velocity, and delivery metrics, proactively flagging risks to scope or timeline, and incorporate feedback from user acceptance testing and beta programs into subsequent backlog iterations.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, technology, or equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Manager, or integration or interface engineer, including at least 2 years on platform, infrastructure, or integration products rather than end-user feature applications.
  • Working knowledge of agile/scrum methodologies and hands-on experience with backlog and sprint management tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Hands-on working knowledge of DICOM (DIMSE services, DICOMweb, AE title configuration, conformance statements) and HL7 v2 (ADT, ORM, ORU), demonstrated by writing requirements for, configuring, or troubleshooting DICOM or HL7 interfaces in production.
  • Experience partnering directly with engineering teams, with comfort leading technical discussions on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs, including high availability, failover, and multi-region design for Linux-based, containerized services.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail in requirements definition and quality validation.
  • Working understanding of cloud infrastructure and operations, including AWS or equivalent, containers, infrastructure as-code (such as Terraform and Ansible), networking (load balancers, VPN, TLS and mTLS), and observability tooling.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience with medical imaging systems (PACS, VNA, RIS) or integration engines and routers (such as Mirth/NextGen Connect, Rhapsody, Cloverleaf, or DICOM routing products).
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence rather than authority.
  • Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a track record of collaboration across engineering, design, and cross-functional business teams.
  • Experience defining SLAs, RTO/RPO, or reliability targets for clinical or other mission-critical systems.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures, tenant isolation, and healthcare security and privacy obligations (HIPAA, GDPR, or equivalent).
  • Exposure to digital pathology (whole slide imaging) or high-volume modality workflows such as mammography and large CT. This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.

The base pay for this position ranges from $86,250 - $115,000/yr USD within any geographic market in the US. Pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Intelerad is a total compensation company. Pay is dependent on the position offered. Bonus and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, retirement, PTO, and/or other benefits.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Applicants may be required to complete an online personality assessment as part of your application.

Intelerad is committed to the principles of equal employment. We are committed to complying with all federal, state and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and all other employment laws and regulations. Applicants, employees and former employees are protected from employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age , disability and genetic information (including family medical history). Intelerad is dedicated to the fulfillment of this policy regarding all aspects of employment, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, placement, transfer, training, promotion, rates of pay, and other compensation, termination, and all other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment.

 

Intelerad is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity for qualified individuals with disabilities. At Intelerad, we believe the path to answers in healthcare should be clear-whether you are waiting for a diagnosis or trying to expedite one. Our medical imaging solutions streamline the flow of information, simplifying complex processes, maximizing efficiencies, and shining a light on the unknown. We empower physicians to get patients the answers they need faster and improve outcomes for everyone. With more accessible imaging, we are getting patients out of the dark.

Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 800 employees located in offices across four countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. Intelerad’s modern enterprise solutions have been acknowledged by a Best in KLAS recognition, ranking #1 for PACS Europe UK/Ireland in the 2026 Best in KLAS: Global Software (Non-US) report.

jobs.description:
Come Join Our Team

For over 20 years, PSG (an EPIC owned company) has been singularly focused on helping our clients navigate the complex and ever-changing challenges of drug management. Through our leading pharmacy intelligence and technologies, we save our clients billions of dollars every year with an unwavering commitment to serving as an advocate and strategic partner to our clients.

The Opportunity

PSG’s vision is to be the world’s innovator in drug management solutions, providing clinically appropriate and affordable pharmaceutical care for all.Artemetrx is PSG’s robust data and analytics platform that drives measurable financial and clinical results. The Client Success Manager serves as the operational owner of assigned client relationships, connecting client priorities with the appropriate PSG resources and ensuring commitments are communicated, coordinated, and completed. Working in collaboration with the lead consultant, the Client Success Manager provides continuity across client communication, account operations, platform utilization, and cross-functional delivery while the consultant leads strategy, clinical recommendations, and consulting engagements.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Partner with the lead consultant, aligning before communicating material recommendations, commitments, scope changes, or sensitive commercial matters.
  • Establish and manage an appropriate client communication and meeting cadence, including agendas, internal preparation, meeting facilitation, notes, collateral, action items, decisions, and follow-up.
  • Provide timely, accurate, and proactive status updates on deliverables, support activity, risks, dependencies, delays, and completion so clients do not need to repeatedly request updates.
  • Coordinate client needs across Consulting, Product, Data, Clinical, Analytics, Finance, Contracting, and other PSG teams; confirm ownership, next steps, due dates, and closure of commitments.
  • Maintain accurate and current Salesforce account and project records, including contacts, milestones, client health, risks, commitments, utilization, contract details, and renewal status.
  • Monitor project plans, service-level agreements, performance guarantees, contractual deliverables, platform access, user counts, membership thresholds, and other account obligations; escalate risks promptly.
  • Steward client hours and utilization by confirming appropriate Harvest project setup, reviewing billable status and hours against contractual allocations, and addressing potential overages, underutilization, or misalignment.
  • Support invoice accuracy by validating account-level information, active statements of work and orders, applicable rates, membership or user counts, and alignment among services delivered, contract terms, Salesforce, Harvest, and Finance processes.
  • Coordinate renewal planning and execution, including timelines, internal alignment, client communication, signatures, approvals, purchase-order needs, effective dates, execution risks, and post-execution operational updates.
  • Maintain sufficient awareness of implementations, configurations, data processing, technical issues, product enhancements, support tickets, and data investigations to communicate client impact and coordinate next steps.
  • Review platform utilization and client needs to expand adoption and value through tailored training, enablement, best-practice sharing, product education, and appropriate service recommendations.
  • Identify client satisfaction, retention, growth, and relationship risks; communicate material feedback to leadership and coordinate corrective actions with the appropriate owners.
  • Support business reviews, sales and best-and-final activities, scope development, and client presentations as appropriate while presenting a consistent PSG position.
  • Travel to client sites as needed and perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, healthcare, analytics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Three or more years of experience in PBM, health plan, healthcare consulting, client management, customer success, or business-to-business technology services.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships, competing priorities, action items, risks, and deliverables with strong attention to follow-through.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, meeting facilitation, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to interpret contracts, reports, utilization measures, service metrics, financial information, and client trends and translate them into clear actions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and client or project management systems; experience with Salesforce, Harvest, ticketing systems, or similar platforms is preferred.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across consulting, clinical, product, data, analytics, finance, contracting, and technical teams without direct authority over each workstream.
  • Working knowledge of pharmacy benefits, healthcare data and analytics, or SaaS platform operations is preferred.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% as needed.

Location

This position will be 100% remote, open to all candidates residing in the United States

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $100,000 – $140,000. This range represents the employer’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this role at the time of posting.

Compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, training, certifications, education, internal equity, and market data. This role may also be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.description:
About Rivet

Rivet is an AI-native accounting firm. In less than 3 years, we've built a T500 firm in the US, combining corporate and personal income tax, sales tax, R&D credits, and bookkeeping into a single, all-inclusive experience that eliminates the worst parts of tax season for real businesses and the people who run them.

Our platform is designed to feel invisible: it guides clients through their tax to-dos, automates the drudgery for preparers, and gets out of the way when it's not needed. We measure success in time saved and returns completed, not vanity usage metrics. We run Rivet (the firm) on Rivet (the platform) because owning the stack makes it possible to deeply embed AI into every step of our workflows, far more than our competition will ever be able to relying on third-party/off-the-shelf tooling.

Our team of 75 supports more than 1,300 clients, including some of the most innovative companies in the US — Cursor, Cognition, and ModRetro — and their executives, investors, and employees.

And while we may have just gotten started a little over two years ago, this isn't our first rodeo:

  • Nick Abouzeid (cofounder & CEO) comes from Ramp, where he ran three of their Growth teams from $100M → $600M in ARR

  • Kyle Christenson (cofounder & Head of Tax) comes from the IRS, where he spent six years as an auditor before leaving to start his own firm over a decade ago

We're well-funded, growing quickly, and sustainable. We've raised over $7M to date, from investors like XYZ Ventures, Susa Ventures, Haystack Ventures, and 40+ executives from Ramp, Anduril, Physical Intelligence, & more.

Why this role is different

Tax software fails quietly. A number lands in the wrong box, nobody notices until a notice arrives, and by then it's a client's problem. The backend is where we decide that doesn't happen.

  • Ownership from first commit to production. Engineers design, build, ship, and maintain their work — no handoffs, no middle-management mazes.

  • Decisions happen at the edge. Engineers talk to clients and tax preparers directly. We optimize for speed and context, not committee consensus.

  • Clear is kind. We surface problems early, talk about tradeoffs openly, and don't sugarcoat. We're kind by being honest, not by being vague.

  • Pragmatic stacks. We pick tools that solve real problems. If it doesn't help us ship faster, safer, or better, we don't use it.

  • Skin in the game. We ship things we'd be proud to put our name on — and if something breaks, we own it and fix it fast.

Our stack

Six engineers today, five languages. Our platform and infrastructure are Go end to end:

  • Platform: Go, as a modular monolith — Connect RPC over protobuf, Go Fx for wiring, sqlc and goose against Postgres, River Pro for background jobs, Watermill for pub-sub over RabbitMQ.

  • Frontend: React and TanStack, deployed to Cloudflare Workers.

  • AI and eval: Python, in their own repos — ModelBridge (a gRPC service for AI building blocks) and TaxBench, our internal eval suite.

  • Legacy integration: a C# Windows agent that drives Drake, one of the tax platforms our industry never built APIs for.

  • Infrastructure: AWS — ECS Fargate, Amazon MQ, AMP, Loki, Tempo — provisioned by Pulumi, itself written in Go.

  • Around the edges: Buildkite for CI, OpenTelemetry throughout, Doppler for secrets, Linear for tracking.

What you'll do

  • Own modules in the Go monolith end to end — schema and migrations through Connect RPC surface, including the background jobs and pub-sub flows behind them.

  • Automate systems nobody meant to be automated. Our industry never built APIs. We drive a desktop tax platform through a C# agent, parse filings that arrive as scanned paper, and reconcile ledgers that disagree with each other. This is most of the interesting work.

  • Put AI on the critical path. Wire ModelBridge into real workflows and hold it to TaxBench, our eval suite — we treat eval as an asset, not a side project. A model that's right 95% of the time is a design problem, not a launch.

  • Own what you ship in production. Tracing, alerting, on-call, and the load curve of a firm whose traffic triples in March. April 15th doesn't move.

  • Work directly with preparers. The people who'll catch your bug are on Slack, and they'll tell you exactly what happened.

We're fully distributed — but if you want an office, we'll help you find one through our investor network.

What makes you a fit

  • 4+ years building backend systems, including 2+ years writing Go in production

  • Real Postgres depth — schema design, migrations against live data, and knowing why a query got slow

  • Have built and operated asynchronous systems: background jobs, queues, retries, and the failure modes that come with them

  • Bias toward correctness in a domain where a wrong number has consequences, and the judgment to know when it doesn't

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, early-stage environment

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Nice to haves

  • Connect RPC, gRPC, or protobuf-first API design

  • Event-driven architectures on RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar

  • Infrastructure as code — Pulumi, Terraform, or CDK — and comfort owning your own deploys

  • Shipped LLM systems into production paths and evaluated them properly, not as prototypes

  • Built tax-adjacent software — fund administration, payroll, accounting platforms, filing systems

  • Enjoy getting creative with APIs and systems that were never meant to be automated

What we offer

  • Benefits and meaningful equity

  • A fully remote team, plus twice-yearly company offsites

  • A well-funded, fast-moving environment with minimal layers of management

  • A world-class client base that values your time and pays for the premium experience

  • Problems that are unusual — nobody else is writing daemons against 1990s tax software to feed a modern agent stack

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box.

embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.


Following our acquisition by Salesforce, we continue to operate with the pace and ownership of a startup, backed by the distribution, resources, and long-term runway of a global enterprise. Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback.


You'll work alongside a high-talent-density team that cares deeply about craft, performance, reliability, and user experience, and that raises the bar through collaboration, code review, and strong engineering principles. You'll make architecture decisions, solve meaningful system design challenges, and see your work land quickly with customers, without layers of approvals slowing you down.


The Role


As an Engineer on the AI Core team, you'll operate as a technical leader who turns ambiguous, high-stakes AI problems into durable, high-quality systems, while raising the technical bar for the broader team. AI Core builds the retrieval systems and agent infrastructure that power how our AI agents find, trust, and use knowledge, and the developer tooling that lets engineers across the company ship production agents quickly and safely.


You'll lead significant initiatives end to end: faithful answering over a customer's own knowledge, retrieval that combines RAG and hybrid search, content lifecycle controls such as freshness, deduplication and source precedence, transcript processing, and the frameworks, registries, and evaluation tooling that make building a production agent a paved path. You'll partner closely with product, design, and engineering leadership to decide what we build, how we build it, and how we measure whether answers actually got better.


What You'll Do


Lead retrieval initiatives end to end: Design, build, and operate retrieval systems using RAG and hybrid search (lexical plus vector, reranking, filtering) so agents answer from the right content with the right amount of context. Own delivery from scope and design through launch, monitoring, and iteration.


Build developer tooling for production agents: Drive technical design for the frameworks and platform pieces our engineers use to build agents, including multi-agent orchestration, shared primitives for prompts, tools, tracing, and evaluation.


Own answer quality: Diagnose why answers are thin, wrong, or inconsistent by separating retrieval problems from generation problems (prompt, token budget, model choice). Set a quality bar we can test against, and lead the

work to reach it.


Design content and data models: Define how content from documents,

knowledge bases, and call transcripts is ingested, segmented, labeled, and retrieved, including the primitives behind freshness, dedupe, source

precedence, and internal versus external visibility.


Make AI changes safe to ship: Build evaluation, observability, and rollout

practices (offline evals, online monitoring, regression detection) so we can change prompts, models, and retrieval with confidence. Evaluate multiple

solution paths and know when to trust, redirect, or override model and agent output.


Set performance and scaling benchmarks across the platform we own:


Define and track targets for retrieval and indexing, LLM provider usage, and agent orchestration.


Own operational health: Ensure the reliability and performance of the systems your team owns. Participate in on-call, lead incident resolution for your area, and communicate clearly with the team and stakeholders during incidents.


Use agentic development to raise leverage: Use coding agents by default for implementation, testing, refactoring, and documentation while holding a high validation bar. Create reusable workflows, patterns, and tooling that raise the effectiveness of your team beyond your own output.


Partner across functions: Work with product, design, and engineering

leadership to shape roadmap, tradeoffs, and requirements, and to translate strategy into concrete execution plans.


Raise team effectiveness: Mentor engineers, give high-quality code review and technical guidance, and improve standards, tooling, and processes.


Who You Are


Proven experience shipping production AI or backend systems in a high ownership environment, with a recent focus on LLM-powered applications.


Expertise building retrieval systems using RAG and hybrid search, including chunking and indexing strategy, embeddings, vector and lexical search,

reranking, and measuring retrieval quality.


Expertise building developer tooling that lets developers build production agents, which can include frameworks for multi-agent orchestration, an agent and tool registry, and shared infrastructure for tracing and evaluation.

Experience owning platform initiatives from design through adoption,

across systems such as retrieval and indexing, LLM provider integrations, and agent orchestration, including driving adoption and evolving the platform as usage grows.


Demonstrated technical leadership: you lead significant projects, design solutions for non-trivial problems by weighing tradeoffs, and influence architecture and execution beyond your immediate workstream.


Strong track record delivering complex projects with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, or phases.


Strong backend engineering fundamentals and proficiency in languages such as Ruby on Rails, Python, JavaScript, or Go, with SQL and RDBMS experience (PostgreSQL preferred).


Hands-on experience with the AI application lifecycle: experiment setup, dataset curation, offline evaluation, error analysis, deployment, and online evaluation.


Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity: you can frame problems, propose solutions, and align others.


Strong communicator across functions, able to explain technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences and to translate complex concepts into business impact.


Ownership mindset and bias for action. You raise the bar for the team through mentoring, code review, and your own work.


Curious and continuously learning, with an agent-forward approach to how you build software.


Nice to Have


Experience with pgvector or other vector indexes, and with query performance at scale.


Experience with content ingestion from third-party systems (document stores, knowledge bases, CRM knowledge objects) and the lifecycle problems that follow: sync state, dedupe, source conflict.


Experience processing conversation or call transcripts, including handling PII and consent constraints.


Experience designing evaluation suites that score qualities such as thoroughness and faithfulness, not only correctness.


Experience with voice or real-time conversational agents.


Experience with enterprise SaaS (especially B2B marketing or sales tech) or Salesforce/CRM integrations.


Startup experience and rapid shipping.


Why Join Qualified


Foundational impact: Shape how our AI agents retrieve, reason, and answer, and the tooling every engineer here uses to build them.


Lead real initiatives: Own significant projects end to end, with scope and

influence that grow as you deliver. You'll own the platform as it scales, from retrieval to model providers to agent orchestration, and set the performance and reliability bar that grows with the company.


AI as a core product surface: Turn new AI capabilities into dependable

experiences that customers trust, with strong engineering around evaluation, observability, and iteration.


High bar, low bureaucracy: Work with a team that values craft and decisive execution, where strong ideas win and shipping is the default.


Room to grow: Take on larger technical and product scope over time: leading projects, influencing architecture, and leveling up quickly.


If you're excited to build retrieval systems and agent infrastructure at the intersection of AI and enterprise software, we'd love to hear from you.


Unleash Your Potential

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Company Overview

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and deliver production AI/ML systems. This role is ideal for an engineer with several years of experience who can confidently own features end-to-end, contribute to architectural decisions, and bring strong technical judgment to the problems they take on.

In this role, you will work as a key contributor on a cross-functional team, designing and implementing models, building the data pipelines and training workflows around them, and deploying systems to production environments. You’ll be joining real, in-flight work where reliability, performance, and scalability matter. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers to enhance existing systems, deliver new capabilities, and contribute to the technical decisions that shape how our AI work scales over time.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Design, implement, and deploy ML/AI models end-to-end, from concept through production, including data pipelines, training workflows, and optimization for performance, accuracy, and efficiency
  • Maintain and evolve AI systems in production, monitoring for drift, debugging issues, and driving ongoing improvements to reliability and scalability
  • Bring an AI-forward coding mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude and Cursor to ship higher-quality work at pace

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and data teams to align AI work with broader product and business goals
  • Translate technical tradeoffs, model behavior, and constraints into terms non-specialists can act on
  • Participate actively in code reviews and design discussions, raising concerns and offering constructive feedback

Leadership & Influence

  • Contribute to AI architecture decisions with thoughtful perspective on tradeoffs and long-term implications
  • Take ownership of meaningful work end-to-end, including the unglamorous parts of getting AI into production
  • Raise the bar on engineering practices through your own work and by supporting more junior engineers when opportunities arise

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years professional software engineering experience, with 2+ years focused on AI/ML systems in production and hands-on experience with generative AI development
  • Strong software engineering background (Python or similar)
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms, preferably with in-depth understanding of AWS services and AWS GenAI offerings
  • Proven ability to design and ship agentic systems
  • Experience with AI frameworks and orchestration tools
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks, and observability tools for LLM apps
  • Understanding of AI safety, responsible AI principles, prompt injection defenses, and PII handling
  • Hands-on experience building RAG pipelines: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector databases
  • API development experience, including designing and integrating with internal and third-party services
  • Cost optimization expertise: token economics, caching strategies, model routing, quantization
  • Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for containerized deployments
  • Demonstrable, day-to-day usage and knowledge of AI-forward coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous technical challenges with sound judgment

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

Why Join Robots & Pencils?

At Robots & Pencils, we build intelligent systems for real-world environments, blending creativity, engineering excellence, and applied AI to help organizations work smarter. Our teams partner directly with leading North American organizations to design and deliver production-ready digital and AI solutions that create measurable impact.

As an AI Engineer, you will build production AI systems alongside experienced architects and senior engineers, strengthening your foundation in machine learning, scalable system design, and modern cloud-native delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with US-based clients, gaining hands-on exposure to complex problem-solving while contributing to meaningful, real-world outcomes.

By joining Robots & Pencils, you also benefit from our Advanced AWS Partnership and participation in the highly exclusive AWS Patterns Partnership, a distinction held by only 11 companies worldwide out of more than 190,000 AWS partners. This provides access to specialized training, early access to emerging cloud capabilities, and advanced engineering resources that support accelerated professional growth.

This is a role for builders who want to sharpen their craft, grow quickly, and deliver impactful AI systems within an elite global engineering ecosystem.

jobs.description:
Sapiens has something truly unique. Over 40 years, we’ve built deep insurance expertise that no-one else can replicate. Combined with the power of SapiensAIP that knowledge gives us an extraordinary opportunity to transform how insurance works, and to help build the autonomous insurer of tomorrow.
This is where Advance the Possible comes in. It isn’t a programme or a new strategy. It’s our DNA. It’s about how we think, work and challenge ourselves every day. It means moving with greater urgency, questioning old ways of working and creating better outcomes for our customers. Go to to find out more.

Come and join us now!

PURPOSE
Find the problem worth solving, turn it into a live buildable backlog, redesign the process around AI and make sure the value lands.

Job Responsibilities

  • Run continuous direct discovery with process owners and front-line users; discovery is delivery work.
  • Identify the real broken process and express the value hypothesis in terms a P&L owner recognises.
  • Convert discovery into a live, prioritised backlog the AI-FDE can build against immediately.
  • Own process redesign and adoption: the change counts only when customer people use the new process.
  • Hold scope to the measurable business outcome through MVE build, validation and production.
  • Present results and next priorities from front line to executive sponsor; feed patterns to the catalogue and R&D.
  • Partners one-to-one with the AI-FDE. Not the BVDE (account-level value) or PDE (programme and commercial). Customer process owners co-own adoption.

How success is judged:
  • Quality and value of the backlog, not volume of requirements.
  • Measured production outcome and customer adoption.
  • Speed from idea to buildable use case; value delivered per account and expansion.

Job Requirements

• 8+ years in P&C or L&A insurance operations or consulting; process redesign and business cases.
• Domain-expert-challenger; executive presence with COOs and CUOs and with front-line users.
• Working data fluency (SQL, Python or advanced Excel); low ego, high tolerance for ambiguity.
• A record of process redesign that delivered a measurable result: cost, speed, loss ratio or customer experience.
• Curiosity about AI: you have led automation or AI work, or you are ready to learn fast inside a pod.
• Experience of core insurance systems or Sapiens implementations would desired but not essential


Job Benefits

  • A role at the start of a new model in the industry, with room to grow into pod and regional leadership.

jobs.excerpt: AboutThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role

Build and improve ML systems that power our AI-native applications.

Work on classification, retrieval, ranking, personalization and evaluation, taking ownership from model development to production deployment.

This role is for engineers who enjoy solving practical ML problems, improving model quality and shipping reliable systems used by real users.

Focus

  • Build and improve ML models for classification, ranking, retrieval and personalization.

  • Develop efficient classifiers and optimize model accuracy, precision, latency and cost.

  • Improve search relevance and context retrieval using embeddings, hybrid search and reranking.

  • Build personalization models that learn from user behavior while respecting privacy.

  • Develop evaluation pipelines, labeled datasets and metrics to measure model quality.

  • Fine-tune and adapt existing models when supported by sufficient data.

  • Build and maintain ML training, inference and deployment pipelines.

  • Debug production issues, monitor model performance and ship improvements based on real-world feedback.

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • Embeddings, vector search and ranking models

  • Production ML systems and inference pipelines

Ideal Experience

  • Strong foundations in machine learning and modern neural architectures.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production.

  • Experience in classification, ranking, retrieval, recommendation systems or personalization.

  • Understanding of model evaluation, experimentation and performance metrics.

  • Comfortable writing production-quality code and working with real-world datasets.

  • Able to balance model quality, latency, cost and reliability.

  • Strong ownership, problem-solving skills

Outcomes

  • ML models in production meet expected accuracy, relevance, latency and reliability targets.

  • Classification and ranking improvements deliver measurable gains in model quality.

  • Evaluation pipelines identify regressions and support reliable model releases.

  • Training, inference and data pipelines are robust, reproducible and maintainable.

  • Model improvements are driven by real-world feedback and measurable results.

  • Collaborates effectively with engineering and product teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, world-class teams. We are a high-talent-density, hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move quickly, balancing high-quality work with continuous learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put a truly magical product into the hands of our users.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted virtually and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us.

jobs.excerpt: Our client is an AI-native product company built to replace how billions of people manage their digital lives — starting with email, notes, and task tools that were never designed to be AI-native.
jobs.description:
Our client is an AI-native product company built to replace how billions of people manage their digital lives — starting with email, notes, and task tools that were never designed to be AI-native. It's backed by multi-million-dollar investment and built remote-first from day one, with a clear target: cut the time it takes users to get everyday things done by roughly 90%. That means solving the problems most AI products avoid — long-running workflows, persistent context, and reliable behavior under real-world, non-deterministic conditions. The team is small and high-talent-density by design, not by necessity, and moves at a pace that matches the scale of what it's building.

About the Role

You'll own the research and intelligence direction of this system — defining how the AI reasons, evaluates, and improves in a product used with high frequency.

What You'll Do

  • Set and evolve the research direction for the company's core intelligence, including context representation, memory, reasoning, planning, and orchestration

  • Decide when to design new model architectures versus adapting or leveraging frontier open-source or commercial models

  • Define evaluation frameworks that measure real-world usefulness, robustness, safety, and long-term behavior — not benchmark vanity

  • Own alignment, safety, and guardrail strategy as first-class product concerns

  • Guide exploration of frontier techniques: retrieval-augmented training, mixture-of-experts, distillation, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal systems

  • Shape early product intelligence direction in close partnership with product and application engineering

  • Set the technical bar for research rigor, judgment, and taste across the organization

Requirements

  • Deep experience building or evolving real machine learning systems used in production

  • Strong technical judgment around model behavior, failure modes, and long-horizon trade-offs

  • A builder's mindset — you care about systems that work in the real world, not just ideas

  • Comfortable making irreversible or high-impact decisions with incomplete information

  • An obsession with evaluation, correctness, and how systems behave over time

  • High ownership mentality — you operate as a founder, not a manager

This probably isn't a fit if your focus is primarily publishing, incremental benchmarks, or managing a large research organization — this role is not that.

Tech Stack

Python · PyTorch / JAX · GPU-based training and inference systems

What to Expect

The best products in the world are built by small, world-class teams. Decisions are made collectively, at rapid speed — balancing high-quality shipping with fast learning. You'll be expected to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently.

Compensation and benefits are competitive and vary by location; the package includes base salary and equity, discussed openly with you as part of the process.

If there's a fit, expect 3–4 interviews total, followed by a prompt, transparent decision.

jobs.description:
Staff Data Platform Engineer

Location: NYC HQ or Remote (U.S.)| Full-time | Engineering

Who we are.

Reality Defender is an award-winning cybersecurity company helping enterprises and governments detect deepfakes and AI-generated media. Utilizing a patented multi-model approach, Reality Defender is robust against the bleeding edge of generative platforms producing video, audio, imagery, and text media. Reality Defender's API-first deepfake detection platform empowers teams and developers alike to identify fraud, disinformation campaigns, and harmful deepfakes in real time.

Backed by world class investors including DCVC, Illuminate Financial, Y Combinator, Booz Allen Hamilton, IBM, Accenture, Rackhouse, and Argon VC, Reality Defender works with leading enterprise clients, financial institutions, and governments in order to ensure AI-generated media is not used for malicious purposes.

Youtube: Reality Defender Wins RSA Most Innovative Startup

The Staff Data Platform Engineer Role.

Reality Defender's detection models are only as strong as the data behind them, and every new generative tool raises the bar on the volume and variety of media we need to train and evaluate against. The Staff Data Platform Engineer will own the shared AI data platform behind our vision, audio, and multimodal research, turning acquired and internally generated image, video, audio, and text data into reliable, reproducible datasets, from continuous ingestion through processing, governance, and export. This is a senior, hands-on role where you'll complete our Databricks and distributed processing platform and build the reusable infrastructure behind our in-house synthetic data generation, including producing the very deepfakes our models learn to catch. This is a full-time role, reporting to our Director of Data. Responsibilities include:

  • Own the end-to-end data platform for AI research: continuous ingestion, preprocessing, governance, and export of image, video, audio, and text data at high volume.

  • Complete and scale our Databricks lakehouse and distributed processing stack (Spark, Ray, or similar), making architecture and build-vs-buy decisions that hold up as data volume grows.

  • Build reusable infrastructure for in-house synthetic data generation, so researchers can produce new deepfake variants across modalities on demand instead of one-off.

  • Make every dataset reproducible and traceable through versioning, lineage, metadata, quality checks, and stable train/eval splits, so any model result can be tied back to the exact data behind it.

  • Own pipeline reliability, observability, and processing cost per dataset as core metrics of the platform.

  • Partner with ML researchers to understand their data needs and turn them into self-serve tools that speed up model iteration.

  • Mentor engineers and raise the bar on data engineering practices: code review, testing, documentation, and runbooks.

  • Work with Security and compliance stakeholders to make sure data handling, licensing, and access controls meet the standards our enterprise and government clients expect.

  • Help shape the long-term data platform roadmap with engineering and research leadership.

Who you are.

  • 8+ years building data platforms or data infrastructure, including staff- or lead-level ownership of production pipelines that generate, ingest, or deliver data at high volume.

  • Deep hands-on experience with distributed processing (Spark, Ray, or similar) and lakehouse platforms, ideally Databricks, on top of cloud object storage (S3, GCS, or Azure Blob).

  • Production experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, and Spark on AWS, including performance tuning, access controls, and operational troubleshooting.

  • Experience working with large unstructured media such as video, audio, or images, including the realities of large files, decoding and transcoding, and metadata at scale.

  • A track record of building reproducible ML datasets: versioning, lineage, data quality validation, and orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Databricks Workflows, or similar).

  • Strong Python and SQL, and the judgment to own ambiguous platform problems end-to-end on a lean team.

  • Own infrastructure and deployment automation using Terraform and CI/CD, including AWS storage, IAM, compute, Databricks resources, and distributed processing environments.

  • Experience building synthetic data generation pipelines or running generative models (diffusion, voice cloning/TTS, video generation) at scale. (nice to have)

  • Background supporting ML research teams with training and evaluation data, especially for multimodal models. (nice to have)

  • Experience in security, fraud, trust & safety, or another adversarial domain, or at a Series A or B startup where scope regularly outpaces headcount. (nice to have)

Within 12 months, you'll…

  • Own a mature, self-serve data platform that researchers use to create, version, and export datasets without waiting on platform support.

  • Have scaled synthetic data generation across vision, audio, and multimodal research, broadening our detection coverage of new generative techniques.

  • Deliver reproducible evaluation datasets that let the company compare model versions with confidence.

  • Be setting the multi-year data platform roadmap and leading high-leverage initiatives beyond the original scope.

What we offer.

Reality Defender offers the following benefits to all our employees, regardless of location:

  • Healthcare plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and partial coverage available for dependents

  • Dental and Vision plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and their dependents

  • Short/Long-term disability and life insurance plans with 100% premium coverage for employees

  • FSA/HSA and 401k programs

  • Equity compensation

  • 20 days of PTO per year

  • 12 weeks of Parental Leave

  • Learning and Development budget

  • Monthly wellness benefits

  • Annual company-sponsored offsite

For employees working from Reality Defender's HQ in NYC, we offer the following benefits:

  • Daily in-office lunch through UberEats

  • Commuter benefits

  • Remote Fridays

  • Happy Hours and other local events

Base salary range: 210,000 - 260,000, based on experience, level, and location. Role includes equity.

We are venture-backed, and our team has a rare blend of deep experience across cybersecurity, AI/ML, and SaaS product development. Join us if you want to be on the ground floor of using Gen AI to transform cyber defense. Learn more at.

About the role

The Engineering Rapid Development Team owns the design and delivery of core capabilities and improvements that power Dropzone AI’s autonomous investigation platform. This role is pivotal in maintaining and expanding our SOC agents and ensuring the platform is ready to face a wide array of customer environments in an evolving security landscape.

What you'll do

  • Lead the design and development of platform capabilities and code fixes that enable our AI agents to autonomously investigate and respond to security alerts
  • Evolve the investigation logic and pipelines to handle new classes of security alerts, balancing accuracy, performance, and maintainability
  • Review and analyze investigations performed by our AI to identify strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities for improvement, and then translate those insights into product enhancements
  • Partner with GTM and customer success teams to provide input on technical direction, prioritize features, and ensure we’re solving the most impactful problems for defenders

  • Build into and improve the product by writing investigation flows, building integrations with security tools, and fixing bugs
  • Collaborate with customer facing teams,to provide fixes for customer pain points, or security tooling limitations

Requirements

  • Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining security-focused software products or large-scale security tooling
  • Strong development skills in Python, with the ability to produce clean, maintainable, production-grade code
  • Proficiency with AI coding tools, and agentic workflows
  • Familiarity working with clients to deliver fixes that balance long term product goals and maintainability
  • Expertise integrating with and building on top of security platforms (e.g. SIEMs, SOAR, EDR, cloud security services)
  • Solid understanding of modern security operations practices, detection engineering, and common attack techniques and vulnerabilities
